source: Existing project English translations before catalogue pruning
note: Match literal Chinese explanations before attaching English; same headword alone is insufficient.

一.e: 惟初太始，道立於一，造分天地，化成萬物。凡一之屬皆从一。
一.eEn: At the very beginning, in the primordial inception, the Way was established in One; it brought forth and divided Heaven and Earth, and transformed and completed the myriad things. All characters in the 一 class are formed with 一.

示.e: 天垂象，見吉凶，所以示人也。从二。(二，古文上字。)三垂，日月星也。觀乎天文，以察時變。示，神事也。凡示之屬皆从示。
示.eEn: Heaven hangs down signs that reveal good and ill fortune, thereby showing them to people. Formed from 二. (二 is the ancient form of 上, 'above.') The three hanging strokes represent the sun, moon, and stars. By observing Heaven's patterns, one discerns changes in the seasons. 示 concerns affairs of the spirits. All characters in the 示 class are formed with 示.

瑛.eEn: The radiance of jade. Formed from 玉, with 英 indicating the pronunciation.

趖.eEn: The sense of running. Formed from 走, with 坐 indicating the pronunciation.

璑.eEn: Jade of three colors. Formed from 玉, with 無 indicating the pronunciation.

赹.e: 獨行也。从走勻聲。讀若煢。
赹.eEn: To walk alone. Formed from 走, with 勻 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 煢.

起.eEn: To be able to stand. Formed from 走, with 巳 indicating the pronunciation.

趛.eEn: To walk quickly with one's head lowered. Formed from 走, with 金 indicating the pronunciation.

珛.e: 朽玉也。从玉有聲。讀若畜牧之畜。
珛.eEn: Decayed jade. Formed from 玉, with 有 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 畜 in 畜牧, 'to raise livestock.'

趌.eEn: 趌𧼨 means to run in anger. Formed from 走, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation.

赽.eEn: To kick. Formed from 走, with an abbreviated form of 決 indicating the pronunciation.

趩.e: 行聲也。一曰不行皃。从走異聲。讀若敕。
趩.eEn: The sound of walking. Another explanation is the appearance of not moving. Formed from 走, with 異 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 敕.

趆.eEn: To hurry along. Formed from 走, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation.

趍.eEn: 趨趙 means to linger. Formed from 走, with 多 indicating the pronunciation.

趙.eEn: To linger, as in 趨趙. Formed from 走, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation.

璿.e: 美玉也。从玉睿聲。《春秋傳》曰：“璿弁玉纓。”
璿.eEn: Fine jade. Formed from 玉, with 睿 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'A cap adorned with fine jade, with jade pendants on its cords.'

赾.e: 行難也。从走斤聲。讀若堇。
赾.eEn: To walk with difficulty. Formed from 走, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 堇.

趠.eEn: Far or distant. Formed from 走, with 卓 indicating the pronunciation.

球.eEn: The sound of jade. Formed from 玉, with 求 indicating the pronunciation.

趉.e: 走也。从走出聲。讀若無尾之屈。
趉.eEn: To run. Formed from 走, with 出 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 屈 meaning 'without a tail.'

趜.eEn: To be constrained. Formed from 走, with 匊 indicating the pronunciation.

趑.e: 趑趄，行不進也。从走次聲。
趑.eEn: 趑趄 means to walk without making progress. Formed from 走, with 次 indicating the pronunciation.

趄.eEn: To hesitate without advancing, as in 趑趄. Formed from 走, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

趢.eEn: Cramped movement, as in 䟒趢. Formed from 走, with 录 indicating the pronunciation.

琳.eEn: Fine jade. Formed from 玉, with 林 indicating the pronunciation.

趡.e: 動也。从走隹聲。《春秋傳》曰：“盟于趡。”趡，地名。
趡.eEn: To move. Formed from 走, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'They made a covenant at 趡.' 趡 is a place name.

璧.eEn: A round ceremonial jade token. Formed from 玉, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

趧.e: 趧𡝤，四夷之舞，各自有曲。从走是聲。
趧.eEn: 趧𡝤 is a dance of the peoples of the four outer regions, each having its own tune. Formed from 走, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

趒.eEn: The way a sparrow moves. Formed from 走, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation.

赶.eEn: To run with the tail raised. Formed from 走, with 干 indicating the pronunciation.

止.e: 下基也。象艸木出有址，故以止爲足。凡止之屬皆从止。
止.eEn: A foundation beneath. It depicts plants emerging with a base; thus 止 is used to represent a foot. All characters in the 止 class are formed with 止.

歱.eEn: The heel. Formed from 止, with 重 indicating the pronunciation.

歭.eEn: To hesitate, as expressed by 䠧. Formed from 止, with 寺 indicating the pronunciation.

歫.e: 止也。从止巨聲。一曰搶也。一曰超歫。
歫.eEn: To stop. Formed from 止, with 巨 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to thrust against something. Another is to leap over, as in 超歫.

前.e: 不行而進謂之歬。从止在舟上。
前.eEn: To advance without walking is called 歬. Formed from 止 positioned above 舟, 'boat.'

歷.eEn: To pass. Formed from 止, with 厤 indicating the pronunciation.

瑗.e: 大孔璧。人君上除陛以相引。从玉爰聲。《爾雅》曰：“好倍肉謂之瑗，肉倍好謂之璧。”
瑗.eEn: A jade disk with a large central opening, used to help draw a ruler upward when he ascends the steps. Formed from 玉, with 爰 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: 'When the opening is twice the width of the jade surrounding it, it is called 瑗; when the jade surrounding it is twice the width of the opening, it is called 璧.'

歸.eEn: For a woman to marry. Formed from 止 and an abbreviated form of 婦, with 𠂤 indicating the pronunciation.

疌.e: 疾也。从止从又。又，手也。屮聲。
疌.eEn: Swift. Formed from 止 and 又. 又 means 'hand.' 屮 indicates the pronunciation.

歰.eEn: Not smooth or slippery. Formed from four instances of 止.

癶.e: 足剌癶也。从止、𣥂。凡癶之屬皆从癶。讀若撥。
癶.eEn: The feet spread apart. Formed from 止 and 𣥂. All characters in the 癶 class are formed with 癶. Read like 撥.

登.e: 上車也。从癶、豆。象登車形。
登.eEn: To mount a carriage. Formed from 癶 and 豆. It depicts the form of mounting a carriage.

癹.e: 以足蹋夷艸。从癶从殳。《春秋傳》曰：“癹夷蘊崇之。”
癹.eEn: To trample grass flat with the feet. Formed from 癶 and 殳. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'Trample it flat, heap it up, and pile it high.'

環.e: 璧也。肉好若一謂之環。从玉睘聲。
環.eEn: A jade disk. When the width of the jade surrounding the opening and the width of the opening are equal, it is called 環. Formed from 玉, with 睘 indicating the pronunciation.

步.e: 行也。从止𣥂相背。凡步之屬皆从步。
步.eEn: To walk. Formed from 止 and 𣥂 facing away from each other. All characters in the 步 class are formed with 步.

歲.e: 木星也。越歴二十八宿，宣徧陰陽，十二月一次。从步戌聲。律歴書名五星爲五步。
歲.eEn: Jupiter. It passes through the twenty-eight lunar lodges, extending throughout yin and yang, moving one station in twelve months. Formed from 步, with 戌 indicating the pronunciation. The Treatise on Pitch Pipes and the Calendar calls the five planets the 'five paces.'

此.e: 止也。从止从匕。匕，相比次也。凡此之屬皆从此。
此.eEn: To stop. Formed from 止 and 匕. 匕 means to be placed alongside in sequence. All characters in the 此 class are formed with 此.

啙.eEn: Weak or deficient. Explanation missing in the source.

些.e: 語辭也。見《楚辭》。从此从二。其義未詳。
些.eEn: A grammatical particle, found in the Songs of Chu. Formed from 此 and 二. Its meaning is not fully understood.

正.e: 是也。从止，一以止。凡正之屬皆从正。
正.eEn: Correct. Formed from 止, with 一 marking where to stop. All characters in the 正 class are formed with 正.

乏.eEn: The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'Reversing 正 makes 乏.'

是.e: 直也。从日、正。凡是之屬皆从是。
是.eEn: Straight or upright. Formed from 日 and 正. All characters in the 是 class are formed with 是.

韙.e: 是也。从是韋聲。《春秋傳》曰：“犯五不韙。”
韙.eEn: Right or correct. Formed from 是, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'To commit five wrongs.'

璜.eEn: Half a jade disk. Formed from 玉, with 黃 indicating the pronunciation.

尟.e: 是少也。尟俱存也。从是、少。賈侍中說。
尟.eEn: What is present is little. 尟 means that both remain in existence. Formed from 是 and 少. This is the explanation of Palace Attendant Jia.

辵.e: 乍行乍止也。从彳从止。凡辵之屬皆从辵。讀若《春秋公羊傳》曰“辵階而走”。
辵.eEn: To walk and stop by turns. Formed from 彳 and 止. All characters in the 辵 class are formed with 辵. Read like 辵 in the Gongyang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals: 'He 辵 the steps and ran.'

迹.eEn: The place where one has stepped; a footprint. Formed from 辵, with 亦 indicating the pronunciation.

邁.eEn: To travel far. Formed from 辵, with an abbreviated form of 蠆 indicating the pronunciation.

巡.eEn: The appearance of moving along continuously. Formed from 辵, with 川 indicating the pronunciation.

邎.eEn: To travel along a roundabout path. Formed from 辵, with 䌛 indicating the pronunciation.

祜.eEn: A name taboo of the reigning emperor.

琮.e: 瑞玉。大八寸，似車釭。从玉宗聲。
琮.eEn: A ceremonial jade token, eight inches across, resembling the hub fitting of a carriage wheel. Formed from 玉, with 宗 indicating the pronunciation.

隨.eEn: To follow. Formed from 辵, with an abbreviated form of 𡐦 indicating the pronunciation.

迋.e: 往也。从辵王聲。《春秋傳》曰：“子無我迋。”
迋.eEn: To go. Formed from 辵, with 王 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'Do not deceive me.'

逝.eEn: To go. Formed from 辵, with 折 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 誓.

述.eEn: To follow. Formed from 辵, with 术 indicating the pronunciation.

遵.eEn: To follow. Formed from 辵, with 尊 indicating the pronunciation.

適.e: 之也。从辵啻聲。適，宋魯語。
適.eEn: To go to. Formed from 辵, with 啻 indicating the pronunciation. 適 is an expression used in Song and Lu.

過.eEn: To pass across. Formed from 辵, with 咼 indicating the pronunciation.

琥.e: 發兵瑞玉，爲虎文。从玉从虎，虎亦聲。《春秋傳》曰：“賜子家雙琥。”
琥.eEn: A ceremonial jade token used to dispatch troops, bearing a tiger pattern. Formed from 玉 and 虎, with 虎 also indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'He bestowed a pair of tiger-patterned jade tokens on Zijia.'

遦.eEn: To become accustomed to. Formed from 辵, with 貫 indicating the pronunciation.

進.eEn: To ascend. Formed from 辵, with an abbreviated form of 閵 indicating the pronunciation.

造.e: 就也。从辵告聲。譚長說：造，上士也。
造.eEn: To reach or accomplish. Formed from 辵, with 告 indicating the pronunciation. Elder Tan explains: '造 means a senior officer.'

逾.e: 𨒋進也。从辵俞聲。《周書》曰：“無敢昬逾。”
逾.eEn: To advance beyond. Formed from 辵, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: 'Let none dare recklessly transgress.'

遝.eEn: To come together, as expressed by 䢔. Formed from 辵, with 眔 indicating the pronunciation.

迮.eEn: 迮迮 means to rise. Formed from 辵, with an abbreviated form of 作 indicating the pronunciation.

逪.eEn: Crossing tracks, as in 迹逪. Formed from 辵, with 昔 indicating the pronunciation.

遄.e: 往來𢿙也。从辵耑聲。《易》曰：“㠯事遄往。”
遄.eEn: To come and go frequently. Formed from 辵, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: 'When there is business, go swiftly.'

瓏.e: 禱旱玉。龍文。从玉从龍，龍亦聲。
瓏.eEn: Jade used when praying during a drought, bearing a dragon pattern. Formed from 玉 and 龍, with 龍 also indicating the pronunciation.

速.eEn: Swift. Formed from 辵, with 束 indicating the pronunciation.

迅.eEn: Swift. Formed from 辵, with 卂 indicating the pronunciation.

适.eEn: Swift. Formed from 辵, with 𠯑 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 括.

逆.e: 迎也。从辵屰聲。關東曰逆，關西曰迎。
逆.eEn: To go to meet someone. Formed from 辵, with 屰 indicating the pronunciation. East of the passes, this is called 逆; west of the passes, it is called 迎.

迎.eEn: To meet. Formed from 辵, with 卬 indicating the pronunciation.

遇.eEn: To meet. Formed from 辵, with 禺 indicating the pronunciation.

遭.e: 遇也。从辵曹聲。一曰邐行。
遭.eEn: To encounter. Formed from 辵, with 曹 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to travel along a winding course.

遘.eEn: To encounter. Formed from 辵, with 冓 indicating the pronunciation.

逢.eEn: To encounter. Formed from 辵, with an abbreviated form of 峯 indicating the pronunciation.

琬.eEn: A jade tablet with a rounded end. Formed from 玉, with 宛 indicating the pronunciation.

遌.e: 相遇驚也。从辵从㖾，㖾亦聲。
遌.eEn: To be startled on encountering one another. Formed from 辵 and 㖾, with 㖾 also indicating the pronunciation.

迪.eEn: A way or path. Formed from 辵, with 由 indicating the pronunciation.

遞.eEn: To alternate or replace. Formed from 辵, with 虒 indicating the pronunciation.

通.eEn: To reach or pass through. Formed from 辵, with 甬 indicating the pronunciation.

迻.eEn: To move or relocate. Formed from 辵, with 多 indicating the pronunciation.

遷.eEn: To ascend. Formed from 辵, with 𠨧 indicating the pronunciation.

運.eEn: To move or relocate. Formed from 辵, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

遁.e: 遷也。一曰逃也。从辵盾聲。
遁.eEn: To move away. Another explanation is to flee. Formed from 辵, with 盾 indicating the pronunciation.

遜.eEn: To withdraw. Formed from 辵, with 孫 indicating the pronunciation.

璋.e: 剡上爲圭，半圭爲璋。从玉章聲。《禮》：六幣：圭以馬，璋以皮，璧以帛，琮以錦，琥以繡，璜以黼。
璋.eEn: A jade tablet with its upper end sharpened is called 圭; half a 圭 is called 璋. Formed from 玉, with 章 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites lists six ceremonial offerings: 'A 圭 with a horse; a 璋 with hides; a 璧 with silk; a 琮 with brocade; a 琥 with embroidery; and a 璜 with cloth bearing an axe pattern.'

返.e: 還也。从辵从反，反亦聲。《商書》曰：“祖甲返。”
返.eEn: To return. Formed from 辵 and 反, with 反 also indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Shang says: 'Zujia returned.'

還.eEn: To return. Formed from 辵, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation.

選.e: 遣也。从辵、巽，巽遣之；巽亦聲。一曰選，擇也。
選.eEn: To dispatch. Formed from 辵 and 巽: 巽 conveys dispatching; 巽 also indicates the pronunciation. Another explanation: to choose.

送.eEn: To dispatch. Formed from 辵 and an abbreviated form of 㑞.

遣.eEn: To release. Formed from 辵, with 𠳋 indicating the pronunciation.

邐.eEn: To walk in a winding course. Formed from 辵, with 麗 indicating the pronunciation.

逮.eEn: In 唐逮, to reach. Formed from 辵, with 隶 indicating the pronunciation.

遲.e: 徐行也。从辵犀聲。《詩》曰：“行道遲遲。”
遲.eEn: To walk slowly. Formed from 辵, with 犀 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “They travel along the road slowly.”

邌.eEn: Slow. Formed from 辵, with 黎 indicating the pronunciation.

遰.eEn: To depart. Formed from 辵, with 帶 indicating the pronunciation.

琰.e: 璧上起美色也。从玉炎聲。
琰.eEn: Beautiful coloration appearing on a jade disk. Formed from 玉, with 炎 indicating the pronunciation.

逗.eEn: To stop. Formed from 辵, with 豆 indicating the pronunciation.

逶.e: 逶迆，衺去之皃。从辵委聲。
逶.eEn: 逶迆 describes moving away obliquely. Formed from 辵, with 委 indicating the pronunciation.

迆.e: 衺行也。从辵也聲。《夏書》曰：“東迆北，會于匯。”
迆.eEn: To travel obliquely. Formed from 辵, with 也 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Xia says: “Winding eastward and northward, it meets at the gathering waters.”

遹.eEn: To turn aside and avoid. Formed from 辵, with 矞 indicating the pronunciation.

避.eEn: To turn aside. Formed from 辵, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

違.eEn: To separate. Formed from 辵, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

遴.e: 行難也。从辵㷠聲。《易》曰：“以往䢯。”
遴.eEn: To travel with difficulty. Formed from 辵, with 㷠 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “To go onward in this way brings difficulty.”

玠.e: 大圭也。从玉介聲。《周書》曰：“稱奉介圭。”
玠.eEn: A large gui jade tablet. Formed from 玉, with 介 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “He raised and presented the great gui jade tablet.”

逡.eEn: To return. Formed from 辵, with 夋 indicating the pronunciation.

達.e: 行不相遇也。从辵羍聲。《詩》曰：“挑兮達兮。”
達.eEn: To travel without encountering one another. Formed from 辵, with 羍 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Leaping about, roaming about!”

逯.eEn: To walk cautiously. Formed from 辵, with 录 indicating the pronunciation.

迵.eEn: To alternate. Formed from 辵, with 同 indicating the pronunciation.

迭.e: 更迭也。从辵失聲。一曰达。
迭.eEn: To alternate or succeed one another. Formed from 辵, with 失 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to reach.

迷.eEn: To be confused. Formed from 辵, with 米 indicating the pronunciation.

連.eEn: To link together in a circle. Formed from 辵 and 車.

逑.e: 斂聚也。从辵求聲。《虞書》曰：“㫄逑孱功。”又曰：“怨匹曰逑。”
逑.eEn: To gather together. Formed from 辵, with 求 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Yu says: “Seek widely those of modest accomplishment.” It also says: “An adversarial counterpart is called 逑.”

瑒.e: 圭。尺二寸，有瓚，以祠宗廟者也。从玉昜聲。
瑒.eEn: A gui jade tablet, one chi and two cun long, fitted with a libation ladle and used in sacrifices at the ancestral temple. Formed from 玉, with 昜 indicating the pronunciation.

逭.eEn: To escape. Formed from 辵, with 官 indicating the pronunciation.

遯.eEn: To escape. Formed from 辵 and 豚.

逋.eEn: To flee. Formed from 辵, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation.

遺.eEn: To lose. Formed from 辵, with 䝿 indicating the pronunciation.

遂.eEn: To flee. Formed from 辵, with 㒸 indicating the pronunciation.

逃.eEn: To flee. Formed from 辵, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation.

追.eEn: To pursue. Formed from 辵, with 𠂤 indicating the pronunciation.

逐.eEn: To pursue. Formed from 辵 and an abbreviated form of 豚.

逎.eEn: To press upon. Formed from 辵, with 酉 indicating the pronunciation.

近.eEn: To be close to. Formed from 辵, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation.

瓛.eEn: The huan gui jade tablet, held by a duke. Formed from 玉, with 獻 indicating the pronunciation.

邋.eEn: To draw together. Formed from 辵, with 巤 indicating the pronunciation.

迫.eEn: To be near. Formed from 辵, with 白 indicating the pronunciation.

邇.eEn: Near. Formed from 辵, with 爾 indicating the pronunciation.

遏.e: 微止也。从辵曷聲。讀若桑蟲之蝎。
遏.eEn: To check slightly. Formed from 辵, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 蝎, the name of a mulberry-tree insect.

遮.eEn: To check or obstruct. Formed from 辵, with 庶 indicating the pronunciation.

迣.e: 迾也。晉趙曰迣。从辵丗聲。讀若寘。
迣.eEn: To block or intercept. In Jin and Zhao, this is called 迣. Formed from 辵, with 丗 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 寘.

迾.eEn: To block or obstruct. Formed from 辵, with 𠛱 indicating the pronunciation.

迀.eEn: To advance. Formed from 辵, with 干 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 干.

珽.e: 大圭。長三尺，抒上，終葵首。从玉廷聲。
珽.eEn: A large gui jade tablet, three chi long, tapered above and with a mallet-shaped head. Formed from 玉, with 廷 indicating the pronunciation.

遱.eEn: Linked continuously together. Formed from 辵, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation.

逞.e: 通也。从辵呈聲。楚謂疾行爲逞。《春秋傳》曰：“何所不逞欲。”
逞.eEn: To pass through or attain fulfillment. Formed from 辵, with 呈 indicating the pronunciation. In Chu, walking swiftly is called 逞. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Where would he not gratify his desires?”

遼.eEn: Distant. Formed from 辵, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation.

遠.eEn: Distant. Formed from 辵, with 袁 indicating the pronunciation.

逖.eEn: Distant. Formed from 辵, with 狄 indicating the pronunciation.

迥.eEn: Distant. Formed from 辵, with 冋 indicating the pronunciation.

禮.e: 履也。所以事神致福也。从示从豊，豊亦聲。
禮.eEn: To carry out observances. It is the means of serving the spirits and bringing blessings. Formed from 示 and 豊; 豊 also indicates the pronunciation.

瑁.e: 諸侯執圭朝天子，天子執玉以冒之，似犂冠。《周禮》曰：“天子執瑁四寸。”从玉、冒，冒亦聲。
瑁.eEn: When the regional lords hold gui jade tablets in audience with the Son of Heaven, the Son of Heaven holds this jade object to cap them. It resembles a plow cap. The Rites of Zhou says: “The Son of Heaven holds a mao jade cap measuring four cun.” Formed from 玉 and 冒; 冒 also indicates the pronunciation.

逴.e: 遠也。从辵卓聲。一曰蹇也。讀若棹苕之棹。
逴.eEn: Distant. Formed from 辵, with 卓 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: lame. Read like 棹 in 棹苕.

迂.eEn: To avoid. Formed from 辵, with 于 indicating the pronunciation.

邍.e: 高平之野，人所登。从辵、备、录。闕。
邍.eEn: High, level open country that people ascend. Formed from 辵, 备, and 录. Explanation missing in the source.

道.e: 所行道也。从辵从𩠐。一達謂之道。
道.eEn: A road along which one travels. Formed from 辵 and 𩠐. A way leading through in one direction is called 道.

遽.e: 傳也。一曰窘也。从辵豦聲。
遽.eEn: A relay conveyance. Another explanation: hard-pressed. Formed from 辵, with 豦 indicating the pronunciation.

迒.eEn: An animal's tracks. Formed from 辵, with 亢 indicating the pronunciation.

邂.e: 邂逅，不期而遇也。从辵解聲。
邂.eEn: 邂逅 means to meet without a prior arrangement. Formed from 辵, with 解 indicating the pronunciation.

璬.eEn: A jade pendant. Formed from 玉, with 敫 indicating the pronunciation.

逅.eEn: An unplanned encounter, as in 邂逅. Formed from 辵, with 后 indicating the pronunciation.

遑.eEn: Urgent or hurried. Formed from 辵, with 皇 indicating the pronunciation. A variant is formed with 彳.

逼.eEn: To be near. Formed from 辵, with 畐 indicating the pronunciation.

遐.eEn: Distant. Formed from 辵, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation.

迄.eEn: To arrive. Formed from 辵, with 气 indicating the pronunciation.

迸.eEn: To scatter and run. Formed from 辵, with 并 indicating the pronunciation.

透.eEn: To leap; to pass beyond. Formed from 辵, with 秀 indicating the pronunciation.

邏.eEn: To patrol. Formed from 辵, with 羅 indicating the pronunciation.

迢.eEn: Distant. Formed from 辵, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

珩.e: 佩上玉也。所以節行止也。从玉行聲。
珩.eEn: The upper jade piece in a pendant assembly. It serves to regulate walking and stopping. Formed from 玉, with 行 indicating the pronunciation.

逍.e: 逍遥，猶翱翔也。从辵肖聲。
逍.eEn: 逍遥 means to wander freely, much like soaring. Formed from 辵, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation.

遥.e: 逍遥也。又，遠也。从辵䍃聲。
遥.eEn: To wander freely, as in 逍遥. Also, distant. Formed from 辵, with 䍃 indicating the pronunciation.

彳.e: 小步也。象人脛三屬相連也。凡彳之屬皆从彳。
彳.eEn: A small step. It depicts the three connected sections of a person's leg. All characters in the 彳 class are formed with 彳.

德.eEn: To ascend. Formed from 彳, with 㥁 indicating the pronunciation.

徑.eEn: A footpath. Formed from 彳, with 巠 indicating the pronunciation.

復.eEn: To go and come back. Formed from 彳, with 复 indicating the pronunciation.

徎.eEn: To walk directly. Formed from 彳, with 呈 indicating the pronunciation.

往.eEn: To go. Formed from 彳, with 㞷 indicating the pronunciation.

忂.eEn: The manner of walking. Formed from 彳, with 瞿 indicating the pronunciation.

玦.eEn: A jade pendant. Formed from 玉, with 夬 indicating the pronunciation.

彼.eEn: To go forth, with something added. Formed from 彳, with 皮 indicating the pronunciation.

徼.eEn: To follow a course. Formed from 彳, with 敫 indicating the pronunciation.

循.eEn: To proceed in an orderly course. Formed from 彳, with 盾 indicating the pronunciation.

彶.eEn: To walk hurriedly. Formed from 彳, with 及 indicating the pronunciation.

微.e: 隱行也。从彳𢼸聲。《春秋傳》曰：“白公其徒微之。”
微.eEn: To travel secretly. Formed from 彳, with 𢼸 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “As for Duke Bai, his followers concealed him.”

徥.e: 徥徥，行皃。从彳是聲。《爾雅》曰：“徥，則也。”
徥.eEn: 徥徥 describes a manner of walking. Formed from 彳, with 是 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “徥 means a rule or standard.”

徐.eEn: To walk calmly. Formed from 彳, with 余 indicating the pronunciation.

瑞.eEn: To use jade as a token of trust. Formed from 玉 and 耑.

徬.eEn: To walk alongside. Formed from 彳, with 㫄 indicating the pronunciation.

徯.eEn: To wait. Formed from 彳, with 奚 indicating the pronunciation.

待.eEn: To wait. Formed from 彳, with 寺 indicating the pronunciation.

徧.eEn: To extend all around. Formed from 彳, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation.

徦.eEn: To arrive. Formed from 彳, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation.

後.eEn: To be slow or late. Formed from 彳, 幺, and 夊: being small and walking slowly means being behind.

珥.eEn: A jade ear ornament. Formed from 玉 and 耳; 耳 also indicates the pronunciation.

徲.eEn: A long time. Formed from 彳, with 犀 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 遲.

很.e: 不聽从也。一曰行難也。一曰盭也。从彳𥃩聲。
很.eEn: To refuse to obey. Another explanation: to travel with difficulty. Another explanation: perverse or contrary. Formed from 彳, with 𥃩 indicating the pronunciation.

得.eEn: To obtain something while going along. Formed from 彳, with 㝵 indicating the pronunciation.

徛.eEn: To raise the shin to make a crossing. Formed from 彳, with 奇 indicating the pronunciation.

律.eEn: To distribute evenly. Formed from 彳, with 聿 indicating the pronunciation.

御.eEn: To drive horses. Formed from 彳 and 卸.

亍.eEn: To stop one's steps. Formed from a reversed 彳. Read like 畜.

廴.e: 長行也。从彳引之。凡廴之屬皆从廴。
廴.eEn: To walk with long strides. Formed by extending 彳. All characters in the 廴 class are formed with 廴.

瑱.e: 以玉充耳也。从玉眞聲。《詩》曰：“玉之瑱兮。”
瑱.eEn: To fill the ears with jade ornaments. Formed from 玉, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Those jade ear ornaments!”

廷.eEn: The interior of the court. Formed from 廴, with 壬 indicating the pronunciation.

建.eEn: To establish the court's statutes. Formed from 聿 and 廴.

延.eEn: To walk with long strides. Formed from 㢟, with 丿 indicating the pronunciation.

行.e: 人之步趨也。从彳从亍。凡行之屬皆从行。
行.eEn: A person's walking or hurrying. Formed from 彳 and 亍. All characters in the 行 class are formed with 行.

術.eEn: A road within a settlement. Formed from 行, with 术 indicating the pronunciation.

街.eEn: A road open in four directions. Formed from 行, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

衢.eEn: A thoroughfare reaching in four directions is called 衢. Formed from 行, with 瞿 indicating the pronunciation.

琫.e: 佩刀上飾。天子以玉，諸矦以金。从玉奉聲。
琫.eEn: The upper ornament of a worn sword's scabbard. The Son of Heaven uses jade; the feudal lords use gold. Formed from 玉, with 奉 indicating the pronunciation.

衕.eEn: A connecting street. Formed from 行, with 同 indicating the pronunciation.

衙.eEn: The manner of walking. Formed from 行, with 吾 indicating the pronunciation.

衎.eEn: The appearance of walking joyfully. Formed from 行, with 干 indicating the pronunciation.

衞.e: 宿衞也。从韋、帀，从行。行，列衞也。
衞.eEn: To keep guard overnight. Formed from 韋 and 帀, together with 行. 行 signifies guards arranged in ranks.

齒.e: 口齗骨也。象口齒之形，止聲。凡齒之屬皆从齒。
齒.eEn: The bones of the gums in the mouth. It depicts the shape of the mouth and teeth, with 止 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 齒 class are formed with 齒.

齗.eEn: The roots of the teeth. Formed from 齒, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation.

齔.e: 毀齒也。男八月生齒，八歲而齔。女七月生齒，七歲而齔。从齒从七。
齔.eEn: To shed the teeth. Boys grow teeth at eight months and shed them at eight years; girls grow teeth at seven months and shed them at seven years. Formed from 齒 and 七.

珌.e: 佩刀下飾。天子以玉。从玉必聲。
珌.eEn: The lower ornament of a worn sword's scabbard. The Son of Heaven uses jade. Formed from 玉, with 必 indicating the pronunciation.

齜.e: 齒相齗也。一曰開口見齒之皃。从齒，柴省聲。讀若柴。
齜.eEn: For the teeth to press against one another. Another explanation is the appearance of opening the mouth and exposing the teeth. Formed from 齒, with an abbreviated 柴 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 柴.

齘.eEn: For the teeth to grind against one another. Formed from 齒, with 介 indicating the pronunciation.

齞.eEn: The mouth is open and the teeth are visible. Formed from 齒, with 只 indicating the pronunciation.

齺.e: 齒搚也。一曰齰也。一曰馬口中糜也。从齒芻聲。
齺.eEn: For the teeth to draw together. Another explanation is to bite. Another explanation is mash in a horse's mouth. Formed from 齒, with 芻 indicating the pronunciation.

齵.eEn: Teeth that are not straight. Formed from 齒, with 禺 indicating the pronunciation.

齱.eEn: Misaligned teeth. Formed from 齒, with 取 indicating the pronunciation.

璏.eEn: The jade fitting on a sword's suspension loop. Formed from 玉, with 彘 indicating the pronunciation.

齤.e: 缺齒也。一曰曲齒。从齒𢍏聲。讀若權。
齤.eEn: Missing teeth. Another explanation is crooked teeth. Formed from 齒, with 𢍏 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 權.

齳.eEn: To have no teeth. Formed from 齒, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

齾.eEn: Missing teeth. Formed from 齒, with 獻 indicating the pronunciation.

齯.eEn: An old person's teeth. Formed from 齒, with 兒 indicating the pronunciation.

齮.eEn: To bite. Formed from 齒, with 奇 indicating the pronunciation.

齰.eEn: To bite. Formed from 齒, with 㫺 indicating the pronunciation.

禧.eEn: Good fortune in ritual. Formed from 示, with 喜 indicating the pronunciation.

瑵.eEn: A jade claw-shaped fitting on a carriage canopy. Formed from 玉, with 蚤 indicating the pronunciation.

齦.eEn: To bite. Formed from 齒, with 𥃩 indicating the pronunciation.

齩.eEn: To gnaw bones. Formed from 齒, with 交 indicating the pronunciation.

齝.e: 吐而噍也。从齒台聲。《爾雅》曰：“牛曰齝。”
齝.eEn: To bring food back up and chew it. Formed from 齒, with 台 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “In cattle, this is called 齝.”

齕.eEn: To bite. Formed from 齒, with 气 indicating the pronunciation.

瑑.e: 圭璧上起兆瑑也。从玉，篆省聲。《周禮》曰：“瑑圭璧。”
瑑.eEn: Raised patterns carved on gui tablets and bi discs. Formed from 玉, with an abbreviated 篆 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “Carved gui tablets and bi discs.”

齧.eEn: To bite. Formed from 齒, with 㓞 indicating the pronunciation.

齭.e: 齒傷酢也。从齒所聲。讀若楚。
齭.eEn: For the teeth to be hurt by sourness. Formed from 齒, with 所 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 楚.

齨.e: 老人齒如臼也。一曰馬八歲齒臼也。从齒从臼，臼亦聲。
齨.eEn: An old person's teeth, resembling mortars. Another explanation is that a horse's teeth become mortar-shaped at eight years of age. Formed from 齒 and 臼, with 臼 also indicating the pronunciation.

齬.eEn: For the teeth not to meet one another. Formed from 齒, with 吾 indicating the pronunciation.

齛.eEn: Food held in a sheep's mouth. Formed from 齒, with 丗 indicating the pronunciation.

齸.eEn: Food held in the mouths of deer and milu deer. Formed from 齒, with 益 indicating the pronunciation.

珇.eEn: The carved patterns on a jade cong tube. Formed from 玉, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

齡.eEn: Years of age. Formed from 齒, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

牙.e: 牡齒也。象上下相錯之形。凡牙之屬皆从牙。
牙.eEn: The large teeth. A pictograph depicting the upper and lower teeth interlocking. All characters in the 牙 class are formed with 牙.

足.e: 人之足也。在下。从止、口。凡足之屬皆从足。
足.eEn: A person's foot, situated below. Formed from 止 and 口. All characters in the 足 class are formed with 足.

蹏.eEn: A foot. Formed from 足, with 虒 indicating the pronunciation.

跟.eEn: The heel of the foot. Formed from 足, with 𥃩 indicating the pronunciation.

踝.eEn: The ankle of the foot. Formed from 足, with 果 indicating the pronunciation.

跖.eEn: The underside of the foot. Formed from 足, with 石 indicating the pronunciation.

踦.eEn: One foot. Formed from 足, with 奇 indicating the pronunciation.

跪.eEn: To bow in homage. Formed from 足, with 危 indicating the pronunciation.

跽.eEn: To kneel upright. Formed from 足, with 忌 indicating the pronunciation.

踧.e: 行平易也。从足叔聲。《詩》曰：“踧踧周道。”
踧.eEn: Level and easy to travel on. Formed from 足, with 叔 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Level and easy is the road of Zhou.”

躣.eEn: The manner of walking. Formed from 足, with 瞿 indicating the pronunciation.

踖.e: 長脛行也。从足㫺聲。一曰踧踖。
踖.eEn: To walk with long shins. Formed from 足, with 㫺 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to move with cautious steps, as in 踧踖.

踽.e: 䟽行皃。从足禹聲。《詩》曰：“獨行踽踽。”
踽.eEn: The appearance of walking apart from others. Formed from 足, with 禹 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Alone I walk, solitary.”

璪.e: 玉飾。如水藻之文。从玉喿聲。《虞書》曰：“璪火黺米。”
璪.eEn: A jade ornament with patterns resembling aquatic plants. Formed from 玉, with 喿 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Yu says: “Aquatic plants, fire, and grains of rice.”

踰.eEn: To cross over. Formed from 足, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

蹻.e: 舉足行高也。从足喬聲。《詩》曰：“小子蹻蹻。”
蹻.eEn: To lift the feet and walk high. Formed from 足, with 喬 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The young men stride proudly.”

跾.eEn: Swift. Also, long. Formed from 足, with 攸 indicating the pronunciation.

蹌.eEn: To move. Formed from 足, with 倉 indicating the pronunciation.

踊.eEn: To jump. Formed from 足, with 甬 indicating the pronunciation.

躋.e: 登也。从足齊聲。《商書》曰：“予顚躋。”
躋.eEn: To ascend. Formed from 足, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Shang says: “I fall and rise.”

躍.eEn: Swift. Formed from 足, with 翟 indicating the pronunciation.

跧.e: 蹴也。一曰卑也，絭也。从足全聲。
跧.eEn: To kick. Another explanation is to lower oneself and curl up. Formed from 足, with 全 indicating the pronunciation.

蹴.eEn: To tread upon. Formed from 足, with 就 indicating the pronunciation.

瑬.eEn: Hanging jade pendants, ornaments of a ceremonial crown. Formed from 玉, with 流 indicating the pronunciation.

躡.eEn: To tread upon. Formed from 足, with 聶 indicating the pronunciation.

跨.eEn: To cross. Formed from 足, with 夸 indicating the pronunciation.

蹋.eEn: To tread upon. Formed from 足, with 𦐇 indicating the pronunciation.

踄.eEn: To tread upon. Formed from 足, with 步 indicating the pronunciation.

蹈.eEn: To tread upon. Formed from 足, with 舀 indicating the pronunciation.

躔.eEn: To tread upon. Formed from 足, with 廛 indicating the pronunciation.

踐.eEn: To step upon. Formed from 足, with 戔 indicating the pronunciation.

踵.e: 追也。从足重聲。一曰往來皃。
踵.eEn: To pursue. Formed from 足, with 重 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is the appearance of coming and going.

踔.eEn: To guard, as expressed by 踶. Formed from 足, with 㔬 indicating the pronunciation.

蹛.eEn: To guard, as expressed by 踶. Formed from 足, with 帶 indicating the pronunciation.

璹.eEn: A jade vessel. Formed from 玉, with 𠷎 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 淑.

蹩.e: 踶也。从足敝聲。一曰跛也。
蹩.eEn: To guard, as expressed by 踶. Formed from 足, with 敝 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to limp.

踶.eEn: To guard, as expressed by 躛. Formed from 足, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

躛.eEn: To guard. Formed from 足, with 衞 indicating the pronunciation.

蹢.e: 住足也。从足，適省聲。或曰蹢躅。賈侍中說：足垢也。
蹢.eEn: To halt one's feet. Formed from 足, with an abbreviated 適 indicating the pronunciation. Some explain it as pacing back and forth, as in 蹢躅. Palace Attendant Jia explains it as dirt on the feet.

躅.eEn: To pace back and forth, as in 蹢躅. Formed from 足, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation.

踤.e: 觸也。从足卒聲。一曰駭也。一曰蒼踤。
踤.eEn: To strike against. Formed from 足, with 卒 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to start in fright. Another explanation is to move hurriedly, as in 蒼踤.

蹶.e: 僵也。从足厥聲。一曰跳也。亦讀若橜。
蹶.eEn: To fall over. Formed from 足, with 厥 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to jump. Also read like 橜.

跳.e: 蹶也。从足兆聲。一曰躍也。
跳.eEn: To fall over, as expressed by 蹶. Formed from 足, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to leap.

瓃.eEn: A jade vessel. Formed from 玉, with 畾 indicating the pronunciation.

蹠.e: 楚人謂跳躍曰蹠。从足庶聲。
蹠.eEn: The people of Chu call jumping and leaping 蹠. Formed from 足, with 庶 indicating the pronunciation.

趿.e: 進足有所擷取也。从足及聲。《爾雅》曰：“趿謂之擷。”
趿.eEn: To advance the foot to seize something. Formed from 足, with 及 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “趿 is called 擷, ‘to seize.’”

躓.e: 跲也。从足質聲。《詩》曰：“載躓其尾。”
躓.eEn: To stumble. Formed from 足, with 質 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Then it trips over its tail.”

跲.eEn: To stumble. Formed from 足, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

瑳.eEn: The bright white color of jade. Formed from 玉, with 差 indicating the pronunciation.

跇.eEn: To proceed along. Formed from 足, with 丗 indicating the pronunciation.

蹎.eEn: To stumble. Formed from 足, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation.

跋.eEn: To stumble and falter. Formed from 足, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation.

蹐.e: 小步也。从足𦟝聲。《詩》曰：“不敢不蹐。”
蹐.eEn: To take small steps. Formed from 足, with 𦟝 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “I dare not fail to tread with small steps.”

跌.e: 踼也。从足失聲。一曰越也。
跌.eEn: To stumble. Formed from 足, with 失 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to cross over.

踼.e: 跌踼也。从足昜聲。一曰搶也。
踼.eEn: To stumble and fall. Formed from 足, with 昜 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to fall forward.

蹲.eEn: To squat. Formed from 足, with 尊 indicating the pronunciation.

踞.eEn: To squat. Formed from 足, with 居 indicating the pronunciation.

躩.eEn: The manner of moving the feet briskly. Formed from 足, with 矍 indicating the pronunciation.

玼.e: 玉色鮮也。从玉此聲。《詩》曰：“新臺有玼。”
玼.eEn: The vivid color of jade. Formed from 玉, with 此 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The new terrace is brightly adorned.”

踣.e: 僵也。从足咅聲。《春秋傳》曰：“晉人踣之。”
踣.eEn: To fall prostrate. Formed from 足, with 咅 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The men of Jin brought him down.”

跛.e: 行不正也。从足皮聲。一曰足排之。讀若彼。
跛.eEn: To walk unevenly. Formed from 足, with 皮 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to push something aside with the foot. Pronounced like 彼.

蹇.eEn: To limp. Formed from 足, with an abbreviated form of 寒 indicating the pronunciation.

蹁.e: 足不正也。从足扁聲。一曰拖後足馬。讀若苹。或曰徧。
蹁.eEn: The foot being out of alignment. Formed from 足, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a horse that drags a hind foot. Pronounced like 苹; some say like 徧.

踒.eEn: A stumbling or twisting of the foot. Formed from 足, with 委 indicating the pronunciation.

跣.eEn: The feet touching the ground directly; barefoot. Formed from 足, with 先 indicating the pronunciation.

跔.eEn: The feet becoming cramped in cold weather. Formed from 足, with 句 indicating the pronunciation.

距.eEn: A cock’s spur. Formed from 足, with 巨 indicating the pronunciation.

禛.eEn: To receive blessings through sincerity. Formed from 示, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation.

璱.e: 玉英華相帶如瑟弦。从玉瑟聲。《詩》曰：“瑟彼玉瓚。”
璱.eEn: The gleaming patterns of jade running alongside one another like the strings of a se zither. Formed from 玉, with 瑟 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “How gleaming is that jade libation ladle!”

躧.eEn: A dancing shoe. Formed from 足, with 麗 indicating the pronunciation.

跀.eEn: To cut off a foot. Formed from 足, with 月 indicating the pronunciation.

趽.e: 曲脛馬也。从足方聲。讀與彭同。
趽.eEn: A horse with bent lower legs. Formed from 足, with 方 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 彭.

趹.eEn: The manner of a horse’s movement. Formed from 足, with an abbreviated form of 決 indicating the pronunciation.

趼.eEn: An animal’s foot raised on its tips. Formed from 足, with 幵 indicating the pronunciation.

路.eEn: A road. Formed from 足 and 各.

蹸.eEn: To tread or crush underfoot. Formed from 足, with 㷠 indicating the pronunciation.

跂.eEn: To have extra toes on the foot. Formed from 足, with 支 indicating the pronunciation.

瑮.e: 玉英華羅列秩秩。从玉㮚聲。《逸論語》曰：“玉粲之璱兮。其𤩰猛也。”
瑮.eEn: The gleaming patterns of jade arranged in orderly rows. Formed from 玉, with 㮚 indicating the pronunciation. The Lost Analects says: “How splendidly the jade gleams! How vigorous its ordered brilliance!”

蹮.eEn: In 蹁蹮: to move in a circling manner. Formed from 足, with 䙴 indicating the pronunciation.

蹭.eEn: In 蹭蹬: to lose one’s way. Formed from 足, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

蹬.eEn: To lose one’s way, as in 蹭蹬. Formed from 足, with 登 indicating the pronunciation.

蹉.eEn: In 蹉跎: to miss the proper time. Formed from 足, with 差 indicating the pronunciation.

跎.eEn: To miss the proper time, as in 蹉跎. Formed from 足, with 它 indicating the pronunciation.

蹙.e: 迫也。从足戚聲。臣鉉等案：李善《文選注》通蹴字。
蹙.eEn: To press closely. Formed from 足, with 戚 indicating the pronunciation. Your servants Xu Xuan and others observe: Li Shan’s Commentary on the Selections of Refined Literature treats this as interchangeable with 蹴.

踸.e: 踸踔，行無常皃。从足甚聲。
踸.eEn: In 踸踔: the appearance of walking without a steady gait. Formed from 足, with 甚 indicating the pronunciation.

疋.e: 足也。上象腓腸，下从止。《弟子職》曰：“問疋何止。”古文以爲《詩·大疋》字。亦以爲足字。或曰胥字。一曰疋，記也。凡疋之屬皆从疋。
疋.eEn: A foot. The upper part depicts the calf of the leg; the lower part is formed from 止. Duties of Disciples says: “Ask where the feet are to rest.” In ancient script it serves as the character 雅 in the title Greater Odes of the Book of Odes. It also serves as 足, ‘foot.’ Some say it is the character 胥. Another explanation is: 疋 means to record. All characters in the 疋 class are formed with 疋.

瑩.e: 玉色。从玉，熒省聲。一曰石之次玉者。《逸論語》曰：“如玉之瑩。”
瑩.eEn: The color of jade. Formed from 玉, with an abbreviated form of 熒 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a stone inferior to jade. The Lost Analects says: “Like the luster of jade.”

品.e: 眾庶也。从三口。凡品之屬皆从品。
品.eEn: The multitude. Formed from three instances of 口. All characters in the 品 class are formed with 品.

喦.e: 多言也。从品相連。《春秋傳》曰：“次于喦北。”讀與聶同。
喦.eEn: To speak much. Formed from the connected mouths of 品. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “They encamped north of 喦.” Pronounced the same as 聶.

喿.eEn: Birds calling together in a flock. Formed from 品 above 木.

龠.e: 樂之竹管，三孔，以和眾聲也。从品、侖。侖，理也。凡龠之屬皆从龠。
龠.eEn: A bamboo musical pipe with three holes, used to harmonize the various sounds. Formed from 品 and 侖. 侖 means order. All characters in the 龠 class are formed with 龠.

龢.e: 調也。从龠禾聲。讀與和同。
龢.eEn: To harmonize. Formed from 龠, with 禾 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 和.

龤.e: 樂和龤也。从龠皆聲。《虞書》曰：“八音克龤。”
龤.eEn: Music being in harmony. Formed from 龠, with 皆 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Yu says: “The eight kinds of musical sound can be brought into harmony.”

冊.e: 符命也。諸矦進受於王也。象其札一長一短，中有二編之形。凡冊之屬皆从冊。
冊.eEn: A document conferring a royal mandate, which the feudal lords come forward to receive from the king. It depicts writing slips, some long and some short, with two binding cords across the middle. All characters in the 冊 class are formed with 冊.

嗣.e: 諸侯嗣國也。从冊从口，司聲。
嗣.eEn: For a feudal lord to succeed to a state. Formed from 冊 and 口, with 司 indicating the pronunciation.

璊.e: 玉䞓色也。从玉㒼聲。禾之赤苗謂之虋，言璊，玉色如之。
璊.eEn: Jade of a reddish color. Formed from 玉, with 㒼 indicating the pronunciation. Red grain seedlings are called 虋; 璊 describes jade whose color resembles them.

扁.e: 署也。从戶、冊。戶冊者，署門戶之文也。
扁.eEn: An inscription. Formed from 戶 and 冊. The combination of 戶 and 冊 represents writing inscribed over a doorway.

嚚.eEn: The sound of speech. Formed from 㗊, with 臣 indicating the pronunciation.

囂.e: 聲也。气出頭上。从㗊从頁。頁，首也。
囂.eEn: A sound. Breath emerges above the head. Formed from 㗊 and 頁. 頁 means the head.

嘂.e: 高聲也。一曰大呼也。从㗊丩聲。《春秋公羊傳》曰：“魯昭公叫然而哭。”
嘂.eEn: A loud voice. Another explanation is: to shout loudly. Formed from 㗊, with 丩 indicating the pronunciation. The Gongyang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Duke Zhao of Lu cried out and wept.”

器.e: 皿也。象器之口，犬所以守之。
器.eEn: Vessels. It depicts the openings of vessels, with a dog to guard them.

舌.e: 在口，所以言也、別味也。从干从口，干亦聲。凡舌之屬皆从舌。
舌.eEn: What is inside the mouth and is used to speak and distinguish flavors: the tongue. Formed from 干 and 口, with 干 also indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 舌 class are formed with 舌.

舓.eEn: To take food with the tongue. Formed from 舌, with 易 indicating the pronunciation.

瑕.eEn: A small red mark in jade. Formed from 玉, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation.

干.e: 犯也。从反入，从一。凡干之屬皆从干。
干.eEn: To encroach upon. Formed from a reversed 入 and 一. All characters in the 干 class are formed with 干.

屰.e: 不順也。从干下屮。屰之也。
屰.eEn: To go against; not to comply. Formed from 干 with 屮 below it, turned contrary to its normal orientation.

只.e: 語巳詞也。从口，象气下引之形。凡只之屬皆从只。
只.eEn: A particle marking the end of an utterance. Formed from 口, depicting breath drawn downward. All characters in the 只 class are formed with 只.

矞.e: 以錐有所穿也。从矛从㕯。一曰滿有所出也。
矞.eEn: To pierce something with an awl. Formed from 矛 and 㕯. Another explanation is: something full, with something emerging from it.

商.e: 从外知内也。从㕯，章省聲。
商.eEn: To know what is within from what is outside. Formed from 㕯, with an abbreviated form of 章 indicating the pronunciation.

琢.eEn: To work jade. Formed from 玉, with 豖 indicating the pronunciation.

句.e: 曲也。从口丩聲。凡句之屬皆从句。
句.eEn: Bent. Formed from 口, with 丩 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 句 class are formed with 句.

拘.eEn: To restrain. Formed from 句 and 手, with 句 also indicating the pronunciation.

笱.e: 曲竹捕魚笱也。从竹从句，句亦聲。
笱.eEn: A fish trap made of bent bamboo. Formed from 竹 and 句, with 句 also indicating the pronunciation.

鉤.eEn: Bent; a hook. Formed from 金 and 句, with 句 also indicating the pronunciation.

丩.e: 相糾繚也。一曰瓜瓠結丩起。象形。凡丩之屬皆从丩。
丩.eEn: To intertwine with one another. Another explanation is: the curling growth of melon and gourd plants. A pictograph. All characters in the 丩 class are formed with 丩.

糾.eEn: A rope made by combining three strands. Formed from 糸 and 丩.

古.e: 故也。从十、口。識前言者也。凡古之屬皆从古。
古.eEn: What is old. Formed from 十 and 口, representing knowledge of the words of earlier times. All characters in the 古 class are formed with 古.

嘏.eEn: Great and far-reaching. Formed from 古, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation.

十.e: 數之具也。一爲東西，|爲南北，則四方中央備矣。凡十之屬皆从十。
十.eEn: The completeness of numbers. 一 represents east and west, and the vertical stroke represents south and north; thus the four directions and the center are all present. All characters in the 十 class are formed with 十.

琱.e: 治玉也。一曰石似玉。从玉周聲。
琱.eEn: To work jade. Another explanation is: a stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 周 indicating the pronunciation.

丈.eEn: Ten chi in length. Formed from 又 holding 十.

千.eEn: Ten hundreds. Formed from 十 and 人.

肸.eEn: The spreading of sound. Formed from 十 and 䏌.

卙.e: 卙卙，盛也。从十从甚。汝南名蠶盛曰卙。
卙.eEn: In 卙卙: abundant. Formed from 十 and 甚. In Runan, an abundance of silkworms is called 卙.

博.e: 大通也。从十从尃。尃，布也。
博.eEn: Broadly penetrating or comprehending. Formed from 十 and 尃. 尃 means to spread.

廿.eEn: Twenty combined into one character. An abbreviated ancient-script form.

卅.e: 三十并也。古文省。凡卅之屬皆从卅。
卅.eEn: Thirty combined into one character. An abbreviated ancient-script form. All characters in the 卅 class are formed with 卅.

世.e: 三十年爲一丗。从卅而曳長之。亦取其聲也。
世.eEn: Thirty years make one generation. Formed from 卅 with a stroke drawn out and lengthened. Its pronunciation is also taken from 卅.

理.eEn: To work jade. Formed from 玉, with 里 indicating the pronunciation.

言.e: 直言曰言，論難曰語。从口䇂聲。凡言之屬皆从言。
言.eEn: Direct speech is called 言; discussion and disputation are called 語. Formed from 口, with 䇂 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 言 class are formed with 言.

譻.eEn: A sound. Formed from 言, with 賏 indicating the pronunciation.

謦.e: 欬也。从言殸聲。殸，籒文磬字。
謦.eEn: To cough. Formed from 言, with 殸 indicating the pronunciation. 殸 is the large-seal form of 磬.

語.eEn: To discuss. Formed from 言, with 吾 indicating the pronunciation.

談.eEn: To speak. Formed from 言, with 炎 indicating the pronunciation.

謂.eEn: To reply. Formed from 言, with 胃 indicating the pronunciation.

諒.eEn: Trustworthy. Formed from 言, with 京 indicating the pronunciation.

詵.e: 致言也。从言从先，先亦聲。《詩》曰：“螽斯羽詵詵兮。”
詵.eEn: To convey words. Formed from 言 and 先, with 先 also indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The wings of the locusts—how numerous they are!”

請.eEn: To request an audience. Formed from 言, with 青 indicating the pronunciation.

謁.eEn: To report or make something known. Formed from 言, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation.

珍.eEn: A treasure. Formed from 玉, with 㐱 indicating the pronunciation.

許.eEn: To heed or consent. Formed from 言, with 午 indicating the pronunciation.

諾.eEn: To respond in assent. Formed from 言, with 若 indicating the pronunciation.

讎.eEn: Likewise, to respond. Formed from 言, with 雔 indicating the pronunciation.

諸.eEn: To distinguish or explain. Formed from 言, with 者 indicating the pronunciation.

詩.eEn: An expression of intent. Formed from 言, with 寺 indicating the pronunciation.

讖.eEn: A verification or fulfillment. Formed from 言, with 韱 indicating the pronunciation.

諷.eEn: To recite. Formed from 言, with 風 indicating the pronunciation.

誦.eEn: To recite. Formed from 言, with 甬 indicating the pronunciation.

讀.eEn: To recite a written text. Formed from 言, with 賣 indicating the pronunciation.

玩.eEn: To play with. Formed from 玉, with 元 indicating the pronunciation.

訓.eEn: To explain and teach. Formed from 言, with 川 indicating the pronunciation.

誨.eEn: To enlighten and teach. Formed from 言, with 每 indicating the pronunciation.

譔.eEn: To teach exclusively. Formed from 言, with 巽 indicating the pronunciation.

譬.eEn: To explain so that someone understands. Formed from 言, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

謜.e: 徐語也。从言原聲。《孟子》曰：“故謜謜而來。”
謜.eEn: To speak slowly. Formed from 言, with 原 indicating the pronunciation. The Mengzi says: “Thus they came slowly and gently.”

詇.eEn: To know beforehand. Formed from 言, with 央 indicating the pronunciation.

諭.eEn: To inform. Formed from 言, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

詖.e: 辯論也。古文以爲頗字。从言皮聲。
詖.eEn: To debate. In ancient writing, it was used as the character 頗. Formed from 言, with 皮 indicating the pronunciation.

諄.e: 告曉之孰也。从言𦎫聲。讀若庉。
諄.eEn: To inform and explain thoroughly. Formed from 言, with 𦎫 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 庉.

祿.eEn: Good fortune. Formed from 示, with 彔 indicating the pronunciation.

玲.eEn: The sound of jade. Formed from 玉, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

謘.eEn: Speech that is earnest and thorough. Formed from 言, with 屖 indicating the pronunciation.

詻.e: 論訟也。《傳》曰：“詻詻孔子容。”从言各聲。
詻.eEn: To argue a legal dispute. The Commentary says: “Firm and forthright was Confucius’s demeanor.” Formed from 言, with 各 indicating the pronunciation.

誾.eEn: To remonstrate while speaking harmoniously. Formed from 言, with 門 indicating the pronunciation.

謀.eEn: Considering difficulties is called 謀. Formed from 言, with 某 indicating the pronunciation.

謨.e: 議謀也。从言莫聲。《虞書》曰：“咎繇謨。”
謨.eEn: To deliberate and plan. Formed from 言, with 莫 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Yu says: “Gao Yao counseled.”

訪.eEn: Consulting widely is called 訪. Formed from 言, with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

諏.eEn: To gather together to deliberate. Formed from 言, with 取 indicating the pronunciation.

論.eEn: To discuss. Formed from 言, with 侖 indicating the pronunciation.

議.eEn: To speak. Formed from 言, with 義 indicating the pronunciation.

訂.eEn: To deliberate impartially. Formed from 言, with 丁 indicating the pronunciation.

瑲.e: 玉聲也。从玉倉聲。《詩》曰：“鞗革有瑲。”
瑲.eEn: The sound of jade. Formed from 玉, with 倉 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The bridle leathers ring out.”

詳.eEn: To deliberate carefully. Formed from 言, with 羊 indicating the pronunciation.

諟.eEn: To put in order. Formed from 言, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

諦.eEn: To examine carefully. Formed from 言, with 帝 indicating the pronunciation.

識.e: 常也。一曰知也。从言戠聲。
識.eEn: Constancy. Another explanation is: to know. Formed from 言, with 戠 indicating the pronunciation.

訊.eEn: To ask. Formed from 言, with 卂 indicating the pronunciation.

詧.e: 言微親詧也。从言，察省聲。
詧.eEn: To examine subtle speech closely. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 察 indicating the pronunciation.

謹.eEn: To be cautious. Formed from 言, with 堇 indicating the pronunciation.

諶.e: 誠諦也。从言甚聲。《詩》曰：“天難諶斯。”
諶.eEn: Sincere and true. Formed from 言, with 甚 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Heaven is difficult to trust.”

信.eEn: Sincerity. Formed from 人 and 言. A compound conveying meaning through its combined components.

玎.e: 玉聲也。从玉丁聲。齊太公子伋謚曰玎公。
玎.eEn: The sound of jade. Formed from 玉, with 丁 indicating the pronunciation. Ji, the son of the Grand Duke of Qi, was posthumously titled Duke 玎.

訦.e: 燕、代、東齊謂信訦。从言冘聲。
訦.eEn: In Yan, Dai, and eastern Qi, trustworthiness is called 訦. Formed from 言, with 冘 indicating the pronunciation.

誠.eEn: Trustworthiness. Formed from 言, with 成 indicating the pronunciation.

誡.eEn: To admonish. Formed from 言, with 戒 indicating the pronunciation.

誋.eEn: To admonish. Formed from 言, with 忌 indicating the pronunciation.

諱.eEn: To admonish. Formed from 言, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

誥.eEn: To announce. Formed from 言, with 告 indicating the pronunciation.

詔.eEn: To announce. Formed from 言 and 召, with 召 also indicating the pronunciation.

誓.eEn: To bind by an agreement. Formed from 言, with 折 indicating the pronunciation.

譣.e: 問也。从言僉聲。《周書》曰：“勿以譣人。”
譣.eEn: To question. Formed from 言, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “Do not use this to question others.”

詁.e: 訓故言也。从言古聲。《詩》曰詁訓。
詁.eEn: To explain ancient words. Formed from 言, with 古 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes uses the expression “explanations of ancient words and their meanings.”

琤.eEn: The sound of jade. Formed from 玉, with 爭 indicating the pronunciation.

藹.e: 臣盡力之美。从言葛聲。《詩》曰：“譪譪王多吉士。”
藹.eEn: The excellence of ministers exerting their full strength. Formed from 言, with 葛 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Excellent indeed—the king has many worthy men.”

誎.eEn: To urge haste in feeding and returning. Formed from 言, with 束 indicating the pronunciation.

諝.eEn: Knowledge. Formed from 言, with 胥 indicating the pronunciation.

証.eEn: To remonstrate. Formed from 言, with 正 indicating the pronunciation.

諫.eEn: To offer corrective counsel. Formed from 言, with 柬 indicating the pronunciation.

諗.e: 深諫也。从言念聲。《春秋傳》曰：“辛伯諗周桓公。”
諗.eEn: To remonstrate earnestly. Formed from 言, with 念 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Xin Bo remonstrated with Duke Huan of Zhou.”

課.eEn: To test. Formed from 言, with 果 indicating the pronunciation.

試.e: 用也。从言式聲。《虞書》曰：“明試以功。”
試.eEn: To put to use. Formed from 言, with 式 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Yu says: “Test them clearly through their accomplishments.”

諴.e: 和也。从言咸聲。《周書》曰：“不能諴于小民。”
諴.eEn: To bring into harmony. Formed from 言, with 咸 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “Unable to bring harmony among the common people.”

瑣.eEn: The sound of jade. Formed from 玉, with 𧴪 indicating the pronunciation.

詮.eEn: Complete. Formed from 言, with 全 indicating the pronunciation.

訢.eEn: Joy. Formed from 言, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation.

說.e: 說，釋也。从言、兌。一曰談說。
說.eEn: To release or explain. Formed from 言 and 兌. Another explanation is: to converse and explain.

計.eEn: To reckon; to calculate. Formed from 言 and 十.

諧.eEn: To accord. Formed from 言, with 皆 indicating the pronunciation.

詥.eEn: To harmonize. Formed from 言, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

調.eEn: To harmonize. Formed from 言, with 周 indicating the pronunciation.

話.e: 合會善言也。从言𠯑聲。《傳》曰：“告之話言。”
話.eEn: To bring good words together. Formed from 言, with 𠯑 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary says: “Tell him words of good counsel.”

諈.eEn: 諈諉 means to burden or implicate. Formed from 言, with 𡍮 indicating the pronunciation.

諉.eEn: To burden or implicate. Formed from 言, with 委 indicating the pronunciation.

瑝.eEn: The sound of jade. Formed from 玉, with 皇 indicating the pronunciation.

警.eEn: To warn. Formed from 言 and 敬, with 敬 also indicating the pronunciation.

謐.e: 靜語也。从言𥁑聲。一曰無聲也。
謐.eEn: Quiet speech. Formed from 言, with 𥁑 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: without sound.

謙.eEn: Respectfulness. Formed from 言, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

詡.eEn: To speak grandly. Formed from 言, with 羽 indicating the pronunciation.

諓.e: 善言也。从言戔聲。一曰謔也。
諓.eEn: Good words. Formed from 言, with 戔 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to jest.

誐.e: 嘉善也。从言我聲。《詩》曰：“誐以溢我。”
誐.eEn: To praise what is good. Formed from 言, with 我 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “With praise, he fills me to overflowing.”

詷.e: 共也。一曰譀也。从言同聲。《周書》曰：“在夏后之詷。”
詷.eEn: Together. Another explanation is: to speak boastfully. Formed from 言, with 同 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “In the shared undertaking of the sovereign of Xia.”

設.e: 施陳也。从言从殳。殳，使人也。
設.eEn: To set out and arrange. Formed from 言 and 殳. 殳 signifies directing people.

護.eEn: To rescue and watch over. Formed from 言, with 蒦 indicating the pronunciation.

瑀.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 禹 indicating the pronunciation.

譞.eEn: Intelligent. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 圜 indicating the pronunciation.

誧.e: 大也。一曰人相助也。从言甫聲。讀若逋。
誧.eEn: Great. Another explanation is: people helping one another. Formed from 言, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 逋.

諰.eEn: The sense of thinking. Formed from 言 and 思.

託.eEn: To entrust. Formed from 言, with 乇 indicating the pronunciation.

記.eEn: To record. Formed from 言, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

譽.eEn: Fine or slender, as given by the parenthesized gloss 纤. Formed from 言, with 與 indicating the pronunciation.

譒.e: 𢾭也。从言番聲。《商書》曰：“王譒告之。”
譒.eEn: To spread abroad. Formed from 言, with 番 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Shang says: “The king proclaimed it widely to them.”

謝.eEn: To take leave and depart. Formed from 言, with 䠶 indicating the pronunciation.

謳.eEn: To sing in unison. Formed from 言, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

詠.eEn: To sing. Formed from 言, with 永 indicating the pronunciation.

玤.e: 石之次玉者。以爲系璧。从玉丰聲。讀若《詩》曰“瓜瓞菶菶”。一曰若𧊧蚌。
玤.eEn: A stone inferior to jade, used to make a bi disk for attachment. Formed from 玉, with 丰 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 菶 in the line from the Odes: “The gourds and their young fruits grow luxuriantly.” Another pronunciation is like 蚌 in 𧊧蚌.

諍.eEn: To stop. Formed from 言, with 爭 indicating the pronunciation.

謼.eEn: To call out, as in 𧦝謼. Formed from 言, with 虖 indicating the pronunciation.

訖.eEn: To stop. Formed from 言, with 气 indicating the pronunciation.

諺.eEn: A saying handed down. Formed from 言, with 彥 indicating the pronunciation.

訝.e: 相迎也。从言牙聲。《周禮》曰：“諸侯有卿訝發。”
訝.eEn: To go out to receive someone. Formed from 言, with 牙 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “For the feudal lords, a minister goes out to receive them at their departure.”

詣.eEn: To await arrival. Formed from 言, with 旨 indicating the pronunciation.

講.eEn: To reconcile. Formed from 言, with 冓 indicating the pronunciation.

謄.eEn: To copy a written text. Formed from 言, with 朕 indicating the pronunciation.

訒.e: 頓也。从言刃聲。《論語》曰：“其言也訒。”
訒.eEn: To pause or hesitate. Formed from 言, with 刃 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “He is hesitant in his speech.”

玪.e: 玪𤨙，石之次玉者。从玉今聲。
玪.eEn: 玪𤨙 is a stone inferior to jade. Formed from 玉, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

訥.eEn: To have difficulty speaking. Formed from 言 and 内.

謯.eEn: To follow. Formed from 言, with 虘 indicating the pronunciation.

譥.eEn: To cry out in pain. Formed from 言, with 敫 indicating the pronunciation.

譊.eEn: To cry out in anger. Formed from 言, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

謍.e: 小聲也。从言，熒省聲。《詩》曰：“謍謍青蠅。”
謍.eEn: A soft sound. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 熒 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The blueflies buzz softly.”

諎.e: 大聲也。从言昔聲。讀若笮。
諎.eEn: A loud sound. Formed from 言, with 昔 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 笮.

諛.eEn: To flatter. Formed from 言, with 㬰 indicating the pronunciation.

讇.eEn: To flatter. Formed from 言, with 閻 indicating the pronunciation.

諼.eEn: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 爰 indicating the pronunciation.

謷.e: 不肖人也。从言敖聲。一曰哭不止，悲聲謷謷。
謷.eEn: An unworthy person. Formed from 言, with 敖 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to weep without stopping, making the sorrowful sound 謷謷.

訹.eEn: To entice. Formed from 言, with 术 indicating the pronunciation.

詑.e: 沇州謂欺曰詑。从言它聲。
詑.eEn: In Yanzhou, deception is called 詑. Formed from 言, with 它 indicating the pronunciation.

謾.eEn: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 曼 indicating the pronunciation.

譇.eEn: 譇拏 means to be ashamed and at a loss. Formed from 言, with 奢 indicating the pronunciation.

謺.eEn: Chattering speech, as in 謺讘. Formed from 言, with 執 indicating the pronunciation.

謰.eEn: Rambling speech, as in 謰謱. Formed from 言, with 連 indicating the pronunciation.

謱.eEn: Rambling speech, as in 謰謱. Formed from 言, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation.

詒.e: 相欺詒也。一曰遺也。从言台聲。
詒.eEn: To deceive one another. Another explanation: to give. Formed from 言, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

禠.eEn: Blessing or good fortune. Formed from 示, with 虒 indicating the pronunciation.

琚.e: 瓊琚。从玉居聲。《詩》曰：“報之以瓊琚。”
琚.eEn: A jade ornament, as in 瓊琚. Formed from 玉, with 居 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “I repay it with a fine jade ornament.”

謲.eEn: To urge one another angrily. Formed from 言, with 參 indicating the pronunciation.

誑.eEn: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 狂 indicating the pronunciation.

譺.eEn: Foolish. Formed from 言, with 疑 indicating the pronunciation.

訕.eEn: To slander. Formed from 言, with 山 indicating the pronunciation.

譏.eEn: To disparage. Formed from 言, with 幾 indicating the pronunciation.

誣.eEn: To impute something to someone. Formed from 言, with 巫 indicating the pronunciation.

誹.eEn: To slander. Formed from 言, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

謗.eEn: To malign. Formed from 言, with 㫄 indicating the pronunciation.

譸.e: 詶也。从言壽聲。讀若醻。《周書》曰：“無或譸張爲幻。”
譸.eEn: To curse. Formed from 言, with 壽 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 醻. The Documents of Zhou says: “Let no one fabricate deceptions to delude others.”

璓.e: 石之次玉者。从玉莠聲。《詩》曰：“充耳璓瑩。”
璓.eEn: A stone inferior to jade. Formed from 玉, with 莠 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The ear pendants are of gleaming stone.”

詶.eEn: To curse. Formed from 言, with 州 indicating the pronunciation.

詛.eEn: To curse. Formed from 言, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

誃.e: 離別也。从言多聲。讀若《論語》“跢予之足”。周景王作洛陽誃臺。
誃.eEn: To separate or part. Formed from 言, with 多 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 跢 in the Analects phrase “spread my feet apart.” King Jing of Zhou built the 誃 Terrace at Luoyang.

誖.eEn: Disorder. Formed from 言, with 孛 indicating the pronunciation.

誤.eEn: An error. Formed from 言, with 吳 indicating the pronunciation.

詿.eEn: An error. Formed from 言, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

誒.e: 可惡之辭。从言矣聲。一曰誒然。《春秋傳》曰：“誒誒出出。”
誒.eEn: An expression of disgust. Formed from 言, with 矣 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: the manner expressed by 誒然. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Ugh! Ugh! Out! Out!”

譆.eEn: Pain. Formed from 言, with 喜 indicating the pronunciation.

玖.e: 石之次玉黑色者。从玉久聲。《詩》曰：“貽我佩玖。”讀若芑。或曰若人句脊之句。
玖.eEn: A black stone inferior to jade. Formed from 玉, with 久 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “You gave me a pendant of black stone.” Read like 芑. Some say it is read like 句 in 句脊, “a person's hunched back.”

詯.e: 膽气滿聲在人上。从言自聲。讀若反目相睞。
詯.eEn: Boldness and spirit overflowing, with one's voice raised above others. Formed from 言, with 自 indicating the pronunciation. Its reading is associated with people turning their eyes to glare at one another.

謧.eEn: 謧詍 means much talking. Formed from 言, with 离 indicating the pronunciation.

詍.e: 多言也。从言世聲。《詩》曰：“無然詍詍 。”
詍.eEn: Much talking. Formed from 言, with 世 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Do not chatter on like that.”

訾.e: 不思稱意也。从言此聲。《詩》曰：“翕翕訿訿。”
訾.eEn: To fail to consider whether something accords with one's intentions. Formed from 言, with 此 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Gathering together, they disparage.”

誻.eEn: Chattering speech, as in 䜚誻. Formed from 言, with 沓 indicating the pronunciation.

詽.eEn: The clamorous speech of argument, expressed by 詽詽. Formed from 言, with 幵 indicating the pronunciation.

讗.e: 言壯㒵。一曰數相怒也。从言巂聲。讀若畫。
讗.eEn: The manner of forceful speech. Another explanation: repeatedly becoming angry with one another. Formed from 言, with 巂 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 畫.

訇.e: 騃言聲。从言，勻省聲。漢中西城有訇鄉。又讀若玄。
訇.eEn: The sound of foolish speech. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 勻 indicating the pronunciation. There is a 訇 Township in Xicheng, Hanzhong. It is also read like 玄.

諞.e: 便巧言也。从言扁聲。《周書》曰：“𢧵𢧵善諞言。”《論語》曰：“友諞佞。”
諞.eEn: Clever, glib speech. Formed from 言, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “Glib speakers, skilled in clever words.” The Analects says: “Befriending those who are glib and flattering.”

誽.eEn: To probe and watch one another through speech. Formed from 言, with 兒 indicating the pronunciation.

誂.eEn: To call to and entice one another. Formed from 言, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation.

譄.eEn: To add. Formed from 言, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

詄.eEn: To forget. Formed from 言, with 失 indicating the pronunciation.

諅.e: 忌也。从言其聲。《周書》曰：“上不諅于凶德。”
諅.eEn: To be wary of. Formed from 言, with 其 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “Those above are not wary of evil conduct.”

譀.eEn: Exaggerated or extravagant speech. Formed from 言, with 敢 indicating the pronunciation.

珢.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 艮 indicating the pronunciation.

誇.eEn: Exaggerated or extravagant speech. Formed from 言, with 夸 indicating the pronunciation.

誕.eEn: Extravagance in words. Formed from 言, with 延 indicating the pronunciation.

謔.e: 戲也。从言虐聲。《詩》曰：“善戲謔兮。”
謔.eEn: To jest. Formed from 言, with 虐 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “How skilled he is at playful jesting!”

詪.eEn: A hostile look of the eyes. Formed from 言, with 𥃩 indicating the pronunciation.

訌.e: 䜋也。从言工聲。《詩》曰：“蟊賊内訌。”
訌.eEn: Disorder leading to collapse. Formed from 言, with 工 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The destructive pests cause disorder within.”

諣.eEn: Rapid speech. Formed from 言, with 咼 indicating the pronunciation.

譟.eEn: To make a disturbance. Formed from 言, with 喿 indicating the pronunciation.

訆.e: 大呼也。从言丩聲。《春秋傳》曰：“或訆于宋大廟。”
訆.eEn: To cry out loudly. Formed from 言, with 丩 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Someone cried out in the great ancestral temple of Song.”

諕.eEn: To cry out. Formed from 言 and 虎.

讙.eEn: Clamorous noise. Formed from 言, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation.

譁.eEn: Clamorous noise. Formed from 言, with 華 indicating the pronunciation.

謣.eEn: Reckless or unfounded speech. Formed from 言, with 雩 indicating the pronunciation.

譌.e: 譌言也。从言爲聲。《詩》曰：“民之譌言。”
譌.eEn: False speech. Formed from 言, with 爲 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The people's false words.”

謬.e: 狂者之妄言也。从言翏聲。
謬.eEn: The wild, unfounded speech of a mad person. Formed from 言, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation.

璅.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 巢 indicating the pronunciation.

詤.eEn: Speech in dreams. Formed from 言, with 巟 indicating the pronunciation.

謈.e: 大呼自勉也。从言，暴省聲。
謈.eEn: To cry out loudly to encourage oneself. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 暴 indicating the pronunciation.

訬.e: 訬，擾也。一曰訬，獪。从言少聲。讀若毚。
訬.eEn: To disturb. Another explanation: to be cunning. Formed from 言, with 少 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 毚.

諆.eEn: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 其 indicating the pronunciation.

譎.e: 權詐也。益、梁曰謬欺，天下曰譎。从言矞聲。
譎.eEn: Crafty deception. In Yi and Liang it is called 謬欺; throughout the realm it is called 譎. Formed from 言, with 矞 indicating the pronunciation.

詐.eEn: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 乍 indicating the pronunciation.

訏.e: 詭譌也。从言于聲。一曰訏，𧪰。齊、楚謂信曰訏。
訏.eEn: Deceitful and false speech. Formed from 言, with 于 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: boasting. In Qi and Chu, trustworthiness is called 訏.

讋.e: 失气言。一曰不止也。从言，龖省聲。傅毅讀若慴。
讋.eEn: To speak with one's spirit overcome. Another explanation: not stopping. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 龖 indicating the pronunciation. Fu Yi reads it like 慴.

謵.eEn: Intimidated speech, as in 謵讋. Formed from 言, with 習 indicating the pronunciation.

璡.e: 石之似玉者。从玉進聲。讀若津。
璡.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 進 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 津.

詾.eEn: To speak. Formed from 言, with 匈 indicating the pronunciation.

訟.eEn: To contend. Formed from 言, with 公 indicating the pronunciation. Also used in 謌訟, “to sing praises.”

謓.e: 恚也。从言眞聲。賈侍中說：謓，笑。一曰讀若振。
謓.eEn: Anger. Formed from 言, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation. Palace Attendant Jia explains 謓 as laughter. Another account says it is read like 振.

讘.e: 多言也。从言聶聲。河東有狐讘縣。
讘.eEn: Much talking. Formed from 言, with 聶 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Húniè County, written 狐讘, in Hedong.

訶.eEn: To speak loudly in anger. Formed from 言, with 可 indicating the pronunciation.

訐.e: 面相厈罪，相告訐也。从言干聲。
訐.eEn: To confront someone directly with their faults; to accuse and expose one another. Formed from 言, with 干 indicating the pronunciation.

訴.e: 告也。从言，厈省聲。《論語》曰：“訴子路於季孫。”
訴.eEn: To report or accuse. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 厈 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “He accused Zilu before Jisun.”

譖.eEn: To make an accusation. Formed from 言, with 朁 indicating the pronunciation.

讒.eEn: To make slanderous accusations. Formed from 言, with 毚 indicating the pronunciation.

譴.eEn: To question reproachfully. Formed from 言, with 遣 indicating the pronunciation.

謫.eEn: To punish. Formed from 言, with 啻 indicating the pronunciation.

諯.e: 數也。一曰相讓也。从言耑聲。讀若專。
諯.eEn: To enumerate. Another explanation: to reproach one another. Formed from 言, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 專.

讓.eEn: To reproach one another. Formed from 言, with 襄 indicating the pronunciation.

譙.e: 嬈譊也。从言焦聲。讀若嚼。
譙.eEn: To harass with clamorous words. Formed from 言, with 焦 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 嚼.

誶.e: 讓也。从言卒聲。《國語》曰：“誶申胥。”
誶.eEn: To reproach. Formed from 言, with 卒 indicating the pronunciation. The Discourses of the States says: “He reproached Shen Xu.”

璁.e: 石之似玉者。从玉悤聲。讀若蔥。
璁.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 悤 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 蔥.

詰.eEn: To question. Formed from 言, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation.

詭.eEn: To reproach. Formed from 言, with 危 indicating the pronunciation.

證.eEn: To report or inform. Formed from 言, with 登 indicating the pronunciation.

詘.e: 詰詘也。一曰屈襞。从言出聲。
詘.eEn: To be pressed by questioning, as in 詰詘. Another explanation: to bend or fold. Formed from 言, with 出 indicating the pronunciation.

詗.eEn: To learn someone's whereabouts and report them. Formed from 言, with 冋 indicating the pronunciation.

讂.eEn: Circulating rumors. Formed from 言, with 夐 indicating the pronunciation.

詆.e: 苛也。一曰訶也。从言氐聲。
詆.eEn: To be harshly critical. Another explanation: to scold. Formed from 言, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation.

誰.eEn: Who; which person. Formed from 言, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

禎.eEn: An auspicious sign. Formed from 示, with 貞 indicating the pronunciation.

諽.e: 飾也。一曰更也。从言革聲。讀若戒。
諽.eEn: To embellish. Another explanation is: to change. Formed from 言, with 革 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 戒.

讕.eEn: Contentious denial (怟讕). Formed from 言, with 闌 indicating the pronunciation.

診.eEn: To examine. Formed from 言, with 㐱 indicating the pronunciation.

訧.e: 罪也。从言尤聲。《周書》曰：“報以庶訧。”
訧.eEn: A fault or offense. Formed from 言, with 尤 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “Repay them for their many offenses.”

誅.eEn: To punish. Formed from 言, with 朱 indicating the pronunciation.

討.eEn: To bring into order. Formed from 言 and 寸.

諳.eEn: To know thoroughly. Formed from 言, with 音 indicating the pronunciation.

讄.e: 禱也。累功德以求福。《論語》云：“讄曰：‘禱尔于上下神祇。’”从言，纍省聲。
讄.eEn: To pray: to recount accumulated achievements and virtues in seeking blessings. The Analects says: “The prayer text says, ‘I have prayed for you to the spirits above and below.’” Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 纍 indicating the pronunciation.

諡.eEn: A designation reflecting the traces of a person's conduct. Formed from 言, 兮, and 皿. Explanation missing in the source.

誄.eEn: To confer a posthumous designation. Formed from 言, with 耒 indicating the pronunciation.

謑.eEn: Shame or disgrace. Formed from 言, with 奚 indicating the pronunciation.

詬.eEn: 謑詬 means shame or disgrace. Formed from 言, with 后 indicating the pronunciation.

諜.eEn: A counterspy within an army. Formed from 言, with 枼 indicating the pronunciation.

該.e: 軍中約也。从言亥聲。讀若心中滿該。
該.eEn: An agreement or stipulated rule within an army. Formed from 言, with 亥 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 該 in the expression “the heart is filled to the full.”

譯.e: 傳譯四夷之言者。从言睪聲。
譯.eEn: One who conveys and translates the speech of the peoples of the four quarters. Formed from 言, with 睪 indicating the pronunciation.

訄.eEn: To press or compel. Formed from 言, with 九 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 求.

謚.eEn: The appearance of laughing. Formed from 言, with 益 indicating the pronunciation.

譶.eEn: To speak rapidly. Formed from three instances of 言. Read like 沓.

詢.eEn: To consult. Formed from 言, with 旬 indicating the pronunciation.

讜.eEn: Upright speech. Formed from 言, with 黨 indicating the pronunciation.

譜.e: 籍録也。从言普聲。《史記》从並。
譜.eEn: A register or record. Formed from 言, with 普 indicating the pronunciation. In the Records of the Grand Historian, it is written with 並.

詎.eEn: A rhetorical interrogative like 豈: “how could it be?” Formed from 言, with 巨 indicating the pronunciation.

謎.eEn: A riddle or concealed expression. Formed from 言 and 迷, with 迷 also indicating the pronunciation.

誌.eEn: To record. Formed from 言, with 志 indicating the pronunciation.

訣.e: 訣别也。一曰法也。从言，決省聲。
訣.eEn: To take leave or part. Another explanation is: a method or rule. Formed from 言, with an abbreviated form of 決 indicating the pronunciation.

誩.e: 競言也。从二言。凡誩之屬皆从誩。讀若競。
誩.eEn: To contend in speech. Formed from two instances of 言. All characters in the 誩 class are formed with 誩. Read like 競.

譱.e: 吉也。从誩从羊。此與義美同意。
譱.eEn: Good or auspicious. Formed from 誩 and 羊. Its underlying meaning is the same as that of 義 and 美.

競.e: 彊語也。一曰逐也。从誩，从二人。
競.eEn: To speak forcefully. Another explanation is: to pursue or compete. Formed from 誩 and two instances of 人.

讟.e: 痛怨也。从誩𧷏聲。《春秋傳》曰：“民無怨讟。”
讟.eEn: Bitter resentment. Formed from 誩, with 𧷏 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The people had no resentment or bitter complaints.”

音.e: 聲也。生於心，有節於外，謂之音。宮商角徵羽，聲；絲竹金石匏土革木，音也。从言含一。凡音之屬皆从音。
音.eEn: Sound. What arises in the heart and is expressed outwardly with measured articulation is called 音. 宮, 商, 角, 徵, and 羽 are 聲, tones; silk, bamboo, metal, stone, gourd, clay, hide, and wood produce 音, musical sounds. Formed from 言 containing 一. All characters in the 音 class are formed with 音.

響.eEn: Sound. Formed from 音, with 鄉 indicating the pronunciation.

韽.eEn: A low sound that carries through. Formed from 音, with 酓 indicating the pronunciation.

韶.e: 虞舜樂也。《書》曰：“《簫韶》九成，鳳皇來儀。”从音召聲。
韶.eEn: The music of Shun of Yu. The Book of Documents says: “When the nine sections of the 簫韶 had been performed, phoenixes came and moved in ceremonial harmony.” Formed from 音, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

章.e: 樂竟爲一章。从音从十。十，數之終也。
章.eEn: The completion of a musical passage constitutes one section. Formed from 音 and 十. 十 is the completion of the numerical series.

竟.eEn: The ending of a musical piece is called 竟. Formed from 音 and 人.

韻.e: 和也。从音員聲。裴光遠云：古與均同。未知其審。
韻.eEn: Harmony. Formed from 音, with 員 indicating the pronunciation. Pei Guangyuan says that in antiquity it was the same as 均. Whether this is accurate is not known.

童.e: 男有辠曰奴，奴曰童，女曰妾。从䇂，重省聲。
童.eEn: A male who has committed an offense is called a 奴, a slave; such a slave is called a 童. A female is called a 妾. Formed from 䇂, with an abbreviated form of 重 indicating the pronunciation.

玽.e: 石之次玉者。从玉句聲。讀若苟。
玽.eEn: A stone ranking next to jade. Formed from 玉, with 句 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 苟.

妾.e: 有辠女子，給事之得接於君者。从䇂从女。《春秋》云：“女爲人妾。”妾，不娉也。
妾.eEn: A woman who has committed an offense and serves in a capacity that allows her to approach her lord. Formed from 䇂 and 女. The Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The woman became another person's concubine.” A 妾 is not taken in marriage through betrothal.

丵.e: 叢生艸也。象丵嶽相竝出也。凡丵之屬皆从丵。讀若浞。
丵.eEn: Grasses growing in a clump. It depicts clustered, towering growths emerging side by side. All characters in the 丵 class are formed with 丵. Read like 浞.

業.e: 大版也。所以飾縣鍾鼓。捷業如鋸齒，以白畫之。象其鉏鋙相承也。从丵从巾。巾象版。《詩》曰：“巨業維樅。”
業.eEn: A large board used to ornament suspended bells and drums. Its projections resemble saw teeth and are painted white. It depicts their interlocking, uneven arrangement. Formed from 丵 and 巾; 巾 depicts the board. The Book of Odes says: “The great toothed boards stand tall.”

叢.eEn: To gather together. Formed from 丵, with 取 indicating the pronunciation.

對.e: 譍無方也。从丵从口从寸。
對.eEn: To respond without restriction to any particular direction. Formed from 丵, 口, and 寸.

菐.e: 瀆菐也。从丵从廾，廾亦聲。凡菐之屬皆从菐。
菐.eEn: To trouble or importune, as in 瀆菐. Formed from 丵 and 廾, with 廾 also indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 菐 class are formed with 菐.

僕.e: 給事者。从人从菐，菐亦聲。
僕.eEn: One who performs service. Formed from 人 and 菐, with 菐 also indicating the pronunciation.

奉.eEn: To receive or support respectfully. Formed from 手 and 廾, with 𡴀 indicating the pronunciation.

琂.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 言 indicating the pronunciation.

丞.e: 翊也。从廾从卩从山。山高，奉承之義。
丞.eEn: To assist. Formed from 廾, 卩, and 山. A mountain is high, conveying the sense of respectfully supporting it.

奐.e: 取奐也。一曰大也。从廾，夐省。
奐.eEn: To take or obtain, as in 取奐. Another explanation is: great. Formed from 廾 and an abbreviated form of 夐.

弇.eEn: To cover. Formed from 廾 and 合.

异.e: 舉也。从廾㠯聲。《虞書》曰： “岳曰：异哉！”
异.eEn: To raise up. Formed from 廾, with 㠯 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Yu says: “Yue said, ‘Raise him up!’”

弄.eEn: To play with. Formed from 廾 holding 玉.

璶.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 盡 indicating the pronunciation.

戒.e: 警也。从廾持戈，以戒不虞。
戒.eEn: To be on guard. Formed from 廾 holding 戈, a dagger-axe, to guard against the unexpected.

兵.e: 械也。从廾持斤，并力之皃。
兵.eEn: Weapons or implements. Formed from 廾 holding 斤, an axe, depicting the exertion of combined strength.

龏.eEn: Sincere and respectful. Formed from 廾, with 龍 indicating the pronunciation.

弈.e: 圍棊也。从廾亦聲。《論語》曰：“不有博弈者乎！”
弈.eEn: The game of encircling chess, or Go. Formed from 廾, with 亦 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “Are there not people who play board games and Go?”

具.e: 共置也。从廾，从貝省。古以貝爲貨。
具.eEn: To provide and set out. Formed from 廾 and an abbreviated form of 貝. In antiquity, shells were used as currency.

樊.e: 鷙不行也。从𠬜从棥，棥亦聲。
樊.eEn: To hold fast so that movement is prevented. Formed from 𠬜 and 棥, with 棥 also indicating the pronunciation.

奱.eEn: To bind or restrain, as expressed by 樊. Formed from 𠬜, with 䜌 indicating the pronunciation.

共.e: 同也。从廿、廾。凡共之屬皆从共。
共.eEn: Together or the same. Formed from 廿 and 廾. All characters in the 共 class are formed with 共.

龔.eEn: To supply or provide. Formed from 共, with 龍 indicating the pronunciation.

琟.e: 石之似玉者。从玉隹聲。讀若維。
琟.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 維.

異.e: 分也。从廾从畀。畀，予也。凡異之屬皆从異。
異.eEn: To divide or distinguish. Formed from 廾 and 畀. 畀 means to give. All characters in the 異 class are formed with 異.

戴.e: 分物得增益曰戴。从異𢦔聲。
戴.eEn: When the division of things brings an increase to one's share, this is called 戴. Formed from 異, with 𢦔 indicating the pronunciation.

舁.e: 共舉也。从𦥑从廾。凡舁之屬皆从舁。讀若余。
舁.eEn: To lift together. Formed from 𦥑 and 廾. All characters in the 舁 class are formed with 舁. Read like 余.

與.eEn: An ally or associate. Formed from 舁 and 与.

興.eEn: To rise or raise up. Formed from 舁 and 同, expressing the joining of strength.

要.e: 身中也。象人要自𦥑之形。从𦥑，交省聲。
要.eEn: The middle of the body, the waist. It depicts a person's waist with 𦥑, hands, at it. Formed from 𦥑, with an abbreviated form of 交 indicating the pronunciation.

瑦.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 烏 indicating the pronunciation.

爨.e: 齊謂之炊爨。𦥑象持甑，冂爲竈口，廾推林内火。凡爨之屬皆从爨。
爨.eEn: In Qi, cooking is called 炊爨. 𦥑 depicts holding a steamer; 冂 represents the stove opening; 廾 pushes 林, wood, into 火, the fire. All characters in the 爨 class are formed with 爨.

釁.e: 血祭也。象祭竈也。从爨省，从酉。酉，所以祭也。从分，分亦聲。
釁.eEn: A blood sacrifice. It depicts making a sacrifice to the stove. Formed from an abbreviated form of 爨 and from 酉; 酉 represents what is used in the sacrifice. It also contains 分, which indicates the pronunciation.

革.e: 獸皮治去其毛，革更之。象古文革之形。凡革之屬皆从革。
革.eEn: An animal hide treated to remove its hair and thereby altered. It depicts the form of 革 in ancient script. All characters in the 革 class are formed with 革.

鞹.e: 去毛皮也。《論語》曰：“虎豹之鞹。”从革郭聲。
鞹.eEn: A hide with its hair removed. The Analects says: “The hairless hides of tigers and leopards.” Formed from 革, with 郭 indicating the pronunciation.

靬.e: 靬，乾革也。武威有麗靬縣。从革干聲。
靬.eEn: Dry leather. There is a Liqian County in Wuwei. Formed from 革, with 干 indicating the pronunciation.

鞄.e: 柔革工也。从革包聲。讀若朴。《周禮》曰：“柔皮之工鮑氏。”鞄卽鮑也。
鞄.eEn: A craftsman who softens leather. Formed from 革, with 包 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 朴. The Rites of Zhou says: “The craftsmen who soften hides are the 鮑 craftsmen.” 鞄 is the same as 鮑.

鞣.eEn: To soften. Formed from 革 and 柔, with 柔 also indicating the pronunciation.

瑂.e: 石之似玉者。从玉眉聲。讀若眉。
瑂.eEn: A stone resembling jade. Formed from 玉, with 眉 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 眉.

靼.eEn: Softened leather. Formed from 革, with 旦 indicating the pronunciation.
