竷.eEn: To sing and dance. Music has patterned sections. Formed from 章, 夅, and 夊. The Book of Odes says: “Dancing rhythmically, they make me dance.”

夏.e: 中國之人也。从夊从頁从𦥑。𦥑，兩手；夊，兩足也。
夏.eEn: A person of the Central States. Formed from 夊, 頁, and 𦥑. 𦥑 represents two hands; 夊 represents two feet.

畟.e: 治稼畟畟進也。从田、人，从夊。《詩》曰：“畟畟良耜。”
畟.eEn: To advance briskly in tending crops. Formed from 田, 人, and 夊. The Book of Odes says: “Briskly go the fine plowshares.”

夒.e: 貪獸也。一曰母猴，似人。从頁，巳、止、夊，其手足。
夒.eEn: A greedy beast. Another explanation is: a monkey resembling a person. Formed from 頁, with 巳, 止, and 夊 representing its hands and feet.

萑.eEn: The appearance of abundant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

夔.e: 神魖也。如龍，一足，从夊；象有角、手、人面之形。
夔.eEn: A divine xu-spirit. It resembles a dragon and has one foot, represented by 夊. The graph depicts horns, hands, and a human face.

夎.eEn: To lose proper deportment when bowing. Formed from 夊, with 坐 indicating the pronunciation.

舛.e: 對臥也。从夊𡕒相背。凡舛之屬皆从舛。
舛.eEn: To lie facing opposite directions. Formed from 夊 and 𡕒 with their backs to one another. All characters in the 舛 class are formed with 舛.

舞.e: 樂也。用足相背，从舛；無聲。
舞.eEn: A musical performance. It uses 舛 to represent feet turned in opposite directions, with 無 indicating the pronunciation.

舝.e: 車軸耑鍵也。兩穿相背，从舛；𥜿省聲。𥜿，古文偰字。
舝.eEn: The fastening pin at the end of a carriage axle. The two inserted ends face opposite directions, represented by 舛; an abbreviated 𥜿 indicates the pronunciation. 𥜿 is the ancient form of 偰.

舜.e: 艸也。楚謂之葍，秦謂之藑。蔓地連華。象形。从舛，舛亦聲。凡䑞之屬皆从䑞。(今隸變作舜。)
舜.eEn: A plant called 葍 in Chu and 藑 in Qin. It trails over the ground and has flowers joined along it. A pictograph. Formed from 舛, which also indicates the pronunciation. All characters in the 䑞 class are formed with 䑞. In the present clerical transformation, it is written 舜.

韋.e: 相背也。从舛囗聲。獸皮之韋，可以束枉戾相韋背，故借以爲皮韋。凡韋之屬皆从韋。
韋.eEn: To turn one's back on another. Formed from 舛, with 囗 indicating the pronunciation. Animal hide can bind things that are bent, twisted, or turned away from one another; therefore the character was borrowed to mean leather. All characters in the 韋 class are formed with 韋.

韠.e: 韍也。所以蔽前，以韋。下廣二尺，上廣一尺，其頸五寸。一命縕韠，再命赤韠。从韋畢聲。
韠.eEn: A ceremonial apron. It covers the front of the body and is made of leather. Its lower part is two chi wide, its upper part one chi wide, and its neck five cun wide. At the first rank of appointment, one wears a dark reddish apron; at the second, a red apron. Formed from 韋, with 畢 indicating the pronunciation.

韎.e: 茅蒐𣑱韋也。一入曰韎。从韋末聲。
韎.eEn: Leather dyed with madder. A single immersion in the dye is called 韎. Formed from 韋, with 末 indicating the pronunciation.

茥.eEn: The plant called “broken basin.” Formed from 艸, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

韢.e: 櫜紐也。从韋惠聲。一曰盛虜頭橐也。
韢.eEn: The fastening loop of a case or bag. Formed from 韋, with 惠 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a sack for holding the heads of captured enemies.

韜.eEn: A sword covering. Formed from 韋, with 舀 indicating the pronunciation.

韝.eEn: An arm guard for archery. Formed from 韋, with 冓 indicating the pronunciation.

韘.e: 射決也。所以拘弦，以象骨，韋系，著右巨指。从韋枼聲。《詩》曰：“童子佩韘。”
韘.eEn: An archer's thumb ring. It is used to hold the bowstring, is made of ivory or bone, is secured with leather, and is worn on the right thumb. Formed from 韋, with 枼 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The boy wears an archer's thumb ring.”

韣.eEn: A bow covering. Formed from 韋, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation.

韔.e: 弓衣也。从韋長聲。《詩》曰：“交韔二弓。”
韔.eEn: A bow covering. Formed from 韋, with 長 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The two bows are placed crosswise in their cases.”

韤.eEn: A covering for the feet; stockings. Formed from 韋, with 蔑 indicating the pronunciation.

莙.e: 井藻也。从艸君聲。讀若威。
莙.eEn: Well algae. Formed from 艸, with 君 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 威.

韏.eEn: A division in the middle of a hide is called 韏. Formed from 韋, with 𢍏 indicating the pronunciation.

韌.eEn: Supple yet strong. Formed from 韋, with 刃 indicating the pronunciation.

弟.e: 韋束之次弟也。从古字之象。凡弟之屬皆从弟。
弟.eEn: The successive order of leather bindings. Based on the pictorial form of the ancient character. All characters in the 弟 class are formed with 弟.

夂.e: 从後至也。象人兩脛後有致之者。凡夂之屬皆从夂。讀若黹。
夂.eEn: To arrive from behind. It depicts a person with something behind the two lower legs causing the person to advance. All characters in the 夂 class are formed with 夂. Pronounced like 黹.

夆.eEn: To oppose or encounter resistance. Formed from 夂, with 𡴀 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 縫.

夅.e: 服也。从夂、午，相承不敢竝也。
夅.eEn: To submit. Formed from 夂 and 午, one following the other, not daring to stand side by side.

夃.e: 秦以市買多得爲夃。从𠄎从夂，益至也。从乃。《詩》曰：“我夃酌彼金罍。”
夃.eEn: In Qin, obtaining extra when buying at a market is called 夃. Formed from 𠄎 and 夂, meaning that an increase arrives. It is formed from 乃. The Book of Odes says: “I shall draw wine from that bronze wine jar.”

久.e: 以後灸之，象人兩脛後有距也。《周禮》曰：“久諸牆以觀其橈。”凡久之屬皆从久。
久.eEn: To apply cauterization from behind. It depicts a person with a support behind the two lower legs. The Rites of Zhou says: “Brace them against a wall to observe their bending.” All characters in the 久 class are formed with 久.

桀.e: 磔也。从舛在木上也。凡桀之屬皆从桀。
桀.eEn: To spread out or dismember. Formed from 舛 above 木. All characters in the 桀 class are formed with 桀.

磔.eEn: To dismember as punishment. Formed from 桀, with 石 indicating the pronunciation.

椉.e: 覆也。从入、桀。桀，黠也。軍法曰乘。
椉.eEn: To cover. Formed from 入 and 桀. 桀 means crafty. In military regulations it is called 乘.

木.e: 冒也。冒地而生。東方之行。从屮，下象其根。凡木之屬皆从木。
木.eEn: To emerge: it emerges from the ground and grows. The phase associated with the east. Formed from 屮, with the lower part depicting its roots. All characters in the 木 class are formed with 木.

橘.eEn: A fruit that comes from south of the Yangtze. Formed from 木, with 矞 indicating the pronunciation.

橙.eEn: A kind of citrus related to 橘. Formed from 木, with 登 indicating the pronunciation.

柚.e: 條也。似橙而酢。从木由聲。《夏書》曰：“厥包橘柚。”
柚.eEn: The fruit called 條. It resembles an orange but is sour. Formed from 木, with 由 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Xia says: “Their bundled offerings were mandarins and pomelos.”

祪.eEn: Ancestors associated with the rites called 祔 and 祪. Formed from 示, with 危 indicating the pronunciation.

蒚.eEn: The upper part of the plant called fuli. Formed from 艸, with 鬲 indicating the pronunciation.

樝.eEn: A fruit resembling a pear but sour. Formed from 木, with 虘 indicating the pronunciation.

棃.eEn: The name of a fruit: the pear. Formed from 木, with 𥝢 indicating the pronunciation. 𥝢 is the ancient form of 利.

梬.eEn: A kind of jujube resembling a persimmon. Formed from 木, with 甹 indicating the pronunciation.

柿.eEn: A fruit with red flesh or a red fruiting body: the persimmon. Formed from 木, with 市 indicating the pronunciation.

枏.eEn: The mei plum. Formed from 木, with 冄 indicating the pronunciation.

梅.eEn: The tree or fruit called 枏. It is edible. Formed from 木, with 每 indicating the pronunciation.

杏.eEn: A fruit: the apricot. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated 可 indicating the pronunciation.

柰.eEn: A fruit. Formed from 木, with 示 indicating the pronunciation.

李.eEn: A fruit: the plum. Formed from 木, with 子 indicating the pronunciation.

桃.eEn: A fruit: the peach. Formed from 木, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation.

苢.e: 芣苢。一名馬舄。其實如李，令人宜子。从艸㠯聲。《周書》所說。
苢.eEn: Fuyi, also called “horse's shoe.” Its fruit resembles a plum and makes people more likely to have children. Formed from 艸, with 㠯 indicating the pronunciation. It is described in the Book of Zhou.

楷.e: 木也。孔子冢蓋樹之者。从木皆聲。
楷.eEn: A tree, presumably the kind planted at Confucius's tomb. Formed from 木, with 皆 indicating the pronunciation.

梫.eEn: The gui tree. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated 㑴 indicating the pronunciation.

桂.e: 江南木，百藥之長。从木圭聲。
桂.eEn: A tree from south of the Yangtze, foremost among the many medicinal substances. Formed from 木, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

棠.e: 牡曰棠，牝曰杜。从木尚聲。
棠.eEn: The male tree is called 棠; the female is called 杜. Formed from 木, with 尚 indicating the pronunciation.

杜.eEn: The sweet tang tree. Formed from 木, with 土 indicating the pronunciation.

槢.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 習 indicating the pronunciation.

樿.e: 木也。可以爲櫛。从木單聲。
樿.eEn: A tree whose wood can be used to make combs. Formed from 木, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

椲.e: 木也。可屈爲杅者。从木韋聲。
椲.eEn: A tree whose wood can be bent to make basins. Formed from 木, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

蕁.eEn: The plant called chenfan. Formed from 艸, with 尋 indicating the pronunciation.

楢.e: 柔木也。工官以爲耎輪。从木酋聲。讀若糗。
楢.eEn: A pliable tree. Government artisans use its wood to make flexible wheels. Formed from 木, with 酋 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 糗.

桏.eEn: The tree called jiju. Formed from 木, with 邛 indicating the pronunciation.

棆.e: 毋杶也。从木侖聲。讀若《易》卦屯。
棆.eEn: The tree called wuchun. Formed from 木, with 侖 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 屯, the hexagram in the Book of Changes.

楈.e: 木也。从木胥聲。讀若芟刈之芟。
楈.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 胥 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 芟 in the expression meaning “to cut and mow.”

柍.e: 梅也。从木央聲。一曰江南橦材，其實謂之柍。
柍.eEn: A mei plum. Formed from 木, with 央 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: the tong timber tree of the region south of the Yangtze; its fruit is called 柍.

楑.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 癸 indicating the pronunciation. Also, to measure.

椆.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 周 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 丩.

樕.eEn: The tree called 樸樕. Formed from 木, with 欶 indicating the pronunciation.

梣.eEn: A tree with green bark. Formed from 木, with 岑 indicating the pronunciation.

棳.e: 木也。从木叕聲。益州有棳縣。
棳.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 叕 indicating the pronunciation. There is a county named 棳 in Yizhou.

棪.e: 遬其也。从木炎聲。讀若三年導服之導。
棪.eEn: The tree called 遬其. Formed from 木, with 炎 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 導 in the expression referring to 導 garments after three years of mourning.

椋.eEn: The tree called 卽來. Formed from 木, with 京 indicating the pronunciation.

檍.eEn: The 杶 tree. Formed from 木, with 意 indicating the pronunciation.

楀.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 禹 indicating the pronunciation.

蓲.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

蘽.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 藟 indicating the pronunciation.

桋.e: 赤栜也。从木夷聲。《詩》曰：“隰有杞桋。”
桋.eEn: The red 栜 tree. Formed from 木, with 夷 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “In the low, wet ground are 杞 and 桋 trees.”

栟.eEn: The palm called 栟櫚. Formed from 木, with 并 indicating the pronunciation.

椶.e: 栟櫚也。可作萆。从木㚇聲。
椶.eEn: The palm called 栟櫚. It can be used to make coverings. Formed from 木, with 㚇 indicating the pronunciation.

檟.e: 楸也。从木賈聲。《春秋傳》曰：“樹六檟於蒲圃。”
檟.eEn: The 楸 tree. Formed from 木, with 賈 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “He planted six 檟 trees at Pupu.”

椅.eEn: The 梓 tree. Formed from 木, with 奇 indicating the pronunciation.

梓.eEn: The 楸 tree. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 宰 indicating the pronunciation.

楸.eEn: The 梓 tree. Formed from 木, with 秋 indicating the pronunciation.

柀.e: 檆也。从木皮聲。一曰折也。
柀.eEn: The 檆 tree. Formed from 木, with 皮 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to break.

檆.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 煔 indicating the pronunciation.

榛.e: 木也。从木秦聲。一曰菆也。
榛.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 秦 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation identifies it as the plant called 菆.

杶.e: 木也。从木屯聲。《夏書》曰：“杶榦栝柏。”
杶.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 屯 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Xia says: “杶 trees, bow staves, 栝 trees, and cypresses.”

橁.eEn: The 杶 tree. Formed from 木, with 筍 indicating the pronunciation.

桵.eEn: The white 桵, namely the 棫 tree. Formed from 木, with 妥 indicating the pronunciation.

棫.eEn: The white 桵 tree. Formed from 木, with 或 indicating the pronunciation.

椐.eEn: The 樻 tree. Formed from 木, with 居 indicating the pronunciation.

樻.eEn: The 椐 tree. Formed from 木, with 貴 indicating the pronunciation.

栩.e: 柔也。从木羽聲。其皁，一曰様。
栩.eEn: The tree called 柔. Formed from 木, with 羽 indicating the pronunciation. Its acorn is also called 様.

様.eEn: The fruit of the 栩 tree. Formed from 木, with 羕 indicating the pronunciation.

杙.eEn: The 劉 tree, called 劉杙. Formed from 木, with 弋 indicating the pronunciation.

枇.eEn: The 枇杷, a tree. Formed from 木, with 比 indicating the pronunciation.

桔.e: 桔梗，藥名。从木吉聲。一曰直木。
桔.eEn: 桔梗, the name of a medicinal plant. Formed from 木, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a straight tree.

柞.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 乍 indicating the pronunciation.

榗.e: 木也。从木晉聲。書曰：竹箭如榗。
榗.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 晉 indicating the pronunciation. A written text says: “Bamboo arrow shafts are like 榗 wood.”

藷.eEn: Sugarcane, called 藷蔗. Formed from 艸, with 諸 indicating the pronunciation.

椵.e: 木。可作牀几。从木叚聲。讀若賈。
椵.eEn: A tree whose wood can be used to make beds and small tables. Formed from 木, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 賈.

橞.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 惠 indicating the pronunciation.

楛.e: 木也。从木苦聲。《詩》曰：“榛楛濟濟。”
楛.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 苦 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The 榛 and 楛 trees grow thickly together.”

櫅.e: 木也。可以爲大車軸。从木齊聲。
櫅.eEn: A tree whose wood can be used to make axles for large carts. Formed from 木, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation.

樲.eEn: The sour jujube. Formed from 木, with 貳 indicating the pronunciation.

橪.e: 酸小棗。从木然聲。一曰染也。
橪.eEn: A small, sour jujube. Formed from 木, with 然 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to dye.

柅.eEn: A tree whose fruit resembles a pear. Formed from 木, with 尼 indicating the pronunciation.

蔗.eEn: Sugarcane, called 藷蔗. Formed from 艸, with 庶 indicating the pronunciation.

梢.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation.

梭.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 夋 indicating the pronunciation.

楋.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 剌 indicating the pronunciation.

枸.e: 木也。可爲醬。出蜀。从木句聲。
枸.eEn: A tree that can be used to make a sauce. It grows in Shu. Formed from 木, with 句 indicating the pronunciation.

樜.eEn: A tree that grows on Mount Fajiu. Formed from 木, with 庶 indicating the pronunciation.

枋.eEn: A tree whose wood can be used to make carts. Formed from 木, with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

橿.e: 枋也。从木畺聲。一曰鉏柄名。
橿.eEn: The 枋 tree. Formed from 木, with 畺 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: the name of a hoe handle.

樗.e: 木也。以其皮裹松脂。从木雩聲。讀若華。
樗.eEn: A tree whose bark is used to wrap pine resin. Formed from 木, with 雩 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 華.

檗.eEn: A yellow tree. Formed from 木, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

梤.eEn: An aromatic tree. Formed from 木, with 㞣 indicating the pronunciation.

榝.e: 似茱萸。出淮南。从木殺聲。
榝.eEn: A plant resembling 茱萸. It grows in Huainan. Formed from 木, with 殺 indicating the pronunciation.

槭.e: 木。可作大車輮。从木戚聲。
槭.eEn: A tree whose wood can be used to make the curved wheel rims of large carts. Formed from 木, with 戚 indicating the pronunciation.

楊.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 昜 indicating the pronunciation.

檉.eEn: The river willow. Formed from 木, with 聖 indicating the pronunciation.

桺.e: 小楊也。从木戼聲。戼，古文酉。
桺.eEn: A small 楊 tree. Formed from 木, with 戼 indicating the pronunciation. 戼 is the ancient-script form of 酉.

欒.e: 木。似欄。从木䜌聲。《禮》：天子樹松，諸侯柏，大夫欒，士楊。
欒.eEn: A tree resembling the 欄 tree. Formed from 木, with 䜌 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites states: “The Son of Heaven plants pines; the feudal lords, cypresses; the great officers, 欒 trees; and the gentlemen, 楊 trees.”

祔.e: 後死者合食於先祖。从示付聲。
祔.eEn: For someone who has died later to share sacrificial offerings with the ancestors. Formed from 示, with 付 indicating the pronunciation.

栘.eEn: The 棠棣 tree. Formed from 木, with 多 indicating the pronunciation.

棣.eEn: The white 棣 tree. Formed from 木, with 隶 indicating the pronunciation.

枳.eEn: A tree resembling the mandarin orange. Formed from 木, with 只 indicating the pronunciation.

楓.e: 木也。厚葉弱枝，善搖。一名欇。从木風聲。
楓.eEn: A tree with thick leaves and slender, yielding branches that readily sway. Another name is 欇. Formed from 木, with 風 indicating the pronunciation.

權.e: 黃華木。从木雚聲。一曰反常。
權.eEn: A tree with yellow flowers. Formed from 木, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to depart from the usual rule.

柜.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 巨 indicating the pronunciation.

槐.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 鬼 indicating the pronunciation.

榖.eEn: The 楮 tree. Formed from 木, with 㱿 indicating the pronunciation.

楮.eEn: The 榖 tree. Formed from 木, with 者 indicating the pronunciation.

檵.e: 枸杞也。从木，繼省聲。一曰監木也。
檵.eEn: The 枸杞 plant. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 繼 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation identifies it as the tree called 監木.

杞.eEn: The 枸杞 plant. Formed from 木, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

枒.e: 木也。从木牙聲。一曰車𨊾會也。
枒.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 牙 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: the joint where the cart part called 𨊾 meets.

檀.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 亶 indicating the pronunciation.

櫟.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 樂 indicating the pronunciation.

梂.eEn: The fruit of the 櫟 tree. Another explanation is: the head of the implement called 𨯳. Formed from 木, with 求 indicating the pronunciation.

楝.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 柬 indicating the pronunciation.

檿.e: 山桑也。从木厭聲。《詩》曰：“其檿其柘。”
檿.eEn: The mountain mulberry. Formed from 木, with 厭 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Its mountain mulberries and its 柘 trees.”

柘.eEn: A mulberry tree. Formed from 木, with 石 indicating the pronunciation.

萯.eEn: The plant called 王萯. Formed from 艸, with 負 indicating the pronunciation.

梧.e: 梧桐木。从木吾聲。一名櫬。
梧.eEn: The 梧桐 tree. Formed from 木, with 吾 indicating the pronunciation. Another name is 櫬.

榮.e: 桐木也。从木，熒省聲。一曰屋梠之兩頭起者爲榮。
榮.eEn: The 桐 tree. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 熒 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: the raised portions at the two ends of a building's eaves beam are called 榮.

桐.eEn: The 榮 tree. Formed from 木, with 同 indicating the pronunciation.

橎.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 番 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 樊.

榆.eEn: The elm, the white 枌 tree. Formed from 木, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

枌.eEn: The elm. Formed from 木, with 分 indicating the pronunciation.

梗.e: 山枌榆。有朿，莢可爲蕪夷者。从木更聲。
梗.eEn: The mountain 枌 elm. It has thorns, and its pods can be used to make 蕪夷. Formed from 木, with 更 indicating the pronunciation.

樵.eEn: To cut up wood. Formed from 木, with 焦 indicating the pronunciation.

松.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 公 indicating the pronunciation.

樠.eEn: The heartwood of a pine. Formed from 木, with 㒼 indicating the pronunciation.

芺.e: 艸也。味苦，江南食以下气。从艸夭聲。
芺.eEn: A plant with a bitter taste. In Jiangnan, people eat it to send qi downward. Formed from 艸, with 夭 indicating the pronunciation.

檜.eEn: A tree with cypress leaves and a pine trunk. Formed from 木, with 會 indicating the pronunciation.

樅.eEn: A tree with pine leaves and a cypress trunk. Formed from 木, with 從 indicating the pronunciation.

柏.eEn: The tree called 鞠. Formed from 木, with 白 indicating the pronunciation.

机.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 几 indicating the pronunciation.

枮.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 占 indicating the pronunciation.

梇.e: 木也。从木弄聲。益州有梇棟縣。
梇.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 弄 indicating the pronunciation. There is a county named 梇棟 in Yizhou.

楰.e: 鼠梓木。从木臾聲。《詩》曰：“北山有楰。”
楰.eEn: The tree called 鼠梓. Formed from 木, with 臾 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “On the northern mountain are 楰 trees.”

桅.eEn: A yellow tree that can be used for dyeing. Formed from 木, with 危 indicating the pronunciation.

杒.eEn: A fetter or restraint, called 桎杒. Formed from 木, with 刃 indicating the pronunciation.

榙.e: 榙𣝋。果似李。从木荅聲。讀若嚃。
榙.eEn: The 榙𣝋 tree. Its fruit resembles a plum. Formed from 木, with 荅 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 嚃.

某.eEn: A sour fruit. Formed from 木 and 甘. Explanation missing in the source.

櫾.e: 崐崘河隅之長木也。从木繇聲。
櫾.eEn: A tall tree at a bend of the Kunlun River. Formed from 木, with 繇 indicating the pronunciation.

樹.eEn: A general name for growing plants. Formed from 木, with 尌 indicating the pronunciation.

本.e: 木下曰本。从木，一在其下。
本.eEn: The lower part of a tree is called 本. Formed from 木, with 一 beneath it.

柢.eEn: A tree root. Formed from 木, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation.

朱.e: 赤心木。松柏屬。从木，一在其中。
朱.eEn: A tree with a red heart, belonging to the pine and cypress group. Formed from 木, with 一 in its middle.

根.eEn: The stump or rootstock of a tree. Formed from 木, with 艮 indicating the pronunciation.

株.eEn: A tree root. Formed from 木, with 朱 indicating the pronunciation.

末.e: 木上曰末。从木，一在其上。
末.eEn: The upper part of a tree is called 末. Formed from 木, with 一 above it.

果.e: 木實也。从木，象果形在木之上。
果.eEn: The fruit of a tree. Formed from 木, depicting fruit above the tree.

杈.eEn: A branch. Formed from 木, with 叉 indicating the pronunciation.

枝.eEn: A shoot growing separately from a tree. Formed from 木, with 支 indicating the pronunciation.

朴.eEn: Tree bark. Formed from 木, with 卜 indicating the pronunciation.

條.eEn: A small branch. Formed from 木, with 攸 indicating the pronunciation.

枚.e: 榦也。可爲杖。从木从攴。《詩》曰：“施于條枚。”
枚.eEn: A stem or trunk, suitable for making a staff. Formed from 木 and 攴. The Book of Odes says: “Extending over the branches and trunks.”

莩.eEn: A kind of grass. Formed from 艸, with 孚 indicating the pronunciation.

栠.eEn: A weak appearance. Formed from 木, with 任 indicating the pronunciation.

枖.e: 木少盛皃。从木夭聲。《詩》曰：“桃之枖枖。”
枖.eEn: The appearance of a young, flourishing tree. Formed from 木, with 夭 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The peach tree is young and flourishing.”

槇.e: 木頂也。从木眞聲。一曰仆木也。
槇.eEn: The top of a tree. Formed from 木, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: a fallen tree.

梃.eEn: A single stem. Formed from 木, with 廷 indicating the pronunciation.

標.eEn: The tip of a treetop. Formed from 木, with 𤐫 indicating the pronunciation.

杪.eEn: The very tip of a tree. Formed from 木, with 少 indicating the pronunciation.

朶.e: 樹木垂朵朵也。从木，象形。此與𥝩同意。
朶.eEn: Trees with drooping clusters. Formed from 木. A pictograph. This expresses the same idea as 𥝩.

桹.eEn: A tall tree. Formed from 木, with 良 indicating the pronunciation.

橌.eEn: The appearance of a large tree. Formed from 木, with 閒 indicating the pronunciation.

蔩.eEn: The plant called “hare melon.” Formed from 艸, with 寅 indicating the pronunciation.

枵.e: 木根也。从木号聲。《春秋傳》曰：“歲在玄枵。”玄枵，虛也。
枵.eEn: A tree root. Formed from 木, with 号 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Jupiter was in 玄枵.” 玄枵 means “empty.”

柖.eEn: The appearance of a tree swaying. Formed from 木, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

榣.eEn: A tree moving. Formed from 木, with 䍃 indicating the pronunciation.

樛.eEn: Bending downward is called 樛. Formed from 木, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation.

朻.eEn: A tall tree. Formed from 木, with 丩 indicating the pronunciation.

枉.eEn: Slanting and crooked. Formed from 木, with 㞷 indicating the pronunciation.

橈.eEn: Bent wood. Formed from 木, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

枎.eEn: 枎疏 means spreading out in all four directions. Formed from 木, with 夫 indicating the pronunciation.

檹.e: 木檹施。从木旖聲。賈侍中說，檹卽椅木，可作琴。
檹.eEn: A tree spreading or trailing. Formed from 木, with 旖 indicating the pronunciation. Palace Attendant Jia says that 檹 is the 椅 tree, whose wood can be used to make a qin zither.

荓.eEn: The plant called “horse broom.” Formed from 艸, with 并 indicating the pronunciation.

槮.e: 木長皃。从木參聲。《詩》曰：“槮差荇菜。”
槮.eEn: The appearance of a tall tree. Formed from 木, with 參 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Uneven in length is the water mallow.”

梴.e: 長木也。从木延聲。《詩》曰：“松桷有梴。”
梴.eEn: A long piece of timber. Formed from 木, with 延 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The pine rafters are long.”

橚.eEn: The appearance of a tall tree. Formed from 木, with 肅 indicating the pronunciation.

杕.e: 樹皃。从木大聲。《詩》曰：“有杕之杜。”
杕.eEn: The appearance of a tree standing alone. Formed from 木, with 大 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “There is a solitary wild pear tree.”

格.eEn: The appearance of a tall tree. Formed from 木, with 各 indicating the pronunciation.

槷.eEn: Pieces of wood rubbing against one another. Formed from 木, with 埶 indicating the pronunciation.

枯.e: 槀也。从木古聲。《夏書》曰：“唯箘輅枯。”木名也。
枯.eEn: Withered. Formed from 木, with 古 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Xia says: “Only 箘, 輅, and 枯.” Here 枯 is the name of a tree.

槀.eEn: A tree withered. Formed from 木, with 高 indicating the pronunciation.

蕕.eEn: A grass growing beside water. Formed from 艸, with 猶 indicating the pronunciation.

樸.eEn: Wood in its plain, unworked state. Formed from 木, with 菐 indicating the pronunciation.

楨.e: 剛木也。从木貞聲。上郡有楨林縣。
楨.eEn: A hard, strong tree. Formed from 木, with 貞 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Zhenlin County in Shang Commandery.

柔.eEn: Wood that can be bent or straightened. Formed from 木, with 矛 indicating the pronunciation.

柝.e: 判也。从木㡿聲。《易》曰：“重門擊𣔳。”
柝.eEn: To split apart. Formed from 木, with 㡿 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “Double gates, with watch clappers being struck.”

朸.e: 木之理也。从木力聲。平原有朸縣。
朸.eEn: The grain of wood. Formed from 木, with 力 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Li County in Pingyuan.

材.eEn: A stem or piece of timber. Formed from 木, with 才 indicating the pronunciation.

柴.eEn: Small pieces of wood; miscellaneous timber. Formed from 木, with 此 indicating the pronunciation.

榑.e: 榑桑，神木，日所出也。从木尃聲。
榑.eEn: 榑桑 is a divine tree where the sun rises. Formed from 木, with 尃 indicating the pronunciation.

杲.eEn: Bright. Formed from 日 above 木.

杳.eEn: Dark. Formed from 日 beneath 木.

祖.eEn: The temple of the founding ancestor. Formed from 示, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

荌.eEn: A kind of grass. Formed from 艸, with 安 indicating the pronunciation.

栽.e: 築牆長版也。从木𢦔聲。《春秋傳》曰：“楚圍蔡，里而𣒭。”
栽.eEn: Long boards used in building rammed-earth walls. Formed from 木, with 𢦔 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Chu besieged Cai, measuring out the distance in li and setting up wall-building boards.”

築.eEn: To pound or ram. Formed from 木, with 筑 indicating the pronunciation.

榦.eEn: The end timbers used in building rammed-earth walls. Formed from 木, with 倝 indicating the pronunciation.

檥.eEn: An upright supporting timber. Formed from 木, with 義 indicating the pronunciation.

構.e: 蓋也。从木冓聲。杜林以爲椽桷字。
構.eEn: To cover or roof over. Formed from 木, with 冓 indicating the pronunciation. Du Lin considers this a character meaning a rafter.

模.e: 法也。从木莫聲。讀若嫫母之嫫。
模.eEn: A model or standard. Formed from 木, with 莫 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 嫫 in the name 嫫母.

桴.eEn: A name for a ridgepole. Formed from 木, with 孚 indicating the pronunciation.

棟.eEn: The highest roof beam. Formed from 木, with 東 indicating the pronunciation.

極.eEn: A ridgepole. Formed from 木, with 亟 indicating the pronunciation.

藄.eEn: The plant called 綦月爾. Formed from 艸, with 綦 indicating the pronunciation.

柱.eEn: A pillar. Formed from 木, with 主 indicating the pronunciation.

楹.e: 柱也。从木盈聲。《春秋傳》曰：“丹桓宫楹。”
楹.eEn: A pillar. Formed from 木, with 盈 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “They painted the pillars of Duke Huan’s temple red.”

樘.eEn: A slanting supporting post. Formed from 木, with 堂 indicating the pronunciation.

榰.e: 柱砥。古用木，今以石。从木耆聲。《易》：“榰恒凶。”
榰.eEn: The base supporting a pillar. In ancient times wood was used; now stone is used. Formed from 木, with 耆 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “Persisting in support brings misfortune.”

櫨.e: 柱上柎也。从木盧聲。伊尹曰：“果之美者，箕山之東，青鳧之所，有櫨橘焉。夏孰也。”一曰宅櫨木，出弘農山也。
櫨.eEn: A supporting block above a pillar. Formed from 木, with 盧 indicating the pronunciation. Yi Yin says: “Among fine fruits, east of Mount Ji, where the blue ducks dwell, there are 櫨 oranges. They ripen in summer.” Another explanation: the 宅櫨 tree, which grows in the mountains of Hongnong.

枅.eEn: A supporting block in a roof structure. Formed from 木, with 幵 indicating the pronunciation.

栵.e: 栭也。从木𠛱聲。《詩》曰：“其灌其𣔜。”
栵.eEn: A roof support. Formed from 木, with 𠛱 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Its shrubs and its 栵 trees.”

栭.e: 屋枅上標。从木而聲。《爾雅》曰：“栭謂之㮞。”
栭.eEn: The upright member above a roof’s supporting block. Formed from 木, with 而 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “栭 is called 㮞.”

莃.eEn: The plant called “hare mallow.” Formed from 艸, with an abbreviated form of 稀 indicating the pronunciation.

檼.eEn: Roof-supporting beams. Formed from 木, with 㥯 indicating the pronunciation.

橑.eEn: A rafter. Formed from 木, with 𤋯 indicating the pronunciation.

桷.e: 榱也。椽方曰桷。从木角聲。《春秋傳》曰：“刻桓宫之桷。”
桷.eEn: A rafter. A square rafter is called 桷. Formed from 木, with 角 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “They carved the rafters of Duke Huan’s temple.”

椽.eEn: A rafter. Formed from 木, with 彖 indicating the pronunciation.

榱.e: 秦名爲屋椽，周謂之榱，齊魯謂之桷。从木衰聲。
榱.eEn: What Qin calls a roof rafter, Zhou calls 榱, and Qi and Lu call 桷. Formed from 木, with 衰 indicating the pronunciation.

楣.e: 秦名屋𣝼聯也。齊謂之檐，楚謂之梠。从木眉聲。
楣.eEn: The joining roof member called 𣝼聯 in Qin. In Qi it is called 檐, and in Chu it is called 梠. Formed from 木, with 眉 indicating the pronunciation.

梠.eEn: An eaves beam. Formed from 木, with 呂 indicating the pronunciation.

檐.eEn: The overhanging edge of a roof. Formed from 木, with 詹 indicating the pronunciation.

橝.e: 屋梠前也。从木覃聲。一曰蠶槌。
橝.eEn: The part in front of a roof’s eaves beam. Formed from 木, with 覃 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: a mallet used in silkworm raising.

樀.e: 戶樀也。从木啻聲。《爾雅》曰：“檐謂之樀。”讀若滴。
樀.eEn: The upper member of a doorway. Formed from 木, with 啻 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “檐 is called 樀.” Read like 滴.

植.eEn: The upright post of a doorway. Formed from 木, with 直 indicating the pronunciation.

樞.eEn: The pivot of a door. Formed from 木, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

槏.eEn: A door. Formed from 木, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

樓.eEn: A building with more than one story. Formed from 木, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation.

楯.eEn: A railing. Formed from 木, with 盾 indicating the pronunciation.

櫺.eEn: The small members between the rails of a railing. Formed from 木, with 霝 indicating the pronunciation.

杗.e: 棟也。从木亡聲。《爾雅》曰：“杗𢊺謂之梁。”
杗.eEn: A ridgepole. Formed from 木, with 亡 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “杗𢊺 is called a beam.”

蕧.eEn: The plant called 盜庚. Formed from 艸, with 復 indicating the pronunciation.

梀.eEn: A short rafter. Formed from 木, with 束 indicating the pronunciation.

杇.e: 所以涂也。秦謂之杇，關東謂之槾。从木亏聲。
杇.eEn: An implement used for plastering. In Qin it is called 杇; east of the passes it is called 槾. Formed from 木, with 亏 indicating the pronunciation.

槾.eEn: A plastering tool. Formed from 木, with 曼 indicating the pronunciation.

椳.eEn: A door pivot is called 椳. Formed from 木, with 畏 indicating the pronunciation.

梱.eEn: A door peg or stop. Formed from 木, with 困 indicating the pronunciation.

柤.eEn: A wooden barrier. Formed from 木, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

槍.e: 歫也。从木倉聲。一曰槍，欀也。
槍.eEn: To ward off. Formed from 木, with 倉 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: a supporting timber.

楗.eEn: A bar securing a door. Formed from 木, with 建 indicating the pronunciation.

苓.eEn: Cocklebur. Formed from 艸, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

櫼.eEn: A wedge. Formed from 木, with 韱 indicating the pronunciation.

楔.eEn: A wedge. Formed from 木, with 契 indicating the pronunciation.

柵.e: 編樹木也。从木从冊，冊亦聲。
柵.eEn: An enclosure made by arranging wooden stakes. Formed from 木 and 冊; 冊 also indicates the pronunciation.

杝.eEn: A fence. Formed from 木, with 也 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 他.

桓.eEn: A marker post at a postal station. Formed from 木, with 亘 indicating the pronunciation.

楃.eEn: A wooden tent frame. Formed from 木, with 屋 indicating the pronunciation.

橦.eEn: The main pole of a tent. Formed from 木, with 童 indicating the pronunciation.

杠.eEn: A horizontal wooden member at the front of a bed. Formed from 木, with 工 indicating the pronunciation.

桯.eEn: A small table placed before a bed. Formed from 木, with 呈 indicating the pronunciation.

桱.e: 桱桯也，東方謂之蕩。从木坙聲。
桱.eEn: A frame called 桱桯, known in the eastern regions as 蕩. Formed from 木, with 坙 indicating the pronunciation.

牀.eEn: A seat on which to rest the body. Formed from 木, with 爿 indicating the pronunciation.

枕.eEn: Something that supports the head when lying down. Formed from 木, with 冘 indicating the pronunciation.

楲.eEn: The chamber utensil called 楲窬. Formed from 木, with 威 indicating the pronunciation.

櫝.e: 匱也。从木賣聲。一曰木名。又曰：大梡也。
櫝.eEn: A chest. Formed from 木, with 賣 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: the name of a tree. Yet another definition: a large chopping block.

櫛.e: 梳比之總名也。从木節聲。
櫛.eEn: The general name for combs, both coarse-toothed and fine-toothed. Formed from 木, with 節 indicating the pronunciation.

梳.eEn: To arrange the hair. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 疏 indicating the pronunciation.

槈.eEn: A weeding implement. Formed from 木, with 辱 indicating the pronunciation.

藑.e: 茅，葍也。一名蕣。从艸夐聲。
藑.eEn: A grass: bindweed. Another name is 蕣. Formed from 艸, with 夐 indicating the pronunciation.

枱.eEn: The end of a plough handle. Formed from 木, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

楎.e: 六叉犂。一曰犂上曲木，犂轅。从木軍聲。讀若渾天之渾。
楎.eEn: A six-forked plough. Another definition: the curved piece of wood on a plough, its shaft. Formed from 木, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 渾 in 渾天.

櫌.e: 摩田器。从木憂聲。《論語》曰：“櫌而不輟。”
櫌.eEn: An implement for smoothing fields. Formed from 木, with 憂 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “He went on smoothing the field without stopping.”

欘.e: 斫也，齊謂之鎡錤。一曰斤柄，性自曲者。从木屬聲。
欘.eEn: A chopping implement, called 鎡錤 in Qi. Another definition: an axe handle whose natural shape is curved. Formed from 木, with 屬 indicating the pronunciation.

櫡.eEn: A chopping implement is called 櫡. Formed from 木, with 箸 indicating the pronunciation.

杷.eEn: An implement for gathering wheat. Formed from 木, with 巴 indicating the pronunciation.

柃.eEn: A tree. Formed from 木, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

柫.eEn: A flail for striking grain. Formed from 木, with 弗 indicating the pronunciation.

枷.e: 柫也。从木加聲。淮南謂之柍。
枷.eEn: A flail. Formed from 木, with 加 indicating the pronunciation. In Huainan it is called 柍.

杵.eEn: A pestle for pounding. Formed from 木, with 午 indicating the pronunciation.

槩.eEn: To level off the contents of dou and hu measures. Formed from 木, with 旣 indicating the pronunciation.

杚.eEn: To level. Formed from 木, with 气 indicating the pronunciation.

柶.eEn: The Book of Rites mentions the 柶. It is a spoon. Formed from 木, with 四 indicating the pronunciation.

桮.eEn: A cup. Formed from 木, with 否 indicating the pronunciation.

槃.eEn: A receiving tray. Formed from 木, with 般 indicating the pronunciation.

榹.eEn: A tray. Formed from 木, with 虒 indicating the pronunciation.

葍.eEn: Bindweed, also called 䔰. Formed from 艸, with 畐 indicating the pronunciation.

案.eEn: A kind of small table. Formed from 木, with 安 indicating the pronunciation.

檈.eEn: A round table. Formed from 木, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation.

椷.eEn: A receptacle, termed 钌. Formed from 木, with 咸 indicating the pronunciation.

枓.eEn: A ladle. Formed from 木 and 斗.

杓.eEn: The handle of a ladle. Formed from 木 and 勺.

櫑.e: 龜目酒尊，刻木作雲雷象。象施不窮也。从木畾聲。
櫑.eEn: A wine vessel with turtle-eye markings, carved from wood with patterns of clouds and thunder. These patterns symbolize giving without end. Formed from 木, with 畾 indicating the pronunciation.

椑.eEn: A round wine container. Formed from 木, with 卑 indicating the pronunciation.

榼.eEn: A wine vessel. Formed from 木, with 盍 indicating the pronunciation.

橢.e: 車笭中橢橢器也。从木隋聲。
橢.eEn: An elongated, rounded container within a carriage's basket compartment. Formed from 木, with 隋 indicating the pronunciation.

槌.e: 關東謂之槌，關西謂之㭙。从木追聲。
槌.eEn: Called 槌 east of the Pass and 㭙 west of the Pass. Formed from 木, with 追 indicating the pronunciation.

蓨.eEn: A shoot. Formed from 艸, with 脩 indicating the pronunciation.

栚.e: 槌之橫者也。關西謂之㯢。从木灷聲。
栚.eEn: The horizontal member of a 槌 frame. West of the Pass it is called 㯢. Formed from 木, with 灷 indicating the pronunciation.

槤.eEn: The ritual vessel called 瑚槤. Formed from 木, with 連 indicating the pronunciation.

櫎.e: 所以几器。从木廣聲。一曰帷屏風之屬。
櫎.eEn: Something used to support utensils. Formed from 木, with 廣 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: something of the kind used as a curtain or folding screen.

檕.eEn: The wooden piece at the end of a well rope. Formed from 木, with 毄 indicating the pronunciation.

檷.e: 絡絲檷。从木爾聲。讀若柅。
檷.eEn: A frame for winding silk thread. Formed from 木, with 爾 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 柅.

機.eEn: That which controls release is called 機. Formed from 木, with 幾 indicating the pronunciation.

榺.eEn: The part of a loom that holds the warp threads. Formed from 木, with 朕 indicating the pronunciation.

杼.eEn: The part of a loom that holds the weft thread. Formed from 木, with 予 indicating the pronunciation.

苖.eEn: A shoot, also called 蓨. Formed from 艸, with 由 indicating the pronunciation.

椱.eEn: The part of a loom that holds the silk fabric. Formed from 木, with 复 indicating the pronunciation.

楥.e: 履法也。从木爰聲。讀若指撝。
楥.eEn: A form for making shoes. Formed from 木, with 爰 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 撝 in 指撝.

核.e: 蠻夷以木皮爲篋，狀如籢尊。从木亥聲。
核.eEn: A basket made from tree bark by the Man and Yi peoples, shaped like a 籢 wine vessel. Formed from 木, with 亥 indicating the pronunciation.

棚.eEn: A raised wooden structure. Formed from 木, with 朋 indicating the pronunciation.

棧.e: 棚也。竹木之車曰棧。从木戔聲。
棧.eEn: A raised wooden structure. A vehicle made of bamboo and wood is called 棧. Formed from 木, with 戔 indicating the pronunciation.

栫.eEn: To enclose with brushwood and timber. Formed from 木, with 存 indicating the pronunciation.

槶.eEn: The bottom of a basket. Formed from 木, with 國 indicating the pronunciation.

梯.eEn: Wooden steps. Formed from 木, with 弟 indicating the pronunciation.

棖.e: 杖也。从木長聲。一曰法也。
棖.eEn: A staff. Formed from 木, with 長 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: a rule or standard.

桊.eEn: A ring in an ox's nose. Formed from 木, with 𢍏 indicating the pronunciation.

椯.e: 箠也。从木耑聲。一曰椯度也。一曰剟也。
椯.eEn: A whip. Formed from 木, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: to measure or estimate. Another definition: to cut away.

橜.e: 弋也。从木厥聲。一曰門梱也。
橜.eEn: A stake. Formed from 木, with 厥 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: a door threshold.

樴.eEn: A stake. Formed from 木, with 戠 indicating the pronunciation.

杖.eEn: To hold or support. Formed from 木, with 丈 indicating the pronunciation.

柭.eEn: A club. Formed from 木, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation.

棓.eEn: A wooden staff. Formed from 木, with 咅 indicating the pronunciation.

椎.e: 擊也。齊謂之終葵。从木隹聲。
椎.eEn: To strike. In Qi it is called 終葵. Formed from 木, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

柯.eEn: An axe handle. Formed from 木, with 可 indicating the pronunciation.

棁.eEn: A wooden staff. Formed from 木, with 兌 indicating the pronunciation.

柄.eEn: An axe handle. Formed from 木, with 丙 indicating the pronunciation.

薁.eEn: The plant called 嬰薁. Formed from 艸, with 奥 indicating the pronunciation.

柲.eEn: A pole of bundled rods. Formed from 木, with 必 indicating the pronunciation.

欑.e: 積竹杖也。从木贊聲。一曰穿也。一曰叢木。
欑.eEn: A staff made of gathered bamboo. Formed from 木, with 贊 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: to pierce. Another definition: a cluster of trees.

杘.eEn: The handle of a thread-winding frame. Formed from 木, with 尸 indicating the pronunciation.

榜.eEn: Something used to strengthen a bow or crossbow. Formed from 木, with 㫄 indicating the pronunciation.

桰.e: 𨽌也。从木𠯑聲。一曰矢栝，築弦處。
桰.eEn: A device for straightening a bow. Formed from 木, with 𠯑 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition: an arrow's nock, the place where the bowstring is seated.

棊.eEn: Pieces for the game of bo. Formed from 木, with 其 indicating the pronunciation.

椄.eEn: To join wood. Formed from 木, with 妾 indicating the pronunciation.

栙.e: 栙雙也。从木夅聲。讀若鴻。
栙.eEn: The sail called 栙雙. Formed from 木, with 夅 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 鴻.

葴.eEn: The plant called 馬藍, or horse indigo. Formed from 艸, with 咸 indicating the pronunciation.

栝.eEn: Wood for firing a cooking stove. Formed from 木, with 舌 indicating the pronunciation.

槽.eEn: A feeding vessel for domestic animals. Formed from 木, with 曹 indicating the pronunciation.

臬.e: 射凖的也。从木从自。李陽冰曰：“自非聲，从劓省。”
臬.eEn: A target used to guide shooting. Formed from 木 and 自. Li Yangbing says: “自 does not indicate the pronunciation; the character is formed with an abbreviated form of 劓.”

桶.eEn: A square wooden vessel holding six sheng. Formed from 木, with 甬 indicating the pronunciation.

櫓.eEn: A large shield. Formed from 木, with 魯 indicating the pronunciation.

樂.e: 五聲八音緫名。象鼓鞞。木，虡也。
樂.eEn: The general name for the five tones and the eight categories of musical sound. It depicts large and small drums. 木 represents their stand.

柎.eEn: The feet of a railing. Formed from 木, with 付 indicating the pronunciation.

枹.eEn: A stick for striking a drum. Formed from 木, with 包 indicating the pronunciation.

椌.eEn: The musical instrument called 柷. Formed from 木, with 空 indicating the pronunciation.

柷.e: 樂，木空也。所以止音爲節。从木，祝省聲。
柷.eEn: A musical instrument made of hollow wood. It is used to stop the sound and mark the musical divisions. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 祝 indicating the pronunciation.

槧.eEn: An unfinished wooden writing tablet. Formed from 木, with 斬 indicating the pronunciation.

札.eEn: A writing tablet. Formed from 木, with 乙 indicating the pronunciation.

檢.eEn: A written label or endorsement. Formed from 木, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation.

檄.eEn: A written document two chi long. Formed from 木, with 敫 indicating the pronunciation.

棨.eEn: A pass or credential, serving as proof of authorization. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 啟 indicating the pronunciation.

楘.e: 車歴録束文也。从木敄聲。《詩》曰：“五楘梁輈。”
楘.eEn: The patterned bindings around a carriage shaft. Formed from 木, with 敄 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Five sets of bindings adorn the curved shaft.”

枑.e: 行馬也。从木互聲。《周禮》曰：“設梐枑再重。”
枑.eEn: A barrier for blocking passage. Formed from 木, with 互 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “Set up two successive rows of barriers.”

梐.eEn: A barrier, as in 梐枑. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 陛 indicating the pronunciation.

极.e: 驢上負也。从木及聲。或讀若急。
极.eEn: A load carried on a donkey's back. Formed from 木, with 及 indicating the pronunciation. Alternatively, read like 急.

槅.eEn: The yoke of a large cart. Formed from 木, with 鬲 indicating the pronunciation.

橾.e: 車轂中空也。从木喿聲。讀若藪。
橾.eEn: The hollow inside a wheel hub. Formed from 木, with 喿 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 藪.

楇.e: 盛膏器。从木咼聲。讀若過。
楇.eEn: A vessel for holding grease. Formed from 木, with 咼 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 過.

枊.e: 馬柱。从木卬聲。一曰堅也。
枊.eEn: A post for tethering horses. Formed from 木, with 卬 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is “firm.”

棝.eEn: A 棝斗, a device with which rats can be shot. Formed from 木, with 固 indicating the pronunciation.

欙.e: 山行所乘者。从木纍聲。《虞書》曰：“予乘四載。”水行乘舟，陸行乘車，山行乘欙，澤行乘䡅。
欙.eEn: A conveyance used for traveling through mountains. Formed from 木, with 纍 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Yu says: “I traveled by four kinds of conveyance.” On water one travels by boat; on land, by carriage; in mountains, by 欙; and in marshes, by 䡅.

榷.e: 水上橫木，所以渡者也。从木隺聲。
榷.eEn: A timber laid across water for crossing it. Formed from 木, with 隺 indicating the pronunciation.

橋.eEn: A bridge over water. Formed from 木, with 喬 indicating the pronunciation.

梁.eEn: A bridge over water. Formed from 木 and 水, with 刅 indicating the pronunciation.

蔞.e: 艸也。可以亨魚。从艸婁聲。
蔞.eEn: An herb that can be used in cooking fish. Formed from 艸, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation.

橃.eEn: A large seagoing boat. Formed from 木, with 發 indicating the pronunciation.

楫.eEn: A boat's oar. Formed from 木, with 咠 indicating the pronunciation.

欚.eEn: The name of a large riverboat. Formed from 木, with 蠡 indicating the pronunciation.

校.eEn: A wooden restraint for prisoners. Formed from 木, with 交 indicating the pronunciation.

樔.eEn: A lookout tower for guarding vegetation in marshland. Formed from 木, with 巢 indicating the pronunciation.

采.eEn: To pluck and gather. Formed from 木 and 爪.

杮.e: 削木札樸也。从木巿聲。陳楚謂櫝爲杮。
杮.eEn: Chips and rough scraps produced by shaving wood. Formed from 木, with 巿 indicating the pronunciation. In Chen and Chu, a wooden case is called 杮.

横.eEn: A crosswise barrier timber. Formed from 木, with 黃 indicating the pronunciation.

梜.eEn: A clamping enclosure. Formed from 木, with 夾 indicating the pronunciation.

桄.eEn: To fill. Formed from 木, with 光 indicating the pronunciation.

藟.e: 艸也。从艸畾聲。《詩》曰：“莫莫葛藟。”一曰秬鬯也。
藟.eEn: An herb. Formed from 艸, with 畾 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Thickly growing are the kudzu and 藟 vines.” Another explanation identifies it with the black-millet sacrificial wine 秬鬯.

檇.e: 以木有所擣也。从木雋聲。《春秋傳》曰：“越敗吳於檇李。”
檇.eEn: To pound something with wood. Formed from 木, with 雋 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Yue defeated Wu at Zuili.”

椓.eEn: To strike. Formed from 木, with 豖 indicating the pronunciation.

朾.eEn: To ram or strike against. Formed from 木, with 丁 indicating the pronunciation.

柧.e: 棱也。从木瓜聲。又，柧棱，殿堂上最高之處也。
柧.eEn: An edge or ridge. Formed from 木, with 瓜 indicating the pronunciation. Also, 柧棱 is the highest part of a palace hall.

棱.eEn: An edge or ridge, like 柧. Formed from 木, with 夌 indicating the pronunciation.

枰.eEn: Level or flat. Formed from 木 and 平, with 平 also indicating the pronunciation.

柆.eEn: Broken wood. Formed from 木, with 立 indicating the pronunciation.

槎.e: 衺斫也。从木差聲。《春秋傳》曰：“山不槎。”
槎.eEn: To chop obliquely. Formed from 木, with 差 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The mountains are not subjected to indiscriminate chopping.”

柮.e: 斷也。从木出聲。讀若《爾雅》“貀無前足”之“貀”。
柮.eEn: To sever. Formed from 木, with 出 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 貀 in the Erya passage “The 貀 has no forefeet.”

蒬.eEn: The plant 棘蒬. Formed from 艸, with 冤 indicating the pronunciation.

檮.e: 斷木也。从木𠷎聲。《春秋傳》曰：“𣚑柮。”
檮.eEn: A cut piece of wood. Formed from 木, with 𠷎 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “A stump of wood.”

析.e: 破木也。一曰折也。从木从斤。
析.eEn: To split wood. Another meaning is “to break.” Formed from 木 and 斤.

棷.eEn: Wood used as fuel. Formed from 木, with 取 indicating the pronunciation.

梡.eEn: Unsplit wood used as fuel. Formed from 木, with 完 indicating the pronunciation.

楄.e: 楄部，方木也。从木扁聲。《春秋傳》曰：“楄部薦榦。”
楄.eEn: 楄部: squared timber. Formed from 木, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Squared timbers were laid beneath the body.”

楅.e: 以木有所逼束也。从木畐聲。《詩》曰：“夏而楅衡。”
楅.eEn: To constrain and bind something with wood. Formed from 木, with 畐 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “In summer, fit the cattle with restraining crossbars.”

枼.eEn: A flat piece of wood. 枼 means “thin.” Formed from 木, with 丗 indicating the pronunciation.

休.eEn: To rest or stop. Formed from 人 leaning against 木.

祰.eEn: A sacrifice for making an announcement. Formed from 示, with 告 indicating the pronunciation.

茈.eEn: The herb 茈. Formed from 艸, with 此 indicating the pronunciation.

械.e: 桎梏也。从木戒聲。一曰器之緫名。一曰持也。一曰有盛爲械，無盛爲器。
械.eEn: Fetters and hand restraints. Formed from 木, with 戒 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation calls it a general term for implements. Another meaning is “to hold.” Another explanation says: “An implement with a receptacle is called 械; one without a receptacle is called 器.”

杽.eEn: A restraint. Formed from 木 and 手, with 手 also indicating the pronunciation.

桎.eEn: A restraint for the feet. Formed from 木, with 至 indicating the pronunciation.

梏.eEn: A restraint for the hands. Formed from 木, with 告 indicating the pronunciation.

櫪.eEn: 櫪㯕: flat, fingerlike pieces. Formed from 木, with 歴 indicating the pronunciation.

檻.eEn: An enclosure or cage. Formed from 木, with 監 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is “a pen.”

櫳.eEn: An enclosure or cage. Formed from 木, with 龍 indicating the pronunciation.

柙.e: 檻也。以藏虎兕。从木甲聲。
柙.eEn: A cage used to confine tigers and rhinoceroses. Formed from 木, with 甲 indicating the pronunciation.

棺.e: 關也。所以掩尸。从木官聲。
棺.eEn: To enclose; that which covers a corpse. Formed from 木, with 官 indicating the pronunciation.

櫬.e: 棺也。从木親聲。《春秋傳》曰：“士輿櫬。”
櫬.eEn: A coffin. Formed from 木, with 親 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The officers carried coffins on carts.”

槥.eEn: A coffin or coffin box. Formed from 木, with 彗 indicating the pronunciation.

椁.eEn: A wooden outer enclosure used in burial. Formed from 木, with 𩫏 indicating the pronunciation.

楬.e: 楬桀也。从木曷聲。《春秋傳》曰：“楬而書之。”
楬.eEn: An upright wooden marker. Formed from 木, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Set up a marker and write upon it.”

梟.e: 不孝鳥也。日至，捕梟磔之。从鳥頭在木上。
梟.eEn: An unfilial bird. At the solstice, owls are caught and their bodies exposed after dismemberment. Formed by depicting a bird's head on 木.

棐.eEn: To assist. Formed from 木, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

梔.eEn: A tree whose fruit can be used for dyeing. Formed from 木, with 巵 indicating the pronunciation.

榭.eEn: A raised platform with a roofed structure on it. Formed from 木, with 䠶 indicating the pronunciation.

槊.eEn: A spear. Formed from 木, with 朔 indicating the pronunciation.

萴.eEn: The herb 烏喙, “crow's beak.” Formed from 艸, with 則 indicating the pronunciation.

椸.eEn: A clothes rack. Formed from 木, with 施 indicating the pronunciation.

榻.eEn: A couch or bed. Formed from 木, with 𦐇 indicating the pronunciation.

櫍.eEn: A supporting base. Formed from 木, with 質 indicating the pronunciation.

櫂.e: 所以進舩也。从木翟聲。或从卓。《史記》通用濯。
櫂.eEn: An implement used to propel a boat. Formed from 木, with 翟 indicating the pronunciation. A variant is formed with 卓. The Records of the Grand Historian uses 濯 interchangeably.

槹.e: 桔槹，汲水器也。从木臯聲。
槹.eEn: 桔槹: a device for drawing water. Formed from 木, with 臯 indicating the pronunciation.

樁.eEn: A stake or post. Formed from 木, with 舂 indicating the pronunciation.

櫻.eEn: A fruit. Formed from 木, with 嬰 indicating the pronunciation.

栜.eEn: The tree 桋. Formed from 木, with an abbreviated form of 策 indicating the pronunciation.

東.e: 動也。从木。官溥說：从日在木中。凡東之屬皆从東。
東.eEn: To move. Formed from 木. Guan Pu explains: “Formed from 日 within 木.” All characters in the 東 class are formed with 東.

蒐.e: 茅蒐，茹藘。人血所生，可以染絳。从艸从鬼。
蒐.eEn: 茅蒐, also called 茹藘: madder. It grows from human blood and can be used to dye a deep red. Formed from 艸 and 鬼.

林.e: 平土有叢木曰林。从二木。凡林之屬皆从林。
林.eEn: A cluster of trees on level ground is called 林. Formed from two 木 components. All characters in the 林 class are formed with 林.

鬱.eEn: Trees growing densely together. Formed from 林, with an abbreviated form of 𩰪 indicating the pronunciation.

楚.e: 叢木。一名荊也。从林疋聲。
楚.eEn: A cluster of trees or shrubs. Another name is 荊. Formed from 林, with 疋 indicating the pronunciation.

棽.e: 木枝條棽儷皃。从林今聲。
棽.eEn: The appearance of tree branches spreading luxuriantly. Formed from 林, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

楙.eEn: Luxuriant growth of trees. Formed from 林, with 矛 indicating the pronunciation.

麓.e: 守山林吏也。从林鹿聲。一曰林屬於山爲麓。《春秋傳》曰：“沙麓崩。”
麓.eEn: An official who guards mountain forests. Formed from 林, with 鹿 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says that woodland adjoining a mountain is called 麓. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Shalu collapsed.”

棼.eEn: The ridgepole of a multistory building. Formed from 林, with 分 indicating the pronunciation.

森.e: 木多皃。从林从木。讀若曾參之參。
森.eEn: The appearance of many trees. Formed from 林 and 木. Read like 參 in the name Zeng Shen.

梵.e: 出自西域釋書，未詳意義。
梵.eEn: It comes from Buddhist writings of the Western Regions; its meaning has not been ascertained.

茜.eEn: Madder, also called 茅蒐. Formed from 艸, with 西 indicating the pronunciation.

才.e: 艸木之初也。从丨上貫一，將生枝葉。一，地也。凡才之屬皆从才。
才.eEn: The beginning of plant growth. Formed from 丨 piercing upward through 一, about to produce branches and leaves. 一 represents the ground. All characters in the 才 class are formed with 才.

叒.e: 日初出東方湯谷，所登榑桑，叒木也。象形。凡叒之屬皆从叒。
叒.eEn: When the sun first rises in the east at Tang Valley, the Fusang tree that it ascends is the 叒 tree. A pictograph. All characters in the 叒 class are formed with 叒.

桑.eEn: The tree whose leaves silkworms eat. Formed from 叒 and 木.

之.e: 出也。象艸過屮，枝莖益大，有所之。一者，地也。凡之之屬皆从之。
之.eEn: To emerge. It depicts vegetation growing beyond the sprout stage, its branches and stems becoming larger and extending onward. 一 represents the ground. All characters in the 之 class are formed with 之.

帀.e: 周也。从反之而帀也。凡帀之屬皆从帀。周盛說。
帀.eEn: To go all the way around. Formed from an inverted 之, expressing a complete circuit. All characters in the 帀 class are formed with 帀. This is Zhou Sheng's explanation.

師.e: 二千五百人爲師。从帀从𠂤。𠂤，四帀，眾意也。
師.eEn: A force of 2,500 people constitutes a 師. Formed from 帀 and 𠂤. 𠂤, surrounded on all four sides, conveys the idea of a multitude.

出.e: 進也。象艸木益滋，上出達也。凡出之屬皆从出。
出.eEn: To advance. It depicts plants growing increasingly luxuriant and emerging upward. All characters in the 出 class are formed with 出.

賣.eEn: To put goods out for sale. Formed from 出 and 買.

糶.e: 出穀也。从出从䊮，䊮亦聲。
糶.eEn: To put grain out for sale. Formed from 出 and 䊮, with 䊮 also indicating the pronunciation.

索.e: 艸有莖葉，可作繩索。从𣎵、糸。杜林說：𣎵亦朱木字。
索.eEn: A plant with stems and leaves that can be made into rope. Formed from 𣎵 and 糸. Du Lin explains: “𣎵 is also the character for the red tree.”

孛.e: 𢍚也，从𣎵；人色也，从子。《論語》曰：“色孛如也。”
孛.eEn: Luxuriant growth, expressed through 𣎵; also a person's countenance, expressed through 子. The Analects says: “His countenance was solemn.”

南.e: 艸木至南方，有枝任也。从𣎵𢆉聲。
南.eEn: When plants reach the south, they have branches capable of bearing a load. Formed from 𣎵, with 𢆉 indicating the pronunciation.

生.e: 進也。象艸木生出土上。凡生之屬皆从生。
生.eEn: To advance. It depicts plants growing out above the soil. All characters in the 生 class are formed with 生.

丰.eEn: The luxuriant, flourishing appearance of plants. Formed from 生, extending through above and below.

薜.eEn: The plant called 牡贊. Formed from 艸, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

産.eEn: To give birth. Formed from 生, with an abbreviated form of 彥 indicating the pronunciation.

甤.e: 草木實甤甤也。从生，豨省聲。讀若綏。
甤.eEn: The drooping, luxuriant appearance of the fruits of plants and trees. Formed from 生, with an abbreviated form of 豨 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 綏.

甡.e: 眾生並立之兒。从二生。《詩》曰：“甡甡其鹿。”
甡.eEn: The appearance of many living creatures standing together. Formed from two 生 components. The Book of Odes says: “Its deer stand in a multitude.”

乇.e: 艸葉也。从垂穗，上貫一，下有根。象形。凡乇之屬皆从乇。
乇.eEn: A plant's leaves. It depicts a hanging ear of grain, passing upward through 一, with roots below. A pictograph. All characters in the 乇 class are formed with 乇.

華.e: 榮也。从艸从𠌶。凡華之屬皆从華。
華.eEn: Blossoms. Formed from 艸 and 𠌶. All characters in the 華 class are formed with 華.

皣.eEn: The white blossoms of plants and trees. Formed from 華 and 白.

莣.eEn: The plant called 杜榮. Formed from 艸, with 忘 indicating the pronunciation.

稽.e: 畱止也。从𥝌从尤，旨聲。凡稽之屬皆从稽。
稽.eEn: To remain; to stop. Formed from 𥝌 and 尤, with 旨 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 稽 class are formed with 稽.

巢.e: 鳥在木上曰巢，在穴曰窠。从木，象形。凡巢之屬皆从巢。
巢.eEn: A bird's dwelling in a tree is called 巢; one in a hole is called 窠. Formed from 木. A pictograph. All characters in the 巢 class are formed with 巢.

桼.e: 木汁。可以䰍物。象形。桼如水滴而下。凡桼之屬皆从桼。
桼.eEn: Tree sap, which can be used to lacquer objects. A pictograph. The sap is shown dripping downward like water. All characters in the 桼 class are formed with 桼.

苞.e: 艸也。南陽以爲麤履。从艸包聲。
苞.eEn: A plant used in Nanyang to make coarse shoes. Formed from 艸, with 包 indicating the pronunciation.

束.e: 縛也。从囗、木。凡束之屬皆从束。
束.eEn: To bind. Formed from 囗 and 木. All characters in the 束 class are formed with 束.

柬.e: 分別𥳑之也。从束从八。八，分別也。
柬.eEn: To distinguish and select. Formed from 束 and 八. 八 means to separate and distinguish.

剌.e: 戾也。从束从刀。刀者，剌之也。
剌.eEn: To go against; to be contrary. Formed from 束 and 刀. 刀 represents cutting it apart.

橐.eEn: A sack. Formed from an abbreviated form of 㯻, with 石 indicating the pronunciation.

囊.eEn: A bag. Formed from an abbreviated form of 㯻, with an abbreviated form of 襄 indicating the pronunciation.

櫜.e: 車上大橐。从㯻省，咎聲。《詩》曰：“載櫜弓矢。”
櫜.eEn: A large sack carried on a carriage. Formed from an abbreviated form of 㯻, with 咎 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Then put away the bows and arrows in their cases.”

艾.eEn: The plant called 冰臺, mugwort. Formed from 艸, with 乂 indicating the pronunciation.

囗.e: 回也。象回帀之形。凡囗之屬皆从囗。
囗.eEn: To surround. It depicts a shape enclosing something on all sides. All characters in the 囗 class are formed with 囗.

圜.eEn: The form of heaven. Formed from 囗, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation.

團.eEn: Round. Formed from 囗, with 專 indicating the pronunciation.

囩.eEn: To turn or go around. Formed from 囗, with 云 indicating the pronunciation.

圓.e: 圜全也。从囗員聲。讀若員。
圓.eEn: Round and complete. Formed from 囗, with 員 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 員.

回.eEn: To turn. Formed from 囗; the interior depicts a turning movement.

圖.e: 畫計難也。从囗从啚。啚，難意也。
圖.eEn: To draw up plans for difficulties. Formed from 囗 and 啚. 啚 conveys the idea of difficulty.

圛.e: 回行也。从囗睪聲。《尚書》：“曰圛。” 圛，升雲半有半無。讀若驛。
圛.eEn: To move in a circling course. Formed from 囗, with 睪 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Documents says: “It is called 圛.” 圛 describes rising clouds, partly present and partly absent. Pronounced like 驛.

國.eEn: A state. Formed from 囗 and 或.

祏.e: 宗廟主也。《周禮》有郊、宗、石室。一曰大夫以石爲主。从示从石，石亦聲。
祏.eEn: An ancestral tablet in the ancestral temple. The Rites of Zhou mentions stone chambers at the suburban sacrificial site and the ancestral temple. Another explanation is that a grand officer uses stone for his ancestral tablet. Formed from 示 and 石, with 石 also indicating the pronunciation.

蔁.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 章 indicating the pronunciation.

囷.e: 廩之圜者。从禾在囗中。圜謂之囷，方謂之京。
囷.eEn: A round granary. Formed from 禾 inside 囗. A round one is called 囷; a square one is called 京.

圈.eEn: An enclosure for raising livestock. Formed from 囗, with 卷 indicating the pronunciation.

囿.e: 苑有垣也。从囗有聲。一曰禽獸曰囿。
囿.eEn: A park enclosed by walls. Formed from 囗, with 有 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is that a park for birds and beasts is called 囿.

園.eEn: A place for planting fruit trees. Formed from 囗, with 袁 indicating the pronunciation.

圃.eEn: A place where vegetables are planted is called 圃. Formed from 囗, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation.

因.eEn: To approach or attach oneself to. Formed from 囗 and 大.

囹.eEn: A prison. Formed from 囗, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

圄.eEn: To keep under guard. Formed from 囗, with 吾 indicating the pronunciation.

芹.eEn: The plant called 楚葵. Formed from 艸, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation.

囚.eEn: To confine. Formed from 人 inside 囗.

固.eEn: Closed off on all four sides. Formed from 囗, with 古 indicating the pronunciation.

圍.eEn: To guard. Formed from 囗, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

困.eEn: An old dwelling. Formed from 木 inside 囗.

圂.e: 廁也。从囗，象豕在囗中也。會意。
圂.eEn: A privy. Formed from 囗, depicting a pig inside an enclosure. A compound conveying meaning through its components.

囮.e: 譯也。从囗、化。率鳥者繫生鳥以來之，名曰囮。讀若譌。又音由。
囮.eEn: To interpret or convey. Formed from 囗 and 化. A bird-catcher ties up a live bird to attract others; it is called 囮. Pronounced like 譌. It also has the pronunciation of 由.

員.e: 物數也。从貝囗聲。凡員之屬皆从員。
員.eEn: The number of things. Formed from 貝, with 囗 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 員 class are formed with 員.

貝.e: 海介蟲也。居陸名猋，在水名蜬。象形。古者貨貝而寶龜，周而有泉，至秦廢貝行錢。凡貝之屬皆从貝。
貝.eEn: A marine shell-bearing creature, called 猋 on land and 蜬 in water. A pictograph. In antiquity, cowries served as money and tortoise shells were treasured; coinage appeared under the Zhou, and the Qin abolished cowries in favor of coins. All characters in the 貝 class are formed with 貝.

薽.eEn: The plant called 豕首, “pig's head.” Formed from 艸, with 甄 indicating the pronunciation.

賄.eEn: Wealth or property. Formed from 貝, with 有 indicating the pronunciation.

財.eEn: What people treasure. Formed from 貝, with 才 indicating the pronunciation.

貨.eEn: Wealth or goods. Formed from 貝, with 化 indicating the pronunciation.

資.eEn: Goods or property. Formed from 貝, with 次 indicating the pronunciation.

贎.eEn: Goods or property. Formed from 貝, with 萬 indicating the pronunciation.

賑.eEn: Wealthy. Formed from 貝, with 辰 indicating the pronunciation.

賢.eEn: Having many talents. Formed from 貝, with 臤 indicating the pronunciation.

賁.eEn: To adorn. Formed from 貝, with 卉 indicating the pronunciation.

賀.e: 以禮相奉慶也。从貝加聲。
賀.eEn: To offer ceremonial gifts to one another in celebration. Formed from 貝, with 加 indicating the pronunciation.

蔦.e: 寄生也。从艸鳥聲。《詩》曰：“蔦與女蘿。”
蔦.eEn: A parasitic plant. Formed from 艸, with 鳥 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The 蔦 and the 女蘿.”

貢.eEn: To present the products of one's work. Formed from 貝, with 工 indicating the pronunciation.

贊.eEn: To present oneself. Formed from 貝 and 兟.

賮.eEn: Gifts offered at a meeting. Formed from 貝, with 纬 indicating the pronunciation.

齎.eEn: To carry something as a gift. Formed from 貝, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation.

貸.eEn: To bestow. Formed from 貝, with 代 indicating the pronunciation.

貣.eEn: To ask another person for something. Formed from 貝, with 弋 indicating the pronunciation.

賂.eEn: To give a gift. Formed from 貝, with 各 indicating the pronunciation.

賸.e: 物相增加也。从貝朕聲。一曰送也，副也。
賸.eEn: Things increasing through addition to one another. Formed from 貝, with 朕 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to send; also, an additional or secondary portion.

贈.eEn: To send one another cherished objects as gifts. Formed from 貝, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

貱.eEn: To transfer and give. Formed from 貝, with 皮 indicating the pronunciation.

芸.e: 艸也。似目宿。从艸云聲。《淮南子》說：“芸艸可以死復生。”
芸.eEn: A plant resembling alfalfa. Formed from 艸, with 云 indicating the pronunciation. The Huainanzi says: “The 芸 plant can die and come back to life.”

賚.e: 賜也。从貝來聲。《周書》曰：“賚尒秬鬯。”
賚.eEn: To bestow. Formed from 貝, with 來 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “I bestow upon you black-millet sacrificial wine.”

賞.eEn: To reward those who have rendered service. Formed from 貝, with 尚 indicating the pronunciation.

賜.eEn: To give. Formed from 貝, with 易 indicating the pronunciation.

貤.eEn: To arrange things in successive layers or ranks. Formed from 貝, with 也 indicating the pronunciation.

贏.eEn: To have a surplus; profit from trade. Formed from 貝, with 𦝠 indicating the pronunciation.

賴.eEn: To gain a surplus or profit. Formed from 貝, with 剌 indicating the pronunciation.

負.e: 恃也。从人守貝，有所恃也。一曰受貸不償。
負.eEn: To rely on. Formed from a person guarding shells, having something to rely on. Another explanation is to receive a loan and fail to repay it.

貯.eEn: To accumulate. Formed from 貝, with 宁 indicating the pronunciation.

貳.e: 副、益也。从貝弍聲。弍，古文二。
貳.eEn: A secondary portion; an addition. Formed from 貝, with 弍 indicating the pronunciation. 弍 is the ancient-script form of 二.

賓.eEn: Someone who is treated with respect. Formed from 貝, with 𡧍 indicating the pronunciation.

賖.eEn: To buy on credit. Formed from 貝, with 余 indicating the pronunciation.

貰.eEn: To lend. Formed from 貝, with 丗 indicating the pronunciation.

贅.e: 以物質錢。从敖、貝。敖者，猶放；貝，當復取之也。
贅.eEn: To pledge an object for money. Formed from 敖 and 貝. 敖 is like releasing or letting go; 貝 indicates that it is to be taken back again.

質.eEn: To pledge objects to one another. Formed from 貝 and 斦. Explanation missing in the source.

貿.eEn: To exchange goods. Formed from 貝, with 戼 indicating the pronunciation.

贖.eEn: To exchange or trade. Formed from 貝, with 𧸇 indicating the pronunciation.

費.eEn: To expend wealth and resources. Formed from 貝, with 弗 indicating the pronunciation.

責.eEn: To demand or seek. Formed from 貝, with 朿 indicating the pronunciation.

賈.e: 賈市也。从貝襾聲。一曰坐賣售也。
賈.eEn: To trade in the market. Formed from 貝, with 襾 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to sell goods while remaining at a fixed place.

葎.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 律 indicating the pronunciation.

販.eEn: Someone who buys cheaply and sells dearly. Formed from 貝, with 反 indicating the pronunciation.

買.e: 市也。从网、貝。《孟子》曰：“登壟斷而网市利。”
買.eEn: To buy. Formed from 网 and 貝. The Mencius says: “He climbed a prominent mound and netted the profits of the market.”

賤.eEn: Low in price. Formed from 貝, with 戔 indicating the pronunciation.

賦.eEn: To levy or collect. Formed from 貝, with 武 indicating the pronunciation.

貪.eEn: To desire possessions. Formed from 貝, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

貶.eEn: To diminish. Formed from 貝 and 乏.

貧.e: 財分少也。从貝从分，分亦聲。
貧.eEn: To have only a small share of wealth. Formed from 貝 and 分, with 分 also indicating the pronunciation.

賃.eEn: To hire. Formed from 貝, with 任 indicating the pronunciation.

賕.e: 以財物枉法相謝也。从貝求聲。一曰戴質也。
賕.eEn: To use wealth or goods to reward someone for perverting the law. Formed from 貝, with 求 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to bear a pledge.

茦.eEn: A thorn or prickle. Formed from 艸, with 朿 indicating the pronunciation.

購.e: 以財有所求也。从貝冓聲。
購.eEn: To seek something by means of wealth. Formed from 貝, with 冓 indicating the pronunciation.

貲.e: 小罰以財自贖也。从貝此聲。漢律：民不繇，貲錢二十二。
貲.eEn: A minor penalty paid in wealth to redeem oneself. Formed from 貝, with 此 indicating the pronunciation. Han law states: “A commoner who does not perform corvée labor is fined twenty-two coins.”

賨.eEn: A levy imposed on the southern Man peoples. Formed from 貝, with 宗 indicating the pronunciation.

貴.e: 物不賤也。从貝臾聲。臾，古文蕢。
貴.eEn: For a thing to be valuable rather than cheap. Formed from 貝, with 臾 indicating the pronunciation. 臾 is the ancient-script form of 蕢.

賏.eEn: An ornament worn around the neck. Formed from two 貝 components.

貺.eEn: To bestow. Formed from 貝, with 兄 indicating the pronunciation.

賵.e: 贈死者。从貝从冒。冒者，衣衾覆冒之意。
賵.eEn: To present gifts for a deceased person. Formed from 貝 and 冒. 冒 conveys the idea of covering the deceased with garments and quilts.

賭.eEn: To play games of bo and sai. Formed from 貝, with 者 indicating the pronunciation.

貼.eEn: To use an object as a pledge. Formed from 貝, with 占 indicating the pronunciation.

貽.e: 贈遺也。从貝台聲。經典通用詒。
貽.eEn: To give as a present. Formed from 貝, with 台 indicating the pronunciation. In the classics, 詒 is used interchangeably with it.

賽.eEn: To make a return or recompense. Formed from 貝, with an abbreviated form of 塞 indicating the pronunciation.

賻.eEn: To assist. Formed from 貝, with 尃 indicating the pronunciation.

贍.eEn: To supply what is needed. Formed from 貝, with 詹 indicating the pronunciation.

邑.e: 國也。从囗；先王之制，尊卑有大小，从卪。凡邑之屬皆从邑。
邑.eEn: A state. Formed from 囗 and 卪: under the institutions of the former kings, states differed in size according to rank. All characters in the 邑 class are formed with 邑.

邦.eEn: A state. Formed from 邑, with 丰 indicating the pronunciation.

郡.e: 周制：天子地方千里，分爲百縣，縣有四郡。故《春秋傳》曰“上大夫受郡”是也。至秦初置三十六郡，以監其縣。从邑君聲。
郡.eEn: Under the Zhou system, the Son of Heaven's territory was a thousand li square, divided into one hundred counties, each containing four commanderies. Thus the Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says, “A senior grand officer receives a commandery.” At the beginning of Qin rule, thirty-six commanderies were established to oversee their counties. Formed from 邑, with 君 indicating the pronunciation.

都.e: 有先君之舊宗廟曰都。从邑者聲。周禮：距國五百里爲都。
都.eEn: A settlement possessing an ancestral temple inherited from a former ruler is called a du. Formed from 邑, with 者 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou states: “The area five hundred li from the capital is the du domain.”

葑.eEn: The plant called xucong. Formed from 艸, with 封 indicating the pronunciation.

鄰.eEn: Five households constitute a neighborhood. Formed from 邑, with 粦 indicating the pronunciation.

酇.e: 百家爲酇。酇，聚也。从邑贊聲。南陽有酇縣。
酇.eEn: One hundred households constitute a zan. Zan means an aggregation. Formed from 邑, with 贊 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Zan County in Nanyang.

鄙.eEn: Five zan constitute a bi district. Formed from 邑, with 啚 indicating the pronunciation.

郊.e: 距國百里爲郊。从邑交聲。
郊.eEn: The area one hundred li from the capital is called the suburbs. Formed from 邑, with 交 indicating the pronunciation.

邸.eEn: A lodging house for dependent states. Formed from 邑, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation.

郛.eEn: An outer city wall. Formed from 邑, with 孚 indicating the pronunciation.

郵.e: 境上行書舍。从邑、垂。垂，邊也。
郵.eEn: A station on a territorial boundary for conveying written dispatches. Formed from 邑 and 垂. 垂 means an edge or boundary.

鄯.e: 鄯善，西胡國也。从邑从善，善亦聲。
鄯.eEn: Shanshan, a state of the western Hu peoples. Formed from 邑 and 善, with 善 also indicating the pronunciation.

丕.eEn: Great. Formed from 一, with 不 indicating the pronunciation.

薺.e: 蒺棃也。从艸齊聲。《詩》曰：“牆有薺。”
薺.eEn: The plant called jili, or caltrop. Formed from 艸, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “On the wall grows caltrop.”

邰.e: 炎帝之後，姜姓所封，周棄外家國。从邑台聲。右扶風斄縣是也。《詩》曰：“有邰家室。”
邰.eEn: The state enfeoffed to descendants of the Flame Emperor bearing the Jiang surname; it was the state of the maternal family of Qi, ancestor of the Zhou. Formed from 邑, with 台 indicating the pronunciation. It is present-day Tai County in Youfufeng. The Book of Odes says: “He established his household in Tai.”

邠.e: 周太王國。在右扶風美陽。从邑分聲。
邠.eEn: The state of King Tai of Zhou, located in Meiyang in Youfufeng. Formed from 邑, with 分 indicating the pronunciation.

郿.eEn: A county in Youfufeng. Formed from 邑, with 眉 indicating the pronunciation.

郁.e: 右扶風郁夷也。从邑有聲。
郁.eEn: Yuyi in Youfufeng. Formed from 邑, with 有 indicating the pronunciation.

鄠.eEn: The name of a county in Youfufeng. Formed from 邑, with 雩 indicating the pronunciation.

扈.e: 夏后同姓所封，戰於甘者。在鄠，有扈谷、甘亭。从邑戶聲。
扈.eEn: The fief granted to a clan sharing the surname of the rulers of Xia, whose people fought at Gan. It lies in Hu, where there are Hu Valley and Gan Pavilion. Formed from 邑, with 戶 indicating the pronunciation.

莿.eEn: A thorn. Formed from 艸, with 刺 indicating the pronunciation.

郝.e: 右扶風鄠、盩厔鄉。从邑赤聲。
郝.eEn: A township in the area of Hu and Zhouzhi in Youfufeng. Formed from 邑, with 赤 indicating the pronunciation.

酆.e: 周文王所都。在京兆杜陵西南。从邑豐聲。
酆.eEn: The capital established by King Wen of Zhou. It lies southwest of Duling in Jingzhao. Formed from 邑, with 豐 indicating the pronunciation.

鄭.e: 京兆縣。周厲王子友所封。从邑奠聲。宗周之滅，鄭徙潧洧之上，今新鄭是也。
鄭.eEn: A county in Jingzhao, enfeoffed to You, son of King Li of Zhou. Formed from 邑, with 奠 indicating the pronunciation. When Zongzhou fell, Zheng moved to the banks of the Zhen and Wei rivers; this is present-day Xinzheng.

郃.e: 左馮翊郃陽縣。从邑合聲。《詩》曰：“在郃之陽。”
郃.eEn: Heyang County in Zuopingyi. Formed from 邑, with 合 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “On the sunny side of the He.”

邮.eEn: A place in Gaoling in Zuopingyi. Formed from 邑, with 由 indicating the pronunciation.

蕫.e: 鼎蕫也。从艸童聲。杜林曰：藕根。
蕫.eEn: The plant called dingdong. Formed from 艸, with 童 indicating the pronunciation. Du Lin says: “Lotus root.”

邽.eEn: Shanggui in Longxi. Formed from 邑, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

部.eEn: Dibu in Tianshui. Formed from 邑, with 咅 indicating the pronunciation.

郖.eEn: A granary site in Hongnong County. Formed from 邑, with 豆 indicating the pronunciation.

鄏.e: 河南縣直城門官陌地也。从邑辱聲。《春秋傳》曰：“成王定鼎于郟鄏。”
鄏.eEn: A place on the official road directly facing the city gate in Henan County. Formed from 邑, with 辱 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “King Cheng established the tripods at Jiaru.”

鄻.eEn: A Zhou settlement. Formed from 邑, with 輦 indicating the pronunciation.

邙.e: 河南洛陽北亡山上邑。从邑亡聲。
邙.eEn: A settlement on Mount Mang north of Luoyang in Henan. Formed from 邑, with 亡 indicating the pronunciation.

鄩.eEn: A Zhou settlement. Formed from 邑, with 尋 indicating the pronunciation.

郗.e: 周邑也。在河内。从邑希聲。
郗.eEn: A Zhou settlement in Henei. Formed from 邑, with 希 indicating the pronunciation.

鄆.e: 河内沁水鄉。从邑軍聲。魯有鄆地。
鄆.eEn: A township in Qinshui in Henei. Formed from 邑, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation. There is also a place called Yun in Lu.

蘻.eEn: The plant called goudu, “dog poison.” Formed from 艸, with 繫 indicating the pronunciation.

邶.e: 故商邑。自河内朝歌以北是也。从邑北聲。
邶.eEn: An old Shang settlement, referring to the territory north of Chaoge in Henei. Formed from 邑, with 北 indicating the pronunciation.

邘.e: 周武王子所封。在河内野王是也。从邑于聲。又讀若區。
邘.eEn: The fief granted to a son of King Wu of Zhou. It is located in Yewang in Henei. Formed from 邑, with 于 indicating the pronunciation. It is also read like 區.

邵.eEn: A settlement of Jin. Formed from 邑, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

鄍.e: 晉邑也。从邑冥聲。《春秋傳》曰：“伐鄍三門。”
鄍.eEn: A settlement of Jin. Formed from 邑, with 冥 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “They attacked the three gates of Ming.”

鄐.eEn: A settlement belonging to the Marquis of Xing in Jin. Formed from 邑, with 畜 indicating the pronunciation.

邲.e: 晉邑也。从邑必聲。《春秋傳》曰：“晋楚戰于邲。”
邲.eEn: A settlement of Jin. Formed from 邑, with 必 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Jin and Chu fought at Bi.”

郤.e: 晉大夫叔虎邑也。从邑谷聲。
郤.eEn: The settlement of Shuhu, a grand officer of Jin. Formed from 邑, with 谷 indicating the pronunciation.

邼.eEn: A township in Wenxi in Hedong. Formed from 邑, with 匡 indicating the pronunciation.

鄈.e: 河東臨汾地，即漢之所祭后土處。从邑癸聲。
鄈.eEn: A place in Linfen in Hedong, where the Han court sacrifices to the Earth Deity. Formed from 邑, with 癸 indicating the pronunciation.

郉.e: 周公子所封，地近河内懷。从邑幵聲。
郉.eEn: The fief granted to a son of the Duke of Zhou; its territory lies near Huai in Henei. Formed from 邑, with 幵 indicating the pronunciation.

鄔.eEn: A county in Taiyuan. Formed from 邑, with 烏 indicating the pronunciation.

祁.eEn: A county in Taiyuan. Formed from 邑, with 示 indicating the pronunciation.

鄴.eEn: A county in Wei Commandery. Formed from 邑, with 業 indicating the pronunciation.

邯.eEn: Handan County in Zhao. Formed from 邑, with 甘 indicating the pronunciation.

鄲.eEn: Handan County. Formed from 邑, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

芐.e: 地黃也。从艸下聲。《禮記》“鈃毛：牛、藿；羊、芐；豕、薇。”是。
芐.eEn: Rehmannia. Formed from 艸, with 下 indicating the pronunciation. This is the word in the Book of Rites passage: “For slipping off the hair: for cattle, bean leaves; for sheep, rehmannia; for pigs, wild vetch.”

郇.e: 周武王子所封國，在晉地。从邑旬聲。讀若泓。
郇.eEn: A state enfeoffed to a son of King Wu of Zhou, situated in the territory of Jin. Formed from 邑, with 旬 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 泓.

鄃.eEn: A county in Qinghe. Formed from 邑, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

鄗.e: 常山縣。丗祖所卽位，今爲高邑。从邑高聲。
鄗.eEn: A county in Changshan. It is where Emperor Shizu ascended the throne and is now called Gaoyi. Formed from 邑, with 高 indicating the pronunciation.

鄡.eEn: A county in Julu. Formed from 邑, with 梟 indicating the pronunciation.

鄚.eEn: A county in Zhuo Commandery. Formed from 邑, with 莫 indicating the pronunciation.

郅.eEn: Yuzhi County in Beidi. Formed from 邑, with 至 indicating the pronunciation.

鄦.e: 炎帝太嶽之胤，甫矦所封，在潁川。从邑無聲。讀若許。
鄦.eEn: The fief granted to the Marquis of Fu, a descendant of Taiyue of the Flame Emperor's line, situated in Yingchuan. Formed from 邑, with 無 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 許.

邟.eEn: A county in Yingchuan. Formed from 邑, with 亢 indicating the pronunciation.

郾.eEn: A county in Yingchuan. Formed from 邑, with 匽 indicating the pronunciation.

薟.eEn: The plant called bailian, “white lian.” Formed from 艸, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation.

郟.eEn: A county in Yingchuan. Formed from 邑, with 夾 indicating the pronunciation.

郪.eEn: Xinqi, a county in Runan. Formed from 邑, with 妻 indicating the pronunciation.

鄎.e: 姬姓之國，在淮北。从邑息聲。今汝南新鄎。
鄎.eEn: A state of the Ji surname, north of the Huai River. Formed from 邑, with 息 indicating the pronunciation. It is present-day Xinxi in Runan.

郋.e: 汝南邵陵里。从邑自聲。讀若奚。
郋.eEn: A village in Shaoling in Runan. Formed from 邑, with 自 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 奚.

郹.e: 蔡邑也。从邑狊聲。《春秋傳》曰：“郹陽封人之女奔之。”
郹.eEn: A settlement of Cai. Formed from 邑, with 狊 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The daughter of the boundary officer of Juyang fled to him.”

鄧.e: 曼姓之國。今屬南陽。从邑登聲。
鄧.eEn: A state of the Man surname, now belonging to Nanyang. Formed from 邑, with 登 indicating the pronunciation.

鄾.e: 鄧國地也。从邑憂聲。《春秋傳》曰：“鄧南鄙鄾人攻之。”
鄾.eEn: A place in the state of Deng. Formed from 邑, with 憂 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The people of You, on Deng's southern border, attacked them.”

鄛.eEn: A township in Zaoyang in Nanyang. Formed from 邑, with 巢 indicating the pronunciation.

菳.eEn: The plant called huangqin. Formed from 艸, with 金 indicating the pronunciation.

郢.e: 故楚都。在南郡江陵北十里。从邑呈聲。
郢.eEn: The former capital of Chu, ten li north of Jiangling in Nan Commandery. Formed from 邑, with 呈 indicating the pronunciation.

鄢.e: 南郡縣。孝惠三年改名宜城。从邑焉聲。
鄢.eEn: A county in Nan Commandery. In the third year of Emperor Xiaohui, its name was changed to Yicheng. Formed from 邑, with 焉 indicating the pronunciation.

鄳.eEn: A county in Jiangxia. Formed from 邑, with 𪓑 indicating the pronunciation.

鄂.eEn: A county in Jiangxia. Formed from 邑, with 㖾 indicating the pronunciation.

邔.eEn: A county in Nanyang. Formed from 邑, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

芩.e: 艸也。从艸今聲。《詩》曰：“食野之芩。”
芩.eEn: An herb. Formed from 艸, with 今 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “They eat the qin growing in the wilds.”

邾.eEn: A county in Jiangxia. Formed from 邑, with 朱 indicating the pronunciation.

鄖.e: 漢南之國。从邑員聲。漢中有鄖關。
鄖.eEn: A state south of the Han River. Formed from 邑, with 員 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Yun Pass in Hanzhong.

鄘.eEn: A state of the southern Yi peoples. Formed from 邑, with 庸 indicating the pronunciation.

郫.eEn: A county in Shu. Formed from 邑, with 卑 indicating the pronunciation.

邡.eEn: Shifang, a county in Guanghan. Formed from 邑, with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

鄨.e: 䍧牱縣。从邑敝聲。讀若鷩雉之鷩。
鄨.eEn: A county in Zangke. Formed from 邑, with 敝 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 鷩 in 鷩雉, the name of a pheasant.

藨.e: 鹿藿也。从艸麃聲。讀若剽。一曰𦳋屬。
藨.eEn: The plant called luhuo. Formed from 艸, with 麃 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 剽. Another explanation identifies it as a kind of meng plant, 𦳋.

鄱.eEn: Poyang, a county in Yuzhang. Formed from 邑, with 番 indicating the pronunciation.

酃.eEn: A county in Changsha. Formed from 邑, with 霝 indicating the pronunciation.

郴.eEn: A county in Guiyang. Formed from 邑, with 林 indicating the pronunciation.

鄮.eEn: A county in Kuaiji. Formed from 邑, with 貿 indicating the pronunciation.

鄞.eEn: A county in Kuaiji. Formed from 邑, with 堇 indicating the pronunciation.

邴.eEn: A subordinate settlement of Song. Formed from 邑, with 丙 indicating the pronunciation.

祠.e: 春祭曰祠。品物少，多文詞也。从示司聲。仲春之月，祠不用犧牲，用圭璧及皮幣。
