幩.eEn: Cloth wrapped around a horse's bit to fan away sweat. Formed from 巾, with 賁 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The vermilion bit-cloths are splendid.”

帑.eEn: A place where money and silk valuables are stored. Formed from 巾, with 奴 indicating the pronunciation.

布.eEn: Fabric woven from hemp. Formed from 巾, with 父 indicating the pronunciation.

幏.e: 南郡蠻夷賨布。从巾家聲。
幏.eEn: Cloth paid as tribute by the Man and Yi peoples of Nan Commandery. Formed from 巾, with 家 indicating the pronunciation.

荆.eEn: The chaste tree. Formed from 艸, with 刑 indicating the pronunciation.

幦.e: 䰍布也。从巾辟聲。《周禮》曰：“駹車大幦。”
幦.eEn: Lacquering cloth. Formed from 巾, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “The carriage with mixed-colored decoration has a large covering.”

幢.eEn: A kind of banner or flag. Formed from 巾, with 童 indicating the pronunciation.

幟.eEn: A kind of banner or flag. Formed from 巾, with 戠 indicating the pronunciation.

帟.eEn: A covering positioned overhead is called 帟. Formed from 巾, with 亦 indicating the pronunciation.

幗.eEn: A woman's head ornament. Formed from 巾, with 國 indicating the pronunciation.

幧.eEn: Something used to gather up the hair. Formed from 巾, with 喿 indicating the pronunciation.

帒.eEn: A bag. Formed from 巾, with 代 indicating the pronunciation. An alternative form uses 衣.

祓.eEn: A sacrifice for removing evil. Formed from 示, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation.

菭.eEn: A coating of aquatic growth. Formed from 艸, with 治 indicating the pronunciation.

帊.eEn: Three breadths of silk fabric are called a 帊. Formed from 巾, with 巴 indicating the pronunciation.

幞.eEn: A cloth of three breadths. Formed from 巾, with 菐 indicating the pronunciation.

幰.eEn: A carriage curtain. Formed from 巾, with 憲 indicating the pronunciation.

巿.e: 韠也。上古衣蔽前而已，巿以象之。天子朱巿，諸矦赤巿，大夫葱衡。从巾，象連帶之形。凡巿之屬皆从巿。
巿.eEn: A ceremonial front apron. In high antiquity, clothing merely covered the front of the body; 巿 depicts this. The Son of Heaven has a vermilion apron, the feudal lords red aprons, and great officers an apron with an onion-green transverse band. Formed from 巾, depicting its connection to a belt. All characters in the 巿 class are formed with 巿.

帛.e: 繒也。从巾白聲。凡帛之屬皆从帛。
帛.eEn: Silk fabric. Formed from 巾, with 白 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 帛 class are formed with 帛.

錦.eEn: Patterned weaving from Xiangyi. Formed from 帛, with 金 indicating the pronunciation.

白.e: 西方色也。陰用事，物色白。从入合二。二，陰數。凡白之屬皆从白。
白.eEn: The color of the west. When yin holds sway, the color of things is white. Formed from 入 joined with 二. Two is a yin number. All characters in the 白 class are formed with 白.

皎.e: 月之白也。从白交聲。《詩》曰：“月出皎兮。”
皎.eEn: The whiteness of the moon. Formed from 白, with 交 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The moon rises, shining white.”

皢.eEn: The whiteness of the sun. Formed from 白, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

芽.eEn: A sprout or bud. Formed from 艸, with 牙 indicating the pronunciation.

皙.eEn: The whiteness of a person's complexion. Formed from 白, with 析 indicating the pronunciation.

皤.e: 老人白也。从白番聲。《易》曰：“賁如皤如。”
皤.eEn: The whiteness of an old person. Formed from 白, with 番 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “Adorned, then white.”

皚.eEn: The whiteness of frost and snow. Formed from 白, with 豈 indicating the pronunciation.

皅.eEn: The whiteness of herbaceous flowers. Formed from 白, with 巴 indicating the pronunciation.

皦.eEn: The whiteness of jade and stone. Formed from 白, with 敫 indicating the pronunciation.

皛.eEn: Manifest or clearly visible. Formed from three instances of 白. Pronounced like 皎.

敝.e: 帗也。一曰敗衣。从攴从㡀，㡀亦聲。
敝.eEn: A cloth one breadth wide. Another explanation is worn-out clothing. Formed from 攴 and 㡀, with 㡀 also indicating the pronunciation.

萌.eEn: A plant's sprout. Formed from 艸, with 明 indicating the pronunciation.

黹.e: 箴縷所紩衣。从㡀，丵省。凡黹之屬皆从黹。
黹.eEn: Work stitched onto clothing with needle and thread. Formed from 㡀 and an abbreviated form of 丵. All characters in the 黹 class are formed with 黹.

黼.e: 白與黑相次文。从黹甫聲。
黼.eEn: A pattern in which white and black alternate. Formed from 黹, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation.

黻.e: 黑與青相次文。从黹犮聲。
黻.eEn: A pattern in which black and blue-green alternate. Formed from 黹, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation.

黺.e: 衮衣山龍華蟲。黺，畫粉也。从黹，从粉省。衞宏說。
黺.eEn: The mountain, dragon, and ornate pheasant designs on a ceremonial robe. 黺 means the powder used in painting. Formed from 黹 and an abbreviated form of 粉. This is Wei Hong's explanation.

人.e: 天地之性最貴者也。此籒文。象臂脛之形。凡人之屬皆从人。
人.eEn: The most honored among the beings endowed with a nature by Heaven and Earth. This is the large-seal form. It depicts the shape of an arm and a lower leg. All characters in the 人 class are formed with 人.

僮.eEn: One who has not yet undergone the capping ceremony. Formed from 人, with 童 indicating the pronunciation.

保.eEn: To nurture. Formed from 人 and an abbreviated form of 𤓽. 𤓽 is the ancient form of 孚.

仁.eEn: To be affectionate or close to others. Formed from 人 and 二.

茁.e: 艸初生出地皃。从艸出聲。《詩》曰：“彼茁者葭。”
茁.eEn: The appearance of a plant first emerging from the ground. Formed from 艸, with 出 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Those reeds are sprouting.”

企.eEn: To raise the heels. Formed from 人, with 止 indicating the pronunciation.

仞.e: 伸臂一尋，八尺。从人刃聲。
仞.eEn: One span of the outstretched arms: eight chi. Formed from 人, with 刃 indicating the pronunciation.

仕.eEn: To study. Formed from 人 and 士.

佼.eEn: To associate or mingle. Formed from 人 and 交.

僎.eEn: To provide or make ready. Formed from 人, with 巽 indicating the pronunciation.

俅.e: 冠飾皃。从人求聲。《詩》曰：“弁服俅俅。”
俅.eEn: The appearance of an adorned cap. Formed from 人, with 求 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Their caps and garments are finely adorned.”

佩.e: 大帶佩也。从人从凡从巾。佩必有巾，巾謂之飾。
佩.eEn: An object worn from the broad sash. Formed from 人, 凡, and 巾. What is worn at the waist must include a cloth; the cloth is called an adornment.

儒.e: 柔也。術士之偁。从人需聲。
儒.eEn: Gentle or yielding. A designation for men versed in learned arts. Formed from 人, with 需 indicating the pronunciation.

俊.eEn: One whose ability equals that of a thousand people. Formed from 人, with 夋 indicating the pronunciation.

傑.eEn: Proud or haughty. Formed from 人, with 桀 indicating the pronunciation.

莖.eEn: The supporting stalk of branches. Formed from 艸, with 巠 indicating the pronunciation.

伋.eEn: A personal name. Formed from 人, with 及 indicating the pronunciation.

伉.e: 人名。从人亢聲。《論語》有陳伉。
伉.eEn: A personal name. Formed from 人, with 亢 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects mentions Chen Kang (陳伉).

伯.eEn: Eldest; senior. Formed from 人, with 白 indicating the pronunciation.

仲.eEn: Middle. Formed from 人 and 中, with 中 also indicating the pronunciation.

伊.e: 殷聖人阿衡，尹治天下者。从人从尹。
伊.eEn: The sage of the Yin dynasty, the Aheng minister, who governed all under Heaven. Formed from 人 and 尹.

偰.e: 高辛氏之子，堯司徒，殷之先。从人契聲。
偰.eEn: The son of Gaoxin, minister of instruction under Yao, and ancestor of the Yin dynasty. Formed from 人, with 契 indicating the pronunciation.

倩.e: 人字。从人青聲。東齊壻謂之倩。
倩.eEn: A person's courtesy name. Formed from 人, with 青 indicating the pronunciation. In eastern Qi, a son-in-law is called 倩.

伃.eEn: A female court official. Formed from 人, with 予 indicating the pronunciation.

伀.eEn: One's purpose reaching the multitude. Formed from 人, with 公 indicating the pronunciation.

莛.eEn: A stalk. Formed from 艸, with 廷 indicating the pronunciation.

儇.eEn: Clever. Formed from 人, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation.

倓.eEn: At ease. Formed from 人, with 炎 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 談.

侚.eEn: Swift. Formed from 人, with 旬 indicating the pronunciation.

傛.e: 不安也。从人容聲。一曰華。
傛.eEn: Uneasy. Formed from 人, with 容 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is splendid.

僷.e: 宋衞之間謂華僷僷。从人葉聲。
僷.eEn: In the region between Song and Wei, a splendid appearance is described as 僷僷. Formed from 人, with 葉 indicating the pronunciation.

佳.eEn: Good. Formed from 人, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

侅.eEn: 奇侅 means extraordinary. Formed from 人, with 亥 indicating the pronunciation.

傀.e: 偉也。从人鬼聲。《周禮》曰：“大傀異。”
傀.eEn: Great; remarkable. Formed from 人, with 鬼 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “Great prodigies and strange occurrences.”

偉.eEn: Extraordinary. Formed from 人, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

份.e: 文質僣也。从人分聲。《論語》曰：“文質份份。”
份.eEn: Refinement and substance both present (following the annotated reading 備; the supplied text has 僣). Formed from 人, with 分 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: "Refinement and substance in harmonious balance."

葉.eEn: The leaves of grasses and trees. Formed from 艸, with 枼 indicating the pronunciation.

僚.eEn: A pleasing appearance. Formed from 人, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation.

佖.e: 威儀也。从人必聲。《詩》曰：“威儀佖佖。”
佖.eEn: Dignified bearing. Formed from 人, with 必 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Their bearing is dignified.”

儠.e: 長壯儠巤也。从人巤聲。《春秋傳》曰：“長儠者相之。”
儠.eEn: Tall and robust, as in 儠巤. Formed from 人, with 巤 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “A tall, robust man assisted him.”

儦.e: 行皃。从人麃聲。《詩》曰：“行人儦儦。”
儦.eEn: The appearance of walking. Formed from 人, with 麃 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The travelers walk along.”

儺.e: 行人節也。从人難聲。《詩》曰：“佩玉之儺。”
儺.eEn: The measured movement of a person walking. Formed from 人, with 難 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The measured movement of the jade pendants.”

倭.e: 順皃。从人委聲。《詩》曰：“周道倭遟。”
倭.eEn: A compliant appearance. Formed from 人, with 委 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The road of Zhou winds gently onward.”

僓.e: 嫺也。从人貴聲。一曰長皃。
僓.eEn: Refined. Formed from 人, with 貴 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is a tall appearance.

僑.eEn: High; tall. Formed from 人, with 喬 indicating the pronunciation.

俟.e: 大也。从人矣聲。《詩》曰：“伾伾俟俟。”
俟.eEn: Great. Formed from 人, with 矣 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Strong and imposing.”

侗.e: 大皃。从人同聲。《詩》曰：“神罔時侗。”
侗.eEn: A large appearance. Formed from 人, with 同 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The spirits do not always act greatly.”

佶.e: 正也。从人吉聲。《詩》曰：“旣佶且閑。”
佶.eEn: Upright; properly aligned. Formed from 人, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Both properly aligned and well trained.”

俁.e: 大也。从人吳聲。《詩》曰：“碩人俁俁。”
俁.eEn: Large. Formed from 人, with 吳 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The great man is imposing.”

仜.e: 大腹也。从人工聲。讀若紅。
仜.eEn: Having a large belly. Formed from 人, with 工 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 紅.

僤.e: 疾也。从人單聲。《周禮》曰：“句兵欲無僤。”
僤.eEn: Swift. Formed from 人, with 單 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “Hooked weapons should have no swift movement.”

健.eEn: Strong. Formed from 人, with 建 indicating the pronunciation.

倞.eEn: Strong. Formed from 人, with 京 indicating the pronunciation.

傲.eEn: Haughty. Formed from 人, with 敖 indicating the pronunciation.

仡.e: 勇壯也。从人气聲。《周書》曰：“㐹㐹勇夫。”
仡.eEn: Brave and robust. Formed from 人, with 气 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “Mighty, mighty are the brave men.”

倨.eEn: Disrespectful. Formed from 人, with 居 indicating the pronunciation.

芣.e: 華盛。从艸不聲。一曰芣苢。
芣.eEn: Luxuriant flowering. Formed from 艸, with 不 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation identifies it with 芣苢, plantain.

儼.e: 昂頭也。从人嚴聲。一曰好皃。
儼.eEn: To hold the head high. Formed from 人, with 嚴 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is a pleasing appearance.

傪.eEn: A pleasing appearance. Formed from 人, with 參 indicating the pronunciation.

俚.eEn: To rely upon. Formed from 人, with 里 indicating the pronunciation.

伴.eEn: A large appearance. Formed from 人, with 半 indicating the pronunciation.

俺.eEn: Large. Formed from 人, with 奄 indicating the pronunciation.

僩.e: 武皃。从人閒聲。《詩》曰：“瑟兮僩兮。”
僩.eEn: A martial appearance. Formed from 人, with 閒 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Solemn and martial.”

伾.e: 有力也。从人丕聲。《詩》曰：“以車伾伾。”
伾.eEn: Possessing strength. Formed from 人, with 丕 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “With the chariots, strong and powerful.”

偲.e: 彊力也。从人思聲。《詩》曰：“其人美且偲。”
偲.eEn: Strong and powerful. Formed from 人, with 思 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “That man is handsome and strong.”

倬.e: 箸大也。从人㔬聲。《詩》曰：“倬彼雲漢。”
倬.eEn: Conspicuous and great. Formed from 人, with 㔬 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Conspicuous is that River of Clouds, the Milky Way.”

侹.e: 長皃。一曰箸地。一曰代也。从人廷聲。
侹.eEn: A tall appearance. Another explanation is touching the ground. Another explanation is to replace. Formed from 人, with 廷 indicating the pronunciation.

葩.eEn: A flower. Formed from 艸, with 皅 indicating the pronunciation.

倗.e: 輔也。从人朋聲。讀若陪位。
倗.eEn: To assist. Formed from 人, with 朋 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 陪 in 陪位, attending in an auxiliary position.

傓.e: 熾盛也。从人扇聲。《詩》曰：“豔妻傓方處。”
傓.eEn: Blazing and flourishing. Formed from 人, with 扇 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The beautiful wife, powerful and flourishing, is now established.”

儆.e: 戒也。从人敬聲。《春秋傳》曰：“儆宮。”
儆.eEn: To warn; to be on guard. Formed from 人, with 敬 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Put the palace on guard.”

俶.e: 善也。从人叔聲。《詩》曰：“令終有俶。”一曰始也。
俶.eEn: Good. Formed from 人, with 叔 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “A good ending has a good beginning.” Another explanation is beginning.

傭.eEn: Even and upright. Formed from 人, with 庸 indicating the pronunciation.

僾.e: 仿佛也。从人愛聲。《詩》曰：“僾而不見。”
僾.eEn: Indistinct; dimly perceived. Formed from 人, with 愛 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Dimly present, yet unseen.”

仿.eEn: To resemble one another. Formed from 人, with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

佛.eEn: To see indistinctly. Formed from 人, with 弗 indicating the pronunciation.

僁.eEn: A sound. Formed from 人, with 悉 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 㞕.

僟.e: 精謹也。从人幾聲。《明堂月令》：“數將僟終。”
僟.eEn: Meticulous and cautious. Formed from 人, with 幾 indicating the pronunciation. The Monthly Ordinances of the Hall of Light says: “The reckoning is about to approach its end.”

吏.e: 治人者也。从一从史，史亦聲。
吏.eEn: One who governs people. Formed from 一 and 史, with 史 also indicating the pronunciation.

祈.eEn: To seek blessings. Formed from 示, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation.

芛.eEn: The luxuriant blossoms of plants. Formed from 艸, with 尹 indicating the pronunciation.

佗.eEn: To bear a load. Formed from 人, with 它 indicating the pronunciation.

何.eEn: To carry a load. Formed from 人, with 可 indicating the pronunciation.

儋.eEn: To bear a load. Formed from 人, with 詹 indicating the pronunciation.

供.e: 設也。从人共聲。一曰供給。
供.eEn: To set out; to provide. Formed from 人, with 共 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to supply.

偫.eEn: To wait. Formed from 人 and 待.

儲.eEn: To hold in readiness. Formed from 人, with 諸 indicating the pronunciation.

備.eEn: Cautious. Formed from 人, with 𤰈 indicating the pronunciation.

位.e: 列中庭之左右謂之位。从人、立。
位.eEn: The positions arranged to the left and right of the central courtyard are called 位. Formed from 人 and 立.

儐.eEn: To guide. Formed from 人, with 賓 indicating the pronunciation.

偓.eEn: Used with 佺 in the name 偓佺. Formed from 人, with 屋 indicating the pronunciation.

蘳.eEn: Yellow flowers. Formed from 艸, with 黊 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 壞.

佺.eEn: Wo Quan (偓佺), an immortal. Formed from 人, with 全 indicating the pronunciation.

仢.eEn: To bind. Formed from 人, with 勺 indicating the pronunciation.

儕.e: 等輩也。从人齊聲。《春秋傳》曰：“吾儕小人。”
儕.eEn: People of the same rank or group. Formed from 人, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Petty people such as ourselves.”

倫.e: 輩也。从人侖聲。一曰道也。
倫.eEn: A group or class of people. Formed from 人, with 侖 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is the Way.

侔.eEn: Equal. Formed from 人, with 牟 indicating the pronunciation.

偕.e: 彊也。从人皆聲。《詩》曰：“偕偕士子。”一曰俱也。
偕.eEn: Strong. Formed from 人, with 皆 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Strong are the young men.” Another explanation is together.

俱.eEn: Together. Formed from 人, with 具 indicating the pronunciation.

儹.eEn: To gather together. Formed from 人, with 贊 indicating the pronunciation.

併.eEn: To join together. Formed from 人, with 并 indicating the pronunciation.

蔈.e: 苕之黃華也。从艸𤐫聲。一曰末也。
蔈.eEn: The yellow flowers of the 苕 plant. Formed from 艸, with 𤐫 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is the tip or end.

傅.eEn: To assist. Formed from 人, with 尃 indicating the pronunciation.

侙.e: 惕也。从人式聲。《春秋國語》曰：“於其心侙然。”
侙.eEn: Apprehensive; on the alert. Formed from 人, with 式 indicating the pronunciation. The Discourses of the States of the Spring and Autumn period says: “In his heart he felt apprehensive.”

俌.eEn: To assist. Formed from 人, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 撫.

倚.eEn: To lean upon; to rely upon. Formed from 人, with 奇 indicating the pronunciation.

依.eEn: To lean upon; to rely upon. Formed from 人, with 衣 indicating the pronunciation.

仍.eEn: To follow; to continue from. Formed from 人, with 乃 indicating the pronunciation.

佽.e: 便利也。从人次聲。《詩》曰：“決拾旣佽。”一曰遞也。
佽.eEn: Convenient and serviceable. Formed from 人, with 次 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The thumb rings and arm guards are ready for use.” Another explanation is to take turns.

佴.eEn: To assist, as expressed by 佽. Formed from 人, with 耳 indicating the pronunciation.

倢.eEn: To assist, as expressed by 佽. Formed from 人, with 疌 indicating the pronunciation.

侍.eEn: To attend upon. Formed from 人, with 寺 indicating the pronunciation.

英.e: 艸榮而不實者。一曰黃英。从艸央聲。
英.eEn: Plants that flower but bear no fruit. Another explanation is yellow blossoms. Formed from 艸, with 央 indicating the pronunciation.

傾.eEn: To incline. Formed from 人 and 頃, with 頃 also indicating the pronunciation.

側.eEn: The side. Formed from 人, with 則 indicating the pronunciation.

侒.eEn: At ease. Formed from 人, with 安 indicating the pronunciation.

侐.e: 靜也。从人血聲。《詩》曰：“閟宮有侐。”
侐.eEn: Quiet. Formed from 人, with 血 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The secluded ancestral temple is tranquil.”

付.eEn: To give. Formed from 寸, depicting a hand holding an object toward a person.

俜.eEn: To employ or send. Formed from 人, with 甹 indicating the pronunciation.

俠.eEn: To employ or send. Formed from 人, with 夾 indicating the pronunciation.

儃.eEn: To linger or hesitate. Formed from 人, with 亶 indicating the pronunciation.

侁.eEn: The appearance of walking. Formed from 人, with 先 indicating the pronunciation.

仰.eEn: To raise. Formed from 人 and 卬.

薾.e: 華盛。从艸爾聲。《詩》曰：“彼薾惟何？”
薾.eEn: Flowers flourishing. Formed from 艸, with 爾 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “What is that flourishing there?”

侸.eEn: To stand. Formed from 人, with 豆 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 樹.

儽.e: 垂皃。从人纍聲。一曰嬾解。
儽.eEn: A drooping appearance. Formed from 人, with 纍 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is lazy and slack.

侳.eEn: At ease. Formed from 人, with 坐 indicating the pronunciation.

偁.eEn: To raise or extol. Formed from 人, with 爯 indicating the pronunciation.

伍.eEn: To associate in groups of three or five. Formed from 人 and 五.

什.eEn: To form a group of ten for mutual protection. Formed from 人 and 十.

佰.eEn: To associate in groups of ten or a hundred. Formed from 人 and 百.

佸.e: 會也。从人𠯑聲。《詩》曰：“曷其有𠈲？”一曰𠈲𠈲，力皃。
佸.eEn: To meet. Formed from 人, with 𠯑 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “When shall we meet?” Another explanation is that the repeated form 𠈲𠈲 describes an appearance of exerting strength.

佮.eEn: To join. Formed from 人, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

萋.e: 艸盛。从艸妻聲。《詩》曰：“菶菶萋萋。”
萋.eEn: Grass growing luxuriantly. Formed from 艸, with 妻 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Thick and luxuriant.”

傆.eEn: Cunning. Formed from 人, with 原 indicating the pronunciation.

作.eEn: To rise. Formed from 人 and 乍.

假.e: 非眞也。从人叚聲。一曰至也。《虞書》曰：“假于上下。”
假.eEn: Not genuine. Formed from 人, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to reach. The Book of Yu says: “He reached those above and below.”

借.eEn: To borrow. Formed from 人, with 昔 indicating the pronunciation.

侵.e: 漸進也。从人、又持帚，若埽之進。又，手也。
侵.eEn: To advance gradually. Formed from 人 and 又 holding a broom, resembling the forward movement of sweeping. 又 means a hand.

儥.eEn: To sell. Formed from 人, with 𧷏 indicating the pronunciation.

償.eEn: To repay. Formed from 人, with 賞 indicating the pronunciation.

僅.eEn: Talent and ability. Formed from 人, with 堇 indicating the pronunciation.

代.eEn: To replace. Formed from 人, with 弋 indicating the pronunciation.

菶.eEn: Grass growing luxuriantly. Formed from 艸, with 奉 indicating the pronunciation.

儀.eEn: A measure or standard. Formed from 人, with 義 indicating the pronunciation.

傍.eEn: Near. Formed from 人, with 㫄 indicating the pronunciation.

佀.eEn: To resemble. Formed from 人, with 㠯 indicating the pronunciation.

便.e: 安也。人有不便，更之。从人、更。
便.eEn: At ease. When a person experiences something inconvenient, it is changed. Formed from 人 and 更.

任.eEn: To tally or correspond. Formed from 人, with 壬 indicating the pronunciation.

俔.e: 譬諭也。一曰間見。从人从見。《詩》曰：“俔天之妺。”
俔.eEn: To explain by comparison. Another explanation is to appear intermittently. Formed from 人 and 見. The Book of Odes says: “Like Heaven’s younger sister.”

優.e: 饒也。从人憂聲。一曰倡也。
優.eEn: Abundant. Formed from 人, with 憂 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is a performer.

僖.eEn: Joyful. Formed from 人, with 喜 indicating the pronunciation.

偆.eEn: Wealthy. Formed from 人, with 春 indicating the pronunciation.

俒.e: 完也。《逸周書》曰：“朕實不明，以俒伯父。”从人从完。
俒.eEn: Whole or complete. The Lost Book of Zhou says: “I was indeed undiscerning, and thereby preserved my elder uncle intact.” Formed from 人 and 完.

薿.e: 茂也。从艸疑聲。《詩》曰：“黍稷薿薿。”
薿.eEn: Luxuriant. Formed from 艸, with 疑 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The millets grow luxuriantly.”

儉.eEn: Restrained or frugal. Formed from 人, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation.

偭.e: 鄉也。从人面聲。《少儀》曰：“尊壺者偭其鼻。”
偭.eEn: To face toward. Formed from 人, with 面 indicating the pronunciation. “Minor Rules of Propriety” says: “When setting out a wine jar, turn its spout away from oneself.”

俗.eEn: Customary practice. Formed from 人, with 谷 indicating the pronunciation.

俾.e: 益也。从人卑聲。一曰俾，門侍人。
俾.eEn: To benefit or increase. Formed from 人, with 卑 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is that 俾 means an attendant at a gate.

倪.eEn: To benefit or increase. Formed from 人, with 兒 indicating the pronunciation.

億.eEn: At ease. Formed from 人, with 𢡃 indicating the pronunciation.

使.eEn: To perform or entertain. Formed from 人, with 吏 indicating the pronunciation.

伶.e: 弄也。从人令聲。益州有建伶縣。
伶.eEn: To play or entertain. Formed from 人, with 令 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Jianling County in Yizhou.

儷.eEn: A luxuriantly trailing appearance. Formed from 人, with 麗 indicating the pronunciation.

蕤.eEn: The appearance of flowers drooping on plants and trees. Formed from 艸, with 甤 indicating the pronunciation.

傳.eEn: A relay carriage. Formed from 人, with 專 indicating the pronunciation.

倌.e: 小臣也。从人从官。《詩》曰：“命彼倌人。”
倌.eEn: A minor attendant. Formed from 人 and 官. The Book of Odes says: “Command those attendants.”

价.e: 善也。从人介聲。《詩》曰：“价人惟藩。”
价.eEn: Good. Formed from 人, with 介 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Good men serve as a protective fence.”

仔.eEn: To be capable. Formed from 人, with 子 indicating the pronunciation.

俆.eEn: Slow or unhurried. Formed from 人, with 余 indicating the pronunciation.

偋.eEn: Secluded and poor. Formed from 人, with 屏 indicating the pronunciation.

伸.eEn: To extend, as opposed to bending. Formed from 人, with 申 indicating the pronunciation.

伹.eEn: Clumsy. Formed from 人, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

葼.e: 青齊沇冀謂木細枝曰葼。从艸㚇聲。
葼.eEn: In Qing, Qi, Yan, and Ji, fine branches of trees are called 葼. Formed from 艸, with 㚇 indicating the pronunciation.

偄.eEn: Weak. Formed from 人 and 耎.

倍.eEn: To turn against. Formed from 人, with 咅 indicating the pronunciation.

傿.eEn: To raise a price. Formed from 人, with 焉 indicating the pronunciation.

僭.eEn: False or assumed. Formed from 人, with 朁 indicating the pronunciation.

儗.e: 僭也。一曰相疑。从人从疑。
儗.eEn: To make a false or presumptuous claim. Another explanation is to doubt one another. Formed from 人 and 疑.

偏.eEn: Inclined to one side. Formed from 人, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation.

倀.e: 狂也。从人長聲。一曰什也。
倀.eEn: Mad. Formed from 人, with 長 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is a group of ten.

儔.eEn: To screen or conceal. Formed from 人, with 壽 indicating the pronunciation.

侜.e: 有廱蔽也。从人舟聲。《詩》曰：“誰侜予美？”
侜.eEn: To obstruct and conceal. Formed from 人, with 舟 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Who is deceiving my beloved?”

禱.eEn: To report a matter to the spirits and seek blessings. Formed from 示, with 壽 indicating the pronunciation.

俴.eEn: Shallow. Formed from 人, with 戔 indicating the pronunciation.

佃.e: 中也。从人田聲。《春秋傳》曰：“乘中佃。”一轅車。
佃.eEn: Central. Formed from 人, with 田 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Ride in a central-shaft carriage.” This is a carriage with a single shaft.

侊.e: 小皃。从人光聲。《春秋國語》曰：“侊飯不及一食。”
侊.eEn: A small appearance. Formed from 人, with 光 indicating the pronunciation. The Discourses of the States of the Spring and Autumn period says: “Small meals do not equal one full meal.”

佻.e: 愉也。从人兆聲。《詩》曰：“視民不佻。”
佻.eEn: Carefree or frivolous. Formed from 人, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Regard the people without frivolity.”

僻.e: 避也。从人辟聲。《詩》曰：“宛如左僻。”一曰从㫄牽也。
僻.eEn: To avoid. Formed from 人, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “As though turning aside to the left.” Another explanation is to pull from the side.

伭.eEn: Obstinate. Formed from 人, with an abbreviated form of 弦 indicating the pronunciation.

伎.e: 與也。从人支聲。《詩》曰：“𥷤人伎忒。”
伎.eEn: To associate with. Formed from 人, with 支 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The slanderer associates with wickedness.”

侈.e: 掩脅也。从人多聲。一曰奢也。
侈.eEn: To cover the flanks. Formed from 人, with 多 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is extravagant.

佁.eEn: A foolish appearance. Formed from 人, with 台 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 騃.

蒝.eEn: The form of plants and trees. Formed from 艸, with 原 indicating the pronunciation.

僞.eEn: To deceive. Formed from 人, with 爲 indicating the pronunciation.

伿.eEn: Slack or indolent. Formed from 人, with 只 indicating the pronunciation.

佝.eEn: An undertaking or task. Formed from 人, with 句 indicating the pronunciation.

僄.eEn: Light. Formed from 人, with 㶾 indicating the pronunciation.

倡.eEn: Music or entertainment. Formed from 人, with 昌 indicating the pronunciation.

俳.eEn: Play or amusement. Formed from 人, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

僐.eEn: To adopt a pose. Formed from 人, with 善 indicating the pronunciation.

儳.eEn: Unevenly intermingled; not aligned. Formed from 人, with 毚 indicating the pronunciation.

佚.e: 佚民也。从人失聲。一曰佚，忽也。
佚.eEn: A person who withdraws from public life. Formed from 人, with 失 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is that 佚 means negligent.

荚.eEn: The fruit of a herbaceous plant. Formed from 艸, with 夾 indicating the pronunciation.

俄.e: 行頃也。从人我聲。《詩》曰：“仄弁之俄。”
俄.eEn: To incline while walking. Formed from 人, with 我 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The tilted cap inclines.”

傞.e: 醉舞皃。从人差聲。《詩》曰：“屢舞傞傞。”
傞.eEn: The appearance of dancing drunkenly. Formed from 人, with 差 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Again and again they dance drunkenly.”

僛.e: 醉舞皃。从人欺聲。《詩》曰：“屢舞僛僛。”
僛.eEn: The appearance of dancing drunkenly. Formed from 人, with 欺 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Again and again they dance drunkenly.”

侮.eEn: To injure. Formed from 人, with 𣫭 indicating the pronunciation.

俙.eEn: In a dispute, each party asserts face-to-face that they are right. Formed from 人, with 希 indicating the pronunciation.

僨.eEn: To fall over. Formed from 人, with 賁 indicating the pronunciation.

僵.eEn: To fall over. Formed from 人, with 畺 indicating the pronunciation.

仆.eEn: To fall down. Formed from 人, with 卜 indicating the pronunciation.

偃.eEn: To fall or lie down. Formed from 人, with 匽 indicating the pronunciation.

傷.eEn: A wound. Formed from 人, with an abbreviated form of 𥏻 indicating the pronunciation.

倄.e: 剌也。从人肴聲。一曰痛聲。
倄.eEn: To stab. Formed from 人, with 肴 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is a cry of pain.

侉.eEn: Boastful speech. Formed from 人, with 夸 indicating the pronunciation.

催.e: 相儔也。从人崔聲。《詩》曰：“室人交徧催我。”
催.eEn: To act as companions to one another. Formed from 人, with 崔 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The members of the household all press me in turn.”

俑.eEn: Pain. Formed from 人, with 甬 indicating the pronunciation.

伏.eEn: To watch over. Formed from 人 and 犬.

促.eEn: To press or urge. Formed from 人, with 足 indicating the pronunciation.

例.eEn: To compare. Formed from 人, with 𠛱 indicating the pronunciation.

係.e: 絜束也。从人从系，系亦聲。
係.eEn: To bind together. Formed from 人 and 系, with 系 also indicating the pronunciation.

伐.e: 擊也。从人持戈。一曰敗也。
伐.eEn: To strike. Formed from 人 holding 戈, a dagger-axe. Another explanation is: to defeat.

俘.e: 軍所獲也。从人孚聲。《春秋傳》曰：“以爲俘聝。”
俘.eEn: Those captured by an army. Formed from 人, with 孚 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “To make them captives and take their severed ears.”

但.eEn: To bare the upper body. Formed from 人, with 旦 indicating the pronunciation.

傴.eEn: Bent-backed. Formed from 人, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

僂.e: 尫也。从人婁聲。周公韈僂，或言背僂。
僂.eEn: Physically bent or infirm. Formed from 人, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation. The Duke of Zhou bent when putting on his socks; some say that his back was bent.

僇.e: 癡行僇僇也。从人翏聲。讀若雡。一曰且也。
僇.eEn: The slow, foolish manner of walking described as 僇僇. Formed from 人, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 雡. Another explanation is: moreover.

仇.eEn: An adversary. Formed from 人, with 九 indicating the pronunciation.

儡.e: 相敗也。从人畾聲。讀若雷。
儡.eEn: To defeat one another. Formed from 人, with 畾 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 雷.

蔕.eEn: The attachment point of a melon. Formed from 艸, with 帶 indicating the pronunciation.

咎.e: 災也。从人从各。各者，相違也。
咎.eEn: Calamity. Formed from 人 and 各. 各 signifies being at odds with one another.

仳.e: 別也。从人比聲。《詩》曰：“有女仳離。”
仳.eEn: To part. Formed from 人, with 比 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “There is a woman parted and separated.”

倃.eEn: To disparage. Formed from 人, with 咎 indicating the pronunciation.

倠.eEn: 仳倠 means an ugly face. Formed from 人, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

値.eEn: To place. Formed from 人, with 直 indicating the pronunciation.

侂.e: 寄也。从人㡯聲。㡯，古文宅。
侂.eEn: To entrust. Formed from 人, with 㡯 indicating the pronunciation. 㡯 is the ancient-script form of 宅.

僔.e: 聚也。从人尊聲。《詩》曰：“僔沓背僧。”
僔.eEn: To gather. Formed from 人, with 尊 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Gathering and crowding together, turning their backs in hatred.”

像.e: 象也。从人从象，象亦聲。讀若養。
像.eEn: A likeness. Formed from 人 and 象, with 象 also indicating the pronunciation. Read like 養.

倦.eEn: Weary. Formed from 人, with 卷 indicating the pronunciation.

傮.eEn: To end. Formed from 人, with 曹 indicating the pronunciation.

荄.eEn: The roots of grasses. Formed from 艸, with 亥 indicating the pronunciation.

偶.eEn: A human figure made of tong wood. Formed from 人, with 禺 indicating the pronunciation.

弔.e: 問終也。古之葬者，厚衣之以薪。从人持弓，會敺禽。
弔.eEn: To inquire after a death. In ancient burials, people thickly covered the deceased with firewood. Formed from 人 holding 弓, a bow, conveying the driving away of birds.

佋.e: 廟佋穆。父爲佋，南面。子爲穆，北面。从人召聲。
佋.eEn: The 佋 and 穆 arrangement in an ancestral temple. The father occupies the 佋 position, facing south; the son occupies the 穆 position, facing north. Formed from 人, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

僊.e: 長生僊去。从人从䙴，䙴亦聲。
僊.eEn: To live long and depart as an immortal. Formed from 人 and 䙴, with 䙴 also indicating the pronunciation.

僰.eEn: A non-Han people of Jianwei. Formed from 人, with 棘 indicating the pronunciation.

仚.eEn: A person upon a mountain. Formed from 人 and 山.

僥.e: 南方有焦僥。人長三尺，短之極。从人堯聲。
僥.eEn: In the south there are the Jiaoyao people. They stand three chi tall, the extreme of shortness. Formed from 人, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

俇.eEn: To travel far. Formed from 人, with 狂 indicating the pronunciation.

荺.eEn: A grass root; the root of cogon grass. Formed from 艸, with 均 indicating the pronunciation.

件.e: 分也。从人从牛。牛大物，故可分。
件.eEn: To divide. Formed from 人 and 牛. An ox is a large creature and can therefore be divided.

侶.eEn: A companion or fellow traveler. Formed from 人, with 呂 indicating the pronunciation.

侲.eEn: A young servant boy. Formed from 人, with 辰 indicating the pronunciation.

倅.eEn: A deputy. Formed from 人, with 卒 indicating the pronunciation.

傔.eEn: An attendant. Formed from 人, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

倜.e: 倜儻，不羈也。从人从周。未詳。
倜.eEn: 倜儻 means unrestrained. Formed from 人 and 周. The explanation is not fully known.

儻.eEn: As in 倜儻, unrestrained. Formed from 人, with 黨 indicating the pronunciation.

佾.eEn: The rows and ranks of dancers. Formed from 人, with 䏌 indicating the pronunciation.

倒.eEn: To fall forward. Formed from 人, with 到 indicating the pronunciation.

儈.eEn: To bring together parties in a market transaction. Formed from 人 and 會, with 會 also indicating the pronunciation.

茇.e: 艸根也。从艸犮聲。春艸根枯，引之而發土爲撥，故謂之茇。一曰艸之白華爲茇。
茇.eEn: The roots of grasses. Formed from 艸, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation. In spring, when grass roots are withered, pulling them up lifts the soil; this is called 撥, hence the roots are called 茇. Another explanation is: the white flowers of grasses are called 茇.

低.eEn: Low. Formed from 人 and 氐, with 氐 also indicating the pronunciation.

債.eEn: A debt owed. Formed from 人 and 責, with 責 also indicating the pronunciation.

價.eEn: The value of an object. Formed from 人 and 賈, with 賈 also indicating the pronunciation.

停.eEn: To stop. Formed from 人, with 亭 indicating the pronunciation.

僦.eEn: To hire or rent. Formed from 人 and 就, with 就 also indicating the pronunciation.

伺.e: 𠊱望也。从人司聲。自低已下六字，从人，皆後人所加。
伺.eEn: To watch and wait. Formed from 人, with 司 indicating the pronunciation. The six characters beginning with 低 above are formed from 人 and were all added by later people.

僧.eEn: A Buddhist religious practitioner. Formed from 人, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

佇.eEn: To stand for a long time. Formed from 人 and 宁.

偵.eEn: To inquire. Formed from 人, with 貞 indicating the pronunciation.

芃.e: 艸盛也。从艸凡聲。《詩》曰：“芃芃黍苗。”
芃.eEn: Grass growing luxuriantly. Formed from 艸, with 凡 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Luxuriant are the millet seedlings.”

眞.e: 僊人變形而登天也。从𠤎从目从乚；(音隱。)八，所乘載也。
眞.eEn: An immortal transforms bodily and ascends to heaven. Formed from 𠤎, 目, and 乚; 乚 is pronounced like 隱. 八 represents that which carries the immortal.

化.eEn: Instruction put into practice. Formed from 𠤎 and 人, with 𠤎 also indicating the pronunciation.

匕.e: 相與比敘也。从反人。匕，亦所以用比取飯，一名柶。凡匕之屬皆从匕。
匕.eEn: To arrange alongside one another in order. Formed from a reversed 人. 匕 is also an implement used to take up rice, also called 柶. All characters in the 匕 class are formed with 匕.

匙.eEn: A spoon. Formed from 匕, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

頃.eEn: The head held out of alignment. Formed from 匕 and 頁.

匘.e: 頭𩪦也。从匕；匕，相匕著也。巛象髮，囟象匘形。
匘.eEn: The marrow of the head. Formed from 匕; 匕 signifies things lying closely against one another. 巛 depicts hair, and 囟 depicts the shape of the brain.

禜.e: 設緜蕝爲營，以禳風雨、雪霜、水旱、癘疫於日月星辰山川也。从示，榮省聲。一曰禜、衞，使灾不生。《禮記》曰：“雩，禜。祭水旱。”
禜.eEn: To set up a ritual enclosure using cords and bundles of thatch, and make offerings to the sun, moon, stars, mountains, and rivers to avert wind, rain, snow, frost, floods, droughts, pestilence, and epidemics. Formed from 示, with an abbreviated form of 榮 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: 禜 means to guard, preventing calamities from arising. The Book of Rites says: “The rain-seeking and calamity-averting rites are sacrifices concerning floods and droughts.”

卓.e: 高也。早匕爲㔬，匕卪爲卬，皆同義。
卓.eEn: High. 早 and 匕 form 㔬; 匕 and 卪 form 卬. They all have the same meaning.

艮.e: 很也。从匕、目。匕目，猶目相匕，不相下也。《易》曰：“𥃩其限。”匕目爲𥃩，𠤎目爲眞也。
艮.eEn: Obstinate. Formed from 匕 and 目. 匕 with 目 is like eyes confronting one another, neither yielding to the other. The Book of Changes says: “He stills his waist.” 匕 with 目 forms 𥃩, while 𠤎 with 目 forms 眞.

从.e: 相聽也。从二人。凡从之屬皆从从。
从.eEn: To heed one another. Formed from two 人 components. All characters in the 从 class are formed with 从.

從.eEn: To follow along. Formed from 辵 and 从, with 从 also indicating the pronunciation.

幷.e: 相從也。从从幵聲。一曰从持二爲并。
幷.eEn: To accompany one another. Formed from 从, with 幵 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: 从 holding 二 forms 并.

比.e: 密也。二人爲从，反从爲比。凡比之屬皆从比。
比.eEn: Close together. Two 人 components form 从; reversing 从 forms 比. All characters in the 比 class are formed with 比.

毖.e: 愼也。从比必聲。《周書》曰：“無毖于卹。”
毖.eEn: To be cautious. Formed from 比, with 必 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “Do not be overcautious in giving relief.”

北.e: 𦮃也。从二人相背。凡北之屬皆从北。
北.eEn: To turn one's back. Formed from two 人 components with their backs to one another. All characters in the 北 class are formed with 北.

冀.eEn: A province in the north. Formed from 北, with 異 indicating the pronunciation.

丘.e: 土之高也，非人所爲也。从北从一。一，地也，人居在丘南，故从北。中邦之居，在崐崘東南。一曰四方高，中央下爲丘。象形。凡丘之屬皆从丘。(今隷變作丘。)
丘.eEn: A rise of earth, not made by people. Formed from 北 and 一. 一 represents the ground. People dwell south of a hill, hence the use of 北. The dwelling place of the central lands lies southeast of Kunlun. Another explanation is: a place high on all four sides and low in the middle is called 丘. A pictograph. All characters in the 丘 class are formed with 丘. In the present clerical script, its form has changed to 丘.

蓻.e: 艸木不生也。一曰茅芽。从艸執聲。
蓻.eEn: Grasses and trees failing to grow. Another explanation is: a cogon-grass shoot. Formed from 艸, with 執 indicating the pronunciation.

虛.e: 大丘也。崐崘丘謂之崐崘虛。古者九夫爲井，四井爲邑，四邑爲丘。丘謂之虛。从丘虍聲。
虛.eEn: A great hill. Kunlun Hill is called Kunlun Xu. In antiquity, nine holdings of one man each made a 井; four 井 made an 邑; four 邑 made a 丘. A 丘 is called 虛. Formed from 丘, with 虍 indicating the pronunciation.

屔.e: 反頂受水丘。从丘，泥省聲。
屔.eEn: A hill with an inverted summit that holds water. Formed from 丘, with an abbreviated form of 泥 indicating the pronunciation.

眾.eEn: Many. Formed from 乑 and 目, conveying the meaning of a multitude.

聚.e: 會也。从乑取聲。邑落云聚。
聚.eEn: To assemble. Formed from 乑, with 取 indicating the pronunciation. A settlement is called a 聚.

臮.e: 眾詞與也。从乑自聲。《虞書》曰：“臮咎繇。”
臮.eEn: A word connecting several things, meaning “and.” Formed from 乑, with 自 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Yu says: “And Gao Yao.”

徵.e: 召也。从微省，壬爲徵。行於微而文達者，即徵之。
徵.eEn: To summon. Formed from an abbreviated 微, with 壬 serving as the distinguishing mark. Someone whose conduct is practiced in obscurity but whose cultivated accomplishments become known is then summoned.

朢.e: 月滿與日相朢，以朝君也。从月从臣从𡈼。𡈼，朝廷也。
朢.eEn: When the moon is full, it faces the sun, as one attends an audience with one's ruler. Formed from 月, 臣, and 𡈼. 𡈼 represents the royal court.

重.e: 厚也。从壬東聲。凡重之屬皆从重。
重.eEn: Thick or substantial. Formed from 壬, with 東 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 重 class are formed with 重.

量.e: 稱輕重也。从重省，曏省聲。
量.eEn: To weigh lightness and heaviness. Formed from an abbreviated 重, with an abbreviated form of 曏 indicating the pronunciation.

臥.e: 休也。从人、臣，取其伏也。凡臥之屬皆从臥。
臥.eEn: To rest. Formed from 人 and 臣, expressing a bowed or prostrate posture. All characters in the 臥 class are formed with 臥.

監.eEn: To look down from above. Formed from 臥, with an abbreviated form of 䘓 indicating the pronunciation.

臨.eEn: To oversee from above. Formed from 臥, with 品 indicating the pronunciation.

身.e: 躳也。象人之身。从人𠂆聲。凡身之屬皆从身。
身.eEn: The body. It depicts a person's body. Formed from 人, with 𠂆 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 身 class are formed with 身.

軀.eEn: The body. Formed from 身, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

殷.e: 作樂之盛稱殷。从㐆从殳。《易》曰：“殷薦之上帝。”
殷.eEn: The fullness of music being performed is called 殷. Formed from 㐆 and 殳. The Book of Changes says: “They grandly offer it to the Supreme Deity.”

茂.eEn: Grasses growing abundantly and luxuriantly. Formed from 艸, with 戊 indicating the pronunciation.

衣.e: 依也。上曰衣，下曰裳。象覆二人之形。凡衣之屬皆从衣。
衣.eEn: That upon which one depends. The upper garment is called 衣; the lower garment is called 裳. It depicts the form of covering two people. All characters in the 衣 class are formed with 衣.

裁.eEn: To cut and make clothing. Formed from 衣, with 𢦔 indicating the pronunciation.

衮.e: 天子享先王，卷龍繡於下幅，一龍蟠阿上鄉。从衣公聲。
衮.eEn: When the Son of Heaven makes offerings to the former kings, coiling dragons are embroidered on the lower panels of this garment, with one dragon curling upward and facing above. Formed from 衣, with 公 indicating the pronunciation.

褕.e: 翟，羽飾衣。从衣俞聲。一曰直裾謂之襜褕。
褕.eEn: A garment ornamented with pheasant feathers. Formed from 衣, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a garment with a straight skirt is called 襜褕.

袗.eEn: A dark ceremonial garment. Formed from 衣, with 㐱 indicating the pronunciation.

裏.eEn: The inside of a garment. Formed from 衣, with 里 indicating the pronunciation.

襁.eEn: A cloth for carrying a child on one's back. Formed from 衣, with 强 indicating the pronunciation.

襋.e: 衣領也。从衣棘聲。《詩》曰：“要之襋之。”
襋.eEn: The collar of a garment. Formed from 衣, with 棘 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Give it a waist; give it a collar.”

襮.e: 黼領也。从衣㬥聲。《詩》曰：“素衣朱𧟊。”
襮.eEn: A collar embroidered with the axe-shaped 黼 pattern. Formed from 衣, with 㬥 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “A white garment with a vermilion embroidered collar.”

衽.eEn: The overlapping front of a garment. Formed from 衣, with 壬 indicating the pronunciation.

褸.eEn: The overlapping front of a garment. Formed from 衣, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation.

褘.e: 蔽厀也。从衣韋聲。《周禮》曰：“王后之服褘衣。”謂畫袍。
褘.eEn: A knee covering. Formed from 衣, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “Among the queen’s garments is the 褘 robe.” This refers to a robe decorated with painted designs.

衭.eEn: A robe of the 襲衭 kind. Formed from 衣, with 夫 indicating the pronunciation.

襲.eEn: A robe whose front closes with the left side uppermost. Formed from 衣, with an abbreviated form of 龖 indicating the pronunciation.

袍.e: 襺也。从衣包聲。《論語》曰：“衣弊緼袍。”
袍.eEn: A padded robe. Formed from 衣, with 包 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “Wearing a worn-out robe padded with tangled silk floss.”

蔭.eEn: Ground shaded by vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 陰 indicating the pronunciation.

襺.e: 袍衣也。从衣繭聲。以絮曰襺，以緼曰袍。《春秋傳》曰：“盛夏重襺。”
襺.eEn: A padded robe. Formed from 衣, with 繭 indicating the pronunciation. One padded with silk floss is called 襺; one padded with tangled silk floss is called 袍. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “In the height of summer, wearing layers of padded robes.”

袤.e: 衣帶以上。从衣矛聲。一曰南北曰袤，東西曰廣。
袤.eEn: The part of a garment above the belt. Formed from 衣, with 矛 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says: the north–south dimension is called 袤, and the east–west dimension is called 廣.

襘.e: 帶所結也。从衣會聲。《春秋傳》曰：“衣有襘。”
襘.eEn: The place where a belt is knotted. Formed from 衣, with 會 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “A garment has its belt-knot.”

褧.e: 檾也。《詩》曰：“衣錦褧衣。”示反古。从衣耿聲。
褧.eEn: A garment of nettle-hemp cloth. The Book of Odes says: “Wearing brocade, with a hemp garment over it.” This displays a return to ancient simplicity. Formed from 衣, with 耿 indicating the pronunciation.

袛.eEn: 袛裯 means a short garment. Formed from 衣, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation.

裯.eEn: A garment sleeve; also used in 袛裯, a short garment. Formed from 衣, with 周 indicating the pronunciation.

襤.e: 裯謂之襤褸。襤，無緣也。从衣監聲。
襤.eEn: A 裯 garment is called 襤褸 when ragged. 襤 means lacking a border or edging. Formed from 衣, with 監 indicating the pronunciation.

袪.e: 衣袂也。从衣去聲。一曰袪，褱也。褱者，袌也。袪，尺二寸。《春秋傳》曰：“披斬其袪。”
袪.eEn: The opening of a garment sleeve. Formed from 衣, with 去 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says that 袪 means 褱, and 褱 means to embrace. A 袪 measures one chi and two cun. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Pi cut off his sleeve opening.”

褎.eEn: A sleeve. Formed from 衣, with 𥝩 indicating the pronunciation.

袂.eEn: A sleeve. Formed from 衣, with 夬 indicating the pronunciation.

褢.e: 袖也。一曰藏也。从衣鬼聲。
褢.eEn: A sleeve. Another explanation says: to conceal. Formed from 衣, with 鬼 indicating the pronunciation.

褱.eEn: To hold between or clasp. Formed from 衣, with 眔 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says: a sack.

袌.eEn: To clasp or embrace. Formed from 衣, with 包 indicating the pronunciation.

襜.eEn: A garment covering the front of the body. Formed from 衣, with 詹 indicating the pronunciation.

袥.eEn: A garment opening or slit, called 衸. Formed from 衣, with 石 indicating the pronunciation.

衸.eEn: A garment opening or slit, called 袥. Formed from 衣, with 介 indicating the pronunciation.

襗.eEn: Trousers. Formed from 衣, with 睪 indicating the pronunciation.

茲.eEn: The abundant increase of grasses and trees. Formed from 艸, with an abbreviated form of 兹 indicating the pronunciation.

袉.e: 裾也。从衣它聲。《論語》曰：“朝服，袉紳。”
袉.eEn: The skirt or hem of a garment. Formed from 衣, with 它 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “Court robes, with trailing sashes.”

裾.e: 衣袍也。从衣居聲。讀與居同。
裾.eEn: A robe or garment. Formed from 衣, with 居 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 居.

衧.eEn: A garment called 諸𧘚. Formed from 衣, with 于 indicating the pronunciation.

褰.e: 絝也。从衣，寒省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“徵褰與襦。”
褰.eEn: Trousers. Formed from 衣, with an abbreviated form of 寒 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Requisition trousers and short jackets.”

襱.eEn: A trouser leg. Formed from 衣, with 龍 indicating the pronunciation.

袑.eEn: The upper part of trousers. Formed from 衣, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

襑.eEn: A garment that is broad and large. Formed from 衣, with 尋 indicating the pronunciation.

襃.eEn: A garment with a broad skirt. Formed from 衣, with an abbreviated form of 𠊻 indicating the pronunciation. 𠊻 is the ancient-script form of 𠈃.

褍.eEn: The full, standard breadth of cloth in a garment. Formed from 衣, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation.

複.e: 重衣皃。从衣复聲。一曰褚衣。
複.eEn: The appearance of a garment made in double layers. Formed from 衣, with 复 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says: a padded garment.

褆.eEn: 褆褆 describes a garment’s thickness. Formed from 衣, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

襛.e: 衣厚皃。从衣農聲。《詩》曰：“何彼襛矣。”
襛.eEn: The appearance of a thick garment. Formed from 衣, with 農 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “How thick that garment is!”

裻.e: 新衣聲。一曰背縫。从衣叔聲。
裻.eEn: The sound of a new garment. Another explanation says: a seam down the back. Formed from 衣, with 叔 indicating the pronunciation.

袳.e: 衣張也。从衣多聲。《春秋傳》曰：“公會齊矦于袳。”
袳.eEn: A garment spread out. Formed from 衣, with 多 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The duke met the Marquis of Qi at 袳.”

裔.eEn: The skirt or hem of a garment. Formed from 衣, with 㕯 indicating the pronunciation.

衯.eEn: The appearance of a long garment. Formed from 衣, with 分 indicating the pronunciation.

袁.eEn: The appearance of a long garment. Formed from 衣, with an abbreviated form of 叀 indicating the pronunciation.

藃.e: 艸皃。从艸歊聲。《周禮》曰：“轂𡚁不藃。”
藃.eEn: The appearance of vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 歊 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “The hub wears out but does not warp.”

裵.eEn: The appearance of a long garment. Formed from 衣, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

襡.e: 短衣也。从衣蜀聲。讀若蜀。
襡.eEn: A short garment. Formed from 衣, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 蜀.

襦.e: 短衣也。从衣需聲。一曰㬮衣。
襦.eEn: A short garment. Formed from 衣, with 需 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says: a garment described as 㬮.

褊.eEn: A garment that is small. Formed from 衣, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation.

袷.eEn: A garment without silk-floss padding. Formed from 衣, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

襌.eEn: A garment without a second layer. Formed from 衣, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

襄.e: 漢令：解衣耕謂之襄。从衣𤕦聲。
襄.eEn: According to Han ordinances, removing one’s garment to plow is called 襄. Formed from 衣, with 𤕦 indicating the pronunciation.

被.e: 𡪢衣，長一身有半。从衣皮聲。
被.eEn: A sleeping cover measuring one and a half times a person’s height. Formed from 衣, with 皮 indicating the pronunciation.

禳.e: 磔禳祀，除癘殃也。古者燧人禜子所造。从示襄聲。
禳.eEn: A sacrifice involving the dismembering of a victim to avert pestilence and calamity. It was instituted in antiquity by Suiren and Yongzi. Formed from 示, with 襄 indicating the pronunciation.

蔇.eEn: The appearance of abundant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 旣 indicating the pronunciation.

衾.eEn: A large quilt or coverlet. Formed from 衣, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

襐.eEn: Adornment. Formed from 衣, with 象 indicating the pronunciation.

衵.e: 日日所常衣。从衣从日，日亦聲。
衵.eEn: A garment regularly worn every day. Formed from 衣 and 日, with 日 also indicating the pronunciation.

褻.e: 私服。从衣埶聲。《詩》曰：“是褻袢也。”
褻.eEn: Informal clothing worn in private. Formed from 衣, with 埶 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “This is informal clothing for the heat.”

衷.e: 裏䙝衣。从衣中聲。《春秋傳》曰：“皆衷其衵服。”
衷.eEn: An inner garment worn next to the body. Formed from 衣, with 中 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “All wore their everyday garments underneath.”

袾.e: 好佳也。从衣朱聲。《詩》曰：“靜女其袾。”
袾.eEn: Fine and beautiful. Formed from 衣, with 朱 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The quiet maiden is beautiful.”

袓.eEn: A matter being good or fine. Formed from 衣, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

裨.eEn: To add to and increase. Formed from 衣, with 卑 indicating the pronunciation.

袢.e: 無色也。从衣半聲。一曰《詩》曰：“是紲袢也。”讀若普。
袢.eEn: Without color. Formed from 衣, with 半 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation cites the Book of Odes: “This is 紲袢 clothing.” Pronounced like 普.

雜.eEn: The five colors mingled together. Formed from 衣, with 集 indicating the pronunciation.

薋.eEn: The appearance of abundant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 資 indicating the pronunciation.

裕.e: 衣物饒也。从衣谷聲。《易》曰：“有孚，裕無咎。”
裕.eEn: Abundance of clothing and goods. Formed from 衣, with 谷 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “There is sincerity; with abundance, there is no blame.”

襞.eEn: To fold a garment. Formed from 衣, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

衦.eEn: To rub and smooth out a garment. Formed from 衣, with 干 indicating the pronunciation.

裂.eEn: A remnant of silk cloth. Formed from 衣, with 𠛱 indicating the pronunciation.

袒.eEn: A garment’s seam coming undone. Formed from 衣, with 旦 indicating the pronunciation.

補.eEn: To make a garment whole by mending it. Formed from 衣, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation.

褫.e: 奪衣也。从衣虒聲。讀若池。
褫.eEn: To strip off or take away clothing. Formed from 衣, with 虒 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 池.

蓁.eEn: The appearance of luxuriant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 秦 indicating the pronunciation.

裎.eEn: To be bare or exposed. Formed from 衣, with 呈 indicating the pronunciation.

裼.eEn: To be bare or exposed. Formed from 衣, with 易 indicating the pronunciation.

衺.eEn: Deviant or improper. Formed from 衣, with 牙 indicating the pronunciation.

襭.e: 以衣衽扱物謂之襭。从衣頡聲。
襭.eEn: To gather things in the overlapping front of one’s garment is called 襭. Formed from 衣, with 頡 indicating the pronunciation.

袺.eEn: To hold up the overlapping front of one’s garment is called 袺. Formed from 衣, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation.

褿.eEn: A cloth wrap or swaddling cloth, called 帴. Formed from 衣, with 曹 indicating the pronunciation.

裝.eEn: To wrap up. Formed from 衣, with 壯 indicating the pronunciation.

裹.eEn: To wind or wrap around. Formed from 衣, with 果 indicating the pronunciation.

裛.eEn: A bag for books. Formed from 衣, with 邑 indicating the pronunciation.

莦.eEn: The appearance of noxious vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation.

裋.eEn: A long cloth jacket worn by servants. Formed from 衣, with 豆 indicating the pronunciation.

褐.e: 編枲韤。一曰粗衣。从衣曷聲。
褐.eEn: Socks woven from hemp. Another explanation says: coarse clothing. Formed from 衣, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation.

褗.eEn: The collar of a 䙔 garment. Formed from 衣, with 匽 indicating the pronunciation.

裺.eEn: What is called 褗 is also called 裺. Formed from 衣, with 奄 indicating the pronunciation.

衰.e: 艸雨衣。秦謂之萆。从衣，象形。
衰.eEn: A rain garment made of grass. In Qin it is called 萆. Formed from 衣. A pictograph.

卒.e: 隸人給事者衣爲卒。卒，衣有題識者。
卒.eEn: The clothing of subordinate servants engaged in service is called 卒. 卒 is clothing bearing identifying marks.

褚.e: 卒也。从衣者聲。一曰製衣。
褚.eEn: A servant’s marked garment, called 卒. Formed from 衣, with 者 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says: to make clothing.

製.eEn: To cut out cloth. Formed from 衣 and 制.

袚.e: 蠻夷衣。从衣犮聲。一曰蔽厀。
袚.eEn: Clothing of the Man and Yi peoples. Formed from 衣, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says: a knee covering.

芮.e: 芮芮，艸生皃。从艸内聲。讀若汭。
芮.eEn: 芮芮 describes the appearance of sprouting vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 内 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 汭.

襚.e: 衣死人也。从衣遂聲。《春秋傳》曰：“楚使公親襚。”
襚.eEn: To clothe a dead person. Formed from 衣, with 遂 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Chu made the duke personally clothe the deceased.”

裞.e: 贈終者衣被曰裞。从衣兌聲。
裞.eEn: Clothes and coverings presented as gifts for the deceased are called 裞. Formed from 衣, with 兌 indicating the pronunciation.

褮.e: 鬼衣。从衣，熒省聲。讀若《詩》曰“葛藟縈之”。一曰若“靜女其袾”之袾。
褮.eEn: A ghost’s garment. Formed from 衣, with an abbreviated form of 熒 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 縈 in the Book of Odes line, “Kudzu and climbing vines entwine it.” Another explanation says it is pronounced like 袾 in “The quiet maiden is beautiful.”

褭.eEn: To lead or secure a horse with a woven silk band. Formed from 衣 and 馬.

袨.eEn: Splendid ceremonial clothing. Formed from 衣, with 玄 indicating the pronunciation.

衫.eEn: A garment. Formed from 衣, with 彡 indicating the pronunciation.

襖.eEn: A kind of garment called 𧚍. Formed from 衣, with 奥 indicating the pronunciation.

裘.e: 皮衣也。从衣求聲。一曰象形，與衰同意。凡裘之屬皆从裘。
裘.eEn: A garment made of animal skin. Formed from 衣, with 求 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says: A pictograph, following the same principle as 衰. All characters in the 裘 class are formed with 裘.

茬.e: 艸皃。从艸在聲。濟北有茬平縣。
茬.eEn: The appearance of vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 在 indicating the pronunciation. There is a county called 茬平 in Jibei.

老.e: 考也。七十曰老。从人、毛、匕。言須髮變白也。凡老之屬皆从老。
老.eEn: Aged. At seventy, a person is called old. Formed from 人, 毛, and 匕, expressing that the beard and hair have turned white. All characters in the 老 class are formed with 老.

耊.e: 年八十曰耊。从老省，从至。
耊.eEn: At eighty, a person is called 耊. Formed from an abbreviated 老 and from 至.

耆.eEn: Old. Formed from an abbreviated 老, with 旨 indicating the pronunciation.

耇.e: 老人面凍黎若垢。从老省，句聲。
耇.eEn: An old person's face, darkened as though frostbitten and resembling grime. Formed from an abbreviated 老, with 句 indicating the pronunciation.

壽.eEn: Long-lasting. Formed from an abbreviated 老, with 𠷎 indicating the pronunciation.

考.eEn: Old. Formed from an abbreviated 老, with 丂 indicating the pronunciation.

薈.e: 艸多皃。从艸會聲。《詩》曰：“薈兮蔚兮。”
薈.eEn: The appearance of abundant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 會 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “How luxuriant! How dense!”

孝.e: 善事父母者。从老省，从子。子承老也。
孝.eEn: One who serves their parents well. Formed from an abbreviated 老 and from 子. The child supports the elder.

毛.e: 眉髮之屬及獸毛也。象形。凡毛之屬皆从毛。
毛.eEn: Eyebrows, hair, and the like, as well as animal hair. A pictograph. All characters in the 毛 class are formed with 毛.

毨.e: 仲秋，鳥獸毛盛，可選取以爲器用。从毛先聲。讀若選。
毨.eEn: In the middle month of autumn, the plumage and hair of birds and beasts are abundant and can be selected for making useful articles. Formed from 毛, with 先 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 選.

氊.eEn: Matted hair or wool; felt. Formed from 毛, with 亶 indicating the pronunciation.

毦.eEn: An ornament of feathers or hair. Formed from 毛, with 耳 indicating the pronunciation.

氍.e: 氍毹、毾㲪，皆氊緂之屬，蓋方言也。从毛瞿聲。
氍.eEn: The terms 氍毹 and 毾㲪 both denote kinds of felt or woolen fabric; they are probably regional expressions. Formed from 毛, with 瞿 indicating the pronunciation.

毹.eEn: Used in 氍毹, a kind of felt or woolen fabric. Formed from 毛, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

毾.eEn: Used in 毾㲪, a kind of felt or woolen fabric. Formed from 毛, with 𦐇 indicating the pronunciation.

毬.eEn: A ball for kicking. Formed from 毛, with 求 indicating the pronunciation.

氅.e: 析鳥羽爲旗纛之屬。从毛敞聲。
氅.eEn: Bird feathers split apart for making such things as flags and great standards. Formed from 毛, with 敞 indicating the pronunciation.

毳.e: 獸細毛也。从三毛。凡毳之屬皆从毳。
毳.eEn: The fine hair of animals. Formed from three 毛 components. All characters in the 毳 class are formed with 毳.

尸.e: 陳也。象臥之形。凡尸之屬皆从尸。
尸.eEn: To lay out. It depicts a reclining form. All characters in the 尸 class are formed with 尸.

居.eEn: To squat. Formed from 尸 and 古; 居 is formed with 古.

芼.e: 艸覆蔓。从艸毛聲。《詩》曰：“左右芼之。”
芼.eEn: Vegetation covering and spreading over something. Formed from 艸, with 毛 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “To the left and right, gather it.”

展.eEn: To turn. Formed from 尸, with an abbreviated 𧝑 indicating the pronunciation.

屆.e: 行不便也。一曰極也。从尸凷聲。
屆.eEn: To walk with difficulty. Another meaning is to reach the limit. Formed from 尸, with 凷 indicating the pronunciation.

尻.eEn: The buttocks. Formed from 尸, with 九 indicating the pronunciation.

尼.eEn: To approach someone from behind. Formed from 尸, with 匕 indicating the pronunciation.

蒼.eEn: The color of vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 倉 indicating the pronunciation.

屒.e: 伏皃。从尸辰聲。一曰屋宇。
屒.eEn: The appearance of lying prostrate. Formed from 尸, with 辰 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is a house or its eaves.

屖.eEn: To linger or delay, as in 屖遟. Formed from 尸, with 辛 indicating the pronunciation.

屝.eEn: Footwear. Formed from 尸, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

屍.eEn: The deceased person who is the subject of the funeral rites. Formed from 尸 and 死.

屠.eEn: To cut open. Formed from 尸, with 者 indicating the pronunciation.

屟.eEn: A lining or pad inside footwear. Formed from 尸, with 枼 indicating the pronunciation.

屋.e: 居也。从尸。尸，所主也。一曰尸，象屋形。从至。至，所至止。室、屋皆从至。
屋.eEn: A dwelling. Formed from 尸. 尸 denotes that which presides within. Another explanation is that 尸 depicts the shape of a house. Also formed from 至. 至 denotes the place one reaches and stops. Both 室 and 屋 are formed with 至.

屏.eEn: To screen or shield. Formed from 尸, with 幷 indicating the pronunciation.

層.eEn: A building with multiple stories. Formed from 尸, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

屢.e: 數也。案：今之婁字本是屢空字，此字後人所加。从尸，未詳。
屢.eEn: Repeatedly. Note: the present character 婁 was originally the character used in 屢空; this character was added by later people. Formed from 尸; the details are unclear.

禬.e: 會福祭也。从示从會，會亦聲。《周禮》曰：“禬之祝號。”
禬.eEn: A sacrifice for bringing blessings together. Formed from 示 and 會, with 會 also indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “The invocations for the 禬 sacrifice.”

葻.e: 艸得風皃。从艸、風。讀若婪。
葻.eEn: The appearance of vegetation in the wind. Formed from 艸 and 風. Read like 婪.

尺.e: 十寸也。人手卻十分動脈爲寸口。十寸爲尺。尺，所以指尺䂓榘事也。从尸从乙。乙，所識也。周制，寸、尺、咫、尋、常、仞諸度量，皆以人之體爲法。凡尺之屬皆从尺。
尺.eEn: Ten 寸. On the human hand, measuring back ten divisions gives the pulse site called the 寸口. Ten 寸 make one 尺. The 尺 is used to mark out matters of measurement with compasses and squares. Formed from 尸 and 乙. 乙 denotes the mark. Under the Zhou system, the measures 寸, 尺, 咫, 尋, 常, and 仞 all take the human body as their standard. All characters in the 尺 class are formed with 尺.

咫.e: 中婦人手長八寸，謂之咫。周尺也。从尺只聲。
咫.eEn: The hand of an average woman is eight 寸 long; this is called a 咫. It is the Zhou foot measure. Formed from 尺, with 只 indicating the pronunciation.

尾.e: 微也。从到毛在尸後。古人或飾系尾，西南夷亦然。凡尾之屬皆从尾。(今隸變作尾。)
尾.eEn: Small or slight. Formed from an inverted 毛 behind 尸. Some ancient people attached tails as ornaments; the peoples of the southwest do so as well. All characters in the 尾 class are formed with 尾. In the present clerical-script transformation, it is written 尾.

屬.eEn: To connect. Formed from 尾, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation.

屈.eEn: Without a tail. Formed from 尾, with 出 indicating the pronunciation.

尿.eEn: Human urine. Formed from 尾 and 水.

履.e: 足所依也。从尸从彳从夊，舟象履形。一曰尸聲。凡履之屬皆从履。
履.eEn: That on which the foot rests; footwear. Formed from 尸, 彳, and 夊, with 舟 depicting the shape of footwear. Another explanation is that 尸 indicates the pronunciation. All characters in the 履 class are formed with 履.

屨.e: 履也。从履省，婁聲。一曰鞮也。
屨.eEn: Footwear. Formed from an abbreviated 履, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is leather footwear.

萃.eEn: The appearance of vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 卒 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 瘁.

屩.eEn: Clogs or sandals. Formed from an abbreviated 履, with 喬 indicating the pronunciation.

屐.eEn: Sandals or clogs. Formed from an abbreviated 履, with 支 indicating the pronunciation.

舟.e: 船也。古者，共鼓、貨狄，刳木爲舟，剡木爲楫，以濟不通。象形。凡舟之屬皆从舟。
舟.eEn: A boat. In antiquity, Gong Gu and Huo Di hollowed wood into boats and sharpened wood into oars to cross otherwise impassable waters. A pictograph. All characters in the 舟 class are formed with 舟.

俞.e: 空中木爲舟也。从亼从舟从巜。巜，水也。
俞.eEn: To hollow out the middle of wood to make a boat. Formed from 亼, 舟, and 巜. 巜 means water.

船.eEn: A boat. Formed from 舟, with an abbreviated 鉛 indicating the pronunciation.

舳.e: 艫也。从舟由聲。漢律名船方長爲舳艫。一曰舟尾。
舳.eEn: A boat, as in 舳艫. Formed from 舟, with 由 indicating the pronunciation. Han statutes call boats that are square and long 舳艫. Another meaning is the stern of a boat.

艫.e: 舳艫也。一曰船頭。从舟盧聲。
艫.eEn: A boat, as in 舳艫. Another meaning is the bow of a boat. Formed from 舟, with 盧 indicating the pronunciation.

艐.e: 船著不行也。从舟㚇聲。讀若䔂。
艐.eEn: A boat that is grounded and cannot move. Formed from 舟, with 㚇 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 䔂.

蒔.eEn: To transplant and plant separately. Formed from 艸, with 時 indicating the pronunciation.

朕.eEn: I. Explanation missing in the source.

舫.e: 船師也。《明堂月令》曰“舫人”。習水者。从舟方聲。
舫.eEn: A boatmaster. The Monthly Ordinances of the Hall of Light says “舫人,” meaning a person skilled in navigating water. Formed from 舟, with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

般.e: 辟也。象舟之旋，从舟。从殳，殳，所以旋也。
般.eEn: To turn aside. It depicts a boat turning and is formed from 舟. Also formed from 殳; 殳 is the implement used to turn it.

服.e: 用也。一曰車右騑，所以舟旋。从舟𠬝聲。
服.eEn: To use. Another meaning is the horse on the right outside a carriage's central pair, by which it is turned about like a boat. Formed from 舟, with 𠬝 indicating the pronunciation.

舸.eEn: A boat. Formed from 舟, with 可 indicating the pronunciation.

艇.eEn: A small boat. Formed from 舟, with 廷 indicating the pronunciation.

艅.e: 艅艎，舟名。从舟余聲。經典通用餘皇。
艅.eEn: Used in 艅艎, the name of a boat. Formed from 舟, with 余 indicating the pronunciation. The canonical texts commonly write the name 餘皇.

艎.eEn: Used in 艅艎, the name of a boat. Formed from 舟, with 皇 indicating the pronunciation.

方.e: 併船也。象兩舟省、緫頭形。凡方之屬皆从方。
方.eEn: Boats joined side by side. It depicts two abbreviated boat forms with their bows tied together. All characters in the 方 class are formed with 方.

苗.eEn: Vegetation growing in a field. Formed from 艸 and 田.

儿.e: 仁人也。古文奇字人也。象形。孔子曰：“在人下，故詰屈。”凡儿之屬皆从儿。
儿.eEn: A benevolent person. It is an unusual ancient-script form of 人. A pictograph. Confucius said: “Because it is beneath a person, it is bent and crooked.” All characters in the 儿 class are formed with 儿.

兀.e: 高而上平也。从一在人上。讀若敻。茂陵有兀桑里。
兀.eEn: High and flat on top. Formed from 一 above 人. Read like 敻. In Maoling there is a hamlet called Wusang.

兒.e: 孺子也。从儿，象小兒頭囟未合。
兒.eEn: A young child. Formed from 儿, depicting the fontanel of a young child's head before it has closed.

允.eEn: Trustworthy. Formed from 儿, with 㠯 indicating the pronunciation.

兌.eEn: Joy or delight. Formed from 儿, with 㕣 indicating the pronunciation.

充.eEn: To grow; tall. Formed from 儿, with an abbreviated 育 indicating the pronunciation.

兄.e: 長也。从儿从口。凡兄之屬皆从兄。
兄.eEn: The elder. Formed from 儿 and 口. All characters in the 兄 class are formed with 兄.

兂.e: 首笄也。从人，匕象簪形。凡兂之屬皆从兂。
兂.eEn: A hairpin worn on the head. Formed from 人, with 匕 depicting the shape of a hairpin. All characters in the 兂 class are formed with 兂.

兓.eEn: Keen resolve, as expressed by 朁朁. Formed from two 兂 components.

苛.eEn: Small plants. Formed from 艸, with 可 indicating the pronunciation.

皃.e: 頌儀也。从人，白象人面形。凡皃之屬皆从皃。
皃.eEn: Facial appearance and bearing. Formed from 人, with 白 depicting the shape of a person's face. All characters in the 皃 class are formed with 皃.

覍.e: 冕也。周曰覍，殷曰吁，夏曰收。从皃，象形。
覍.eEn: A ceremonial crown. In the Zhou it was called 覍, in the Yin it was called 吁, and in the Xia it was called 收. Formed from 皃. A pictograph.

兜.e: 兜鍪，首鎧也。从𠑹，从皃省。皃象人頭也。
兜.eEn: Used in 兜鍪, armor for the head; a helmet. Formed from 𠑹 and an abbreviated 皃. 皃 depicts a person's head.

先.e: 前進也。从儿从之。凡先之屬皆从先。
先.eEn: To advance forward. Formed from 儿 and 之. All characters in the 先 class are formed with 先.

兟.eEn: To advance. Formed from two 先 components. 贊 is formed with this component. Explanation missing in the source.

禿.e: 無髮也。从人，上象禾粟之形，取其聲。凡禿之屬皆从禿。王育說：蒼頡出見禿人伏禾中，因以制字。未知其審。
禿.eEn: Without hair. Formed from 人; the upper part depicts grain plants and millet and supplies the pronunciation. All characters in the 禿 class are formed with 禿. Wang Yu explains: “Cangjie went out and saw a bald person crouching among grain plants, and accordingly devised the character.” Whether this is accurate is unknown.

見.e: 視也。从儿从目。凡見之屬皆从見。
見.eEn: To see. Formed from 儿 (a person) and 目 (an eye). All characters in the 見 class are formed with 見.

視.eEn: To look at. Formed from 見 and 示.

蕪.eEn: Overgrown with weeds. Formed from 艸, with 無 indicating the pronunciation.

覣.eEn: To look favorably. Formed from 見, with 委 indicating the pronunciation.

覶.eEn: To look favorably. Formed from 見, with 𤔔 indicating the pronunciation.

覝.e: 察視也。从見㶣聲。讀若鎌。
覝.eEn: To examine closely by looking. Formed from 見, with 㶣 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 鎌.

觀.eEn: To look attentively. Formed from 見, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation.

薉.eEn: Overgrown with weeds. Formed from 艸, with 歲 indicating the pronunciation.

覽.eEn: To observe. Formed from 見 and 監, with 監 also indicating the pronunciation.

覰.e: 拘覰，未致密也。从見虘聲。
覰.eEn: Used in 拘覰, meaning not yet close or compact. Formed from 見, with 虘 indicating the pronunciation.

覭.e: 小見也。从見冥聲。《爾雅》曰：“覭髳，弗離。”
覭.eEn: To be faintly visible. Formed from 見, with 冥 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “覭髳 means not separated.”

覯.eEn: To encounter or meet. Formed from 見, with 冓 indicating the pronunciation.

荒.e: 蕪也。从艸㠩聲。一曰艸淹地也。
荒.eEn: Overgrown with weeds. Formed from 艸, with 㠩 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is vegetation covering the ground.

覘.e: 窺也。从見占聲。《春秋傳》曰：“公使覘之，信。”
覘.eEn: To peep or spy. Formed from 見, with 占 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The duke sent someone to spy on it; it was indeed so.”

覹.eEn: To watch over. Formed from 見, with 微 indicating the pronunciation.

覢.e: 暫見也。从見炎聲。《春秋公羊傳》曰：“覢然公子陽生。”
覢.eEn: To appear briefly. Formed from 見, with 炎 indicating the pronunciation. The Gongyang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Suddenly there appeared Prince Yangsheng.”

覬.eEn: To hope for good fortune. Formed from 見, with 豈 indicating the pronunciation.

覦.eEn: To desire. Formed from 見, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

覺.e: 寤也。从見，學省聲。一曰發也。
覺.eEn: To awaken. Formed from 見, with an abbreviated form of 學 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition is to bring forth.

靚.eEn: To summon. Formed from 見, with 青 indicating the pronunciation.

親.eEn: To arrive; to come close. Formed from 見, with 亲 indicating the pronunciation.

覲.e: 諸矦秋朝曰覲，勞王事。从見堇聲。
覲.eEn: The autumn audience of the regional lords with the king is called 覲; they attend to royal affairs. Formed from 見, with 堇 indicating the pronunciation.

覜.e: 諸矦三年大相聘曰頫。頫，視也。从見兆聲。
覜.eEn: The great exchange of formal visits among regional lords every three years is called 頫. 頫 means to view. Formed from 見, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation.

覒.eEn: To select. Formed from 見, with 毛 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 苗.

覕.eEn: To be concealed so that people cannot see one another. Formed from 見, with 必 indicating the pronunciation.

覿.eEn: To see; to meet. Formed from 見, with 𧸇 indicating the pronunciation.

覞.e: 竝視也。从二見。凡覞之屬皆从覞。
覞.eEn: To look together. Formed from two 見 components. All characters in the 覞 class are formed with 覞.

欠.e: 張口气悟也。象气从人上出之形。凡欠之屬皆从欠。
欠.eEn: To open the mouth and release breath on waking. It depicts breath emerging upward from a person. All characters in the 欠 class are formed with 欠.

欽.eEn: The appearance of yawning. Formed from 欠, with 金 indicating the pronunciation.

禪.eEn: To sacrifice to Heaven. Formed from 示, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

落.e: 凡艸曰零，木曰落。从艸洛聲。
落.eEn: The falling of herbaceous plants is generally called 零; that of trees is called 落. Formed from 艸, with 洛 indicating the pronunciation.

欯.eEn: Joy. Formed from 欠, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation.

吹.eEn: To expel breath. Formed from 欠 and 口.

欨.e: 吹也。一曰笑意。从欠句聲。
欨.eEn: To blow. Another definition is an inclination to smile. Formed from 欠, with 句 indicating the pronunciation.

歑.eEn: To blow warm breath. Formed from 欠, with 虖 indicating the pronunciation.

歟.eEn: An eased breath. Formed from 欠, with 與 indicating the pronunciation.

歕.eEn: To blow out breath. Formed from 欠, with 賁 indicating the pronunciation.

歇.e: 息也。一曰气越泄。从欠曷聲。
歇.eEn: To rest. Another definition is for breath to escape and disperse. Formed from 欠, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation.

歡.eEn: Joy and delight. Formed from 欠, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation.

蔽.eEn: 蔽蔽 is a small herbaceous plant. Formed from 艸, with 敝 indicating the pronunciation.

欣.eEn: To smile with joy. Formed from 欠, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation.

弞.e: 笑不壞顔曰弞。从欠，引省聲。
弞.eEn: Smiling without disturbing one's facial composure is called 弞. Formed from 欠, with an abbreviated form of 引 indicating the pronunciation.

款.eEn: To have something one desires in mind. Formed from 欠 and an abbreviated form of 𡪡.

欲.eEn: To crave; to desire greedily. Formed from 欠, with 谷 indicating the pronunciation.

歌.eEn: To sing. Formed from 欠, with 哥 indicating the pronunciation.

歂.e: 口气引也。从欠耑聲。讀若車輇。
歂.eEn: To draw out breath through the mouth. Formed from 欠, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 輇 in 車輇.

歍.e: 心有所惡，若吐也。从欠烏聲。一曰口相就。
歍.eEn: To feel aversion in one's heart, as though about to vomit. Formed from 欠, with 烏 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition is for mouths to approach one another.

蘀.e: 艸木凡皮葉落陊地爲蘀。从艸擇聲。《詩》曰：“十月隕蘀。”
蘀.eEn: The bark and leaves of plants and trees that fall to the ground are generally called 蘀. Formed from 艸, with 擇 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “In the tenth month, the leaves fall.”

欦.eEn: To hold a smile. Formed from 欠, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

歋.e: 人相笑相歋瘉。从欠虒聲。
歋.eEn: For people to laugh at and ridicule one another. Formed from 欠, with 虒 indicating the pronunciation.

歊.e: 歊歊，气出皃。从欠、高，高亦聲。
歊.eEn: 歊歊 describes the appearance of breath issuing forth. Formed from 欠 and 高, with 高 also indicating the pronunciation.

欻.e: 有所吹起。从欠炎聲。讀若忽。
欻.eEn: For something to be blown up or stirred into motion. Formed from 欠, with 炎 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 忽.

钐.eEn: 钐钐 describes the appearance of breath issuing forth. Formed from 欠, with 䍃 indicating the pronunciation.

歗.e: 吟也。从欠肅聲。《詩》曰：“其歗也謌。”
歗.eEn: To chant. Formed from 欠, with 肅 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “His whistling is song.”

歎.eEn: To chant. Formed from 欠, with an abbreviated form of 𪅀 indicating the pronunciation.

歖.eEn: Sudden joy. Formed from 欠 and 喜.

欸.eEn: To reproach. Formed from 欠, with 矣 indicating the pronunciation.

蕰.e: 積也。从艸温聲。《春秋傳》曰：“蕰利生孽。”
蕰.eEn: To accumulate. Formed from 艸, with 温 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Accumulating profit breeds calamity.”

歐.eEn: To vomit. Formed from 欠, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

歔.e: 欷也。从欠虚聲。一曰出气也。
歔.eEn: To sob or sigh. Formed from 欠, with 虚 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition is to expel breath.

欷.eEn: To sob or sigh. Formed from 欠, with an abbreviated form of 稀 indicating the pronunciation.

歜.eEn: To become angry with surging breath. Formed from 欠, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation.

蔫.eEn: To wither. Formed from 艸, with 焉 indicating the pronunciation.

歃.e: 歠也。从欠臿聲。《春秋傳》曰：“歃而忘。”
歃.eEn: To sip. Formed from 欠, with 臿 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “He sipped the covenant blood and then forgot.”

欶.eEn: To suck. Formed from 欠, with 束 indicating the pronunciation.

歁.e: 食不滿也。从欠甚聲。讀若坎。
歁.eEn: To eat without becoming full. Formed from 欠, with 甚 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 坎.

欿.e: 欲得也。从欠臽聲。讀若貪。
欿.eEn: To desire to obtain something. Formed from 欠, with 臽 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 貪.

欱.eEn: To sip. Formed from 欠, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

歉.eEn: To eat without becoming full. Formed from 欠, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

菸.eEn: To be pent up or dense. Formed from 艸, with 於 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition is to wither.

欭.eEn: To utter a hesitant sound. Formed from 欠, with 因 indicating the pronunciation.

欬.eEn: Breath going against its normal course; to cough. Formed from 欠, with 亥 indicating the pronunciation.

歙.e: 縮鼻也。从欠翕聲。丹陽有歙縣。
歙.eEn: To draw in through the nose. Formed from 欠, with 翕 indicating the pronunciation. There is a She County in Danyang.

欪.e: 咄欪，無慙。一曰無腸意。从欠出聲。讀若卉。
欪.eEn: 咄欪 means without shame. Another definition is an attitude of having no guts. Formed from 欠, with 出 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 卉.

欥.e: 詮詞也。从欠从曰，曰亦聲。《詩》曰：“欥求厥寕。”
欥.eEn: An explanatory particle. Formed from 欠 and 曰, with 曰 also indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Then seek their peace.”

次.eEn: Not foremost; not excellent. Formed from 欠, with 二 indicating the pronunciation.

欺.eEn: To deceive. Formed from 欠, with 其 indicating the pronunciation.

歆.eEn: For spirits to consume the vapors of offerings. Formed from 欠, with 音 indicating the pronunciation.

歈.e: 歌也。从欠俞聲。《切韻》云：“巴歈，歌也。”案：《史記》：渝水之人善歌舞，漢高祖采其聲。後人因加此字。
歈.eEn: A song. Formed from 欠, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation. The Qieyun says: “巴歈 means a song.” Note: according to the Records of the Grand Historian, the people of the Yu River were skilled in singing and dancing, and Emperor Gaozu of Han adopted their melodies. Later people consequently added this character.

歠.eEn: To drink. Formed from an abbreviated form of 㱃, with 叕 indicating the pronunciation.

羨.e: 貪欲也。从㳄，从羑省。羑呼之羑，文王所拘羑里。
羨.eEn: To crave; to desire greedily. Formed from 㳄 and an abbreviated form of 羑. 羑 is the character used in 羑呼, ‘to call out,’ and in Youli, where King Wen was imprisoned.

盜.e: 私利物也。从㳄，㳄欲皿者。
盜.eEn: To take goods for one's private benefit. Formed from 㳄: it represents someone desiring a vessel.

旡.e: 㱃食气屰不得息曰㒫。从反欠。凡㒫之屬皆从㒫。(今變隸作旡。)
旡.eEn: When breath reverses during eating or drinking and one cannot breathe, this is called 㒫. Formed from a reversed 欠. All characters in the 㒫 class are formed with 㒫. The form is now altered in clerical script to 旡.

蔡.eEn: A herbaceous plant. Formed from 艸, with 祭 indicating the pronunciation.

旤.e: 屰惡驚詞也。从㒫咼聲。讀若楚人名多夥。
旤.eEn: An exclamation of alarm at something adverse or hateful. Formed from 㒫, with 咼 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 夥 in the Chu personal name 多夥.

頁.e: 頭也。从𦣻从几。古文䭫首如此。凡頁之屬皆从頁。𦣻者，䭫首字也。
頁.eEn: The head. Formed from 𦣻 and 几. The ancient-script depiction of a head bowing to the ground has this form. All characters in the 頁 class are formed with 頁. 𦣻 is the character depicting a head bowing to the ground.

頭.eEn: The head. Formed from 頁, with 豆 indicating the pronunciation.

顔.eEn: The area between the eyebrows and the eyes. Formed from 頁, with 彥 indicating the pronunciation.

頌.eEn: Appearance; countenance. Formed from 頁, with 公 indicating the pronunciation.

顱.eEn: In 𩑒顱, the bones of the head; the skull. Formed from 頁, with 盧 indicating the pronunciation.

顚.eEn: The top of the head. Formed from 頁, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation.

茷.e: 艸葉多。从艸伐聲。《春秋傳》曰：“晉糴茷。”
茷.eEn: Abundant leaves on herbaceous plants. Formed from 艸, with 伐 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Di Fa of Jin.”

頂.eEn: The crown of the head. Formed from 頁, with 丁 indicating the pronunciation.

顙.eEn: The forehead. Formed from 頁, with 桑 indicating the pronunciation.

題.eEn: The forehead. Formed from 頁, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

頟.eEn: The forehead. Formed from 頁, with 各 indicating the pronunciation.

頞.eEn: The bridge of the nose. Formed from 頁, with 安 indicating the pronunciation.

頯.eEn: The cheekbones. Formed from 頁, with 𢌳 indicating the pronunciation.

頰.eEn: The sides of the face; the cheeks. Formed from 頁, with 夾 indicating the pronunciation.

頜.eEn: The chin. Formed from 頁, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

菜.eEn: Edible herbaceous plants. Formed from 艸, with 采 indicating the pronunciation.

頸.eEn: The stalk supporting the head; the neck. Formed from 頁, with 坙 indicating the pronunciation.

領.eEn: The neck. Formed from 頁, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

項.eEn: The back of the head; the nape. Formed from 頁, with 工 indicating the pronunciation.

顀.eEn: A protruding forehead. Formed from 頁, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

顩.eEn: The appearance of uneven teeth. Formed from 頁, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation.

頵.eEn: A large head, described as 頵頵. Formed from 頁, with 君 indicating the pronunciation.

禦.eEn: To offer sacrifice. Formed from 示, with 御 indicating the pronunciation.

荋.e: 艸多葉皃。从艸而聲。沛城父有楊荋亭。
荋.eEn: The appearance of a herbaceous plant with many leaves. Formed from 艸, with 而 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Yang'er Pavilion in Chengfu, Pei.

碩.eEn: Large-headed. Formed from 頁, with 石 indicating the pronunciation.

頒.e: 大頭也。从頁分聲。一曰鬢也。《詩》曰：“有頒其首。”
頒.eEn: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 分 indicating the pronunciation. Another definition is hair at the temples. The Book of Odes says: “His head has such temple hair.”

顒.e: 大頭也。从頁禺聲。《詩》曰：“其大有顒。”
顒.eEn: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 禺 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “In its greatness, it has a large head.”

顝.e: 大頭也。从頁骨聲。讀若魁。
顝.eEn: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 骨 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 魁.

願.eEn: A large head. Formed from 頁, with 原 indicating the pronunciation.

顤.eEn: A high, elongated head. Formed from 頁, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

頑.eEn: A rounded, undifferentiated head. Formed from 頁, with 元 indicating the pronunciation.

顆.eEn: A small head. Formed from 頁, with 果 indicating the pronunciation.
