鼷.eEn: A small mouse. Formed from 鼠, with 奚 indicating the pronunciation.

蕨.eEn: A soft-shelled turtle. Formed from 艸, with 厥 indicating the pronunciation.

鼩.eEn: The jing-qu rat. Formed from 鼠, with 句 indicating the pronunciation.

鼸.eEn: The rodent called 䶃. Formed from 鼠, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

鼬.e: 如鼠，赤黃而大，食鼠者。从鼠由聲。
鼬.eEn: An animal resembling a rat, but larger and reddish yellow, that eats rats. Formed from 鼠, with 由 indicating the pronunciation.

鼲.e: 鼠。出丁零胡，皮可作𧚍。从鼠軍聲。
鼲.eEn: A rat found among the Dingling Hu people. Its skin can be made into the garment called 𧚍. Formed from 鼠, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

能.e: 熊屬。足似鹿。从肉㠯聲。能獸堅中，故稱賢能；而彊壯，稱能傑也。凡能之屬皆从能。
能.eEn: A kind of bear, with feet resembling a deer's. Formed from 肉, with 㠯 indicating the pronunciation. The neng beast is firm within, hence worthy and capable people are called 賢能; it is also strong and robust, hence outstanding people are called 能傑. All characters in the 能 class are formed with 能.

莎.eEn: The plant gao-hou. Formed from 艸, with 沙 indicating the pronunciation.

熊.e: 獸似豕。山居，冬蟄。从能，炎省聲。凡熊之屬皆从熊。
熊.eEn: A beast resembling a pig. It lives in the mountains and lies dormant in winter. Formed from 能, with an abbreviated form of 炎 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 熊 class are formed with 熊.

羆.e: 如熊，黃白文。从熊，罷省聲。
羆.eEn: An animal resembling a bear, with yellow and white markings. Formed from 熊, with an abbreviated form of 罷 indicating the pronunciation.

火.e: 燬也。南方之行，炎而上。象形。凡火之屬皆从火。
火.eEn: To burn. The phase associated with the south, blazing upward. A pictograph. All characters in the 火 class are formed with 火.

炟.eEn: A name taboo of the reigning emperor.

燬.e: 火也。从火毀聲。《春秋傳》曰：“衞矦燬。”
燬.eEn: Fire. Formed from 火, with 毀 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Hui, Marquis of Wei.”

燹.eEn: Fire. Formed from 火, with 豩 indicating the pronunciation.

焌.e: 然火也。从火夋聲。《周禮》曰：“遂䶴其焌。”焌火在前，以焞焯龜。
焌.eEn: To kindle a fire. Formed from 火, with 夋 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “Then blow upon its burning brand.” The burning brand is placed in front and used to scorch the tortoise shell.

尞.e: 柴祭天也。从火从眘。眘，古文愼字。祭天所以愼也。
尞.eEn: To burn firewood as a sacrifice to Heaven. Formed from 火 and 眘. 眘 is the ancient-script form of 愼, meaning careful reverence. Sacrificing to Heaven is a way of expressing careful reverence.

然.eEn: To burn. Formed from 火, with 肰 indicating the pronunciation.

蓱.eEn: Duckweed. Formed from 艸, with 洴 indicating the pronunciation.

爇.e: 燒也。从火蓺聲。《春秋傳》曰：“爇僖負覉。”
爇.eEn: To burn. Formed from 火, with 蓺 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Burn Xi Fuji.”

燔.eEn: To burn. Formed from 火, with 番 indicating the pronunciation.

燒.eEn: To burn. Formed from 火, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

烈.eEn: Fierce fire. Formed from 火, with 𠛱 indicating the pronunciation.

炪.e: 火光也。从火出聲。《商書》曰：“予亦炪謀。”讀若巧拙之拙。
炪.eEn: Firelight. Formed from 火, with 出 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Shang says: “I too bring the plans to light.” Read like 拙 in 巧拙, meaning skillfulness and clumsiness.

熚.eEn: In 熚𤒓, the appearance of fire. Formed from 火, with 畢 indicating the pronunciation.

烝.eEn: The upward movement of the vapor of fire. Formed from 火, with 丞 indicating the pronunciation.

烰.e: 烝也。从火孚聲。《詩》曰：“烝之烰烰。”
烰.eEn: To steam. Formed from 火, with 孚 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Steam it, with vapor rising thickly.”

煦.e: 烝也。一曰赤皃。一曰溫潤也。从火昫聲。
煦.eEn: To steam. Another explanation: a reddish appearance. Another explanation: warm and moist. Formed from 火, with 昫 indicating the pronunciation.

社.e: 地主也。从示、土。《春秋傳》曰：“共工之子句龍爲社神。”《周禮》：“二十五家爲社，各樹其土所宜之木。”
社.eEn: The lord of the land. Formed from 示 and 土. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Goulong, the son of Gonggong, became the god of the soil.” The Rites of Zhou says: “Twenty-five households constitute a community of the soil altar; each plants the kind of tree suited to its soil.”

蓳.e: 艸也。根如薺，葉如細桺，蒸食之甘。从艸堇聲。
蓳.eEn: A plant whose root resembles shepherd's purse and whose leaves resemble slender willow leaves. It tastes sweet when steamed and eaten. Formed from 艸, with 堇 indicating the pronunciation.

熯.e: 乾皃。从火，漢省聲。《詩》曰：“我孔熯矣。”
熯.eEn: A dry appearance. Formed from 火, with an abbreviated form of 漢 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “I am utterly parched.”

炥.eEn: The appearance of fire. Formed from 火, with 弗 indicating the pronunciation.

熮.e: 火皃。从火翏聲。《逸周書》曰：“味辛而不熮。”
熮.eEn: The appearance of fire. Formed from 火, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation. The Lost Book of Zhou says: “Its taste is pungent, yet it does not burn.”

焛.eEn: The appearance of fire. Formed from 火, with an abbreviated form of 𨳌 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 粦.

熲.eEn: Firelight. Formed from 火, with 頃 indicating the pronunciation.

爚.e: 火飛也。从火龠聲。一曰爇也。
爚.eEn: Flying fire. Formed from 火, with 龠 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to burn.

熛.e: 火飛也。从火㶾聲。讀若摽。
熛.eEn: Flying fire. Formed from 火, with 㶾 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 摽.

熇.e: 火熱也。从火高聲。《詩》曰：“多將熇熇。”
熇.eEn: The heat of fire. Formed from 火, with 高 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Much will bring blazing heat.”

烄.eEn: To cross pieces of wood and set them alight. Formed from 火, with 交 indicating the pronunciation.

菲.eEn: The plant called 芴. Formed from 艸, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

燋.e: 所以然持火也。从火焦聲。《周禮》曰：“以明火爇燋也。”
燋.eEn: Something lit to hold and carry fire; a torch. Formed from 火, with 焦 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “Use bright fire to light the torch.”

炭.eEn: What remains after wood has been burned; charcoal. Formed from 火, with an abbreviated form of 岸 indicating the pronunciation.

炦.eEn: The vapor of fire. Formed from 火, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation.

灰.e: 死火餘㶳也。从火从又。又，手也。火旣滅，可以執持。
灰.eEn: The spent residue of an extinguished fire; ashes. Formed from 火 and 又. 又 means a hand. Once the fire has gone out, its residue can be handled.

炱.eEn: Ash: the soot called tai-mei. Formed from 火, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

煨.eEn: Fire in a basin. Formed from 火, with 畏 indicating the pronunciation.

熄.e: 畜火也。从火息聲。亦曰滅火。
熄.eEn: To bank and preserve a fire. Formed from 火, with 息 indicating the pronunciation. It also means to extinguish a fire.

芴.eEn: The plant called 菲. Formed from 艸, with 勿 indicating the pronunciation.

烓.e: 行竈也。从火圭聲。讀若冋。
烓.eEn: A portable stove. Formed from 火, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 冋.

煁.eEn: A portable stove. Formed from 火, with 甚 indicating the pronunciation.

燀.e: 炊也。从火單聲。《春秋傳》曰：“燀之以薪。”
燀.eEn: To cook over a fire. Formed from 火, with 單 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Heat it with firewood.”

炊.eEn: To cook over a fire. Formed from 火, with an abbreviated form of 吹 indicating the pronunciation.

烘.e: 尞也。从火共聲。《詩》曰：“卭烘于煁。”
烘.eEn: To burn. Formed from 火, with 共 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Then burn it in the stove.”

齌.eEn: To cook a meal quickly. Formed from 火, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation.

熹.eEn: To roast. Formed from 火, with 喜 indicating the pronunciation.

煎.eEn: To dry-roast. Formed from 火, with 前 indicating the pronunciation.

熬.eEn: To cook by dry heating. Formed from 火, with 敖 indicating the pronunciation.

炮.eEn: To roast meat with the hair still on. Formed from 火, with 包 indicating the pronunciation.

爆.eEn: To scorch. Formed from 火, with 暴 indicating the pronunciation.

煬.eEn: To dry by roasting. Formed from 火, with 昜 indicating the pronunciation.

爤.eEn: Cooked. Formed from 火, with 蘭 indicating the pronunciation.

灸.eEn: To scorch. Formed from 火, with 久 indicating the pronunciation.

灼.eEn: To roast. Formed from 火, with 勺 indicating the pronunciation.

煉.eEn: To melt and refine metal. Formed from 火, with 柬 indicating the pronunciation.

燭.eEn: A courtyard torch, a light made with fire. Formed from 火, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation.

熜.eEn: To burn hemp stalks. Formed from 火, with 悤 indicating the pronunciation.

灺.eEn: The burnt remnant of a torch or candle. Formed from 火, with 也 indicating the pronunciation.

焠.eEn: To harden a blade's cutting edge. Formed from 火, with 卒 indicating the pronunciation.

煣.e: 屈申木也。从火、柔，柔亦聲。
煣.eEn: To bend or straighten wood. Formed from 火 and 柔, with 柔 also indicating the pronunciation.

燓.eEn: To burn fields. Formed from 火 and 棥, with 棥 also indicating the pronunciation.

葦.eEn: A large reed. Formed from 艸, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

熑.e: 火煣車網絕也。从火兼聲。《周禮》曰：“煣牙，外不熑。”
熑.eEn: The breaking of a cart's framework when it is bent using fire. Formed from 火, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “When bending the wheel rim, its outer side must not split.”

燎.eEn: To set a fire. Formed from 火, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation.

烖.eEn: Fire from Heaven is called 烖. Formed from 火, with 𢦏 indicating the pronunciation.

煙.eEn: The vapor of fire; smoke. Formed from 火, with 垔 indicating the pronunciation.

焆.eEn: 焆焆 describes the appearance of smoke. Formed from 火, with 肙 indicating the pronunciation.

煴.eEn: Dense, pent-up smoke. Formed from 火, with 昷 indicating the pronunciation.

葭.eEn: A reed that has not yet put forth its flower head. Formed from 艸, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation.

燂.eEn: The heat of fire. Formed from 火, with 覃 indicating the pronunciation.

焞.e: 明也。从火𦎫聲。《春秋傳》曰：“焞燿天地。”
焞.eEn: Bright. Formed from 火, with 𦎫 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Shining upon Heaven and Earth.”

炳.eEn: Bright. Formed from 火, with 丙 indicating the pronunciation.

焯.e: 明也。从火卓聲。《周書》曰：“焯見三有俊心。”
焯.eEn: Bright. Formed from 火, with 卓 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “Clearly discern the outstanding minds of the three possessors.”

照.eEn: Bright. Formed from 火, with 昭 indicating the pronunciation.

煒.e: 盛赤也。从火韋聲。《詩》曰：“彤管有煒。”
煒.eEn: Intensely red. Formed from 火, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The red writing brush glows brightly.”

熠.e: 盛光也。从火習聲。《詩》曰：“熠熠宵行。”
熠.eEn: Brilliant light. Formed from 火, with 習 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Glittering are the night-flying creatures.”

煜.eEn: Brilliant light. Formed from 火, with 昱 indicating the pronunciation.

燿.eEn: To illuminate. Formed from 火, with 翟 indicating the pronunciation.

萊.eEn: The plant called manhua. Formed from 艸, with 來 indicating the pronunciation.

煇.eEn: Light. Formed from 火, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

煌.eEn: Radiance. Formed from 火, with 皇 indicating the pronunciation.

焜.eEn: Radiant. Formed from 火, with 昆 indicating the pronunciation.

炯.eEn: Light. Formed from 火, with 冋 indicating the pronunciation.

爗.e: 盛也。从火曅聲。《詩》曰：“爗爗震電。”
爗.eEn: Intense or flourishing. Formed from 火, with 曅 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Flashing, flashing are the thunder and lightning.”

爓.eEn: The opening of a fire. Formed from 火, with 閻 indicating the pronunciation.

炫.eEn: Shining brilliantly. Formed from 火, with 玄 indicating the pronunciation.

光.e: 明也。从火在人上，光明意也。
光.eEn: Brightness. Formed from 火 above a person, conveying the idea of light and brightness.

熱.eEn: Warm. Formed from 火, with 埶 indicating the pronunciation.

熾.eEn: Intense or flourishing. Formed from 火, with 戠 indicating the pronunciation.

荔.e: 艸也。似蒲而小，根可作㕞。从艸劦聲。
荔.eEn: A plant resembling cattail but smaller; its roots can be made into brushes. Formed from 艸, with 劦 indicating the pronunciation.

燠.eEn: Heat within. Formed from 火, with 奥 indicating the pronunciation.

煖.eEn: Warm. Formed from 火, with 爰 indicating the pronunciation.

煗.eEn: Warm. Formed from 火, with 耎 indicating the pronunciation.

炅.eEn: To see. Formed from 火 and 日.

炕.eEn: Dry. Formed from 火, with 亢 indicating the pronunciation.

燥.eEn: Dry. Formed from 火, with 喿 indicating the pronunciation.

焅.eEn: The air of drought. Formed from 火, with 告 indicating the pronunciation.

燽.eEn: To illuminate broadly and comprehensively. Formed from 火, with 壽 indicating the pronunciation.

爟.e: 取火於日官名，舉火曰爟。《周禮》曰：“司爟，掌行火之政令。”从火雚聲。
爟.eEn: The title of an official who obtains fire from the sun; raising a fire is called 爟. The Rites of Zhou says: “The Fire Officer is responsible for carrying out the governmental orders concerning fire.” Formed from 火, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation.

蒙.eEn: The plant called wangnü, “king's daughter.” Formed from 艸, with 冡 indicating the pronunciation.

爝.e: 苣火，祓也。从火爵聲。呂不韋曰：湯得伊尹，爝以爟火，釁以犧豭。
爝.eEn: A torch fire used for ritual purification. Formed from 火, with 爵 indicating the pronunciation. Lü Buwei says: “When Tang obtained Yi Yin, he purified him with ritual fire and consecrated him with the blood of a sacrificial boar.”

熭.eEn: Fire for drying by exposure to heat. Formed from 火, with 彗 indicating the pronunciation.

熙.eEn: Dry. Formed from 火, with 巸 indicating the pronunciation.

爞.eEn: The air of drought. Formed from 火, with 蟲 indicating the pronunciation.

煽.eEn: Blazing intensely. Formed from 火, with 扇 indicating the pronunciation.

烙.eEn: To scorch. Formed from 火, with 各 indicating the pronunciation.

爍.eEn: In 灼爍, “shining”: light. Formed from 火, with 樂 indicating the pronunciation.

燦.eEn: In 燦爤: the appearance of being bright and clear. Formed from 火, with 粲 indicating the pronunciation.

煥.eEn: Firelight. Formed from 火, with 奐 indicating the pronunciation.

禓.eEn: A sacrifice performed on a road. Formed from 示, with 昜 indicating the pronunciation.

薻.e: 水艸也。从艸从水，巢聲。《詩》曰：“于以采薻？”
薻.eEn: An aquatic plant. Formed from 艸 and 水, with 巢 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Where shall we gather the water plants?”

炎.e: 火光上也。从重火。凡炎之屬皆从炎。
炎.eEn: Firelight rising upward. Formed from two instances of 火. All characters in the 炎 class are formed with 炎.

燄.e: 火行微燄燄也。从炎臽聲。
燄.eEn: Fire moving in faint, flickering flames. Formed from 炎, with 臽 indicating the pronunciation.

煔.eEn: The movement of fire. Formed from 炎, with 占 indicating the pronunciation.

燅.e: 於湯中爚肉。从炎，从熱省。
燅.eEn: To cook meat in hot water. Formed from 炎 and an abbreviated form of 熱.

粦.e: 兵死及牛馬之血爲粦。粦，鬼火也。从炎、舛。
粦.eEn: The blood of those killed in warfare, and of cattle and horses, becomes 粦. 粦 is ghost fire. Formed from 炎 and 舛.

黑.e: 火所熏之色也。从炎，上出𡆧。𡆧，古窻字。凡黑之屬皆从黑。
黑.eEn: The color produced by smoke from fire. Formed from 炎, rising out through 𡆧 above. 𡆧 is the ancient form of 窻, “window.” All characters in the 黑 class are formed with 黑.

黸.eEn: In Qi, black is called 黸. Formed from 黑, with 盧 indicating the pronunciation.

菉.e: 王芻也。从艸录聲。《詩》曰：“菉竹猗猗。”
菉.eEn: The plant called wangchu. Formed from 艸, with 录 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The wangchu and bamboo are luxuriant.”

黯.eEn: Deep black. Formed from 黑, with 音 indicating the pronunciation.

黶.eEn: An extended black mark. Formed from 黑, with 厭 indicating the pronunciation.

黳.eEn: A small black mole. Formed from 黑, with 殹 indicating the pronunciation.

黲.eEn: Pale blue-black. Formed from 黑, with 參 indicating the pronunciation.

黤.eEn: Blue-black. Formed from 黑, with 奄 indicating the pronunciation.

黝.e: 微青黑色。从黑幼聲。《爾雅》曰：“地謂之黝。”
黝.eEn: A slightly blue-black color. Formed from 黑, with 幼 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “The ground is described as 黝.”

蓸.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 曹 indicating the pronunciation.

黗.eEn: A muddy yellow-black. Formed from 黑, with 屯 indicating the pronunciation.

點.eEn: A small black spot. Formed from 黑, with 占 indicating the pronunciation.

黚.e: 淺黃黑也。从黑甘聲。讀若染繒中束緅黚。
黚.eEn: Pale yellow-black. Formed from 黑, with 甘 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 黚 in the silk-dyeing expression 束緅黚.

黠.eEn: Firm blackness. Formed from 黑, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation.

黔.e: 黎也。从黑今聲。秦謂民爲黔首，謂黑色也。周謂之黎民。《易》曰：“爲黔喙。”
黔.eEn: Dark. Formed from 黑, with 今 indicating the pronunciation. Qin called the people “black heads,” referring to the color black. Zhou called them “the dark people.” The Book of Changes says: “It represents a black beak.”

黕.eEn: Sediment and grime. Formed from 黑, with 冘 indicating the pronunciation.

黨.eEn: Not bright or fresh in color. Formed from 黑, with 尚 indicating the pronunciation.

黷.e: 握持垢也。从黑賣聲。《易》曰：“再三黷。”
黷.eEn: Grime from holding and handling. Formed from 黑, with 賣 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “A second and third inquiry are an affront.”

黵.eEn: A large stain. Formed from 黑, with 詹 indicating the pronunciation.

黴.e: 中久雨青黑。从黑，微省聲。
黴.eEn: To become blue-black through prolonged exposure to rain. Formed from 黑, with an abbreviated form of 微 indicating the pronunciation.

黜.eEn: To demote or lower in rank. Formed from 黑, with 出 indicating the pronunciation.

黱.eEn: To paint the eyebrows. Formed from 黑, with 朕 indicating the pronunciation.

儵.e: 青黑繒縫白色也。从黑攸聲。
儵.eEn: White coloring along the seams of blue-black silk. Formed from 黑, with 攸 indicating the pronunciation.

菬.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 沼 indicating the pronunciation.

黮.eEn: The blackness of mulberries. Formed from 黑, with 甚 indicating the pronunciation.

黭.e: 果實黭黯黑也。从黑弇聲。
黭.eEn: The dark black appearance of fruit. Formed from 黑, with 弇 indicating the pronunciation.

黥.eEn: The punishment of tattooing the face with ink. Formed from 黑, with 京 indicating the pronunciation.

黟.e: 黑木也。从黑多聲。丹陽有黟縣。
黟.eEn: Black wood. Formed from 黑, with 多 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Yi County in Danyang.

囪.e: 在牆曰牖，在屋曰囪。象形。凡囪之屬皆从囪。
囪.eEn: An opening in a wall is called 牖; one in a roof is called 囪. A pictograph. All characters in the 囪 class are formed with 囪.

悤.e: 多遽悤悤也。从心、囪，囪亦聲。
悤.eEn: Much haste; being hurried and flustered. Formed from 心 and 囪, with 囪 also indicating the pronunciation.

焱.e: 火華也。从三火。凡焱之屬皆从焱。
焱.eEn: The blossoming brilliance of fire. Formed from three instances of 火. All characters in the 焱 class are formed with 焱.

熒.eEn: The light of lamps and candles beneath a roof. Formed from 焱 and 冂.

燊.e: 盛皃。从焱在木上。讀若《詩》“莘莘征夫”。一曰伇也。
燊.eEn: A flourishing appearance. Formed from 焱 above 木. Pronounced like 莘 in the Book of Odes phrase “the numerous campaigning men.” Another explanation is “service or labor.”

炙.e: 炮肉也。从肉在火上。凡炙之屬皆从炙。
炙.eEn: To roast meat. Formed from 肉 above 火. All characters in the 炙 class are formed with 炙.

爒.eEn: To roast. Formed from 炙, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 燎 in 𤒅燎.

赤.e: 南方色也。从大从火。凡赤之屬皆从赤。
赤.eEn: The color of the south. Formed from 大 and 火. All characters in the 赤 class are formed with 赤.

赨.eEn: Red. Formed from 赤, with an abbreviated form of 蟲 indicating the pronunciation.

赧.e: 面慙赤也。从赤𠬝聲。周失天下於赧王。
赧.eEn: To turn red in the face from shame. Formed from 赤, with 𠬝 indicating the pronunciation. Zhou lost All-under-Heaven under King Nan.

浾.eEn: A variant of 䞓, “the juice of tang-jujubes,” formed with 水.

赭.eEn: Red earth. Formed from 赤, with 者 indicating the pronunciation.

范.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 氾 indicating the pronunciation.

赫.eEn: The red appearance of fire. Formed from two instances of 赤.

赩.eEn: Deep red. Formed from 赤 and 色, with 色 also indicating the pronunciation.

赮.eEn: Red. Formed from 赤, with 叚 indicating the pronunciation.

大.e: 天大，地大，人亦大。故大象人形。古文大(他達切)也。凡大之屬皆从大。
大.eEn: Heaven is great, earth is great, and humans too are great. Thus 大 depicts the shape of a person. It is the ancient-script form of 大, with the pronunciation indicated by the fanqie spelling 他達. All characters in the 大 class are formed with 大.

奎.eEn: The space between the two thighs. Formed from 大, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

夾.eEn: To hold. Formed from 大 flanked by two people.

奄.e: 覆也。大有餘也。又，欠也。从大从申。申，展也。
奄.eEn: To cover. Greatly in excess. Also, to lack. Formed from 大 and 申. 申 means “to extend.”

夸.eEn: Extravagant. Formed from 大, with 于 indicating the pronunciation.

艿.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 乃 indicating the pronunciation.

奯.e: 空大也。从大歲聲。讀若《詩》“施罟泧泧”。
奯.eEn: Empty and vast. Formed from 大, with 歲 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 泧 in the Book of Odes phrase “setting the nets broadly.”

奅.eEn: Large. Formed from 大, with 卯 indicating the pronunciation.

夽.eEn: Large. Formed from 大, with 云 indicating the pronunciation.

奃.eEn: Large. Formed from 大, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 氐.

契.e: 大約也。从大从㓞。《易》曰：“後代聖人易之以書契。”
契.eEn: A major agreement. Formed from 大 and 㓞. The Book of Changes says: “The sages of later ages replaced it with written documents and contracts.”

夷.e: 平也。从大从弓。東方之人也。
夷.eEn: Level. Formed from 大 and 弓. Also, the people of the east.

亦.e: 人之臂亦也。从大，象兩亦之形。凡亦之屬皆从亦。
亦.eEn: A person's armpits. Formed from 大, depicting the shape of the two armpits. All characters in the 亦 class are formed with 亦.

夨.e: 傾頭也。从大，象形。凡夨之屬皆从夨。
夨.eEn: To tilt the head. Formed from 大. A pictograph. All characters in the 夨 class are formed with 夨.

奊.e: 頭衺、骩奊態也。从夨圭聲。
奊.eEn: A tilted head; a crooked, bent posture. Formed from 夨, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

吳.e: 姓也。亦郡也。一曰吳，大言也。从夨、口。
吳.eEn: A surname. Also, a commandery. Another explanation is that 吳 means “to speak loudly.” Formed from 夨 and 口.

夭.e: 屈也。从大，象形。凡夭之屬皆从夭。
夭.eEn: Bent. Formed from 大. A pictograph. All characters in the 夭 class are formed with 夭.

喬.e: 高而曲也。从夭，从高省。《詩》曰：“南有喬木。”
喬.eEn: Tall and curved. Formed from 夭 and an abbreviated form of 高. The Book of Odes says: “In the south there are tall trees.”

萄.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 匋 indicating the pronunciation.

奔.e: 走也。从夭，賁省聲。與走同意，俱从夭。
奔.eEn: To run. Formed from 夭, with an abbreviated 賁 indicating the pronunciation. It shares the meaning of 走; both are formed with 夭.

交.e: 交脛也。从大，象交形。凡交之屬皆从交。
交.eEn: To cross the shins. Formed from 大, depicting a crossing shape. All characters in the 交 class are formed with 交.

絞.eEn: To strangle with a cord. Formed from 交 and 糸.

尣.e: 𤿑，曲脛也。从大，象偏曲之形。凡𡯂之屬皆从𡯂。
尣.eEn: 𤿑: having bent shins. Formed from 大, depicting a lopsided, bent shape. All characters in the 𡯂 class are formed with 𡯂.

尳.e: 厀病也。从尣从骨，骨亦聲。
尳.eEn: An ailment of the knee. Formed from 尣 and 骨, with 骨 also indicating the pronunciation.

祲.e: 精氣感祥。从示，㑴省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“見赤黑之𥛆。”
祲.eEn: An omen produced by the interaction of subtle vital forces. Formed from 示, with an abbreviated 㑴 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “He saw a red and black ominous emanation.”

芑.eEn: A fine grain with pale shoots. Formed from 艸, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

尲.eEn: Not straight or properly aligned. Formed from 尣, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

尬.eEn: Awkward or ill at ease, as in 𡰉𡯗. Formed from 尣, with 介 indicating the pronunciation.

尥.e: 行脛相交也。从尣勺聲。牛行腳相交爲尦。
尥.eEn: For the shins to cross while walking. Formed from 尣, with 勺 indicating the pronunciation. When an ox's legs cross as it walks, this is called 尦.

壺.e: 昆吾圜器也。象形。从大，象其蓋也。凡壷之屬皆从壷。
壺.eEn: A round vessel of Kunwu. A pictograph. Formed with 大, which depicts its lid. All characters in the 壷 class are formed with 壷.

壹.e: 專壹也。从壺吉聲。凡壹之屬皆从壹。
壹.eEn: Single-minded and undivided. Formed from 壺, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 壹 class are formed with 壹.

藚.e: 水舄也。从艸賣聲。《詩》曰：“言采其藚。”
藚.eEn: Water plantain. Formed from 艸, with 賣 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “I gather the water plantain.”

懿.e: 專久而美也。从壹，从恣省聲。
懿.eEn: Single-minded, enduring, and admirable. Formed from 壹, with an abbreviated 恣 indicating the pronunciation.

睪.e: 目視也。从橫目，从㚔。令吏將目捕罪人也。
睪.eEn: To look with the eyes. Formed from a horizontal 目 and 㚔. It represents ordering an officer to use his eyes to apprehend a criminal.

執.e: 捕罪人也。从丮从㚔，㚔亦聲。
執.eEn: To apprehend a criminal. Formed from 丮 and 㚔, with 㚔 also indicating the pronunciation.

圉.e: 囹圄，所以拘罪人。从㚔从囗。一曰圉，垂也。一曰圉人，掌馬者。
圉.eEn: A prison: a place for confining criminals. Formed from 㚔 and 囗. Another explanation is that 圉 means a boundary. Another explanation is that a 圉人 is someone in charge of horses.

盩.e: 引擊也。从㚔、攴，見血也。扶風有盩厔縣。
盩.eEn: To pull and strike. Formed from 㚔 and 攴, with blood appearing. There is a county named 盩厔 in Fufeng.

報.e: 當罪人也。从㚔从𠬝。𠬝，服罪也。
報.eEn: To determine a criminal's appropriate punishment. Formed from 㚔 and 𠬝. 𠬝 means to submit to punishment for an offense.

奢.e: 張也。从大者聲。凡奢之屬皆从奢。
奢.eEn: To spread or extend. Formed from 大, with 者 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 奢 class are formed with 奢.

奲.eEn: The appearance of abundant wealth, as in 奲奲. Formed from 奢, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

苳.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 冬 indicating the pronunciation.

亢.e: 人頸也。从大省，象頸脈形。凡亢之屬皆从亢。
亢.eEn: A person's neck. Formed from an abbreviated 大, depicting the vessels of the neck. All characters in the 亢 class are formed with 亢.

夲.e: 進趣也。从大从十。大十，猶兼十人也。凡𠦍之屬皆从𠦍。讀若滔。
夲.eEn: To advance swiftly. Formed from 大 and 十. 大 together with 十 suggests combining ten people. All characters in the 𠦍 class are formed with 𠦍. Read like 滔.

曓.e: 疾有所趣也。从日出𠦍廾之。
曓.eEn: To hasten toward something. Formed from 日 and 出, with 𠦍 and 廾 acting upon it.

奏.e: 奏進也。从𠦍从廾从屮。屮，上進之義。
奏.eEn: To present or advance. Formed from 𠦍, 廾, and 屮. 屮 conveys the meaning of advancing upward.

皋.e: 气皐白之進也。从𠦍从白。《禮》：祝曰臯，登謌曰奏。故臯奏皆从夲。《周禮》曰：“詔來鼓皐舞。”皐，告之也。
皋.eEn: The advance of vapor, rising white. Formed from 𠦍 and 白. In the Rites, the ritual invoker's call is termed 皋, and ascending to sing is termed 奏. Thus 皋 and 奏 are both formed with 夲. The Rites of Zhou says: “Call them forward, beat the drum, and announce the dance.” Here 皐 means to announce it.

夰.e: 放也。从大而八分也。凡夰之屬皆从夰。
夰.eEn: To release or disperse. Formed from 大, divided apart by 八. All characters in the 夰 class are formed with 夰.

薔.eEn: 薔虞: a kind of smartweed. Formed from 艸, with 嗇 indicating the pronunciation.

奡.e: 嫚也。从𦣻从夰，夰亦聲。《虞書》曰：“若丹朱奡。”讀若傲。《論語》：“奡湯舟。”
奡.eEn: Arrogant. Formed from 𦣻 and 夰, with 夰 also indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Yu says: “Like the arrogant Danzhu.” Read like 傲. The Analects says: “Ao propelled boats.”

昦.e: 春爲昦天，元气昦昦。从日、夰，夰亦聲。
昦.eEn: In spring, Heaven is called 昦天; the primordial vital force is vast and expansive. Formed from 日 and 夰, with 夰 also indicating the pronunciation.

臩.e: 驚走也。一曰往來也。从夰、臦。《周書》曰：“伯臩。”古文臦，古文囧字。
臩.eEn: To run in fright. Another explanation is to come and go. Formed from 夰 and 臦. The Book of Zhou says: “Bo Jiong.” The ancient-script form of 臦 is the ancient-script character 囧.

亣.e: 籒文亣，改古文。亦象人形。凡亣之屬皆从亣。
亣.eEn: The large-seal form of 大, modified from the ancient script. It too depicts a human figure. All characters in the 亣 class are formed with 亣.

奕.e: 大也。从亣亦聲。《詩》曰：“奕奕梁山。”
奕.eEn: Great. Formed from 亣, with 亦 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Lofty and grand is Mount Liang.”

奘.e: 駔大也。从亣从壯，壯亦聲。
奘.eEn: Stout and large. Formed from 亣 and 壯, with 壯 also indicating the pronunciation.

奚.e: 大腹也。从亣，𦃟省聲。𦃟，籒文系字。
奚.eEn: A large belly. Formed from 亣, with an abbreviated 𦃟 indicating the pronunciation. 𦃟 is the large-seal form of 系.

耎.e: 稍前大也。从亣而聲。讀若畏偄。
耎.eEn: Slightly larger toward the front. Formed from 亣, with 而 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 偄 in 畏偄.

苕.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

夫.e: 丈夫也。从大，一以象簪也。周制以八寸爲尺，十尺爲丈。人長八尺，故曰丈夫。凡夫之屬皆从夫。
夫.eEn: An adult man. Formed from 大, with 一 depicting a hairpin. Under the Zhou system, eight inches made one foot, and ten feet made one 丈. A person was eight feet tall, hence the designation 丈夫. All characters in the 夫 class are formed with 夫.

規.eEn: To have rules and standards. Formed from 夫 and 見.

立.e: 住也。从大立一之上。凡立之屬皆从立。
立.eEn: To stand or remain in place. Formed from 大 standing above 一. All characters in the 立 class are formed with 立.

端.eEn: Straight or upright. Formed from 立, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation.

竱.e: 等也。从立專聲。《春秋國語》曰：“竱本肇末。”
竱.eEn: To make equal. Formed from 立, with 專 indicating the pronunciation. The Discourses of the States of the Spring and Autumn period says: “Equalize the foundation and set the branches in order.”

竦.e: 敬也。从立从束。束，自申束也。
竦.eEn: To be reverent. Formed from 立 and 束. 束 conveys restraining and disciplining oneself.

竫.eEn: Settled and at peace. Formed from 立, with 爭 indicating the pronunciation.

靖.e: 立竫也。从立青聲。一曰細皃。
靖.eEn: To stand quietly. Formed from 立, with 青 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is a small or delicate appearance.

竢.eEn: To wait. Formed from 立, with 矣 indicating the pronunciation.

竘.e: 健也。一曰匠也。从立句聲。讀若齲。《逸周書》有竘匠。
竘.eEn: Capable or strong. Another explanation is a craftsman. Formed from 立, with 句 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 齲. The Lost Book of Zhou contains the expression 竘匠, “a capable craftsman.”

竵.eEn: Not straight or properly aligned. Formed from 立, with 𩰬 indicating the pronunciation.

竭.eEn: To carry and lift. Formed from 立, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation.

竣.e: 偓竣也。从立夋聲。《國語》曰：“有司巳事而竣。”
竣.eEn: To withdraw and stand waiting, as in 偓竣. Formed from 立, with 夋 indicating the pronunciation. The Discourses of the States says: “The officials, having completed their duties, withdrew and stood waiting.”

萺.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 冒 indicating the pronunciation.

竲.e: 北地高樓無屋者。从立曾聲。
竲.eEn: A tall tower without a roof in the northern regions. Formed from 立, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

竝.e: 併也。从二立。凡竝之屬皆从竝。
竝.eEn: To stand together or side by side. Formed from two instances of 立. All characters in the 竝 class are formed with 竝.

囟.e: 頭會，匘蓋也。象形。凡囟之屬皆从囟。
囟.eEn: The junction at the top of the head, the covering of the brain. A pictograph. All characters in the 囟 class are formed with 囟.

巤.e: 毛巤也。象髮在囟上及毛髮巤巤之形。此與籒文子字同。
巤.eEn: A mane or mass of hair. It depicts hair on top of 囟 and the appearance of thick, bristling hair. This has the same form as the large-seal character 子.

思.e: 容也。从心囟聲。凡思之屬皆从思。
思.eEn: To contain or accommodate. Formed from 心, with 囟 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 思 class are formed with 思.

慮.eEn: To deliberate and think. Formed from 思, with 虍 indicating the pronunciation.

心.e: 人心，土藏，在身之中。象形。博士說以爲火藏。凡心之屬皆从心。
心.eEn: The human heart, described here as the organ associated with earth, in the center of the body. A pictograph. The court scholars explain it instead as the organ associated with fire. All characters in the 心 class are formed with 心.

息.eEn: To breathe. Formed from 心 and 自, with 自 also indicating the pronunciation.

情.e: 人之陰气有欲者。从心青聲。
情.eEn: The yin vital force in people that has desires. Formed from 心, with 青 indicating the pronunciation.

性.e: 人之陽气性善者也。从心生聲。
性.eEn: The yang vital force in people, whose nature is good. Formed from 心, with 生 indicating the pronunciation.

意.e: 志也。从心察言而知意也。从心从音。
意.eEn: Intention. Formed with 心: by examining words in one's heart, one knows their intention. Formed from 心 and 音.

恉.eEn: Intention or meaning. Formed from 心, with 旨 indicating the pronunciation.

悳.e: 外得於人，内得於己也。从直从心。
悳.eEn: What is attained outwardly in relation to others and inwardly within oneself. Formed from 直 and 心.

應.eEn: To correspond or match. Formed from 心, with 𤸰 indicating the pronunciation.

愼.eEn: To be cautious. Formed from 心, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation.

荼.eEn: Bitter edible greens. Formed from 艸, with 余 indicating the pronunciation.

忠.eEn: To be reverent. Formed from 心, with 中 indicating the pronunciation.

愨.eEn: To be cautious. Formed from 心, with 𣪊 indicating the pronunciation.

快.eEn: Joyful. Formed from 心, with 夬 indicating the pronunciation.

念.eEn: To think of constantly. Formed from 心, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

怤.eEn: To think. Formed from 心, with 付 indicating the pronunciation.

憲.eEn: Quick and perceptive. Formed from 心 and 目, with an abbreviated 害 indicating the pronunciation.

憕.eEn: Even or balanced. Formed from 心, with 登 indicating the pronunciation.

戁.eEn: To be reverent. Formed from 心, with 難 indicating the pronunciation.

忻.e: 闓也。从心斤聲。《司馬法》曰：“善者，忻民之善，閉民之惡。”
忻.eEn: To open. Formed from 心, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation. The Methods of Sima says: “A good leader opens the people's goodness and shuts off their evil.”

惲.eEn: Grave and substantial in character. Formed from 心, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

惇.eEn: Substantial or sincere in character. Formed from 心, with 𦎫 indicating the pronunciation.

忼.e: 慨也。从心亢聲。一曰《易》“忼龍有悔”。
忼.eEn: Impassioned or indignant. Formed from 心, with 亢 indicating the pronunciation. Another usage occurs in the Changes: “The overreaching dragon has cause for regret.”

慨.e: 忼慨，壯士不得志也。从心旣聲。
慨.eEn: 忼慨: the impassioned indignation of a stout-hearted man whose ambitions are unfulfilled. Formed from 心, with 旣 indicating the pronunciation.

悃.eEn: Sincere. Formed from 心, with 困 indicating the pronunciation.

愊.eEn: Sincere in intention. Formed from 心, with 畐 indicating the pronunciation.

愿.eEn: To be cautious. Formed from 心, with 原 indicating the pronunciation.

禍.e: 害也，神不福也。从示咼聲。
禍.eEn: Harm: the spirits do not bestow blessings. Formed from 示, with 咼 indicating the pronunciation.

蒿.eEn: The plant called 菣. Formed from 艸, with 高 indicating the pronunciation.

慧.eEn: Clever or quick-witted. Formed from 心, with 彗 indicating the pronunciation.

憭.eEn: Intelligent or discerning. Formed from 心, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation.

恔.eEn: Discerning or clear in understanding. Formed from 心, with 交 indicating the pronunciation.

瘱.eEn: Quiet or still. Formed from 心, with 㾜 indicating the pronunciation.

悊.eEn: To be reverent. Formed from 心, with 折 indicating the pronunciation.

悰.eEn: Joy. Formed from 心, with 宗 indicating the pronunciation.

恬.eEn: At peace. Formed from 心, with an abbreviated 甛 indicating the pronunciation.

恢.eEn: Great or broad. Formed from 心, with 灰 indicating the pronunciation.

恭.eEn: Solemn and respectful. Formed from 心, with 共 indicating the pronunciation.

憼.eEn: To be reverent. Formed from 心 and 敬, with 敬 also indicating the pronunciation.

蓬.eEn: A kind of wormwood. Formed from 艸, with 逢 indicating the pronunciation.

恕.eEn: Benevolence. Formed from 心, with 如 indicating the pronunciation.

怡.eEn: Harmonious. Formed from 心, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

慈.eEn: To love. Formed from 心, with 兹 indicating the pronunciation.

忯.eEn: To love. Formed from 心, with 氏 indicating the pronunciation.

恮.eEn: Careful; circumspect. Formed from 心, with 全 indicating the pronunciation.

恩.eEn: Kindness; favor. Formed from 心, with 因 indicating the pronunciation.

慸.e: 高也。一曰極也。一曰困劣也。从心帶聲。
慸.eEn: High. Another explanation: extreme. Another explanation: distressed and weak. Formed from 心, with 帶 indicating the pronunciation.

憖.e: 問也。謹敬也。从心猌聲。一曰說也。一曰甘也。《春秋傳》曰：“昊天不憖。”又曰：“兩君之士皆未憖。”
憖.eEn: To ask; to be careful and respectful. Formed from 心, with 猌 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: pleased. Another explanation: willing. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Vast Heaven was unwilling.” It also says: “The officers of both rulers were all unwilling.”

懬.e: 闊也。一曰廣也，大也。一曰寬也。从心从廣，廣亦聲。
懬.eEn: Broad. Another explanation: extensive; great. Another explanation: generous. Formed from 心 and 廣, with 廣 also indicating the pronunciation.

藜.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 黎 indicating the pronunciation.

悈.e: 飾也。从心戒聲。《司馬法》曰：“有虞氏悈於中國。”
悈.eEn: To adorn; to equip. Formed from 心, with 戒 indicating the pronunciation. The Methods of the Minister of War says: “The ruler of the Youyu clan equipped the central states.”

慶.e: 行賀人也。从心从夂。吉禮以鹿皮爲贄，故从鹿省。
慶.eEn: To go and congratulate someone. Formed from 心 and 夂. In auspicious ceremonies, deerskin is used as a presentation gift; hence it is also formed with an abbreviated 鹿.

愃.e: 寬嫺心腹皃。从心宣聲。《詩》曰：“赫兮愃兮。”
愃.eEn: The appearance of being broad-minded and at ease within. Formed from 心, with 宣 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “How imposing! How broad-minded!”

愻.e: 順也。从心孫聲。《唐書》曰：“五品不愻。”
愻.eEn: Compliant. Formed from 心, with 孫 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Tang says: “The five relationships are not harmonious.”

恂.eEn: A trustworthy heart. Formed from 心, with 旬 indicating the pronunciation.

忱.e: 誠也。从心冘聲。《詩》曰：“天命匪忱。”
忱.eEn: Sincere. Formed from 心, with 冘 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Heaven's mandate is not dependable.”

惟.eEn: To think, in a general sense. Formed from 心, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

懷.eEn: To keep in mind; to think of. Formed from 心, with 褱 indicating the pronunciation.

蘬.eEn: The seeds of shepherd's purse. Formed from 艸, with 歸 indicating the pronunciation.

惀.eEn: The appearance of wanting to know something. Formed from 心, with 侖 indicating the pronunciation.

想.eEn: To think with hope or longing. Formed from 心, with 相 indicating the pronunciation.

慉.e: 起也。从心畜聲。《詩》曰：“能不我慉。”
慉.eEn: To raise up. Formed from 心, with 畜 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Yet you will not raise me up.”

悹.eEn: To worry. Formed from 心, with 官 indicating the pronunciation.

憀.eEn: The state expressed by 憀然. Formed from 心, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation.

愙.e: 敬也。从心客聲。《春秋傳》曰：“以陳備三愙。”
愙.eEn: To respect. Formed from 心, with 客 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “With Chen, the complement of the three honored guests was complete.”

愯.e: 懼也。从心，雙省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“駟氏愯。”
愯.eEn: To fear. Formed from 心, with an abbreviated 雙 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The Si clan was afraid.”

懼.eEn: To fear. Formed from 心, with 瞿 indicating the pronunciation.

葆.eEn: The appearance of luxuriant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 𠈃 indicating the pronunciation.

怙.eEn: To rely on. Formed from 心, with 古 indicating the pronunciation.

恃.eEn: To depend on. Formed from 心, with 寺 indicating the pronunciation.

慒.eEn: To ponder. Formed from 心, with 曹 indicating the pronunciation.

悟.eEn: To awaken; to become aware. Formed from 心, with 吾 indicating the pronunciation.

憮.e: 愛也。韓鄭曰憮。一曰不動。从心無聲。
憮.eEn: To love. In Han and Zheng, this is called 憮. Another explanation: unmoving. Formed from 心, with 無 indicating the pronunciation.

慰.e: 安也。从心尉聲。一曰恚怒也。
慰.eEn: To soothe; to put at ease. Formed from 心, with 尉 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: resentment and anger.

蕃.eEn: Luxuriant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 番 indicating the pronunciation.

怞.e: 朗也。从心由聲。《詩》曰：“憂心且怞。”
怞.eEn: Bright; clear. Formed from 心, with 由 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “My troubled heart is also 怞.”

忞.e: 彊也。从心文聲。《周書》曰：“在受德忞。”讀若旻。
忞.eEn: Strong; striving. Formed from 心, with 文 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “In receiving virtue, be steadfast.” Pronounced like 旻.

慔.eEn: To exert oneself. Formed from 心, with 莫 indicating the pronunciation.

愐.eEn: To exert oneself. Formed from 心, with 面 indicating the pronunciation.

懋.e: 勉也。从心楙聲。《虞書》曰：“時惟懋哉。”
懋.eEn: To exert oneself. Formed from 心, with 楙 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Yu says: “In this, exert yourselves!”

悛.eEn: To stop. Formed from 心, with 夋 indicating the pronunciation.

茸.eEn: The appearance of vegetation growing thick and soft. Formed from 艸, with an abbreviated 聦 indicating the pronunciation.

慆.eEn: Pleased. Formed from 心, with 舀 indicating the pronunciation.

懕.e: 安也。从心厭聲。《詩》曰：“懕懕夜飲。”
懕.eEn: At ease. Formed from 心, with 厭 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “At ease, they drink through the night.”

憺.eEn: At ease. Formed from 心, with 詹 indicating the pronunciation.

怕.eEn: Without activity. Formed from 心, with 白 indicating the pronunciation.

恤.eEn: To worry; to gather in. Formed from 心, with 血 indicating the pronunciation.

忓.eEn: To reach an extreme. Formed from 心, with 干 indicating the pronunciation.

懽.e: 喜𠭥也。从心雚聲。《爾雅》曰：“懽懽愮愮，憂無告也。”
懽.eEn: Joy; delight. Formed from 心, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “懽懽 and 愮愮 describe being troubled with no one to tell.”

惄.e: 飢餓也。一曰憂也。从心叔聲。《詩》曰：“惄如朝飢。”
惄.eEn: Hunger; starvation. Another explanation: sorrow. Formed from 心, with 叔 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Distressed as though hungry in the morning.”

葏.eEn: The appearance of vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 津 indicating the pronunciation.

憸.e: 憸詖也。憸利於上，佞人也。从心僉聲。
憸.eEn: Crafty and biased. One who craftily seeks advantage from superiors is a flatterer. Formed from 心, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation.

愒.eEn: To rest. Formed from 心, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation.

急.eEn: Narrow; constrained. Formed from 心, with 及 indicating the pronunciation.

懁.eEn: Impatient; urgent. Formed from 心, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 絹.

慓.eEn: Swift. Formed from 心, with 票 indicating the pronunciation.

懦.eEn: A feeble and weak person. Formed from 心, with 需 indicating the pronunciation.

恁.eEn: To provide for those below. Formed from 心, with 任 indicating the pronunciation.

怚.eEn: Arrogant. Formed from 心, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

悒.eEn: Uneasy. Formed from 心, with 邑 indicating the pronunciation.

悆.e: 忘也。嘾也。从心余聲。《周書》曰：“有疾不悆。”悆，喜也。
悆.eEn: To forget; to crave. Formed from 心, with 余 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “He was ill and not at ease.” 悆 also means joy.

忒.eEn: To change. Formed from 心, with 弋 indicating the pronunciation.

憪.eEn: Pleased; at ease. Formed from 心, with 閒 indicating the pronunciation.

草.e: 草斗，櫟實也。一曰象斗子。从艸早聲。
草.eEn: 草斗, the fruit of an oak. Another explanation: the seed called “elephant-dou.” Formed from 艸, with 早 indicating the pronunciation.

愉.e: 薄也。从心俞聲。《論語》曰：“私覿，愉愉如也。”
愉.eEn: Thin; slight. Formed from 心, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “At a private audience, his manner was pleasantly at ease.”

懱.e: 輕易也。从心蔑聲。《商書》曰：“以相陵懱。”
懱.eEn: To regard lightly; to treat with contempt. Formed from 心, with 蔑 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Shang says: “Thereby bullying and despising one another.”

愚.e: 戇也。从心从禺。禺，猴屬，獸之愚者。
愚.eEn: Foolish. Formed from 心 and 禺. 禺 is a kind of monkey, a foolish animal.

戇.eEn: Foolish. Formed from 心, with 𥫔 indicating the pronunciation.

憃.eEn: Foolish. Formed from 心, with 舂 indicating the pronunciation.

懝.e: 騃也。从心从疑，疑亦聲。一曰惶也。
懝.eEn: Stupid. Formed from 心 and 疑, with 疑 also indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: frightened.

忮.eEn: Obstinate; contrary. Formed from 心, with 支 indicating the pronunciation.

悍.eEn: Brave. Formed from 心, with 旱 indicating the pronunciation.

態.eEn: Intent; disposition. Formed from 心 and 能.

祟.eEn: Calamity caused by spirits. Formed from 示 and 出.

菆.e: 麻蒸也。从艸取聲。一曰蓐也。
菆.eEn: Hemp stalks. Formed from 艸, with 取 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: bedding.

怪.eEn: Strange; unusual. Formed from 心, with 圣 indicating the pronunciation.

慢.e: 惰也。从心曼聲。一曰慢，不畏也。
慢.eEn: Idle; negligent. Formed from 心, with 曼 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: 慢 means having no fear.

怠.eEn: Idle; negligent. Formed from 心, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

懈.eEn: Slack; remiss. Formed from 心, with 解 indicating the pronunciation.

憜.e: 不敬也。从心，𡐦省。《春秋傳》曰：“執玉憜。”
憜.eEn: Disrespectful. Formed from 心 and an abbreviated 𡐦. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “He held the jade disrespectfully.”

怫.eEn: Pent up; stifled. Formed from 心, with 弗 indicating the pronunciation.

忽.eEn: To forget. Formed from 心, with 勿 indicating the pronunciation.

蓄.eEn: To accumulate. Formed from 艸, with 畜 indicating the pronunciation.

忘.e: 不識也。从心从亡，亡亦聲。
忘.eEn: Not to remember. Formed from 心 and 亡, with 亡 also indicating the pronunciation.

慲.eEn: To forget; to be muddled, as expressed by 慲兜. Formed from 心, with 㒼 indicating the pronunciation.

恣.eEn: To give free rein. Formed from 心, with 次 indicating the pronunciation.

愓.e: 放也。从心昜聲。一曰平也。
愓.eEn: Unrestrained. Formed from 心, with 昜 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: level; even.

憧.eEn: Unsettled in one's intentions. Formed from 心, with 童 indicating the pronunciation.

悝.e: 啁也。从心里聲。《春秋傳》有孔悝。一曰病也。
悝.eEn: To mock. Formed from 心, with 里 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals mentions Kong Kui, written 孔悝. Another explanation: illness.

憰.eEn: Scheming and deceit. Formed from 心, with 矞 indicating the pronunciation.

怳.eEn: The appearance of madness. Formed from 心, with an abbreviated 況 indicating the pronunciation.

恑.eEn: To change. Formed from 心, with 危 indicating the pronunciation.

萅.e: 推也。从艸从日，艸春時生也；屯聲。
萅.eEn: To push forth. Formed from 艸 and 日: vegetation grows in spring. 屯 indicates the pronunciation.

悸.eEn: The heart moving or pounding. Formed from 心, with 季 indicating the pronunciation.

憿.eEn: Good fortune. Formed from 心, with 敫 indicating the pronunciation.

懖.e: 善自用之意也。从心銛聲。《商書》曰：“今汝懖懖。”
懖.eEn: A disposition to favor one's own judgment. Formed from 心, with 銛 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Shang says: “Now you are wholly self-willed.”

忨.e: 貪也。从心元聲。《春秋傳》曰：“忨歲而㵣日。”
忨.eEn: To covet. Formed from 心, with 元 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Coveting years and thirsting for days.”

惏.e: 河内之北謂貪曰惏。从心林聲。
惏.eEn: North of Henei, greed is called 惏. Formed from 心, with 林 indicating the pronunciation.

懜.eEn: Unclear; not understanding. Formed from 心, with 夢 indicating the pronunciation.

愆.eEn: A fault; a transgression. Formed from 心, with 衍 indicating the pronunciation.

慊.eEn: To doubt. Formed from 心, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

惑.eEn: Confused; disordered. Formed from 心, with 或 indicating the pronunciation.

怋.eEn: Confusion. Formed from 心, with 民 indicating the pronunciation.

怓.e: 亂也。从心奴聲。《詩》曰：“以謹惽怓。”
怓.eEn: Disorder. Formed from 心, with 奴 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Be cautious about confusion and disorder.”

惷.e: 亂也。从心春聲。《春秋傳》曰：“王室日惷惷焉。”一曰厚也。
惷.eEn: Disorder. Formed from 心, with 春 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The royal house grows more disordered by the day.” Another meaning is substantial or generous.

惛.eEn: Not understanding clearly. Formed from 心, with 昬 indicating the pronunciation.

忥.eEn: A foolish appearance. Formed from 心, with 气 indicating the pronunciation.

憒.eEn: Confusion. Formed from 心, with 貴 indicating the pronunciation.

忌.eEn: To hate or detest. Formed from 心, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

忿.eEn: Anger. Formed from 心, with 分 indicating the pronunciation.

悁.e: 忿也。从心肙聲。一曰憂也。
悁.eEn: Anger. Formed from 心, with 肙 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is sorrow.

菿.eEn: Plants and trees falling over. Formed from 艸, with 到 indicating the pronunciation.

恚.eEn: Resentment. Formed from 心, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

怨.eEn: Anger or resentment. Formed from 心, with 夗 indicating the pronunciation.

怒.eEn: Anger. Formed from 心, with 奴 indicating the pronunciation.

憝.e: 怨也。从心敦聲。《周書》曰：“凡民罔不憝。”
憝.eEn: Resentment. Formed from 心, with 敦 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “Among the people, none fails to resent it.”

慍.eEn: Anger. Formed from 心, with 𥁕 indicating the pronunciation.

惡.eEn: A fault. Formed from 心, with 亞 indicating the pronunciation.

憎.eEn: To hate. Formed from 心, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

芙.eEn: The lotus, called 芙蓉. Formed from 艸, with 夫 indicating the pronunciation.

恨.eEn: Resentment. Formed from 心, with 艮 indicating the pronunciation.

懟.eEn: Resentment. Formed from 心, with 對 indicating the pronunciation.

悔.eEn: Regret and resentment. Formed from 心, with 𣫭 indicating the pronunciation.

怏.eEn: Unwilling to submit; resentful. Formed from 心, with 央 indicating the pronunciation.

懣.eEn: Vexation. Formed from 心 and 滿.

憤.eEn: Vexation. Formed from 心, with 賁 indicating the pronunciation.

悶.eEn: Vexation. Formed from 心, with 門 indicating the pronunciation.

惆.eEn: Disappointment. Formed from 心, with 周 indicating the pronunciation.

蓉.eEn: The lotus, called 芙蓉. Formed from 艸, with 容 indicating the pronunciation.

悵.eEn: Longing and regret. Formed from 心, with 長 indicating the pronunciation.

愾.e: 大息也。从心从氣，氣亦聲。《詩》曰：“愾我寤歎。”
愾.eEn: A deep sigh. Formed from 心 and 氣, with 氣 also indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Deeply I sigh upon waking.”

懆.e: 愁不安也。从心喿聲。《詩》曰：“念子懆懆。”
懆.eEn: Sorrowful and uneasy. Formed from 心, with 喿 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Thinking of you, I am sorrowful and uneasy.”

愴.eEn: Grief. Formed from 心, with 倉 indicating the pronunciation.

怛.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 旦 indicating the pronunciation.

憯.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 朁 indicating the pronunciation.

慘.eEn: Harm or cruelty. Formed from 心, with 參 indicating the pronunciation.

悽.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 妻 indicating the pronunciation.

恫.e: 痛也。一曰呻吟也。从心同聲。
恫.eEn: Pain. Another meaning is to groan. Formed from 心, with 同 indicating the pronunciation.

悲.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

薳.e: 艸也。《左氏傳》：“楚大夫薳子馮。”从艸逺聲。
薳.eEn: A plant. The Zuo Commentary mentions “Wei Zifeng, a high official of Chu.” Formed from 艸, with 逺 indicating the pronunciation.

惻.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 則 indicating the pronunciation.

惜.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 㫺 indicating the pronunciation.

愍.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 敃 indicating the pronunciation.

慇.eEn: Pain. Formed from 心, with 殷 indicating the pronunciation.

慅.e: 動也。从心蚤聲。一曰起也。
慅.eEn: To move. Formed from 心, with 蚤 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is to rise.

感.eEn: To move a person's heart. Formed from 心, with 咸 indicating the pronunciation.

忧.e: 不動也。从心尤聲。讀若祐。
忧.eEn: Unmoving. Formed from 心, with 尤 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 祐.

荀.eEn: A plant. Formed from 艸, with 旬 indicating the pronunciation.

愪.eEn: A worried appearance. Formed from 心, with 員 indicating the pronunciation.

怮.eEn: A worried appearance. Formed from 心, with 幼 indicating the pronunciation.

忦.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 介 indicating the pronunciation.

恙.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 羊 indicating the pronunciation.

惴.e: 憂懼也。从心耑聲。《詩》曰：“惴惴其慄。”
惴.eEn: Worry and fear. Formed from 心, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Anxiously, fearfully trembling.”

憌.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 鈞 indicating the pronunciation.

怲.e: 憂也。从心丙聲。《詩》曰：“憂心怲怲。”
怲.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 丙 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “My troubled heart is full of worry.”

惔.e: 憂也。从心炎聲。《詩》曰：“憂心如惔。”
惔.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 炎 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “My troubled heart is as though burning.”

惙.e: 憂也。从心叕聲。《詩》曰：“憂心惙惙。”一曰意不定也。
惙.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 叕 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “My troubled heart is full of anxiety.” Another meaning is an unsettled mind.

慯.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with an abbreviated form of 殤 indicating the pronunciation.

莋.e: 越嶲縣名，見《史記》。从艸作聲。
莋.eEn: The name of a county in Yuexi, mentioned in the Records of the Grand Historian. Formed from 艸, with 作 indicating the pronunciation.

愁.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 秋 indicating the pronunciation.

愵.e: 憂皃。从心弱聲。讀與惄同。
愵.eEn: A worried appearance. Formed from 心, with 弱 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 惄.

惂.eEn: Worried and distressed. Formed from 心, with 臽 indicating the pronunciation.

悠.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 攸 indicating the pronunciation.

悴.e: 憂也。从心卒聲。讀與《易》萃卦同。
悴.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 卒 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 萃, the hexagram in the Book of Changes.

慁.e: 憂也。从心圂聲。一曰擾也。
慁.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 圂 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is to disturb.

忡.e: 憂也。从心中聲。《詩》曰：“憂心忡忡。”
忡.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 中 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “My troubled heart is full of worry.”

悄.e: 憂也。从心肖聲。《詩》曰：“憂心悄悄。”
悄.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “My troubled heart is full of sorrow.”

蓀.eEn: A fragrant plant. Formed from 艸, with 孫 indicating the pronunciation.

慽.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 戚 indicating the pronunciation.

患.e: 憂也。从心上貫吅，吅亦聲。
患.eEn: Worry. Formed from 心, with 吅 pierced through above it; 吅 also indicates the pronunciation.

恇.eEn: Timidity. Formed from 心 and 匡, with 匡 also indicating the pronunciation.

懾.e: 失气也。从心聶聲。一曰服也。
懾.eEn: To lose one's courage. Formed from 心, with 聶 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is to submit.

憚.e: 忌難也。从心單聲。一曰難也。
憚.eEn: To shrink from difficulty. Formed from 心, with 單 indicating the pronunciation. Another meaning is difficulty.

悼.e: 懼也。陳楚謂懼曰悼。从心卓聲。
悼.eEn: Fear. In Chen and Chu, fear is called 悼. Formed from 心, with 卓 indicating the pronunciation.

恐.eEn: Fear. Formed from 心, with 𢀜 indicating the pronunciation.

慴.eEn: Fear. Formed from 心, with 習 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 疊.

蔬.eEn: Vegetables. Formed from 艸, with 疏 indicating the pronunciation.

怵.eEn: Fear. Formed from 心, with 术 indicating the pronunciation.

惕.eEn: Reverent attentiveness. Formed from 心, with 易 indicating the pronunciation.

惶.eEn: Fear. Formed from 心, with 皇 indicating the pronunciation.

悑.eEn: Fear. Formed from 心, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation.

慹.eEn: Fear. Formed from 心, with 執 indicating the pronunciation.

惎.e: 毒也。从心其聲。《周書》曰：“來就惎惎。”
惎.eEn: To harm. Formed from 心, with 其 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Zhou says: “They come near, intent on harm.”

芊.eEn: Luxuriant vegetation. Formed from 艸, with 千 indicating the pronunciation.

恥.eEn: Disgrace. Formed from 心, with 耳 indicating the pronunciation.

慙.eEn: Shame. Formed from 心, with 斬 indicating the pronunciation.

恧.eEn: Shame. Formed from 心, with 而 indicating the pronunciation.

怍.eEn: Shame. Formed from 心, with an abbreviated form of 作 indicating the pronunciation.

憐.eEn: Pity. Formed from 心, with 粦 indicating the pronunciation.

忍.eEn: To be able to bear. Formed from 心, with 刃 indicating the pronunciation.

茗.eEn: Tea shoots. Formed from 艸, with 名 indicating the pronunciation.

懲.eEn: To chastise. Formed from 心, with 徵 indicating the pronunciation.

憬.e: 覺寤也。从心景聲。《詩》曰：“憬彼淮夷。”
憬.eEn: To awaken. Formed from 心, with 景 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Those Huai tribes awaken.”

慵.eEn: Laziness. Formed from 心, with 庸 indicating the pronunciation.

悱.eEn: The mouth struggling to express itself. Formed from 心, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

怩.eEn: Used in 衂怩, meaning ashamed. Formed from 心, with 尼 indicating the pronunciation.

惉.eEn: Used in 惉懘, meaning a vexing sound. Formed from 心, with 沾 indicating the pronunciation.

懘.eEn: Used in 惉懘, meaning a vexing sound. Formed from 心, with 滞 indicating the pronunciation.

懇.eEn: Sincerity. Formed from 心, with 豤 indicating the pronunciation.

忖.eEn: To assess or estimate. Formed from 心, with 寸 indicating the pronunciation.

薌.eEn: The aroma of grain. Formed from 艸, with 鄉 indicating the pronunciation.

怊.eEn: Sorrow. Formed from 心, with 召 indicating the pronunciation.

慟.eEn: To weep loudly. Formed from 心, with 動 indicating the pronunciation.

惹.eEn: Disorder. Formed from 心, with 若 indicating the pronunciation.

恰.eEn: To apply one's mind. Formed from 心, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

悌.e: 善兄弟也。从心弟聲。經典通用弟。
悌.eEn: To behave well toward one's brothers. Formed from 心, with 弟 indicating the pronunciation. The classical texts commonly use 弟 for this word.

懌.e: 說也。从心睪聲。經典通用釋。
懌.eEn: To be pleased. Formed from 心, with 睪 indicating the pronunciation. The classical texts commonly use 釋 for this word.

惢.e: 心疑也。从三心。凡惢之屬皆从惢。讀若《易》“旅瑣瑣”。
惢.eEn: Doubt in the heart. Formed from three 心 components. All characters in the 惢 class are formed with 惢. Pronounced like 瑣 in the Book of Changes phrase, “The traveler is petty and trifling.”

繠.eEn: To hang down. Formed from 惢, with 糸 indicating the pronunciation.

水.e: 凖也。北方之行。象眾水並流，中有微陽之气也。凡水之屬皆从水。
水.eEn: A level or standard. The phase associated with the north. Its form depicts many streams flowing side by side, with a faint breath of yang energy in their midst. All characters in the 水 class are formed with 水.

汃.e: 西極之水也。从水八聲。《爾雅》曰：“西至汃國，謂四極。”
汃.eEn: The waters of the far west. Formed from 水, with 八 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “Westward as far as the country of 汃: these are called the four extremities.”

河.e: 水。出焞煌塞外昆侖山，發原注海。从水可聲。
河.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Kunlun beyond the frontier at Dunhuang; from its source it flows into the sea. Formed from 水, with 可 indicating the pronunciation.

泑.e: 澤。在昆侖下。从水幼聲。讀與𣢜同。
泑.eEn: A marsh below Mount Kunlun. Formed from 水, with 幼 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 𣢜.

涷.e: 水。出發鳩山，入於河。从水東聲。
涷.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Fajiu and enters the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 東 indicating the pronunciation.

涪.e: 水。出廣漢剛邑道徼外，南入漢。从水咅聲。
涪.eEn: A river. It rises beyond the frontier of Gangyi Circuit in Guanghan and flows south into the Han River. Formed from 水, with 咅 indicating the pronunciation.

潼.e: 水。出廣漢梓潼北界，南入墊江。从水童聲。
潼.eEn: A river. It rises on the northern boundary of Zitong in Guanghan and flows south into the Dian River. Formed from 水, with 童 indicating the pronunciation.

江.e: 水。出蜀湔氐徼外崏山，入海。从水工聲。
江.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Min beyond the frontier of Jiandi in Shu and enters the sea. Formed from 水, with 工 indicating the pronunciation.

沱.e: 江別流也。出㟭山東，別爲沱。从水它聲。
沱.eEn: A branch of the Jiang River. It branches off east of Mount Min and becomes the Tuo River. Formed from 水, with 它 indicating the pronunciation.

浙.e: 江。水東至會稽山陰爲浙江。从水折聲。
浙.eEn: A river. The river flows east to Shanyin in Kuaiji, where it becomes the Zhe River. Formed from 水, with 折 indicating the pronunciation.

涐.e: 水。出蜀汶江徼外，東南入江。从水我聲。
涐.eEn: A river. It rises beyond the frontier of Wenjiang in Shu and flows southeast into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 我 indicating the pronunciation.

湔.e: 水。出蜀郡緜虒玉壘山，東南入江。从水前聲。一曰手𤃬之。
湔.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Yulei in Miansi, Shu Commandery, and flows southeast into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 前 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to rinse something by hand.

蕆.e: 《左氏傳》：“以蕆陳事。”杜預注云：蕆，敕也。从艸未详。
蕆.eEn: The Zuo Commentary says: “To put the affairs of Chen in order.” Du Yu's commentary says: “蕆 means to put in order.” It is formed from 艸; the reason is not fully explained.

沫.e: 水。出蜀西徼外，東南入江。从水末聲。
沫.eEn: A river. It rises beyond the western frontier of Shu and flows southeast into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 末 indicating the pronunciation.

溫.e: 水。出犍爲涪，南入黔水。从水𥁕聲。
溫.eEn: A river. It rises at Fu in Qianwei and flows south into the Qian River. Formed from 水, with 𥁕 indicating the pronunciation.

灊.e: 水。出巴郡宕渠，西南入江。从水鬵聲。
灊.eEn: A river. It rises at Dangqu in Ba Commandery and flows southwest into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 鬵 indicating the pronunciation.

沮.e: 水。出漢中房陵，東入江。从水且聲。
沮.eEn: A river. It rises at Fangling in Hanzhong and flows east into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

滇.eEn: The name of a lake in Yizhou. Formed from 水, with 眞 indicating the pronunciation.

涂.e: 水。出益州牧靡南山，西北入澠。从水余聲。
涂.eEn: A river. It rises on the southern mountain of Mumi in Yizhou and flows northwest into the Mian River. Formed from 水, with 余 indicating the pronunciation.

沅.e: 水。出牂牁故且蘭，東北入江。从水元聲。
沅.eEn: A river. It rises at the former Qielan in Zangke and flows northeast into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 元 indicating the pronunciation.

淹.e: 水。出越巂徼外，東入若水。从水奄聲。
淹.eEn: A river. It rises beyond the frontier of Yuexi and flows east into the Ruo River. Formed from 水, with 奄 indicating the pronunciation.

溺.e: 水。自張掖𠛹丹西，至酒泉合黎，餘波入于流沙。从水弱聲。桑欽所說。
溺.eEn: A river. From west of Shandan in Zhangye it reaches Heli in Jiuquan; its remaining waters enter the Flowing Sands. Formed from 水, with 弱 indicating the pronunciation. This is Sang Qin's account.

洮.e: 水。出隴西臨洮，東北入河。从水兆聲。
洮.eEn: A river. It rises at Lintao in Longxi and flows northeast into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation.

蘸.e: 以物没水也。此蓋俗語。从艸未详。
蘸.eEn: To immerse an object in water. This is probably a colloquial expression. It is formed from 艸; the reason is not fully explained.

涇.e: 水。出安定涇陽幵頭山，東南入渭。雝州之川也。从水坙聲。
涇.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Jiantou at Jingyang in Anding and flows southeast into the Wei River. It is a river of Yongzhou. Formed from 水, with 坙 indicating the pronunciation.

渭.e: 水。出隴西首陽渭首亭南谷，東入河。从水胃聲。杜林說。《夏書》以爲出鳥鼠山。雝州浸也。
渭.eEn: A river. It rises in the southern valley of Weishou Pavilion at Shouyang in Longxi and flows east into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 胃 indicating the pronunciation. This is Du Lin's explanation. The Book of Xia places its source on Mount Niaoshu. It is a principal watercourse of Yongzhou.

漾.e: 水。出隴西相道，東至武都爲漢。从水羕聲。
漾.eEn: A river. It rises at Xiangdao in Longxi and flows east to Wudu, where it becomes the Han River. Formed from 水, with 羕 indicating the pronunciation.

漢.e: 漾也。東爲滄浪水。从水，難省聲。
漢.eEn: The Yang River. Farther east it becomes the Canglang River. Formed from 水, with a reduced form of 難 indicating the pronunciation.

浪.e: 滄浪水也。南入江。从水良聲。
浪.eEn: The Canglang River. It flows south into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 良 indicating the pronunciation.

沔.e: 水。出武都沮縣東狼谷，東南入江。或曰入夏水。从水丏聲。
沔.eEn: A river. It rises in Donglang Valley in Ju County, Wudu, and flows southeast into the Jiang River. Another account says that it enters the Xia River. Formed from 水, with 丏 indicating the pronunciation.

湟.e: 水。出金城臨羌塞外，東入河。从水皇聲。
湟.eEn: A river. It rises beyond the frontier of Linqiang in Jincheng and flows east into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 皇 indicating the pronunciation.

汧.e: 水。出扶風汧縣西北，入渭。从水幵聲。
汧.eEn: A river. It rises northwest of Qian County in Fufeng and enters the Wei River. Formed from 水, with 幵 indicating the pronunciation.

澇.e: 水。出扶風鄠，北入渭。从水勞聲。
澇.eEn: A river. It rises at Hu in Fufeng and flows north into the Wei River. Formed from 水, with 勞 indicating the pronunciation.

漆.e: 水。出右扶風杜陵岐山，東入渭。一曰入洛。从水桼聲。
漆.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Qi at Duling in Right Fufeng and flows east into the Wei River. Another account says that it enters the Luo River. Formed from 水, with 桼 indicating the pronunciation.

蓐.e: 陳艸復生也。从艸辱聲。一曰蔟也。凡蓐之屬皆从蓐。
蓐.eEn: Old grass growing again. Formed from 艸, with 辱 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a cluster. All characters in the 蓐 class are formed with 蓐.

滻.e: 水。出京兆藍田谷，入霸。从水產聲。
滻.eEn: A river. It rises in Lantian Valley in Jingzhao and enters the Ba River. Formed from 水, with 產 indicating the pronunciation.

洛.e: 水。出左馮翊歸德北夷界中，東南入渭。从水各聲。
洛.eEn: A river. It rises in the territory of the northern Yi at Guide in Left Fengyi and flows southeast into the Wei River. Formed from 水, with 各 indicating the pronunciation.

淯.e: 水。出弘農盧氏山，東南入海。从水育聲。或曰出酈山西。
淯.eEn: A river. It rises in the mountains of Lushi in Hongnong and flows southeast into the sea. Formed from 水, with 育 indicating the pronunciation. Another account says that it rises west of Mount Li.

汝.e: 水。出弘農盧氏還歸山，東入淮。从水女聲。
汝.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Huangui at Lushi in Hongnong and flows east into the Huai River. Formed from 水, with 女 indicating the pronunciation.

潩.e: 水。出河南密縣大隗山，南入潁。从水異聲。
潩.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Dawei in Mi County, Henan, and flows south into the Ying River. Formed from 水, with 異 indicating the pronunciation.

汾.e: 水。出太原晉陽山，西南入河。从水分聲。或曰出汾陽北山，冀州浸。
汾.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Jinyang in Taiyuan and flows southwest into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 分 indicating the pronunciation. Another account says that it rises on the northern mountain of Fenyang and is a principal watercourse of Jizhou.

澮.e: 水。出靃山，西南入汾。从水會聲。
澮.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Huo and flows southwest into the Fen River. Formed from 水, with 會 indicating the pronunciation.

沁.e: 水。出上黨羊頭山，東南入河。从水心聲。
沁.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Yangtou in Shangdang and flows southeast into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 心 indicating the pronunciation.

沾.e: 水。出壺關，東入淇。一曰沾，益也。从水占聲。
沾.eEn: A river. It rises at Huguan and flows east into the Qi River. Another explanation is: 沾 means to increase. Formed from 水, with 占 indicating the pronunciation.

潞.e: 冀州浸也。上黨有潞縣。从水路聲。
潞.eEn: A principal watercourse of Jizhou. There is a Lu County in Shangdang. Formed from 水, with 路 indicating the pronunciation.

薅.e: 拔去田艸也。从蓐，好省聲。
薅.eEn: To pull weeds out of cultivated fields. Formed from 蓐, with a reduced form of 好 indicating the pronunciation.

漳.e: 濁漳，出上黨長子鹿谷山，東入清漳。清漳，出沾山大要谷，北入河。南漳，出南郡臨沮。从水章聲。
漳.eEn: The Zhuozhang River rises on Mount Lugu at Zhangzi in Shangdang and flows east into the Qingzhang River. The Qingzhang rises in Dayao Valley on Mount Zhan and flows north into the Yellow River. The Nanzhang rises at Linju in Nan Commandery. Formed from 水, with 章 indicating the pronunciation.

淇.e: 水。出河内共北山，東入河。或曰出隆慮西山。从水其聲。
淇.eEn: A river. It rises on the northern mountain of Gong in Henei and flows east into the Yellow River. Another account says that it rises on the western mountain of Longlü. Formed from 水, with 其 indicating the pronunciation.

沇.e: 水。出河東東垣王屋山，東爲泲。从水允聲。
沇.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Wangwu at Dongyuan in Hedong and becomes the Ji River farther east. Formed from 水, with 允 indicating the pronunciation.

泲.eEn: The Yan River. It flows east into the sea. Formed from 水, with 𠂔 indicating the pronunciation.

洈.e: 水。出南郡高城洈山，東入繇。从水危聲。
洈.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Wei at Gaocheng in Nan Commandery and flows east into the Yao River. Formed from 水, with 危 indicating the pronunciation.

溠.e: 水。在漢南。从水差聲。荆州浸也。《春秋傳》曰：“脩涂梁溠。”
溠.eEn: A river south of the Han River. Formed from 水, with 差 indicating the pronunciation. It is a principal watercourse of Jingzhou. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “They repaired the road and bridged the Zha River.”

洭.e: 水。出桂陽縣盧聚，山洭浦關爲桂水。从水匡聲。
洭.eEn: A river. It rises at Luju in Guiyang County; the text then mentions a mountain and Kuangpu Pass, where it becomes the Gui River. Formed from 水, with 匡 indicating the pronunciation.

潓.e: 水。出廬江，入淮。从水惠聲。
潓.eEn: A river. It rises in Lujiang and enters the Huai River. Formed from 水, with 惠 indicating the pronunciation.

灌.e: 水。出廬江雩婁，北入淮。从水雚聲。
灌.eEn: A river. It rises at Yulou in Lujiang and flows north into the Huai River. Formed from 水, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation.

帝.e: 諦也。王天下之號也。从丄朿聲。
帝.eEn: To discern clearly. The title of one who rules all under Heaven. Formed from 丄, with 朿 indicating the pronunciation.

祘.e: 明視以筭之。从二示。《逸周書》曰：“士分民之祘。均分以祘之也。”读若筭。
祘.eEn: To look clearly and reckon. Formed from two 示 components. The Lost Book of Zhou says: “The officers apportion the people's assessments. They divide them evenly and reckon them.” Pronounced like 筭.

茻.e: 眾艸也。从四屮。凡茻之屬皆从茻。讀與冈同。
茻.eEn: Abundant grasses. Formed from four 屮 components. All characters in the 茻 class are formed with 茻. Pronounced the same as 冈.

漸.e: 水。出丹陽黟南蠻中，東入海。从水斬聲。
漸.eEn: A river. It rises among the southern Man peoples south of Yi in Danyang and flows east into the sea. Formed from 水, with 斬 indicating the pronunciation.

泠.e: 水。出丹陽宛陵，西北入江。从水令聲。
泠.eEn: A river. It rises at Wanling in Danyang and flows northwest into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

溧.e: 水。出丹陽溧陽縣。从水栗聲。
溧.eEn: A river. It rises in Liyang County, Danyang. Formed from 水, with 栗 indicating the pronunciation.

湘.e: 水。出零陵陽海山，北入江。从水相聲。
湘.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Yanghai in Lingling and flows north into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 相 indicating the pronunciation.

汨.e: 長沙汨羅淵，屈原所沈之水。从水，冥省聲。
汨.eEn: The Miluo deep pool in Changsha: the waters in which Qu Yuan drowned himself. Formed from 水, with a reduced form of 冥 indicating the pronunciation.

溱.e: 水。出桂陽臨武，入匯。从水秦聲。
溱.eEn: A river. It rises at Linwu in Guiyang and enters the Hui River. Formed from 水, with 秦 indicating the pronunciation.

深.e: 水。出桂陽南平，西入營道。从水罙聲。
深.eEn: A river. It rises at Nanping in Guiyang and flows west into Yingdao. Formed from 水, with 罙 indicating the pronunciation.

潭.e: 水。出武陵鐔成玉山，東入鬱林。从水覃聲。
潭.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Yu at Tancheng in Wuling and flows east into Yulin. Formed from 水, with 覃 indicating the pronunciation.

油.e: 水。出武陵孱陵西，東南入江。从水由聲。
油.eEn: A river. It rises west of Chanling in Wuling and flows southeast into the Jiang River. Formed from 水, with 由 indicating the pronunciation.

莫.eEn: The sun is about to grow dark. Formed from 日 within 茻.

湞.e: 水。出南海龍川，西入溱。从水貞聲。
湞.eEn: A river. It rises at Longchuan in Nanhai and flows west into the Zhen River. Formed from 水, with 貞 indicating the pronunciation.

澑.eEn: A river. It rises in Yulin Commandery. Formed from 水, with 畱 indicating the pronunciation.

瀷.e: 水。出河南密縣，東入潁。从水翼聲。
瀷.eEn: A river. It rises in Mi County, Henan, and flows east into the Ying River. Formed from 水, with 翼 indicating the pronunciation.

潕.e: 水。出南陽舞陽，東入潁。从水無聲。
潕.eEn: A river. It rises at Wuyang in Nanyang and flows east into the Ying River. Formed from 水, with 無 indicating the pronunciation.

滶.e: 水。出南陽魯陽，入城父。从水敖聲。
滶.eEn: A river. It rises at Luyang in Nanyang and enters Chengfu. Formed from 水, with 敖 indicating the pronunciation.

瀙.e: 水。出南陽舞陽中陽山，入潁。从水親聲。
瀙.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Zhongyang at Wuyang in Nanyang and enters the Ying River. Formed from 水, with 親 indicating the pronunciation.

淮.e: 水。出南陽平氏桐柏大復山，東南入海。从水隹聲。
淮.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Dafu in the Tongbai range at Pingshi in Nanyang and flows southeast into the sea. Formed from 水, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

滍.e: 水。出南陽魯陽堯山，東北入汝。从水蚩聲。
滍.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Yao at Luyang in Nanyang and flows northeast into the Ru River. Formed from 水, with 蚩 indicating the pronunciation.

澧.e: 水。出南陽雉衡山，東入汝。从水豊聲。
澧.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Heng at Zhi in Nanyang and flows east into the Ru River. Formed from 水, with 豊 indicating the pronunciation.

莽.e: 南昌謂犬善逐菟艸中爲莽。从犬从茻，茻亦聲。
莽.eEn: In Nanchang, a dog skilled at chasing hares through grass is called 莽. Formed from 犬 and 茻, with 茻 also indicating the pronunciation.

溳.e: 水。出南陽蔡陽，東入夏水。从水員聲。
溳.eEn: A river. It rises at Caiyang in Nanyang and flows east into the Xia River. Formed from 水, with 員 indicating the pronunciation.

淠.e: 水。出汝南弋陽垂山，東入淮。从水𢌿聲。
淠.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Chui at Yiyang in Runan and flows east into the Huai River. Formed from 水, with 𢌿 indicating the pronunciation.

澺.e: 水。出汝南上蔡黑閭澗，入汝。从水意聲。
澺.eEn: A river. It rises in Heilü Ravine at Shangcai in Runan and enters the Ru River. Formed from 水, with 意 indicating the pronunciation.

灈.e: 水。出汝南吳房，入瀙。从水瞿聲。
灈.eEn: A river. It rises at Wufang in Runan and enters the Qin River. Formed from 水, with 瞿 indicating the pronunciation.

潁.e: 水。出潁川陽城乾山，東入淮。从水頃聲。豫州浸。
潁.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Qian at Yangcheng in Yingchuan and flows east into the Huai River. Formed from 水, with 頃 indicating the pronunciation. It is a principal watercourse of Yuzhou.

洧.e: 水。出潁川陽城山，東南入潁。从水有聲。
洧.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Yangcheng in Yingchuan and flows southeast into the Ying River. Formed from 水, with 有 indicating the pronunciation.

濦.e: 水。出潁川陽城少室山，東入潁。从水㥯聲。
濦.eEn: A river. It rises on Mount Shaoshi at Yangcheng in Yingchuan and flows east into the Ying River. Formed from 水, with 㥯 indicating the pronunciation.

濄.e: 水。受淮陽扶溝浪湯渠，東入淮。从水過聲。
濄.eEn: A river. It receives water from the Langtang Canal at Fugou in Huaiyang and flows east into the Huai River. Formed from 水, with 過 indicating the pronunciation.

泄.e: 水。受九江博安洵波，北入氐。从水丗聲。
泄.eEn: A river. It receives water from the Xunbo at Bo'an in Jiujiang and flows north into the Di River. Formed from 水, with 丗 indicating the pronunciation.

葬.e: 藏也。从死在茻中；一其中，所以薦之。《易》曰：“古之葬者，厚衣之以薪。”
葬.eEn: To conceal. Formed from 死 within 茻; the 一 in the middle represents what supports the body from beneath. The Book of Changes says: “In ancient times, those who buried the dead wrapped them thickly in brushwood.”

汳.e: 水。受陳畱浚儀陰溝，至蒙爲雝水，東入于泗。从水反聲。
汳.eEn: A river. It receives water from the Yin Ditch at Junyi in Chenliu; at Meng it becomes the Yong River and flows east into the Si River. Formed from 水, with 反 indicating the pronunciation.

潧.e: 水。出鄭國。从水曾聲。《詩》曰：“潧與洧，方渙渙兮。”
潧.eEn: A river. It rises in the state of Zheng. Formed from 水, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The Zhen and the Wei are flowing full and broad.”

淩.eEn: A river in Linhuai. Formed from 水, with 夌 indicating the pronunciation.

濮.e: 水。出東郡濮陽，南入鉅野。从水僕聲。
濮.eEn: A river. It rises at Puyang in Dong Commandery and flows south into Juye. Formed from 水, with 僕 indicating the pronunciation.

濼.e: 齊魯閒水也。从水樂聲。《春秋傳》曰：“公會齊侯于濼。”
濼.eEn: A river between Qi and Lu. Formed from 水, with 樂 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The duke met the Marquis of Qi at Luo.”

漷.eEn: A river in Lu. Formed from 水, with 郭 indicating the pronunciation.

淨.e: 魯北城門池也。从水爭聲。
淨.eEn: The moat at the northern city gate of Lu. Formed from 水, with 爭 indicating the pronunciation.

濕.e: 水。出東郡東武陽，入海。从水㬎聲。桑欽云：出平原高唐。
濕.eEn: A river issuing from Dongwuyang in Dong Commandery and entering the sea. Formed from 水, with 㬎 indicating the pronunciation. Sang Qin says that it issues from Gaotang in Pingyuan.

泡.e: 水。出山陽平樂，東北入泗。从水包聲。
泡.eEn: A river issuing from Pingle in Shanyang and flowing northeast into the Si. Formed from 水, with 包 indicating the pronunciation.

菏.e: 菏澤水。在山陽胡陵。《禹貢》：“浮于淮泗，達于菏。”从水苛聲。
菏.eEn: The waters of He Marsh, in Huling in Shanyang. The Tribute of Yu says: “Travel by boat on the Huai and Si, reaching the He.” Formed from 水, with 苛 indicating the pronunciation.

小.e: 物之微也。从八，丨見而分之。凡小之屬皆从小。
小.eEn: The minuteness of things. Formed from 八 and 丨: 丨 is seen and divided. All characters in the 小 class are formed with 小.

泗.e: 受泲水，東入淮。从水四聲。
泗.eEn: A river receiving the waters of the Ji (泲) and flowing east into the Huai. Formed from 水, with 四 indicating the pronunciation.

洹.eEn: A river between Qi and Lu. Formed from 水, with 亘 indicating the pronunciation.

灉.eEn: The Yong, a river associated with the Yellow River, in Song. Formed from 水, with 雝 indicating the pronunciation.

澶.eEn: The waters of Chanyuan, in Song. Formed from 水, with 亶 indicating the pronunciation.

洙.e: 水。出泰山蓋臨樂山，北入泗。从水朱聲。
洙.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Linle in Gai, Taishan, and flowing north into the Si. Formed from 水, with 朱 indicating the pronunciation.

沭.eEn: A river issuing in Qingzhou; a principal watercourse of that region. Formed from 水, with 术 indicating the pronunciation.

沂.e: 水。出東海費東，西入泗。从水斤聲。一曰沂水，出泰山蓋青州浸。
沂.eEn: A river issuing east of Fei in Donghai and flowing west into the Si. Formed from 水, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation. Another account says that the Yi River issues from Gai in Taishan and is a principal watercourse of Qingzhou.

洋.e: 水。出齊臨朐高山，東北入鉅定。从水羊聲。
洋.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Gao in Linqu, Qi, and flowing northeast into Juding. Formed from 水, with 羊 indicating the pronunciation.

濁.e: 水。出齊郡厲嬀山，東北入鉅定。从水蜀聲。
濁.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Ligui in Qi Commandery and flowing northeast into Juding. Formed from 水, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation.

漑.e: 水。出東海桑瀆覆甑山，東北入海。一曰灌注也。从水旣聲。
漑.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Fuzeng in Sangdu, Donghai, and flowing northeast into the sea. Another meaning is to pour water into something. Formed from 水, with 旣 indicating the pronunciation.

少.eEn: Not many; not much. Formed from 小, with 丿 indicating the pronunciation.

濰.e: 水。出琅邪箕屋山，東入海。徐州浸。《夏書》曰：“濰、淄其道。”从水維聲。
濰.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Jiwu in Langye and flowing east into the sea; a principal watercourse of Xuzhou. The Book of Xia says: “The Wei and Zi followed their courses.” Formed from 水, with 維 indicating the pronunciation.

浯.e: 水。出琅邪靈門壺山，東北入濰。从水吾聲。
浯.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Hu in Lingmen, Langye, and flowing northeast into the Wei. Formed from 水, with 吾 indicating the pronunciation.

汶.e: 水。出琅邪朱虛東泰山，東入濰。从水文聲。桑欽說：汶水出泰山萊蕪，西南入泲。
汶.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Tai east of Zhuxu in Langye and flowing east into the Wei. Formed from 水, with 文 indicating the pronunciation. Sang Qin states that the Wen River issues from Laiwu in Taishan and flows southwest into the Ji (泲).

治.e: 水。出東萊曲城陽丘山，南入海。从水台聲。
治.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Yangqiu in Qucheng, Donglai, and flowing south into the sea. Formed from 水, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

寖.e: 水。出魏郡武安，東北入呼沱水。从水𡩠聲。𡩠，籒文𡪢字。
寖.eEn: A river issuing from Wu'an in Wei Commandery and flowing northeast into the Hutuo River. Formed from 水, with 𡩠 indicating the pronunciation. 𡩠 is the large-seal form of 𡪢.

湡.e: 水。出趙國襄國之西山，東北入寖。从水禺聲。
湡.eEn: A river issuing from the western mountains of Xiangguo in the kingdom of Zhao and flowing northeast into the Jin (寖). Formed from 水, with 禺 indicating the pronunciation.

渚.e: 水。在常山中丘逢山，東入湡。从水者聲。《爾雅》曰：“小洲曰渚。”
渚.eEn: A river at Mount Feng in Zhongqiu, Changshan, flowing east into the Yu. Formed from 水, with 者 indicating the pronunciation. The Erya says: “A small island is called a 渚.”

洨.e: 水。出常山石邑井陘，東南入于泜。从水交聲。𨙶國有洨縣。
洨.eEn: A river issuing from Jingxing in Shiyi, Changshan, and flowing southeast into the Zhi (泜). Formed from 水, with 交 indicating the pronunciation. The kingdom of 𨙶 has a county named Xiao.

濟.e: 水。出常山房子贊皇山，東入泜。从水齊聲。
濟.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Zanhuang in Fangzi, Changshan, and flowing east into the Zhi (泜). Formed from 水, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation.

尐.eEn: Few; little. Formed from 小, with 乀 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 輟.

泜.eEn: A river in Changshan. Formed from 水, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation.

濡.e: 水。出涿郡故安，東入漆涑。从水需聲。
濡.eEn: A river issuing from Gu'an in Zhuo Commandery and flowing east into the Qisu. Formed from 水, with 需 indicating the pronunciation.

灅.e: 水。出右北平浚靡，東南入庚。从水壘聲。
灅.eEn: A river issuing from Junmi in Youbeiping and flowing southeast into the Geng. Formed from 水, with 壘 indicating the pronunciation.

沽.e: 水。出漁陽塞外，東入海。从水古聲。
沽.eEn: A river issuing beyond the frontier in Yuyang and flowing east into the sea. Formed from 水, with 古 indicating the pronunciation.

沛.e: 水。出遼東番汗塞外，西南入海。从水巿聲。
沛.eEn: A river issuing beyond the frontier at Fanhan in Liaodong and flowing southwest into the sea. Formed from 水, with 巿 indicating the pronunciation.

浿.e: 水。出樂浪鏤方，東入海。从水貝聲。一曰出浿水縣。
浿.eEn: A river issuing from Loufang in Lelang and flowing east into the sea. Formed from 水, with 貝 indicating the pronunciation. Another account says that it issues from Peishui County.

瀤.eEn: A river in the north. Formed from 水, with 褱 indicating the pronunciation.

泒.e: 水。起雁門葰人戍夫山，東北入海。从水瓜聲。
泒.eEn: A river originating at Mount Shufu in Suiren, Yanmen, and flowing northeast into the sea. Formed from 水, with 瓜 indicating the pronunciation.

八.e: 別也。象分別相背之形。凡八之屬皆从八。
八.eEn: To separate. It depicts things separated and facing away from one another. All characters in the 八 class are formed with 八.

滱.e: 水。起北地靈丘，東入河。从水寇聲。滱水卽漚夷水，并州川也。
滱.eEn: A river originating in Lingqiu, Beidi, and flowing east into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 寇 indicating the pronunciation. The Kou River is the Ouyi River, a watercourse of Bingzhou.

淶.e: 水。起北地廣昌，東入河。从水來聲。幷州浸。
淶.eEn: A river originating in Guangchang, Beidi, and flowing east into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 來 indicating the pronunciation. A principal watercourse of Bingzhou.

泥.e: 水。出北地郁郅北蠻中。从水尼聲。
泥.eEn: A river issuing among the northern Man peoples north of Yuzhi in Beidi. Formed from 水, with 尼 indicating the pronunciation.

湳.e: 西河美稷𠈃東北水。从水南聲。
湳.eEn: A river northeast of Meiji 𠈃 in Xihe. Formed from 水, with 南 indicating the pronunciation.

漹.e: 水。出西河中陽北沙，南入河。从水焉聲。
漹.eEn: A river issuing from Beisha in Zhongyang, Xihe, and flowing south into the Yellow River. Formed from 水, with 焉 indicating the pronunciation.

涶.e: 河津也。在西河西。从水𡍮聲。
涶.eEn: A crossing of the Yellow River, west of Xihe. Formed from 水, with 𡍮 indicating the pronunciation.

洵.eEn: To pass through the water. Formed from 水, with 旬 indicating the pronunciation.

涻.e: 水。出北嚻山，入邙澤。从水舍聲。
涻.eEn: A river issuing from Mount Beixiao and entering Mang Marsh. Formed from 水, with 舍 indicating the pronunciation.

分.e: 別也。从八从刀，刀以分別物也。
分.eEn: To separate. Formed from 八 and 刀: a knife is used to divide things.

淔.eEn: A river. Formed from 水, with 直 indicating the pronunciation.

淁.eEn: A river. Formed from 水, with 妾 indicating the pronunciation.
