噭.eEn: To roar. Formed from 口, with 敫 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is that 噭 means to call out.

揖.e: 攘也。从手咠聲。一曰手箸胷曰揖。
揖.eEn: To push aside. Formed from 手, with 咠 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: placing the hands against the chest is called 揖.

攘.eEn: To push. Formed from 手, with 襄 indicating the pronunciation.

拱.eEn: To bring the hands together. Formed from 手, with 共 indicating the pronunciation.

撿.eEn: To bring the hands together. Formed from 手, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation.

捾.e: 搯捾也。从手官聲。一曰援也。
捾.eEn: To draw out. Formed from 手, with 官 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to pull up.

搯.e: 捾也。从手舀聲。《周書》曰：“師乃搯。”搯者，拔兵刃以習擊刺。《詩》曰：“左旋右搯。”
搯.eEn: To draw out. Formed from 手, with 舀 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “The army then drew out their weapons.” 搯 means drawing bladed weapons to practise striking and thrusting. The Odes says: “Turning to the left and drawing weapons to the right.”

推.eEn: To push away. Formed from 手, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

捘.e: 推也。从手夋聲。《春秋傳》曰：“捘衞侯之手。”
捘.eEn: To push. Formed from 手, with 夋 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “He pushed the hand of the Marquis of Wei.”

噣.eEn: A beak. Formed from 口, with 蜀 indicating the pronunciation.

排.eEn: To press against. Formed from 手, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

擠.eEn: To push away. Formed from 手, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation.

抵.eEn: To press against. Formed from 手, with 氐 indicating the pronunciation.

摧.e: 擠也。从手崔聲。一曰挏也，一曰折也。
摧.eEn: To press against. Formed from 手, with 崔 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to pull. Another explanation: to break.

拉.eEn: To break or crush. Formed from 手, with 立 indicating the pronunciation.

挫.eEn: To break or crush. Formed from 手, with 𡋲 indicating the pronunciation.

扶.eEn: To assist. Formed from 手, with 夫 indicating the pronunciation.

持.eEn: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 寺 indicating the pronunciation.

挈.eEn: To hold suspended. Formed from 手, with 㓞 indicating the pronunciation.

喙.eEn: The mouth. Formed from 口, with 彖 indicating the pronunciation.

拑.eEn: To hold between the sides. Formed from 手, with 甘 indicating the pronunciation.

揲.eEn: To count while holding. Formed from 手, with 枼 indicating the pronunciation.

摯.eEn: To grasp and hold. Formed from 手 and 執.

操.eEn: To take hold of and keep hold of. Formed from 手, with 喿 indicating the pronunciation.

捦.eEn: To grip the front of a garment tightly. Formed from 手, with 金 indicating the pronunciation.

搏.e: 索持也。一曰至也。从手尃聲。
搏.eEn: To seek and take hold of. Another explanation: to reach. Formed from 手, with 尃 indicating the pronunciation.

據.eEn: To support oneself by holding a staff. Formed from 手, with 豦 indicating the pronunciation.

攝.eEn: To draw toward oneself and hold. Formed from 手, with 聶 indicating the pronunciation.

吻.eEn: The edges of the mouth. Formed from 口, with 勿 indicating the pronunciation.

抪.eEn: To feel with the hands and hold. Formed from 手, with 布 indicating the pronunciation.

挾.eEn: To assist in holding. Formed from 手, with 夾 indicating the pronunciation.

捫.e: 撫持也。从手門聲。《詩》曰：“莫捫朕舌。”
捫.eEn: To stroke and hold. Formed from 手, with 門 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Do not touch my tongue.”

擸.eEn: To arrange and hold. Formed from 手, with 巤 indicating the pronunciation.

握.eEn: To grip and hold tightly. Formed from 手, with 屋 indicating the pronunciation.

撣.e: 提持也。从手單聲。讀若行遟驒驒。
撣.eEn: To lift and hold. Formed from 手, with 單 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 驒 in the expression “moving slowly, 驒驒.”

把.eEn: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 巴 indicating the pronunciation.

搹.eEn: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 鬲 indicating the pronunciation.

拏.eEn: To pull or draw along. Formed from 手, with 奴 indicating the pronunciation.

嚨.eEn: The throat. Formed from 口, with 龍 indicating the pronunciation.

攜.eEn: To lift or carry. Formed from 手, with 雟 indicating the pronunciation.

提.eEn: To hold suspended. Formed from 手, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

拈.eEn: To pinch between the fingers. Formed from 手, with 占 indicating the pronunciation.

摛.eEn: To spread out. Formed from 手, with 离 indicating the pronunciation.

捨.eEn: To release. Formed from 手, with 舍 indicating the pronunciation.

擪.eEn: To press with one finger. Formed from 手, with 厭 indicating the pronunciation.

按.eEn: To push down. Formed from 手, with 安 indicating the pronunciation.

控.e: 引也。从手空聲。《詩》曰：“控于大邦。”匈奴名引弓控弦。
控.eEn: To draw or pull. Formed from 手, with 空 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Draw upon the great state.” The Xiongnu call drawing a bow “drawing the string.”

揗.eEn: To rub. Formed from 手, with 盾 indicating the pronunciation.

掾.eEn: To follow along. Formed from 手, with 彖 indicating the pronunciation.

拊.eEn: To rub or stroke. Formed from 手, with 付 indicating the pronunciation.

掊.e: 把也。今鹽官入水取鹽爲掊。从手咅聲。
掊.eEn: To take in the hand. Nowadays, when salt officials enter the water to gather salt, this is called 掊. Formed from 手, with 咅 indicating the pronunciation.

捋.eEn: To take easily. Formed from 手, with 寽 indicating the pronunciation.

撩.eEn: To put in order. Formed from 手, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation.

措.eEn: To place or set down. Formed from 手, with 昔 indicating the pronunciation.

插.eEn: To pierce flesh. Formed from 手 and 臿.

掄.eEn: To select. Formed from 手, with 侖 indicating the pronunciation.

擇.eEn: To choose and select. Formed from 手, with 睪 indicating the pronunciation.

噲.e: 咽也。从口會聲。讀若快。一曰嚵，噲也。
噲.eEn: The throat. Formed from 口, with 會 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 快. Another explanation identifies it with 嚵, greedy eating.

捉.e: 搤也。从手足聲。一曰握也。
捉.eEn: To grip tightly. Formed from 手, with 足 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to grasp.

搤.eEn: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 益 indicating the pronunciation.

挻.eEn: To lengthen. Formed from 手 and 延, with 延 also indicating the pronunciation.

揃.eEn: To pluck or pull away. Formed from 手, with 前 indicating the pronunciation.

搣.eEn: To pluck. Formed from 手, with 烕 indicating the pronunciation.

揤.e: 捽也。从手卽聲。魏郡有揤裴侯國。
揤.eEn: To seize by the hair. Formed from 手, with 卽 indicating the pronunciation. In Wei Commandery there is a marquisate named Jipei.

捽.eEn: To hold someone by the hair of the head. Formed from 手, with 卒 indicating the pronunciation.

撮.e: 四圭也。一曰兩指撮也。从手最聲。
撮.eEn: A measure equal to four gui. Another explanation: to pinch up with two fingers. Formed from 手, with 最 indicating the pronunciation.

吞.eEn: To swallow. Formed from 口, with 天 indicating the pronunciation.

摕.e: 撮取也。从手帶聲。讀若《詩》曰“螮蝀在東”。
摕.eEn: To pinch up and take. Formed from 手, with 帶 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 螮 in the line from the Odes: “The rainbow is in the east.”

捊.eEn: To draw toward oneself and take. Formed from 手, with 孚 indicating the pronunciation.

揜.e: 自關以東謂取曰揜。一曰覆也。从手弇聲。
揜.eEn: East of the Pass, taking is called 揜. Another explanation: to cover. Formed from 手, with 弇 indicating the pronunciation.

授.eEn: To give. Formed from 手 and 受, with 受 also indicating the pronunciation.

承.eEn: To bear or support; to receive. Formed from 手, 卪, and 𠬞.

挋.e: 給也。从手臣聲。一曰約也。
挋.eEn: To supply. Formed from 手, with 臣 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to bind or restrain.

攩.eEn: To form a group of companions. Formed from 手, with 黨 indicating the pronunciation.

接.eEn: To join or connect. Formed from 手, with 妾 indicating the pronunciation.

咽.eEn: The throat. Formed from 口, with 因 indicating the pronunciation.

挏.e: 𢹬引也。漢有挏馬官，作馬酒。从手同聲。
挏.eEn: To push and pull. Under the Han there is an official in charge of churning mare's milk, who makes mare's-milk wine. Formed from 手, with 同 indicating the pronunciation.

招.eEn: To call with the hand. Formed from 手 and 召.

撫.e: 安也。从手無聲。一曰循也。
撫.eEn: To soothe or bring peace. Formed from 手, with 無 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to stroke along.

捪.e: 撫也。从手昏聲。一曰摹也。
捪.eEn: To stroke. Formed from 手, with 昏 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to copy.

揣.e: 量也。从手耑聲。度高曰揣。一曰捶之。
揣.eEn: To measure. Formed from 手, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation. Measuring height is called 揣. Another explanation: to beat something.

抧.e: 開也。从手只聲。讀若抵掌之抵。
抧.eEn: To open. Formed from 手, with 只 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 抵 in the expression “striking the palms together.”

摜.e: 習也。从手貫聲。《春秋傳》曰：“摜瀆鬼神。”
摜.eEn: To become accustomed through practice. Formed from 手, with 貫 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Habitually showing disrespect toward the ghosts and spirits.”

投.eEn: To throw. Formed from 手 and 殳.

擿.e: 搔也。从手適聲。一曰投也。
擿.eEn: To scratch. Formed from 手, with 適 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to throw.

搔.eEn: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 蚤 indicating the pronunciation.

嗌.eEn: The throat. Formed from 口, with 益 indicating the pronunciation.

扴.eEn: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 介 indicating the pronunciation.

摽.e: 擊也。从手票聲。一曰挈門壯也。
摽.eEn: To strike. Formed from 手, with 票 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to lift a gate-bar.

挑.e: 撓也。从手兆聲。一曰摷也。《國語》曰：“卻至挑夭。”
挑.eEn: To disturb or agitate. Formed from 手, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to strike. The Discourses of the States says: “Xi Zhi performed the provocative war-dance.”

抉.eEn: To pick or pry out. Formed from 手, with 夬 indicating the pronunciation.

撓.e: 擾也。从手堯聲。一曰捄也。
撓.eEn: To disturb. Formed from 手, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to gather or scoop up.

挶.eEn: To hold with a halberd. Formed from 手, with 局 indicating the pronunciation.

据.eEn: To hold with a halberd. Formed from 手, with 居 indicating the pronunciation.

擖.e: 刮也。从手葛聲。一曰撻也。
擖.eEn: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 葛 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to beat or flog.

摘.e: 拓果樹實也。从手啻聲。一曰指近之也。
摘.eEn: To knock fruit from a fruit tree. Formed from 手, with 啻 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to point to something nearby.

閏.e: 餘分之月，五歲再閏，告朔之禮，天子居宗廟，閏月居門中。从王在門中。《周禮》曰：“閏月，王居門中，終月也。”
閏.eEn: A month arising from the accumulated remainder of the calendar, with two intercalations in five years. At the rite of announcing the new moon, the Son of Heaven occupies the ancestral temple; during an intercalary month, he occupies the space within the gate. Formed from 王 situated within 門. The Rites of Zhou says: “During an intercalary month, the king occupies the space within the gate for the whole month.”

喗.eEn: A large mouth. Formed from 口, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

搳.eEn: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 害 indicating the pronunciation.

摲.eEn: To do briefly or temporarily. Formed from 手, with 斬 indicating the pronunciation.

拹.e: 摺也。从手劦聲。一曰拉也。
拹.eEn: To fold or break. Formed from 手, with 劦 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation: to crush or break.

摺.eEn: To defeat. Formed from 手, with 習 indicating the pronunciation.

揫.e: 束也。从手秋聲。《詩》曰：“百祿是揫。”
揫.eEn: To bind together. Formed from 手, with 秋 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “All blessings gather here.”

摟.eEn: To drag; to gather. Formed from 手, with 婁 indicating the pronunciation.

抎.e: 有所失也。《春秋傳》曰：“抎子，辱矣。”从手云聲。
抎.eEn: To lose something. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “To lose you, my son, would be a disgrace.” Formed from 手, with 云 indicating the pronunciation.

披.eEn: Holding something from the side is called 披. Formed from 手, with 皮 indicating the pronunciation.

哆.eEn: To open the mouth wide. Formed from 口, with 多 indicating the pronunciation.

掉.e: 搖也。从手卓聲。《春秋傳》曰：“尾大不掉。”
掉.eEn: To shake. Formed from 手, with 卓 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The tail is too large to wag.”

搖.eEn: To move. Formed from 手, with 䍃 indicating the pronunciation.

搈.eEn: To move or shake. Formed from 手, with 容 indicating the pronunciation.

揂.eEn: To gather. Formed from 手, with 酋 indicating the pronunciation.

掔.e: 固也。从手臤聲。讀若《詩》“赤舃掔掔”。
掔.eEn: Firm. Formed from 手, with 臤 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 掔 in the Book of Odes phrase “the red ceremonial shoes, firm and substantial.”

捀.eEn: To present respectfully. Formed from 手, with 夆 indicating the pronunciation.

揚.eEn: To rise flying. Formed from 手, with 昜 indicating the pronunciation.

擧.eEn: To lift together from opposite sides. Formed from 手, with 與 indicating the pronunciation.

呱.e: 小兒嗁聲。从口瓜聲。《詩》曰：“后稷呱矣。”
呱.eEn: The sound of an infant crying. Formed from 口, with 瓜 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Hou Ji cried.”

掀.e: 舉出也。从手欣聲。《春秋傳》曰：“掀公出於淖。”
掀.eEn: To lift out. Formed from 手, with 欣 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “He lifted the duke out of the mud.”

揭.eEn: To lift high. Formed from 手, with 曷 indicating the pronunciation.

抍.e: 上舉也。从手升聲。《易》曰：“抍馬，壯，吉。”
抍.eEn: To lift upward. Formed from 手, with 升 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “Raise the horse: strength; good fortune.”

振.e: 舉救也。从手辰聲。一曰奮也。
振.eEn: To raise up and rescue. Formed from 手, with 辰 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to rouse.

扛.eEn: To lift a crossbar together from opposite sides. Formed from 手, with 工 indicating the pronunciation.

扮.eEn: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 分 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 粉.

撟.e: 舉手也。从手喬聲。一曰撟，擅也。
撟.eEn: To raise the hand. Formed from 手, with 喬 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to act on one's sole authority.

捎.e: 自關巳西，凡取物之上者爲撟捎。从手肖聲。
捎.eEn: West of the passes, taking the upper part of something is called 撟捎. Formed from 手, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation.

擩.e: 染也。从手需聲。《周禮》：“六曰擩祭。”
擩.eEn: To dip or stain. Formed from 手, with 需 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “The sixth is the dipping offering.”

啾.eEn: The sound of a small child. Formed from 口, with 秋 indicating the pronunciation.

揄.eEn: To pull. Formed from 手, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

搫.eEn: 搫擭 means not straight. Formed from 手, with 般 indicating the pronunciation.

擭.e: 搫擭也。一曰布擭也，一曰握也。从手蒦聲。
擭.eEn: Used in 搫擭, meaning not straight. Another explanation is: to spread out. Another is: to grasp. Formed from 手, with 蒦 indicating the pronunciation.

拚.eEn: To clap the hands. Formed from 手, with 弁 indicating the pronunciation.

擅.eEn: To exercise sole control. Formed from 手, with 亶 indicating the pronunciation.

揆.eEn: Mallow. Formed from 手, with 癸 indicating the pronunciation.

擬.eEn: To estimate. Formed from 手, with 疑 indicating the pronunciation.

損.eEn: To reduce. Formed from 手, with 員 indicating the pronunciation.

失.eEn: To let go. Formed from 手, with 乙 indicating the pronunciation.

捝.eEn: To undo or release. Formed from 手, with 兌 indicating the pronunciation.

喤.e: 小兒聲。从口皇聲。《詩》曰：“其泣喤喤。”
喤.eEn: The sound of a small child. Formed from 口, with 皇 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “His crying resounded.”

撥.eEn: To put in order. Formed from 手, with 發 indicating the pronunciation.

挹.eEn: To draw out or ladle out. Formed from 手, with 邑 indicating the pronunciation.

抒.eEn: To draw out or ladle out. Formed from 手, with 予 indicating the pronunciation.

抯.e: 挹也。从手且聲。讀若樝棃之樝。
抯.eEn: To draw out or ladle out. Formed from 手, with 且 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 樝 in 樝棃, the fruit name.

攫.eEn: To scoop from above. Formed from 手, with 矍 indicating the pronunciation.

扟.e: 从上挹也。从手卂聲。讀若莘。
扟.eEn: To scoop from above. Formed from 手, with 卂 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 莘.

拓.eEn: To pick up. An expression used in Chen and Song. Formed from 手, with 石 indicating the pronunciation.

攈.eEn: To pick up. Formed from 手, with 麇 indicating the pronunciation.

拾.eEn: To gather up. Formed from 手, with 合 indicating the pronunciation.

掇.eEn: To pick up and take. Formed from 手, with 叕 indicating the pronunciation.

咺.e: 朝鮮謂兒泣不止曰咺。从口，宣省聲。
咺.eEn: In Chaoxian, a child's unceasing crying is called 咺. Formed from 口, with an abbreviated 宣 indicating the pronunciation.

擐.e: 貫也。从手瞏聲。《春秋傳》曰：“擐甲執兵。”
擐.eEn: To pass through. Formed from 手, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Don armor and take up weapons.”

揯.eEn: To pull; to tighten. Formed from 手, with 恆 indicating the pronunciation.

摍.eEn: To draw back with a kick. Formed from 手, with 宿 indicating the pronunciation.

援.eEn: To pull. Formed from 手, with 爰 indicating the pronunciation.

擢.eEn: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 翟 indicating the pronunciation.

拔.eEn: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation.

揠.eEn: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 匽 indicating the pronunciation.

擣.e: 手推也。一曰築也。从手𠷎聲。
擣.eEn: To push with the hand. Another explanation is: to ram or pound. Formed from 手, with 𠷎 indicating the pronunciation.

唴.e: 秦晉謂兒泣不止曰唴。从口羌聲。
唴.eEn: In Qin and Jin, a child's unceasing crying is called 唴. Formed from 口, with 羌 indicating the pronunciation.

攣.eEn: To bind. Formed from 手, with 䜌 indicating the pronunciation.

挺.eEn: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 廷 indicating the pronunciation.

探.eEn: To reach far to take something. Formed from 手, with 罙 indicating the pronunciation.

撢.eEn: To reach for something. Formed from 手, with 覃 indicating the pronunciation.

捼.e: 推也。从手委聲。一曰兩手相切摩也。
捼.eEn: To push. Formed from 手, with 委 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to rub the two hands against each other.

撆.e: 別也。一曰擊也。从手敝聲。
撆.eEn: To separate. Another explanation is: to strike. Formed from 手, with 敝 indicating the pronunciation.

搦.eEn: To press down. Formed from 手, with 弱 indicating the pronunciation.

掎.eEn: To pull to one side. Formed from 手, with 奇 indicating the pronunciation.

咷.e: 楚謂兒泣不止曰噭咷。从口兆聲。
咷.eEn: In Chu, a child's unceasing crying is called 噭咷. Formed from 口, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation.

揮.eEn: To rouse or brandish. Formed from 手, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

摩.eEn: To grind or rub. Formed from 手, with 麻 indicating the pronunciation.

攪.e: 亂也。从手覺聲。《詩》曰：“祇攪我心。”
攪.eEn: To disturb. Formed from 手, with 覺 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “It only disturbs my heart.”

搑.eEn: To push and pound. Formed from 手, with 茸 indicating the pronunciation.

撞.eEn: To pound swiftly. Formed from 手, with 童 indicating the pronunciation.

扔.eEn: To follow or rely upon. Formed from 手, with 乃 indicating the pronunciation.

括.eEn: To bind together. Formed from 手, with 𠯑 indicating the pronunciation.

抲.e: 抲撝也。从手可聲。《周書》曰：“盡執，抲。”
抲.eEn: To grasp and direct. Formed from 手, with 可 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “Seize them all and take hold of them.”

喑.e: 宋齊謂兒泣不止曰喑。从口音聲。
喑.eEn: In Song and Qi, a child's unceasing crying is called 喑. Formed from 口, with 音 indicating the pronunciation.

擘.eEn: To split apart. Formed from 手, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

撝.e: 裂也。从手爲聲。一曰手指也。
撝.eEn: To split. Formed from 手, with 爲 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to point with the hand.

捇.eEn: To split. Formed from 手, with 赤 indicating the pronunciation.

扐.eEn: In divination with yarrow stalks according to the Book of Changes, the stalks are placed between the fingers twice before the hexagram is formed. Formed from 手, with 力 indicating the pronunciation.

技.eEn: Skill. Formed from 手, with 支 indicating the pronunciation.

摹.eEn: To follow a model. Formed from 手, with 莫 indicating the pronunciation.

拙.eEn: Unskillful. Formed from 手, with 出 indicating the pronunciation.

摶.eEn: Round. Formed from 手, with 專 indicating the pronunciation.

捄.e: 盛土於梩中也。一曰擾也。《詩》曰：“捄之陾陾。”从手求聲。
捄.eEn: To heap earth into a 梩, an earth-carrying implement. Another explanation is: to disturb. The Book of Odes says: “They heaped it up in great numbers.” Formed from 手, with 求 indicating the pronunciation.

拮.e: 手口共有所作也。从手吉聲。《詩》曰：“予手拮据。”
拮.eEn: For the hands and mouth to be engaged together in some work. Formed from 手, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “My hands labored hard.”

搰.eEn: To dig. Formed from 手, with 骨 indicating the pronunciation.

掘.eEn: To dig. Formed from 手, with 屈 indicating the pronunciation.

掩.e: 斂也。小上曰掩。从手奄聲。
掩.eEn: To draw together. Having a small upper part is called 掩. Formed from 手, with 奄 indicating the pronunciation.

摡.e: 滌也。从手旣聲。《詩》曰：“摡之釜鬵。”
摡.eEn: To wash. Formed from 手, with 旣 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Wash the cauldrons and cooking pots.”

揟.e: 取水沮也。从手胥聲。武威有揟次縣。
揟.eEn: A strainer for drawing water. Formed from 手, with 胥 indicating the pronunciation. There is a Xuci County in Wuwei.

播.e: 穜也。一曰布也。从手番聲。
播.eEn: To sow. Another explanation is: to spread. Formed from 手, with 番 indicating the pronunciation.

挃.e: 穫禾聲也。从手至聲。《詩》曰：“穫之挃挃。”
挃.eEn: The sound of harvesting grain. Formed from 手, with 至 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “They harvested it with a cutting sound.”

旁.eEn: Extensive. Formed from 二—Explanation missing in the source—with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

皇.e: 大也。从自。自，始也。始皇者，三皇，大君也。自，讀若鼻，今俗以始生子爲鼻子。
皇.eEn: Great. Formed from 自. 自 means beginning. The first sovereigns, the Three Sovereigns, were great rulers. 自 is pronounced like 鼻; in present common usage, a firstborn child is called 鼻子.

咳.eEn: The laughter of a small child. Formed from 口, with 亥 indicating the pronunciation.

扤.eEn: To move. Formed from 手, with 兀 indicating the pronunciation.

抈.eEn: To break. Formed from 手, with 月 indicating the pronunciation.

摎.eEn: To kill by binding. Formed from 手, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation.

撻.e: 鄉飲酒，罰不敬，撻其背。从手達聲。
撻.eEn: At the district drinking ceremony, disrespect is punished by striking the offender's back. Formed from 手, with 達 indicating the pronunciation.

掕.eEn: To stop a horse. Formed from 手, with 夌 indicating the pronunciation.

抨.eEn: To strike or brush. Formed from 手, with 平 indicating the pronunciation.

捲.e: 气勢也。从手卷聲。《國語》曰：“有捲勇。”一曰捲，收也。
捲.eEn: Vigor or force of spirit. Formed from 手, with 卷 indicating the pronunciation. The Discourses of the States says: “There is vigorous courage.” Another explanation is: to gather up.

扱.eEn: To gather in. Formed from 手, with 及 indicating the pronunciation.

摷.eEn: To restrain and strike. Formed from 手, with 巢 indicating the pronunciation.

挨.eEn: To strike the back. Formed from 手, with 矣 indicating the pronunciation.

嗛.eEn: To hold something in the mouth. Formed from 口, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

撲.eEn: To strike. Formed from 手, with 菐 indicating the pronunciation.

扚.eEn: To strike swiftly. Formed from 手, with 勺 indicating the pronunciation.

抶.eEn: To strike with a whip or rod. Formed from 手, with 失 indicating the pronunciation.

扺.eEn: To strike from the side. Formed from 手, with 氏 indicating the pronunciation.

抰.eEn: To strike with a carriage's harness strap. Formed from 手, with 央 indicating the pronunciation.

捭.eEn: To strike with both hands. Formed from 手, with 卑 indicating the pronunciation.

捶.eEn: To strike with a staff. Formed from 手, with 垂 indicating the pronunciation.

搉.eEn: To knock or strike. Formed from 手, with 隺 indicating the pronunciation.

咀.eEn: To hold something in the mouth and savor its flavor. Formed from 口, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

摬.eEn: To strike the target. Formed from 手, with 竟 indicating the pronunciation.

拂.eEn: To strike in passing. Formed from 手, with 弗 indicating the pronunciation.

摼.e: 擣頭也。从手堅聲。讀若“鏗尔舍瑟而作”。
摼.eEn: To pound the head. Formed from 手, with 堅 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 鏗 in “With a clang, he set down his zither and rose.”

抌.e: 深擊也。从手冘聲。讀若告言不正曰抌。
抌.eEn: To strike deeply. Formed from 手, with 冘 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 抌 in the saying “Reporting words incorrectly is called 抌.”

擊.eEn: To strike. Formed from 手, with 毄 indicating the pronunciation.

扞.eEn: To resist. Formed from 手, with 干 indicating the pronunciation.

抗.eEn: To resist or ward off. Formed from 手, with 亢 indicating the pronunciation.

捕.eEn: To seize. Formed from 手, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation.

簎.e: 剌也。从手，籍省聲。《周禮》曰：“簎魚鼈。”
簎.eEn: To stab. Formed from 手, with an abbreviated form of 籍 indicating the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “To spear fish and turtles.”

啜.e: 嘗也。从口叕聲。一曰喙也。
啜.eEn: To taste. Formed from 口, with 叕 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a mouth or beak.

撚.e: 執也。从手然聲。一曰蹂也。
撚.eEn: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 然 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: to tread on.

挂.eEn: To mark or draw. Formed from 手, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

拕.eEn: To drag. Formed from 手, with 它 indicating the pronunciation.

捈.eEn: To pull horizontally. Formed from 手, with 余 indicating the pronunciation.

抴.eEn: To pull horizontally. Formed from 手, with 世 indicating the pronunciation.

揙.eEn: To stroke. Formed from 手, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation.

撅.e: 从手有所把也。从手厥聲。
撅.eEn: To grasp something with the hand. Formed from 手, with 厥 indicating the pronunciation.

攎.eEn: To grasp and hold. Formed from 手, with 盧 indicating the pronunciation.

挐.eEn: To hold. Formed from 手, with 如 indicating the pronunciation.

搵.eEn: To immerse. Formed from 手, with 𥁕 indicating the pronunciation.

搒.eEn: To cover. Formed from 手, with 㫄 indicating the pronunciation.

挌.eEn: To strike. Formed from 手, with 各 indicating the pronunciation.

拲.e: 兩手同械也。从手从共，共亦聲。《周禮》：“上辠，梏拲而桎。”
拲.eEn: To have both hands confined in the same restraint. Formed from 手 and 共; 共 also indicates the pronunciation. The Rites of Zhou says: “For the gravest offense, put the hands in restraints together and shackle the feet.”

掫.e: 夜戒守，有所擊。从手取聲。《春秋傳》曰：“賓將掫。”
掫.eEn: To keep watch at night, striking when necessary. Formed from 手, with 取 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The guest is about to go on night watch.”

捐.eEn: To discard. Formed from 手, with 肙 indicating the pronunciation.

掤.e: 所以覆矢也。从手朋聲。《詩》曰：“抑釋掤忌。”
掤.eEn: An object used to cover arrows. Formed from 手, with 朋 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Then he removed the arrow-cover.”

扜.eEn: To direct by pointing or gesturing. Formed from 手, with 亏 indicating the pronunciation.

捷.e: 獵也。軍獲得也。从手疌聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊人來獻戎捷。”
捷.eEn: To capture in hunting; what an army captures. Formed from 手, with 疌 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The people of Qi came to present the spoils captured from the Rong.”

扣.eEn: To lead a horse. Formed from 手, with 口 indicating the pronunciation.

嚌.e: 嘗也。从口齊聲。《周書》曰：“大保受同祭嚌。”
嚌.eEn: To taste. Formed from 口, with 齊 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “The Grand Protector received the ceremonial cup, made the offering, and tasted it.”

掍.eEn: To unite. Formed from 手, with 昆 indicating the pronunciation.

換.eEn: To exchange. Formed from 手, with 奐 indicating the pronunciation.

掖.e: 以手持人臂投地也。从手夜聲。一曰臂下也。
掖.eEn: To grasp someone's arm with the hand and throw them to the ground. Formed from 手, with 夜 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: the area beneath the arm.

摦.eEn: Broad across. Formed from 手, with 瓠 indicating the pronunciation.

攙.eEn: To stab. Formed from 手, with 毚 indicating the pronunciation.

搢.e: 插也。从手晉聲。搢紳前史皆作薦紳。
搢.eEn: To insert or tuck in. Formed from 手, with 晉 indicating the pronunciation. Earlier histories all write 搢紳, “those who tuck their tablets into their sashes,” as 薦紳.

掠.e: 奪取也。从手京聲。本音亮。《唐韻》或作擽。
掠.eEn: To seize or take away. Formed from 手, with 京 indicating the pronunciation. Its original pronunciation is that of 亮. In the Tang Rhymes, it is sometimes written 擽.

掐.eEn: To pierce with a fingernail. Formed from 手, with 臽 indicating the pronunciation.

捻.eEn: To twist between the fingers. Formed from 手, with 念 indicating the pronunciation.

噍.eEn: To bite or chew. Formed from 口, with 焦 indicating the pronunciation.

拗.eEn: To pull with the hand. Formed from 手, with 幼 indicating the pronunciation.

摵.eEn: To strike or brush off. Formed from 手, with 戚 indicating the pronunciation.

捌.e: 方言云：無齒杷。从手別聲。
捌.eEn: The Regional Expressions says: “A rake without teeth.” Formed from 手, with 別 indicating the pronunciation.

攤.eEn: To open or spread out. Formed from 手, with 難 indicating the pronunciation.

抛.e: 棄也。从手从尤从力，或从手𠠵聲。案：《左氏傳》通用摽。《詩》：“摽有梅。”摽，落也。義亦同。
抛.eEn: To discard. Formed from 手, 尤, and 力; alternatively, it is analyzed as formed from 手, with 𠠵 indicating the pronunciation. Note: the Zuo Commentary uses 摽 interchangeably with it. The Odes says: “The plums are falling.” 摽 means “to fall”; its meaning is also the same.

摴.e: 舒也。又，摴蒲，戲也。从手雩聲。
摴.eEn: To spread out. Also, 摴蒲 is a game. Formed from 手, with 雩 indicating the pronunciation.

打.eEn: To strike. Formed from 手, with 丁 indicating the pronunciation.

脊.eEn: The vertebrae of the back. Formed from 𠦬 and 肉.

女.e: 婦人也。象形。王育說。凡女之屬皆从女。
女.eEn: A woman. A pictograph, according to Wang Yu's explanation. All characters in the 女 class are formed with 女.

吮.eEn: To suck. Formed from 口, with 允 indicating the pronunciation.

姓.e: 人所生也。古之神聖母，感天而生子，故稱天子。从女从生，生亦聲。《春秋傳》曰：“天子因生以賜姓。”
姓.eEn: That from which a person is born: a surname. In antiquity, the mothers of divine sages conceived sons through the influence of Heaven; hence these sons were called Sons of Heaven. Formed from 女 and 生; 生 also indicates the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “The Son of Heaven grants surnames according to the circumstances of birth.”

姜.e: 神農居姜水，以爲姓。从女羊聲。
姜.eEn: Shennong lived by the Jiang River and took its name as his surname. Formed from 女, with 羊 indicating the pronunciation.

姬.e: 黃帝居姬水，以爲姓。从女𦣞聲。
姬.eEn: The Yellow Emperor lived by the Ji River and took its name as his surname. Formed from 女, with 𦣞 indicating the pronunciation.

姞.e: 黃帝之後百䱔姓，后稷妃家也。从女吉聲。
姞.eEn: The surname of Bai䱔, a descendant of the Yellow Emperor, and the family of Hou Ji's consort. Formed from 女, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation.

嬴.e: 少昊氏之姓也。从女，羸省聲。
嬴.eEn: The surname of the Shaohao lineage. Formed from 女, with an abbreviated form of 羸 indicating the pronunciation.

姚.e: 虞舜居姚虛，因以爲姓。从女兆聲。或爲姚，嬈也。《史篇》以爲：姚，易也。
姚.eEn: Shun of Yu lived at Yao Xu and accordingly took its name as his surname. Formed from 女, with 兆 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation takes 姚 to mean “alluring.” The Historian's Primer takes 姚 to mean “to change.”

嬀.e: 虞舜居嬀汭，因以爲氏。从女爲聲。
嬀.eEn: Shun of Yu lived at the bend of the Gui River and accordingly took its name as his clan name. Formed from 女, with 爲 indicating the pronunciation.

妘.e: 祝融之後姓也。从女云聲。
妘.eEn: A surname of descendants of Zhurong. Formed from 女, with 云 indicating the pronunciation.

姺.e: 殷諸侯爲亂，疑姓也。从女先聲。《春秋傳》曰：“商有姺邳。”
姺.eEn: A feudal lord under the Yin who rebelled; this is suspected to be a surname. Formed from 女, with 先 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Under the Shang there were Shen and Pi.”

娸.e: 人姓也。从女其聲。杜林說：娸，醜也。
娸.eEn: A person's surname. Formed from 女, with 其 indicating the pronunciation. Du Lin explains: “娸 means ugly.”

奼.eEn: A young girl. Formed from 女, with 乇 indicating the pronunciation.

媒.e: 謀也，謀合二姓。从女某聲。
媒.eEn: To arrange: to arrange the union of two families with different surnames. Formed from 女, with 某 indicating the pronunciation.

妁.e: 酌也，斟酌二姓也。从女勺聲。
妁.eEn: To weigh or consider: to weigh the suitability of two families with different surnames. Formed from 女, with 勺 indicating the pronunciation.

嫁.eEn: For a woman to go to another's household in marriage. Formed from 女, with 家 indicating the pronunciation.

娶.e: 取婦也。从女从取，取亦聲。
娶.eEn: To take a wife. Formed from 女 and 取; 取 also indicates the pronunciation.

婚.e: 婦家也。《禮》：娶婦以昏時，婦人陰也，故曰婚。从女从昏，昏亦聲。
婚.eEn: The wife's family. According to the rites, a bride is taken at dusk; women belong to yin, hence the term 婚. Formed from 女 and 昏; 昏 also indicates the pronunciation.

姻.e: 壻家也。女之所因，故曰姻。从女从因，因亦聲。
姻.eEn: The husband's family. It is that upon which a woman relies, hence the term 姻. Formed from 女 and 因; 因 also indicates the pronunciation.

妻.e: 婦與夫齊者也。从女从屮从又。又，持事，妻職也。
妻.eEn: A wife: the woman who is her husband's equal. Formed from 女, 屮, and 又. 又 represents managing affairs, which is the wife's duty.

嚵.e: 小𠻜也。从口毚聲。一曰喙也。
嚵.eEn: A small sip. Formed from 口, with 毚 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: a mouth or beak.

婦.eEn: To serve or submit. Formed from 女 holding a broom to sprinkle water and sweep.

妃.eEn: A mate or partner. Formed from 女, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

媲.eEn: A mate or partner. Formed from 女, with 𣬉 indicating the pronunciation.

妊.eEn: To be pregnant. Formed from 女 and 壬; 壬 also indicates the pronunciation.

娠.e: 女妊身動也。从女辰聲。《春秋傳》曰：“后緡方娠。”一曰宮婢女隸謂之娠。
娠.eEn: Movement in a woman's pregnant body. Formed from 女, with 辰 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Hou Min was then pregnant.” Another explanation is: female palace servants and bondwomen are called 娠.

媰.e: 婦人妊身也。从女芻聲。《周書》曰：“至于媰婦。”
媰.eEn: For a woman to be pregnant. Formed from 女, with 芻 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “Even to pregnant women.”

嫛.eEn: Used with 婗 in the expression 嫛婗. Formed from 女, with 殹 indicating the pronunciation.

婗.e: 嫛婗也。从女兒聲。一曰婦人惡皃。
婗.eEn: Used in the expression 嫛婗. Formed from 女, with 兒 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: an ugly appearance in a woman.

母.e: 牧也。从女，象褱子形。一曰象乳子也。
母.eEn: To nurture. Formed from 女, depicting holding a child in the arms. Another explanation says it depicts nursing a child.

玉.e: 石之美。有五德：潤澤以溫，仁之方也；䚡理自外，可以知中，義之方也；其聲舒揚，尃以遠聞，智之方也；不橈而折，勇之方也；銳廉而不技，絜之方也。象三玉之連。|，其貫也。凡玉之屬皆从玉。[陽冰曰：“三畫正均如貫玉也。”]
玉.eEn: Beautiful stone. It has five virtues: its moist luster and warmth exemplify benevolence; its markings can be examined from the outside to reveal the inside, exemplifying righteousness; its sound is expansive and clear, spreading so that it can be heard far away, exemplifying wisdom; it breaks rather than bends, exemplifying courage; its edges are sharp yet do not injure, exemplifying purity. It depicts three pieces of jade linked together. The vertical stroke | is the cord passing through them. All characters in the 玉 class are formed with 玉. [Yangbing says: “The three horizontal strokes are evenly aligned, like pieces of jade strung together.”]

噬.eEn: To eat or devour; a mouth or beak. Formed from 口, with 筮 indicating the pronunciation.

嫗.eEn: A mother. Formed from 女, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

媼.e: 女老偁也。从女𥁕聲。讀若奥。
媼.eEn: A term for an elderly woman. Formed from 女, with 𥁕 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 奥.

姁.eEn: A mother or elderly woman. Formed from 女, with 句 indicating the pronunciation.

姐.e: 蜀謂母曰姐，淮南謂之社。从女且聲。
姐.eEn: In Shu, a mother is called 姐; in Huainan, she is called 社. Formed from 女, with 且 indicating the pronunciation.

姑.eEn: A husband's mother. Formed from 女, with 古 indicating the pronunciation.

威.e: 姑也。从女从戌。漢律曰：“婦告威姑。”
威.eEn: A husband's mother. Formed from 女 and 戌. The Han statutes say: “A wife brings an accusation against her mother-in-law.”

妣.eEn: A deceased mother. Formed from 女, with 比 indicating the pronunciation.

姊.eEn: An elder sister. Formed from 女, with 𠂔 indicating the pronunciation.

妹.eEn: A younger sister. Formed from 女, with 未 indicating the pronunciation.

娣.e: 女弟也。从女从弟，弟亦聲。
娣.eEn: A younger sister. Formed from 女 and 弟, with 弟 also indicating the pronunciation.

啗.e: 食也。从口臽聲。讀與含同。
啗.eEn: To eat. Formed from 口, with 臽 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced the same as 含.

媦.e: 楚人謂女弟曰媦。从女胃聲。《公羊傳》曰：“楚王之妻媦。”
媦.eEn: The people of Chu call a younger sister 媦. Formed from 女, with 胃 indicating the pronunciation. The Gongyang Commentary says: “The wife of the king of Chu was a younger sister.”

姪.eEn: An elder brother’s daughter. Formed from 女, with 至 indicating the pronunciation.

姨.e: 妻之女弟同出爲姨。从女夷聲。
姨.eEn: A wife’s younger sister who accompanies her in marriage is called 姨. Formed from 女, with 夷 indicating the pronunciation.

妿.e: 女師也。从女加聲。杜林說：加教於女也。讀若阿。
妿.eEn: A female teacher. Formed from 女, with 加 indicating the pronunciation. Du Lin explains: “It means imparting instruction to women.” Pronounced like 阿.

娒.eEn: A female teacher. Formed from 女, with 𣫭 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 母.

媾.e: 重㛰也。从女冓聲。《易》曰：“匪寇，㛰媾。”
媾.eEn: Marriage between families already related by marriage. Formed from 女, with 冓 indicating the pronunciation. The Changes says: “Not bandits, but marriage partners.”

姼.eEn: A beautiful woman. Formed from 女, with 多 indicating the pronunciation.

妭.eEn: A woman’s beauty. Formed from 女, with 犮 indicating the pronunciation.

嘰.eEn: To eat a little. Formed from 口, with 幾 indicating the pronunciation.

婢.e: 女之卑者也。从女从卑，卑亦聲。
婢.eEn: A woman of low status; a female servant. Formed from 女 and 卑, with 卑 also indicating the pronunciation.

奴.e: 奴、婢，皆古之辠人也。《周禮》曰：“其奴，男子入于辠隸，女子入于舂藁。”从女从又。
奴.eEn: Male and female slaves were both people convicted of crimes in antiquity. The Rites of Zhou says: “Among those enslaved, the men are assigned to penal servitude, and the women to grain-pounding and straw work.” Formed from 女 and 又.

媊.e: 甘氏《星經》曰：“太白上公，妻曰女媊。女媊居南斗，食厲，天下祭之。曰明星。”从女前聲。
媊.eEn: Master Gan’s Classic of the Stars says: “Taibai is the senior lord; his wife is called 女媊. 女媊 dwells in the Southern Dipper and consumes malign influences. All under heaven offer sacrifices to her. She is called the Bright Star.” Formed from 女, with 前 indicating the pronunciation.

媧.e: 古之神聖女，化萬物者也。从女咼聲。
媧.eEn: A divine and sagely woman of antiquity who transformed the myriad things. Formed from 女, with 咼 indicating the pronunciation.

娀.e: 帝高辛之妃，偰母號也。从女戎聲。《詩》曰：“有娀方將。”
娀.eEn: The designation of Emperor Gaoxin’s consort, the mother of 偰. Formed from 女, with 戎 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The You-Song were then flourishing.”

娥.e: 帝堯之女，舜妻娥皇字也。秦晉謂好曰娙娥。从女我聲。
娥.eEn: A character in the courtesy name Ehuang, daughter of Emperor Yao and wife of Shun. In Qin and Jin, beauty is called 娙娥. Formed from 女, with 我 indicating the pronunciation.

嫄.e: 台國之女，周棄母字也。从女原聲。
嫄.eEn: The courtesy name of a woman of the state of Tai, the mother of Qi, ancestor of the Zhou. Formed from 女, with 原 indicating the pronunciation.

嬿.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 燕 indicating the pronunciation.

妸.e: 女字也。从女可聲。讀若阿。
妸.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 可 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 阿.

婕.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 疌 indicating the pronunciation.

嬩.e: 女字也。从女與聲。讀若余。
嬩.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 與 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 余.

孁.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 霝 indicating the pronunciation.

嫽.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation.

婤.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 周 indicating the pronunciation.

姶.e: 女字也。从女合聲。《春秋傳》曰：“嬖人婤姶。”一曰無聲。
姶.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 合 indicating the pronunciation. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “The favored woman, Zhou’e.” Another explanation is: “Without sound.”

妀.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

妵.eEn: A woman’s courtesy name. Formed from 女, with 主 indicating the pronunciation.

含.eEn: To hold something in the mouth. Formed from 口, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

始.eEn: A woman’s beginning. Formed from 女, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

媚.eEn: To please. Formed from 女, with 眉 indicating the pronunciation.

嫵.eEn: Charming or pleasing. Formed from 女, with 無 indicating the pronunciation.

媄.e: 色好也。从女从美，美亦聲。
媄.eEn: Beautiful in appearance. Formed from 女 and 美, with 美 also indicating the pronunciation.

嫷.e: 南楚之外謂好曰嫷。从女隋聲。
嫷.eEn: Beyond southern Chu, beauty is called 嫷. Formed from 女, with 隋 indicating the pronunciation.

姝.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 朱 indicating the pronunciation.

好.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女 and 子.

哺.eEn: To chew food. Formed from 口, with 甫 indicating the pronunciation.

嬹.eEn: Pleased. Formed from 女, with 興 indicating the pronunciation.

嬮.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 厭 indicating the pronunciation.

姣.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 交 indicating the pronunciation.

嬽.e: 好也。从女𡚇聲。讀若蜀郡布名。
嬽.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 𡚇 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like the name of a cloth from Shu Commandery.

娧.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 兌 indicating the pronunciation.

媌.eEn: Beautiful within the eyes. Formed from 女, with 苗 indicating the pronunciation.

嫿.eEn: Quiet and beautiful. Formed from 女, with 畫 indicating the pronunciation.

婠.e: 體德好也。从女官聲。讀若楚卻宛。
婠.eEn: Beautiful in bodily bearing and virtue. Formed from 女, with 官 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 宛 in the name of Que Wan of Chu.

娙.eEn: Tall and beautiful. Formed from 女, with 坙 indicating the pronunciation.

味.eEn: Flavor. Formed from 口, with 未 indicating the pronunciation.

妴.eEn: Gentle and compliant. Formed from 女, with 夗 indicating the pronunciation.

婉.e: 順也。从女宛聲。《春秋傳》曰：“太子痤婉。”
婉.eEn: Compliant. Formed from 女, with 宛 indicating the pronunciation. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “Crown Prince Cuo was gentle and compliant.”

嫣.eEn: A tall appearance. Formed from 女, with 焉 indicating the pronunciation.

嫋.eEn: Soft and delicate. Formed from 女 and 弱.

孅.eEn: Fine and pointed. Formed from 女, with 韱 indicating the pronunciation.

嫇.e: 嬰嫇也。从女冥聲。一曰嫇嫇，小人皃。
嫇.eEn: Used in 嬰嫇. Formed from 女, with 冥 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: “嫇嫇 describes the appearance of a small person.”

嚛.eEn: The sensation of eating something pungent. Formed from 口, with 樂 indicating the pronunciation.

媱.eEn: The appearance of walking with bent shoulders. Formed from 女, with 䍃 indicating the pronunciation.

嬛.e: 材緊也。从女瞏聲。《春秋傳》曰：“嬛嬛在疚。”
嬛.eEn: Able and keen. Formed from 女, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “Alone and afflicted by sorrow.”

姽.e: 閑體，行姽姽也。从女危聲。
姽.eEn: Graceful in bodily bearing, walking with a 姽姽 gait. Formed from 女, with 危 indicating the pronunciation.

委.eEn: To yield and follow. Formed from 女 and 禾.

婐.e: 㛂也。一曰女侍曰婐。讀若騧，或若委。从女果聲。孟軻曰：“舜爲天子，二女婐。”
婐.eEn: Graceful. Another explanation is: “A female attendant is called 婐.” Pronounced like 騧, or like 委. Formed from 女, with 果 indicating the pronunciation. Meng Ke says: “When Shun became Son of Heaven, the two women attended him.”

妗.e: 𡝫妗也。一曰善笑皃。从女今聲。
妗.eEn: Used in 𡝫妗. Another explanation is: “The appearance of smiling readily.” Formed from 女, with 今 indicating the pronunciation.

孂.e: 竦身也。从女簋聲。讀若《詩》“糾糾葛屨”。
孂.eEn: To raise the body upright. Formed from 女, with 簋 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 糾 in the line from the Odes: “Twisted hemp sandals.”

婧.e: 竦立也。从女青聲。一曰有才也。讀若韭菁。
婧.eEn: To stand upright. Formed from 女, with 青 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: “To possess talent.” Pronounced like 菁 in 韭菁, “leek flowers.”

妌.eEn: Quiet. Formed from 女, with 井 indicating the pronunciation.

姂.eEn: A woman’s appearance. Formed from 女, with 乏 indicating the pronunciation.

嫙.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 旋 indicating the pronunciation.

姡.eEn: Ugly in the face. Formed from 女, with 𠯑 indicating the pronunciation.

嬥.e: 直好皃。一曰嬈也。从女翟聲。
嬥.eEn: An upright and beautiful appearance. Another explanation is: “Delicate and charming.” Formed from 女, with 翟 indicating the pronunciation.

嫢.e: 媞也。从女規聲。讀若癸。秦晉謂細爲嫢。
嫢.eEn: Attentive and discerning. Formed from 女, with 規 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 癸. In Qin and Jin, something slender is called 嫢.

媞.e: 諦也。一曰妍黠也。一曰江淮之閒謂母曰媞。从女是聲。
媞.eEn: Careful and discerning. Another explanation is: “Beautiful and clever.” Another explanation is: “Between the Yangtze and Huai rivers, a mother is called 媞.” Formed from 女, with 是 indicating the pronunciation.

婺.eEn: Not to follow. Formed from 女, with 敄 indicating the pronunciation.

噫.eEn: To release breath after eating one’s fill; to belch. Formed from 口, with 意 indicating the pronunciation.

嫺.eEn: Refined. Formed from 女, with 閒 indicating the pronunciation.

媐.eEn: Pleased and joyful. Formed from 女, with 巸 indicating the pronunciation.

婜.eEn: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 臤 indicating the pronunciation.

娛.eEn: Joyful. Formed from 女, with 吳 indicating the pronunciation.

娭.e: 戲也。从女矣聲。一曰卑賤名也。
娭.eEn: To play. Formed from 女, with 矣 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: “A designation for someone of low status.”

媅.eEn: Joyful. Formed from 女, with 甚 indicating the pronunciation.

娓.eEn: Compliant. Formed from 女, with 尾 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 𡡾.

嫡.eEn: Careful and circumspect. Formed from 女, with 啻 indicating the pronunciation.

孎.e: 謹也。从女屬聲。讀若人不孫爲孎。
孎.eEn: Careful. Formed from 女, with 屬 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 孎 in the expression describing a person who is not deferential.

璙.eEn: A kind of jade. Formed from 玉, with 尞 indicating the pronunciation.

嘽.e: 喘息也。一曰喜也。从口單聲。《詩》曰：“嘽嘽駱馬。”
嘽.eEn: To pant. Another explanation is: “Joyful.” Formed from 口, with 單 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The black-maned white horses are panting.”

媕.e: 女有心媕媕也。从女弇聲。
媕.eEn: A woman having thoughts but remaining hesitant. Formed from 女, with 弇 indicating the pronunciation.

媣.eEn: To set right. Formed from 女, with 染 indicating the pronunciation.

嫥.e: 壹也。从女專聲。一曰嫥嫥。
嫥.eEn: Single; undivided. Formed from 女, with 專 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation gives the doubled form 嫥嫥.

如.eEn: To obey and follow. Formed from 女 and 口.

嫧.eEn: Orderly. Formed from 女, with 責 indicating the pronunciation.

娕.e: 謹也。从女束聲。讀若謹敕數數。
娕.eEn: Careful. Formed from 女, with 束 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 數 in 數數, meaning repeatedly to caution or admonish.

嬐.e: 敏疾也。一曰莊敬皃。从女僉聲。
嬐.eEn: Quick and swift. Another explanation is: “A solemn and respectful appearance.” Formed from 女, with 僉 indicating the pronunciation.

嬪.eEn: To submit; to serve. Formed from 女, with 賓 indicating the pronunciation.

唾.eEn: Fluid in the mouth; saliva. Formed from 口, with 𡍮 indicating the pronunciation.

妟.e: 安也。从女、日。《詩》曰：“以妟父母。”
妟.eEn: At ease. Formed from 女 and 日. The Odes says: “To put one’s parents at ease.”

嬗.e: 緩也。从女亶聲。一曰傳也。
嬗.eEn: Slow; relaxed. Formed from 女, with 亶 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is: “To transmit.”

嫴.eEn: To guarantee and take responsibility. Formed from 女, with 辜 indicating the pronunciation.

媻.eEn: Extravagant. Formed from 女, with 般 indicating the pronunciation.

娑.e: 舞也。从女沙聲。《詩》曰：“市也媻娑。”
娑.eEn: To dance. Formed from 女, with 沙 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “In the marketplace, dancing about.”

姷.eEn: To pair; a partner. Formed from 女, with 有 indicating the pronunciation. Pronounced like 祐.

姰.e: 鈞適也。男女併也。从女旬聲。
姰.eEn: An equal match; a man and woman joined together. Formed from 女, with 旬 indicating the pronunciation.

姕.e: 婦人小物也。从女此聲。《詩》曰：“屢舞姕姕。”
姕.eEn: A petty woman. Formed from 女, with 此 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Repeatedly dancing, 姕姕.”

妓.e: 婦人小物也。从女支聲。讀若跂行。
妓.eEn: A petty woman. Formed from 女, with 支 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 跂 in 跂行, “walking on tiptoe.”

嬰.e: 頸飾也。从女、賏。賏，其連也。
嬰.eEn: A neck ornament. Formed from 女 and 賏. 賏 represents its linked arrangement.

咦.e: 南陽謂大呼曰咦。从口夷聲。
咦.eEn: In Nanyang, a loud cry is called 咦. Formed from 口, with 夷 indicating the pronunciation.

媛.e: 美女也。人所援也。从女从爰。爰，引也。《詩》曰：“邦之媛兮。”
媛.eEn: A beautiful woman; one whom people seek to draw toward themselves. Formed from 女 and 爰. 爰 means “to draw.” The Odes says: “The beautiful woman of the state!”

娉.eEn: To inquire. Formed from 女, with 甹 indicating the pronunciation.

娽.eEn: To follow or accompany. Formed from 女, with 彔 indicating the pronunciation.

妝.eEn: To adorn. Formed from 女, with an abbreviated form of 牀 indicating the pronunciation.

孌.eEn: To admire or long for. Formed from 女, with 䜌 indicating the pronunciation.

媟.eEn: To treat with disrespectful familiarity. Formed from 女, with 枼 indicating the pronunciation.

嬻.eEn: Disrespectful familiarity, as in 媟嬻. Formed from 女, with 賣 indicating the pronunciation.

嬖.eEn: To favor and love, as in 便嬖, “a favored intimate.” Formed from 女, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation.

呬.e: 東夷謂息爲呬。从口四聲。《詩》曰：“犬夷呬矣。”
呬.eEn: The Eastern Yi call breathing 呬. Formed from 口, with 四 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The Quan Yi have come to rest.”

妎.eEn: To be jealous. Formed from 女, with 介 indicating the pronunciation.

妒.eEn: A wife's jealousy concerning her husband. Formed from 女, with 戶 indicating the pronunciation.

媢.e: 夫妒婦也。从女冒聲。一曰相視也。
媢.eEn: A husband's jealousy concerning his wife. Formed from 女, with 冒 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is “to look at one another.”

佞.eEn: Skillful flattery and great ability. Formed from 女 and an abbreviated form of 信.

嫈.eEn: A cautious demeanor. Formed from 女, with an abbreviated form of 熒 indicating the pronunciation.

嫪.eEn: To cling affectionately, as expressed by 婟. Formed from 女, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation.

婟.eEn: To cling affectionately, as expressed by 嫪. Formed from 女, with 固 indicating the pronunciation.

姿.eEn: Bearing or demeanor. Formed from 女, with 次 indicating the pronunciation.

喘.eEn: Rapid breathing. Formed from 口, with 耑 indicating the pronunciation.

妨.eEn: To harm. Formed from 女, with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

妄.eEn: Disorder. Formed from 女, with 亡 indicating the pronunciation.

媮.eEn: Clever and crafty. Formed from 女, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

娋.eEn: To encroach little by little. Formed from 女, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation.

妯.eEn: To move. Formed from 女, with 由 indicating the pronunciation.

嫌.e: 不平於心也。一曰疑也。从女兼聲。
嫌.eEn: To feel discontent in one's heart. Another explanation is “to doubt.” Formed from 女, with 兼 indicating the pronunciation.

呼.eEn: To breathe out. Formed from 口, with 乎 indicating the pronunciation.

婼.e: 不順也。从女若聲。《春秋傳》曰：“叔孫婼。”
婼.eEn: Disobedient. Formed from 女, with 若 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “Shusun 婼.”

婞.e: 很也。从女幸聲。《楚詞》曰：“鯀婞直。”
婞.eEn: Obstinate. Formed from 女, with 幸 indicating the pronunciation. The Songs of Chu says: “Gun was obstinate and unbending.”

嫳.e: 易使怒也。从女敝聲。讀若擊撆。
嫳.eEn: Easily angered. Formed from 女, with 敝 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 撆 in 擊撆, “to strike.”

嫸.e: 好枝格人語也。一曰靳也。从女善聲。
嫸.eEn: Fond of obstructing or contradicting others' speech. Another explanation is “to mock or begrudge.” Formed from 女, with 善 indicating the pronunciation.

娺.e: 疾悍也。从女叕聲。讀若唾。
娺.eEn: Quick and fierce. Formed from 女, with 叕 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 唾.

娿.eEn: Hesitant or indecisive, as in 媕娿. Formed from 女, with 阿 indicating the pronunciation.

姸.e: 技也。一曰不省録事。一曰難侵也。一曰惠也。一曰安也。 从女幵聲。讀若研。
姸.eEn: Skill. Another explanation is “not attending to the recording of affairs.” Another is “difficult to encroach upon.” Another is “kind.” Another is “at ease.” Formed from 女, with 幵 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 研.

娃.e: 圜深目皃。或曰吳楚之閒謂好曰娃。从女圭聲。
娃.eEn: The appearance of round, deep-set eyes. Some say that in the region between Wu and Chu, beauty is called 娃. Formed from 女, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

吸.eEn: To breathe in. Formed from 口, with 及 indicating the pronunciation.

妜.e: 鼻目閒皃。讀若煙火炔炔。从女，決省聲。
妜.eEn: The appearance of the area between the nose and eyes. Read like 炔 in 煙火炔炔, describing smoke and fire. Formed from 女, with an abbreviated form of 決 indicating the pronunciation.

孈.e: 愚戇多態也。从女巂聲。讀若隓。
孈.eEn: Foolish and obtuse, with many affected mannerisms. Formed from 女, with 巂 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 隓.

嫼.eEn: An angry appearance. Formed from 女, with 黑 indicating the pronunciation.

嫖.eEn: Light. Formed from 女, with 𤐫 indicating the pronunciation.

姎.e: 女人自偁，我也。从女央聲。
姎.eEn: A woman's term for herself, meaning “I.” Formed from 女, with 央 indicating the pronunciation.

媁.eEn: A displeased appearance. Formed from 女, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

婎.e: 姿婎，姿也。从女隹也。一曰醜也。
婎.eEn: In 姿婎, bearing or demeanor. Formed from 女 and 隹. Another explanation is “ugly.”

噓.eEn: To blow. Formed from 口, with 虛 indicating the pronunciation.

娹.eEn: To remain faithful. Formed from 女, with 弦 indicating the pronunciation.

媥.eEn: A light appearance. Formed from 女, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation.

嫚.eEn: To insult or treat with contempt. Formed from 女, with 曼 indicating the pronunciation.

嬬.e: 弱也。一曰下妻也。从女需聲。
嬬.eEn: Weak. Another explanation is “a wife of subordinate status.” Formed from 女, with 需 indicating the pronunciation.

娝.e: 不肖也。从女否聲。讀若竹皮箁。
娝.eEn: Unworthy. Formed from 女, with 否 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 箁, meaning “bamboo skin.”

嬯.e: 遟鈍也。从女臺聲。闒嬯亦如之。
嬯.eEn: Slow and dull. Formed from 女, with 臺 indicating the pronunciation. 闒嬯 has the same meaning.

婪.e: 貪也。从女林聲。杜林說：卜者黨相詐驗爲婪。讀若潭。
婪.eEn: Greedy. Formed from 女, with 林 indicating the pronunciation. Du Lin explains: “Diviners conspiring to deceive people with supposed confirmations of their predictions is called 婪.” Read like 潭.

嬾.e: 懈也，怠也。一曰臥也。从女賴聲。
嬾.eEn: Slack or idle. Another explanation is “to lie down.” Formed from 女, with 賴 indicating the pronunciation.

婁.e: 空也。从母、中、女，空之意也。一曰婁，務也。
婁.eEn: Empty. Formed from 母, 中, and 女, conveying the idea of emptiness. Another explanation is that 婁 means “to apply oneself to a task.”

娎.eEn: The state expressed by 娎㛍. Formed from 女, with 折 indicating the pronunciation.

嬈.e: 苛也。一曰擾、戲弄也，一曰嬥也。从女堯聲。
嬈.eEn: Harsh or exacting. Another explanation is “to disturb or tease.” Another is the quality expressed by 嬥. Formed from 女, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

姍.e: 誹也。一曰翼便也。从女，𠛹省聲。
姍.eEn: To slander. Another explanation is “pliant and accommodating.” Formed from 女, with an abbreviated form of 𠛹 indicating the pronunciation.

婓.e: 往來婓婓也。一曰醜皃。从女非聲。
婓.eEn: Going back and forth, as in 婓婓. Another explanation is “an ugly appearance.” Formed from 女, with 非 indicating the pronunciation.

喟.eEn: A deep sigh. Formed from 口, with 胃 indicating the pronunciation.

孃.e: 煩擾也。一曰肥大也。从女襄聲。
孃.eEn: To trouble or disturb. Another explanation is “fat and large.” Formed from 女, with 襄 indicating the pronunciation.

嬒.e: 女黑色也。从女會聲。《詩》曰：“嬒兮蔚兮。”
嬒.eEn: A woman's dark complexion. Formed from 女, with 會 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “Dark indeed, luxuriant indeed.”

媆.eEn: A beautiful appearance. Formed from 女, with 耎 indicating the pronunciation.

嫯.eEn: To insult or treat with contempt. Formed from 女, with 敖 indicating the pronunciation.

婬.eEn: Illicit indulgence. Formed from 女, with 㸒 indicating the pronunciation.

姘.e: 除也。漢律：“齊人予妻婢姦曰姘。”从女幷聲。
姘.eEn: To remove. The Han statutes say: “Among the people of Qi, illicit intercourse involving a wife or female servant is called 姘.” Formed from 女, with 幷 indicating the pronunciation.

奸.e: 犯婬也。从女从干，干亦聲。
奸.eEn: To commit sexual misconduct. Formed from 女 and 干, with 干 also indicating the pronunciation.

姅.e: 婦人汚也。从女半聲。漢律：“見姅變，不得侍祠。”
姅.eEn: A woman's impurity. Formed from 女, with 半 indicating the pronunciation. The Han statutes say: “A woman experiencing the condition of 姅 may not attend the sacrifices.”

瓘.e: 玉也。从玉雚聲。《春秋傳》曰：“瓘斚。”
瓘.eEn: A kind of jade. Formed from 玉, with 雚 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: “A 瓘-jade ritual cup.”

啍.e: 口气也。从口𦎫聲。《詩》曰：“大車啍啍。”
啍.eEn: Breath from the mouth. Formed from 口, with 𦎫 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “The great carriage rumbles along.”

娗.eEn: An illness involving discharge in women. Formed from 女, with 廷 indicating the pronunciation.

婥.eEn: An illness of women. Formed from 女, with 卓 indicating the pronunciation.

娷.eEn: To shift responsibility onto another. Formed from 女, with 垂 indicating the pronunciation.

媿.eEn: To feel ashamed. Formed from 女, with 鬼 indicating the pronunciation.

奻.eEn: To dispute or litigate. Formed from two 女 components.

姦.eEn: Illicit conduct. Formed from three 女 components.

嬙.eEn: A female palace office. Formed from 女, with an abbreviated form of 牆 indicating the pronunciation.

妲.e: 女字。妲己，紂妃。从女旦聲。
妲.eEn: A woman's courtesy name. Daji was King Zhou's consort. Formed from 女, with 旦 indicating the pronunciation.

嬌.eEn: Bearing or demeanor. Formed from 女, with 喬 indicating the pronunciation.

嚏.e: 悟解气也。从口疐聲。《詩》曰：“願言則嚏。”
嚏.eEn: A release of breath on waking. Formed from 口, with 疐 indicating the pronunciation. The Odes says: “When I long for you, I sneeze.”

嬋.eEn: In 嬋娟, bearing or demeanor. Formed from 女, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

娟.eEn: The bearing or demeanor expressed by 嬋娟. Formed from 女, with 肙 indicating the pronunciation.

嫠.eEn: A woman without a husband. Formed from 女, with 𠩺 indicating the pronunciation.

姤.eEn: A mate or partner. Formed from 女, with 后 indicating the pronunciation.

毋.e: 止之也。从女，有奸之者。凡毋之屬皆从毋。
毋.eEn: To stop or prohibit something. Formed from 女, with a mark representing someone violating her. All characters in the 毋 class are formed with 毋.

毐.e: 人無行也。从士从毋。賈侍中說：秦始皇母與嫪毐淫，坐誅，故世罵淫曰嫪毐。讀若娭。
毐.eEn: A person without moral conduct. Formed from 士 and 毋. Palace Attendant Jia explains: “The mother of the First Emperor of Qin had illicit relations with Lao Ai; he was executed for the offense. Thus people use Lao Ai as an insult for sexual misconduct.” Read like 娭.

民.e: 眾萌也。从古文之象。凡民之屬皆从民。
民.eEn: The common people. Based on the form of the ancient-script character. All characters in the 民 class are formed with 民.

氓.eEn: The common people. Formed from 民, with 亡 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 盲.

丿.e: 右戾也。象左引之形。凡丿之屬皆从丿。
丿.eEn: To bend to the right. It depicts a stroke drawn toward the left. All characters in the 丿 class are formed with 丿.

乂.eEn: To cut grass. Formed from 丿 and 乀 crossing each other.

弗.eEn: To straighten. Formed from 丿 and 乀, together with an abbreviated form of 韋.

乀.e: 左戾也。从反丿。讀與弗同。
乀.eEn: To bend to the left. Formed from a reversed 丿. Read the same as 弗.

弋.e: 橜也。象折木衺銳著形。从𠂆，象物挂之也。
弋.eEn: A stake. It depicts a broken piece of wood with a slanting, pointed end set in place. Formed with 𠂆, depicting something hanging from it.

乁.e: 流也。从反𠂆。讀若移。凡乁之屬皆从乁。
乁.eEn: To flow. Formed from a reversed 𠂆. Read like 移. All characters in the 乁 class are formed with 乁.

氏.e: 巴蜀山名岸脅之㫄箸欲落𡐦者曰氏，氏崩，聞數百里。象形，乀聲。凡氏之屬皆从氏。楊雄賦：響若氏隤。
氏.eEn: In the mountains of Ba and Shu, an overhanging mass attached to the side of a cliff and about to fall is called 氏. When a 氏 collapses, it can be heard for several hundred li. A pictograph, with 乀 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 氏 class are formed with 氏. A rhapsody by Yang Xiong says: “Its sound was like a 氏 collapsing.”

氒.e: 木本。从氏。大於末。讀若厥。
氒.eEn: The base of a tree. Formed from 氏. It is larger than the tip. Read like 厥.

氐.e: 至也。从氏下箸一。一，地也。凡氐之屬皆从氐。
氐.eEn: To reach. Formed from 氏 with 一 placed beneath it. 一 represents the ground. All characters in the 氐 class are formed with 氐.

唫.eEn: A tightening of the mouth. Formed from 口, with 金 indicating the pronunciation.

戈.e: 平頭𢧢也。从弋，一橫之。象形。凡戈之屬皆从戈。
戈.eEn: A flat-headed halberd. Formed from 弋, with a horizontal stroke across it. A pictograph. All characters in the 戈 class are formed with 戈.

肈.eEn: A name taboo of the reigning emperor.

戣.e: 《周禮》：侍臣執戣，立于東垂。兵也。从戈癸聲。
戣.eEn: The Rites of Zhou says: “Attendant ministers hold 戣 weapons and stand at the eastern side.” A weapon. Formed from 戈, with 癸 indicating the pronunciation.

戛.eEn: A halberd. Formed from 戈 and 𦣻. Read like 棘.

賊.eEn: To ruin or defeat. Formed from 戈, with 則 indicating the pronunciation.

噤.eEn: To close the mouth. Formed from 口, with 禁 indicating the pronunciation.

戍.eEn: To guard the frontier. Formed from a person holding a 戈.

戰.eEn: To fight. Formed from 戈, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

戲.e: 三軍之偏也。一曰兵也。从戈䖒聲。
戲.eEn: A subdivision of the three armies. Another explanation is a weapon. Formed from 戈, with 䖒 indicating the pronunciation.

或.e: 邦也。从囗从戈，以守一。一，地也。
或.eEn: A state. Formed from 囗 and 戈, used to defend 一. 一 represents the land.

戕.e: 搶也。他國臣來弑君曰戕。从戈爿聲。
戕.eEn: To strike with a spear. When a minister from another state comes and kills the ruler, this is called 戕. Formed from 戈, with 爿 indicating the pronunciation.

戮.eEn: To kill. Formed from 戈, with 翏 indicating the pronunciation.

戡.eEn: To stab. Formed from 戈, with 甚 indicating the pronunciation.

名.e: 自命也。从口从夕。夕者，冥也。冥不相見，故以口自名。
名.eEn: To name oneself. Formed from 口 and 夕. 夕 means darkness. In darkness people cannot see one another, so they use their mouths to identify themselves by name.

戭.e: 長搶也。从戈寅聲。《春秋傳》有擣戭。
戭.eEn: A long spear. Formed from 戈, with 寅 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals mentions a person named 擣戭.

戩.e: 滅也。从戈晉聲。《詩》曰：“實始戩商。”
戩.eEn: To destroy. Formed from 戈, with 晉 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Indeed, they began the destruction of Shang.”

武.e: 楚莊王曰：“夫武，定功戢兵。故止戈爲武。”
武.eEn: King Zhuang of Chu said: “Martial achievement means establishing merit and putting away weapons. Thus 止, ‘to stop,’ and 戈, ‘weapons,’ make 武.”

戢.e: 藏兵也。从戈咠聲。《詩》曰：“載戢干戈。”
戢.eEn: To put weapons away. Formed from 戈, with 咠 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Then they put away shields and halberds.”

戠.eEn: Explanation missing in the source. Formed from 戈 and 音.

戔.e: 賊也。从二戈。《周書》曰：“戔戔巧言。”
戔.eEn: To harm or ruin. Formed from two 戈 components. The Documents of Zhou says: “Destructive, destructive are their clever words.”

戉.e: 斧也。从戈𠄌聲。《司馬法》曰：“夏執玄戉，殷執白戚，周左杖黃戉，右秉白髦。”凡戉之屬皆从戉。”
戉.eEn: An axe. Formed from 戈, with 𠄌 indicating the pronunciation. The Methods of the Minister of War says: “Under the Xia they held black axes; under the Yin they held white battle-axes; under the Zhou they carried a yellow axe in the left hand and held a white yak-tail standard in the right.” All characters in the 戉 class are formed with 戉.

戚.eEn: An axe. Formed from 戉, with 尗 indicating the pronunciation.

吾.eEn: I; a term for referring to oneself. Formed from 口, with 五 indicating the pronunciation.

我.e: 施身自謂也。或說我，頃頓也。从戈从𠄒。𠄒，或說古垂字。一曰古殺字。凡我之屬皆从我。
我.eEn: A term applied to one's own person when referring to oneself. Another explanation takes 我 to mean inclining and bowing the head. Formed from 戈 and 𠄒. Some explain 𠄒 as the ancient form of 垂; another explanation calls it the ancient form of 殺. All characters in the 我 class are formed with 我.

義.eEn: The dignity and bearing of one's own person. Formed from 我 and 羊.

亅.e: 鉤逆者謂之亅。象形。凡亅之屬皆从亅。读若橜。
亅.eEn: A hook that turns back is called 亅. A pictograph. All characters in the 亅 class are formed with 亅. Read like 橜.

珡.e: 禁也。神農所作。洞越。練朱五弦，周加二弦。象形。凡珡之屬皆从珡。
珡.eEn: Restraint. Invented by Shennong. It has hollow openings on its underside. It has five strings of processed, vermilion-colored silk; the Zhou added two strings. A pictograph. All characters in the 珡 class are formed with 珡.

瑟.e: 庖犧所作弦樂也。从珡必聲。
瑟.eEn: A stringed musical instrument invented by Paoxi. Formed from 珡, with 必 indicating the pronunciation.

琵.eEn: The pipa, a musical instrument. Formed from 珡, with 比 indicating the pronunciation.

琶.e: 琵琶也。从珡巴聲。義當用枇杷。
琶.eEn: The pipa. Formed from 珡, with 巴 indicating the pronunciation. For this meaning, the characters 枇杷 should be used.

直.eEn: To see straight. Formed from 𠃊, 十, and 目.

哲.eEn: Wisdom. Formed from 口, with 折 indicating the pronunciation.

亾.e: 逃也。从入从𠃊。凡亾之屬皆从亾。
亾.eEn: To flee. Formed from 入 and 𠃊. All characters in the 亾 class are formed with 亾.

乍.e: 止也，一曰亡也。从亾从一。
乍.eEn: To stop. Another explanation is to flee. Formed from 亾 and 一.

望.e: 出亡在外，望其還也。从亾，朢省聲。
望.eEn: When someone has fled and is away, to look for their return. Formed from 亾, with an abbreviated form of 朢 indicating the pronunciation.

無.eEn: To be absent. Formed from 亾, with 𣞤 indicating the pronunciation.

匃.eEn: Breath. Lu An explains: “A fleeing person constitutes 匄.”

匸.e: 衺徯，有所俠藏也。从乚，上有一覆之。凡匸之屬皆从匸。讀與傒同。
匸.eEn: Slanting concealment, with something held hidden. Formed from 乚, with 一 above covering it. All characters in the 匸 class are formed with 匸. Pronounced the same as 傒.

區.e: 踦區，藏匿也。从品在匸中。品，眾也。
區.eEn: To conceal or hide away, as in 踦區. Formed from 品 inside 匸. 品 means a multitude.

匿.e: 亡也。从匸若聲。讀如羊騶箠。
匿.eEn: To flee. Formed from 匸, with 若 indicating the pronunciation. Read like the term for a whip used to drive sheep.

匽.eEn: To conceal. Formed from 匸, with 妟 indicating the pronunciation.

君.eEn: An honored superior. Formed from 尹. Since such a person issues commands, it also contains 口.

医.e: 盛弓弩矢器也。从匸从矢。《國語》曰：“兵不解医。”
医.eEn: A container for arrows used with bows and crossbows. Formed from 匸 and 矢. The Discourses of the States says: “The soldiers did not unfasten their arrow cases.”

匹.e: 四丈也。从八、匸。八揲一匹，八亦聲。
匹.eEn: Four zhang in length. Formed from 八 and 匸. Eight measured folds make one 匹; 八 also indicates the pronunciation.

匚.e: 受物之器。象形。凡匚之屬皆从匚。讀若方。
匚.eEn: A vessel for holding things. A pictograph. All characters in the 匚 class are formed with 匚. Read like 方.

匠.e: 木工也。从匚从斤。斤，所以作器也。
匠.eEn: A woodworker. Formed from 匚 and 斤. 斤 is the tool used to make utensils.

匧.eEn: To store away. Formed from 匚, with 夾 indicating the pronunciation.

匡.eEn: A drinking vessel; a basket. Formed from 匚, with 㞷 indicating the pronunciation.

匜.e: 似羹魁，柄中有道，可以注水。从匚也聲。
匜.eEn: A vessel resembling a soup ladle, with a channel through its handle through which water can be poured. Formed from 匚, with 也 indicating the pronunciation.

匴.eEn: A basket for rinsing rice. Formed from 匚, with 算 indicating the pronunciation.

匪.e: 器，似竹筐。从匚非聲。《逸周書》曰：“實玄黃于匪。”
匪.eEn: A container resembling a bamboo basket. Formed from 匚, with 非 indicating the pronunciation. The Lost Documents of Zhou says: “Place the black and yellow silks in the basket.”

命.eEn: To command. Formed from 口 and 令.

匫.eEn: An ancient vessel. Formed from 匚, with 曶 indicating the pronunciation.

匬.eEn: A bowl; a vessel. Formed from 匚, with 俞 indicating the pronunciation.

匱.eEn: A box or chest. Formed from 匚, with 貴 indicating the pronunciation.

匵.eEn: A box or chest. Formed from 匚, with 賣 indicating the pronunciation.

匣.eEn: A box or chest. Formed from 匚, with 甲 indicating the pronunciation.

匯.eEn: A vessel. Formed from 匚, with 淮 indicating the pronunciation.

柩.eEn: A coffin. Formed from 匚 and 木, with 久 indicating the pronunciation.

璥.eEn: A kind of jade. Formed from 玉, with 敬 indicating the pronunciation.

咨.eEn: To deliberate about affairs is called 咨. Formed from 口, with 次 indicating the pronunciation.

匰.e: 宗廟盛主器也。《周禮》曰：“祭祀共匰主。”从匚單聲。
匰.eEn: A container for holding a spirit tablet in an ancestral temple. The Rites of Zhou says: “For sacrifices, supply the tablet containers and spirit tablets.” Formed from 匚, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

曲.e: 象器曲受物之形。或說曲，蠶薄也。凡曲之屬皆从曲。
曲.eEn: Depicts the shape of a bent vessel that holds things. Another explanation takes 曲 to mean a silkworm tray. All characters in the 曲 class are formed with 曲.

甾.e: 東楚名缶曰甾。象形。凡甾之屬皆从甾。
甾.eEn: In eastern Chu, an earthenware jar is called 甾. A pictograph. All characters in the 甾 class are formed with 甾.

疀.eEn: A spade; an ancient farming implement. Formed from 甾, with 疌 indicating the pronunciation.

瓦.e: 土器已燒之總名。象形。凡瓦之屬皆从瓦。
瓦.eEn: The general term for earthenware objects that have been fired. A pictograph. All characters in the 瓦 class are formed with 瓦.

召.eEn: To call. Formed from 口, with 刀 indicating the pronunciation.

瓬.e: 周家搏埴之工也。从瓦方聲。讀若㧚破之㧚。
瓬.eEn: An artisan of the Zhou royal house who shapes clay. Formed from 瓦, with 方 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 㧚 in 㧚破, ‘to break.’

甄.eEn: To make pottery. Formed from 瓦, with 垔 indicating the pronunciation.

甍.eEn: The ridgepole of a house. Formed from 瓦, with an abbreviated form of 夢 indicating the pronunciation.

甑.eEn: A steaming vessel. Formed from 瓦, with 曾 indicating the pronunciation.

甗.e: 甑也。一曰穿也。从瓦鬳聲。讀若言。
甗.eEn: A steaming vessel. Another explanation is a perforation. Formed from 瓦, with 鬳 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 言.

瓵.eEn: A bowl or small jar is called 瓵. Formed from 瓦, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

瓽.eEn: A large basin. Formed from 瓦, with 尚 indicating the pronunciation.

甌.eEn: A small basin. Formed from 瓦, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

瓮.eEn: A jar. Formed from 瓦, with 公 indicating the pronunciation.

瓨.e: 似罌，長頸。受十升。讀若洪。从瓦工聲。
瓨.eEn: A vessel resembling a jar, with a long neck. It holds ten sheng. Read like 洪. Formed from 瓦, with 工 indicating the pronunciation.

問.eEn: To inquire. Formed from 口, with 門 indicating the pronunciation.

瓴.eEn: A jar resembling a bottle. Formed from 瓦, with 令 indicating the pronunciation.

甂.e: 似小瓿。大口而卑。用食。从瓦扁聲。
甂.eEn: A vessel resembling a small jar, with a wide mouth and a low body. Used for eating. Formed from 瓦, with 扁 indicating the pronunciation.

瓿.eEn: A low, wide-mouthed vessel. Formed from 瓦, with 咅 indicating the pronunciation.

甓.e: 瓴甓也。从瓦辟聲。《詩》曰：“中唐有甓。”
甓.eEn: A paving brick, as in 瓴甓. Formed from 瓦, with 辟 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The path through the courtyard has paving bricks.”

甃.eEn: The lining of a well. Formed from 瓦, with 秋 indicating the pronunciation.

甈.eEn: A useless gourd; a broken jar. Formed from 瓦, with 臬 indicating the pronunciation.

唯.eEn: An affirmative response. Formed from 口, with 隹 indicating the pronunciation.

瓪.eEn: Broken or damaged. Formed from 瓦, with 反 indicating the pronunciation.

瓷.eEn: An earthenware vessel. Formed from 瓦, with 次 indicating the pronunciation.

瓻.eEn: A wine vessel. Formed from 瓦, with an abbreviated form of 稀 indicating the pronunciation.

弓.e: 以近窮遠。象形。古者揮作弓。《周禮》六弓：王弓、弧弓以射甲革甚質；夾弓、庾弓以射干矦鳥獸；唐弓、大弓以授學射者。凡弓之屬皆从弓。
弓.eEn: An implement that reaches what is distant from close at hand. A pictograph. Hui is said to have made bows in antiquity. The Zhou Rites lists six bows: the royal bow and arc bow for shooting armor and exceptionally hard targets; the jia and yu bows for shooting shields, targets, birds, and beasts; and the tang and great bows for those learning archery. All characters in the 弓 class are formed with 弓.

弴.eEn: A painted bow. Formed from 弓, with 𦎫 indicating the pronunciation.

弭.e: 弓無緣，可以解轡紛者。从弓耳聲。
弭.eEn: A bow without binding, which can be used to undo tangled reins. Formed from 弓, with 耳 indicating the pronunciation.

弲.e: 角弓也，洛陽名弩曰弲。从弓肙聲。
弲.eEn: A horn bow. In Luoyang, a crossbow is called 弲. Formed from 弓, with 肙 indicating the pronunciation.

唱.eEn: To lead. Formed from 口, with 昌 indicating the pronunciation.

弧.e: 木弓也。从弓瓜聲。一曰往體寡，來體多曰弧。
弧.eEn: A wooden bow. Formed from 弓, with 瓜 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation says that a bow whose outward curve is slight and whose inward curve is pronounced is called 弧.

弨.e: 弓反也。从弓召聲。《詩》曰：“彤弓弨兮。”
弨.eEn: A bow curving back. Formed from 弓, with 召 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “The vermilion bow curves back.”

彄.e: 弓弩耑，弦所居也。从弓區聲。
彄.eEn: The end of a bow or crossbow, where the string rests. Formed from 弓, with 區 indicating the pronunciation.

張.eEn: To put a string on a bow. Formed from 弓, with 長 indicating the pronunciation.

彏.eEn: To draw a bow swiftly. Formed from 弓, with 矍 indicating the pronunciation.

弸.eEn: The appearance of a strong bow. Formed from 弓, with 朋 indicating the pronunciation.

彊.eEn: A bow having strength. Formed from 弓, with 畺 indicating the pronunciation.

彎.eEn: To hold a bow and fit an arrow to it. Formed from 弓, with 䜌 indicating the pronunciation.

和.eEn: To respond to one another. Formed from 口, with 禾 indicating the pronunciation.

引.eEn: To draw a bow. Formed from 弓 and 丨.

弙.e: 滿弓有所鄉也。从弓于聲。
弙.eEn: To draw a bow fully while aiming in a particular direction. Formed from 弓, with 于 indicating the pronunciation.

弘.e: 弓聲也。从弓厶聲。厶，古文肱字。
弘.eEn: The sound of a bow. Formed from 弓, with 厶 indicating the pronunciation. 厶 is the ancient-script form of 肱.

瓕.eEn: To loosen a bow. Formed from 弓, with 璽 indicating the pronunciation.

弛.eEn: A bow becoming slack. Formed from 弓 and 也.

弢.e: 弓衣也。从弓从𠬢。𠬢，垂飾，與𡔷同意。
弢.eEn: A bow case. Formed from 弓 and 𠬢. 𠬢 represents a hanging ornament and conveys the same idea as 𡔷.

弩.e: 弓有臂者。《周禮》四弩：夾弩、庾弩、唐弩、大弩。从弓奴聲。
弩.eEn: A bow equipped with a stock. The Rites of Zhou lists four crossbows: the 夾 crossbow, the 庾 crossbow, the 唐 crossbow, and the great crossbow. Formed from 弓, with 奴 indicating the pronunciation.

彀.eEn: To draw a crossbow. Formed from 弓, with 𣪊 indicating the pronunciation.

彉.e: 弩滿也。从弓黃聲。讀若郭。
彉.eEn: A crossbow drawn fully. Formed from 弓, with 黃 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 郭.

彃.e: 䠶也。从弓畢聲。《楚詞》曰：“𢏗焉彃日。”
彃.eEn: To shoot. Formed from 弓, with 畢 indicating the pronunciation. The Songs of Chu says: “Where did 𢏗 shoot the suns?”

咥.e: 大笑也。从口至聲。《詩》曰：“咥其笑矣。”
咥.eEn: To laugh heartily. Formed from 口, with 至 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Heartily he laughs.”

彈.eEn: To propel a pellet. Formed from 弓, with 單 indicating the pronunciation.

發.eEn: To release a shot. Formed from 弓, with 癹 indicating the pronunciation.

弜.e: 彊也。从二弓。凡弜之屬皆从弜。
弜.eEn: Strong. Formed from two instances of 弓. All characters in the 弜 class are formed with 弜.

弼.eEn: To assist; to reinforce. Formed from 弜, with 㐁 indicating the pronunciation.

弦.e: 弓弦也。从弓，象絲軫之形。凡弦之屬皆从弦。
弦.eEn: A bowstring. Formed from 弓, depicting the shape of twisted silk. All characters in the 弦 class are formed with 弦.

盭.e: 弻戾也。从弦省，从盩。讀若戾。
盭.eEn: Bent and twisted. Formed from an abbreviated 弦 and from 盩. Read like 戾.

玅.eEn: Taut and twisted. Formed from an abbreviated 弦, with 少 indicating the pronunciation.

系.e: 繋也。从糸丿聲。凡系之屬皆从系。
系.eEn: To tie. Formed from 糸, with 丿 indicating the pronunciation. All characters in the 系 class are formed with 系.

啞.e: 笑也。从口亞聲。《易》曰：“笑言啞啞。”
啞.eEn: To laugh. Formed from 口, with 亞 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Changes says: “Laughing and talking, ha-ha.”

孫.e: 子之子曰孫。从子从系。系，續也。
孫.eEn: A child's child is called 孫, a grandchild. Formed from 子 and 系. 系 means to continue.

緜.eEn: Fine strands joined together. Formed from 系 and 帛.

糸.e: 細絲也。象束絲之形。凡糸之屬皆从糸。讀若覛。
糸.eEn: Fine silk thread. It depicts the shape of a bundle of silk threads. All characters in the 糸 class are formed with 糸. Read like 覛.

繭.eEn: A silkworm's covering, its cocoon. Formed from 糸, 虫, and an abbreviated 黹.

繅.eEn: To unwind a cocoon into silk thread. Formed from 糸, with 巢 indicating the pronunciation.

繹.eEn: To draw out silk thread. Formed from 糸, with 睪 indicating the pronunciation.

緒.eEn: The end of a silk thread. Formed from 糸, with 者 indicating the pronunciation.

緬.eEn: Fine silk thread. Formed from 糸, with 面 indicating the pronunciation.

純.e: 絲也。从糸屯聲。《論語》曰：“今也純，儉。”
純.eEn: Silk. Formed from 糸, with 屯 indicating the pronunciation. The Analects says: “Nowadays silk is used; it is economical.”

噱.eEn: To laugh heartily. Formed from 口, with 豦 indicating the pronunciation.

綃.eEn: Raw silk. Formed from 糸, with 肖 indicating the pronunciation.

紇.e: 絲下也。从糸气聲。《春秋傳》有臧孫紇。
紇.eEn: Inferior silk. Formed from 糸, with 气 indicating the pronunciation. The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals mentions Zangsun He (臧孫紇).

絓.e: 繭滓絓頭也。一曰以囊絮練也。从糸圭聲。
絓.eEn: Cocoon waste: tangled ends. Another explanation is silk floss placed in a bag for scouring. Formed from 糸, with 圭 indicating the pronunciation.

纅.eEn: The color of silk. Formed from 糸, with 樂 indicating the pronunciation.

繀.e: 著絲於筟車也。从糸崔聲。
繀.eEn: To place silk thread on a winding wheel. Formed from 糸, with 崔 indicating the pronunciation.

經.eEn: To weave. Formed from 糸, with 巠 indicating the pronunciation.

織.e: 作布帛之緫名也。从糸戠聲。
織.eEn: The general term for making cloth and silk fabric. Formed from 糸, with 戠 indicating the pronunciation.

唏.e: 笑也。从口，稀省聲。一曰哀痛不泣曰唏。
唏.eEn: To laugh. Formed from 口, with an abbreviated 稀 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is that grieving in pain without weeping is called 唏.

紝.eEn: Threads on a loom. Formed from 糸, with 壬 indicating the pronunciation.

綜.eEn: Threads on a loom. Formed from 糸, with 宗 indicating the pronunciation.

綹.e: 緯十縷爲綹。从糸咎聲。讀若柳。
綹.eEn: Ten weft threads make one 綹, a skein. Formed from 糸, with 咎 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 柳.

緯.eEn: The crosswise silk threads in weaving, the weft. Formed from 糸, with 韋 indicating the pronunciation.

緷.eEn: Weft. Formed from 糸, with 軍 indicating the pronunciation.

繢.eEn: What remains after weaving. Formed from 糸, with 貴 indicating the pronunciation.

統.eEn: To order threads. Formed from 糸, with 充 indicating the pronunciation.

紀.eEn: To separate silk threads. Formed from 糸, with 己 indicating the pronunciation.

繈.eEn: Coarse knots in silk thread. Formed from 糸, with 强 indicating the pronunciation.

琠.eEn: Jade. Formed from 玉, with 典 indicating the pronunciation.

听.eEn: The appearance of laughing. Formed from 口, with 斤 indicating the pronunciation.

纇.eEn: A knot in silk thread. Formed from 糸, with 頪 indicating the pronunciation.

紿.eEn: Silk thread, when worn, becomes slack. Formed from 糸, with 台 indicating the pronunciation.

納.eEn: Silk, when wet, has a soft, clinging quality. Formed from 糸, with 内 indicating the pronunciation.

紡.eEn: Silk thread for nets. Formed from 糸, with 方 indicating the pronunciation.

絕.eEn: To cut silk thread. Formed from 糸, 刀, and 卩.

繼.e: 續也。从糸、㡭。一曰反𢇍爲繼。
繼.eEn: To continue. Formed from 糸 and 㡭. Another explanation is that reversing 𢇍 produces 繼.

續.eEn: To join together. Formed from 糸, with 賣 indicating the pronunciation.

纘.eEn: To carry on. Formed from 糸, with 贊 indicating the pronunciation.

紹.e: 繼也。从糸召聲。一曰紹，緊糾也。
紹.eEn: To continue. Formed from 糸, with 召 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is that 紹 means to twist tightly together.

呭.e: 多言也。从口世聲。《詩》曰：“無然呭呭。”
呭.eEn: To talk much. Formed from 口, with 世 indicating the pronunciation. The Book of Odes says: “Do not chatter on like that.”

縱.e: 緩也。一曰舍也。从糸從聲。
縱.eEn: To loosen. Another explanation is to release. Formed from 糸, with 從 indicating the pronunciation.

紓.eEn: To loosen. Formed from 糸, with 予 indicating the pronunciation.

繎.eEn: Worn silk thread. Formed from 糸, with 然 indicating the pronunciation.

紆.e: 詘也。从糸于聲。一曰縈也。
紆.eEn: To bend. Formed from 糸, with 于 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to wind around.

緈.eEn: Straight. Formed from 糸, with 㚔 indicating the pronunciation. Read like 陘.

纖.eEn: Fine. Formed from 糸, with 韱 indicating the pronunciation.

細.eEn: Minute. Formed from 糸, with 囟 indicating the pronunciation.

緢.e: 旄絲也。从糸苗聲。《周書》曰：“惟緢有稽。”
緢.eEn: Silken strands of a yak's tail. Formed from 糸, with 苗 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Zhou says: “Only in the case of 緢 is there examination.”

縒.eEn: Intermingled and twisted. Formed from 糸, with 差 indicating the pronunciation.

繙.eEn: A ceremonial crown. Formed from 糸, with 番 indicating the pronunciation.

縮.e: 亂也。从糸宿聲。一曰蹴也。
縮.eEn: Disordered. Formed from 糸, with 宿 indicating the pronunciation. Another explanation is to press or tread upon.

紊.e: 亂也。从糸文聲。《商書》曰：“有條而不紊。”
紊.eEn: Disordered. Formed from 糸, with 文 indicating the pronunciation. The Documents of Shang says: “Ordered and without confusion.”

級.eEn: The successive ordering of silk threads. Formed from 糸, with 及 indicating the pronunciation.

總.eEn: To gather and bundle together. Formed from 糸, with 悤 indicating the pronunciation.

約.eEn: To wind around and bind. Formed from 糸, with 勺 indicating the pronunciation.

繚.eEn: To wind around. Formed from 糸, with 𤋯 indicating the pronunciation.

纏.eEn: To wrap around. Formed from 糸, with 廛 indicating the pronunciation.

繞.eEn: To wind around. Formed from 糸, with 堯 indicating the pronunciation.

咄.eEn: To address one another. Formed from 口, with 出 indicating the pronunciation.

紾.eEn: To turn or twist. Formed from 糸, with 㐱 indicating the pronunciation.

缳.eEn: A loop or net. Formed from 糸, with 瞏 indicating the pronunciation.

辮.eEn: To interlace. Formed from 糸, with 辡 indicating the pronunciation.

結.eEn: To tie together. Formed from 糸, with 吉 indicating the pronunciation.
